examples.zh: 我們租了一艘小木船划過湖面。

examples.en: The fishermen returned to the shore with their fishing boat full.
examples.zh: 漁夫們帶著滿載的漁船返回岸邊。

examples.en: Taking a boat trip along the river is popular among tourists.
examples.zh: 搭乘小船沿河遊覽在遊客中非常受歡迎。

examples.en: Drinking plenty of water is essential for your body.
examples.zh: 多喝水對你的身體至關重要。

examples.en: He works out daily to build a strong physical body.
examples.zh: 他每天健身以鍛鍊強壯的身體。

examples.en: The car's body was damaged in the minor traffic accident.
examples.zh: 汽車的車身在輕微交通意外中受損。

examples.en: Please boil some water to make hot green tea.
examples.zh: 請燒開一些水來泡熱綠茶。

examples.en: Water begins to boil at one hundred degrees Celsius under normal pressure.
examples.zh: 在常壓下，水在攝氏一百度時開始沸騰。

examples.en: She boiled the fresh eggs for exactly ten minutes.
examples.zh: 她把新鮮雞蛋水煮了整整十分鐘。

examples.en: Bring the vegetable soup to a gentle boil on low heat.
examples.zh: 用小火將蔬菜湯煮至微沸。

examples.en: Turn down the stove when the pot reaches a rolling boil.
examples.zh: 當鍋子煮到大滾時，請把爐火調小。

examples.en: Keep the sauce at a slow boil while stirring constantly.
examples.zh: 邊持續攪拌，邊讓醬汁保持在慢火沸騰狀態。

examples.en: The dog buried a big bone in the backyard.
examples.zh: 這隻狗在後院埋了一根大骨頭。

examples.en: Eating dairy products helps build strong and healthy bones.
examples.zh: 食用乳製品有助於打造強壯健康的骨骼。

examples.en: He unfortunately broke a bone in his arm during soccer practice.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，他在足球練習時手臂骨折了。

examples.en: She spent the entire afternoon reading a mystery book.
examples.zh: 她花了一整個下午閱讀一本推理小說。

examples.en: Please return the borrowed books to the library on time.
examples.zh: 請按時將借來的書籍歸還給圖書館。

examples.en: He bought a new book for his English class.
examples.zh: 他買了一本英文課要用的新書。

examples.en: We should book a table at the restaurant in advance.
examples.zh: 我們應該提前預訂那家餐廳的座位。

examples.en: She booked two plane tickets to Japan for her vacation.
examples.zh: 她預訂了兩張去日本度假的機票。

examples.en: You can book your hotel room online in just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 你可以在幾分鐘內於線上預訂飯店房間。

examples.en: I bought a new English dictionary at the local bookstore.
examples.zh: 我在當地的書店買了一本新英文字典。

examples.en: The cozy bookstore sells both new and second-hand books.
examples.zh: 這家舒適的書店販售新書與二手書。

examples.en: We decided to meet outside the bookstore near the station.
examples.zh: 我們決定在車站附近的書店外會合。

examples.en: They had to show their passports at the international border.
examples.zh: 他們必須在國際邊境出示護照。

examples.en: She sewed a pretty lace border around the white tablecloth.
examples.zh: 她在白色桌布四周縫上了漂亮的蕾絲邊緣。

examples.en: Guards patrol the border day and night to maintain security.
examples.zh: 警衛日夜巡邏邊境以維持安全。

examples.en: France borders several European countries including Germany and Italy.
examples.zh: 法國與包括德國和義大利在內的幾個歐洲國家毗鄰。

examples.en: A beautiful flower garden borders the stone path.
examples.zh: 一座美麗的花園緊鄰著石子路。

examples.en: Her extreme confidence sometimes borders on arrogance in public.
examples.zh: 她極度自信在公開場合有時近乎傲慢。

examples.en: The children felt bored during the long rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 孩子們在漫長的雨天下午感到很無聊。

examples.en: I get bored when waiting in very long lines.
examples.zh: 當在排著很長的隊伍等待時，我會感到無聊。

examples.en: He was bored with reading the same news daily.
examples.zh: 他厭倦了每天閱讀相同的新聞。

examples.en: The speech was so boring that half the audience fell asleep.
examples.zh: 那場演講太無聊了，以致於半數聽眾都睡著了。

examples.en: I stopped reading the book because the story was boring.
examples.zh: 我停止閱讀那本書，因為故事太乏味了。

examples.en: Doing the same repetitive task every day can be very boring.
examples.zh: 每天重複做同一項任務可能會非常無聊。

examples.en: She was born in a small coastal town in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 她出生在台灣的一個沿海小鎮。

examples.en: He is a born leader who easily inspires other people.
examples.zh: 他是一個天生的領導者，很容易鼓舞他人。

examples.en: Many baby birds are born without any feathers at all.
examples.zh: 許多雛鳥出生時完全沒有羽毛。

examples.en: May I borrow your red pen for a second please?
examples.zh: 請問我可以借用一下你的紅筆嗎？

examples.en: Students can borrow up to five books from the library.
examples.zh: 學生最多可以從圖書館借五本書。

examples.en: He borrowed money from his bank to buy a car.
examples.zh: 他向銀行借錢買了一輛汽車。

examples.en: My boss called a short meeting early this morning.
examples.zh: 我的老闆今天一大早召開了一次短會。

examples.en: She presented her new marketing proposal to her boss.
examples.zh: 她向她的上司展示了新的行銷提案。

examples.en: He works hard to impress his boss at the company.
examples.zh: 他在公司努力工作以給上司留下深刻印象。

examples.en: Both students answered the teacher's question correctly.
examples.zh: 這兩名學生都正確回答了老師的問題。

examples.en: I like both dresses, so I cannot decide.
examples.zh: 這兩件洋裝我都喜歡，所以無法決定。

examples.en: Both sides signed the agreement this afternoon.
examples.zh: 雙方今天下午簽署了協定。

examples.en: Both of my parents are high school teachers.
examples.zh: 我的父母兩位都是高中教師。

examples.en: These shirts are nice, and I will take both.
examples.zh: 這些襯衫很棒，我兩件都要買。

examples.en: Both of us wanted to stay at home.
examples.zh: 我們兩個都想待在家裡。

examples.en: Please do not bother your father while he is working.
examples.zh: 父親工作時請不要打擾他。

examples.en: Loud noise from the street bothers the residents every night.
examples.zh: 街上的噪音每天晚上都打擾到居民。

examples.en: You do not need to bother cooking dinner for me tonight.
examples.zh: 你今晚不需要費心幫我做晚餐。

examples.en: I hope this extra work will not cause you any bother.
examples.zh: 我希望這項額外的工作不會給你帶來任何麻煩。

examples.en: Finding a parking space downtown is always a big bother.
examples.zh: 在市中心找車位總是一件大麻煩。

examples.en: Sorry for the bother, but I need your signature here.
examples.zh: 抱歉打擾了，但我需要你在這裡簽名。

examples.en: She drank a cold bottle of water after her long run.
examples.zh: 她長跑後喝了一瓶冰水。

examples.en: Please put the glass bottle into the green recycling bin.
examples.zh: 請將玻璃瓶放入綠色回收桶中。

examples.en: He opened a bottle of red wine for the dinner.
examples.zh: 他為晚餐開了一瓶紅酒。

examples.en: The factory bottles fresh spring water from the nearby mountain.
examples.zh: 這家工廠裝瓶來自附近山區的新鮮泉水。

examples.en: They bottle milk every morning and deliver it to houses.
examples.zh: 他們每天早上把牛奶裝瓶並送往各家戶。

examples.en: Don't bottle up your emotions when you feel stressed out.
examples.zh: 當你感到壓力大時，不要把情緒壓抑在心裡。

examples.en: Please sign your name at the bottom of the contract page.
examples.zh: 請在合約頁面的底部簽名。

examples.en: Sunlight cannot reach the bottom of the deep ocean.
examples.zh: 陽光無法照射到深海的海底。

examples.en: I found my lost key at the bottom of my heavy backpack.
examples.zh: 我在我沉重的背包底部找到了遺失的鑰匙。

examples.en: Performers bow to the audience after the show ends.
examples.zh: 表演者在表演結束後向觀眾鞠躬。

examples.en: In Japan, people often bow to show respect.
examples.zh: 在日本，人們常以鞠躬表示尊敬。

examples.en: He bowed his head to apologize for the mistake.
examples.zh: 他低頭鞠躬為這個錯誤道歉。

examples.en: The skilled archer pulled the string on a wooden bow.
examples.zh: 技術精湛的射手拉動了木弓上的弦。

examples.en: She tied a red silk bow on the gift box.
examples.zh: 她在禮物盒上繫了一個紅色的絲帶蝴蝶結。

examples.en: The actor made a deep bow before leaving the stage.
examples.zh: 演員在離開舞台前做了一個深深的鞠躬。

examples.en: She ate a warm bowl of soup on the cold evening.
examples.zh: 她在寒冷的晚上喝了一碗熱湯。

examples.en: Mix the flour and eggs together in a large wooden bowl.
examples.zh: 在大木碗裡把麵粉和雞蛋混合在一起。

examples.en: He poured fresh milk into the cereal bowl for breakfast.
examples.zh: 他倒了鮮奶進早餐麥片碗裡。

examples.en: Put all your old books inside this large cardboard box.
examples.zh: 把你所有的舊書放進這個大紙箱裡。

examples.en: She received a lovely box of chocolates for her birthday gift.
examples.zh: 她收到了漂亮的一盒巧克力作為生日禮物。

examples.en: Check the empty box if you agree with the terms above.
examples.zh: 如果你同意上述條款，請在空白方格內打勾。

examples.en: He likes to box at the gym to stay fit every evening.
examples.zh: 他喜歡每天晚上在健身房進行拳擊運動以保持健康。

examples.en: Workers box the manufactured products before sending them to stores.
examples.zh: 工人們在把製造好的產品送到商店前會進行裝箱。

examples.en: My brother learned to box at the sports center on weekends.
examples.zh: 我哥哥週末在運動中心學拳擊。

examples.en: The young boy kicked the soccer ball into the net cleanly.
examples.zh: 這個年輕男孩把足球乾淨俐落地踢進了球網裡。

examples.en: A polite boy held the heavy door open for an elderly lady.
examples.zh: 一個有禮貌的男孩為一位老婦人扶住沉重的門。

examples.en: He was just a boy when his family moved here.
examples.zh: 當他的家人搬到這裡時，他還只是一個少年。

examples.en: The human brain controls every action of the body.
examples.zh: 人類的大腦控制著身體的每一個動作。

examples.en: Getting enough sleep helps keep your brain healthy.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠有助於保持大腦健康。

examples.en: Solving puzzles daily is good training for the brain.
examples.zh: 每天解謎對大腦是很好的訓練。

examples.en: A small bird perched on the high tree branch.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥棲息在高高的樹枝上。

examples.en: Our bank opened a new branch in Taipei today.
examples.zh: 我們銀行今天在台北開了一家新分行。

examples.en: The company has branches in major cities worldwide.
examples.zh: 這家公司在全球主要城市設有分公司。

examples.en: This brand is famous for producing durable sports shoes.
examples.zh: 這個品牌以生產耐用運動鞋而聞名。

examples.en: They launched a new brand of organic fruit juice.
examples.zh: 他們推出了一個新的有機果汁品牌。

examples.en: Consumers trust this coffee brand for its high quality.
examples.zh: 消費者因為高品質而信任這個咖啡品牌。

examples.en: The brave firefighter saved the cat from the tree.
examples.zh: 勇敢的消防員從樹上救下了貓。

examples.en: It was brave of her to speak in public.
examples.zh: 她在公眾面前發言真的很勇敢。

examples.en: Brave firefighters saved many families from the burning building.
examples.zh: 勇敢的消防員從著火的大樓救出了許多家庭。

examples.en: Freshly baked bread smells wonderful when it comes out of the oven.
examples.zh: 新鮮烘焙的麵包剛出爐時聞起來太香了。

examples.en: She toasted two slices of white bread for her breakfast today.
examples.zh: 她今天烤了兩片白麵包作為她的早餐。

examples.en: We bought a warm loaf of whole wheat bread this morning.
examples.zh: 我們今天早上買了一條溫熱的全麥麵包。

examples.en: Be careful not to break the fragile glass vase on the table.
examples.zh: 小心不要打破桌上易碎的玻璃花瓶。

examples.en: He broke his arm while playing basketball with friends.
examples.zh: 他在和朋友打籃球時摔斷了手臂。

examples.en: Taking a short walk can break your long working routine.
examples.zh: 散散步可以打破你長時間工作的例行公事。

examples.en: Let's take a ten-minute coffee break before the next presentation.
examples.zh: 在下一場簡報前，我們來喝杯咖啡休息十分鐘吧。

examples.en: Students enjoy playing outside during their lunch break.
examples.zh: 學生們喜歡在午休時間到戶外玩耍。

examples.en: We took a short break to stretch our legs.
examples.zh: 我們休息了一下，伸展雙腿。

examples.en: Eating a healthy breakfast gives you energy for the morning.
examples.zh: 吃健康的早餐能給你早晨所需的活力。

examples.en: We had hot eggs and milk for breakfast today.
examples.zh: 我們今天早餐吃了熱雞蛋和牛奶。

examples.en: She cooked a delicious warm breakfast for her family.
examples.zh: 她為家人做了一頓美味溫暖的早餐。

examples.en: The old house was built with red bricks.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子是用紅磚建造的。

examples.en: He accidentally dropped a heavy brick on his foot.
examples.zh: 他不小心把一塊重磚頭砸在腳上。

examples.en: Workers are stacking bricks near the construction site.
examples.zh: 工人們正在工地附近堆疊磚塊。

examples.zh: 早上汽車緩慢地駛過長長的石橋。

examples.en: The city built a red bridge to connect two districts.
examples.zh: 這座城市建造了一座紅色的橋來連接兩個地區。

examples.en: We can see boats passing under the ancient river bridge.
examples.zh: 我們可以看到船隻從那座古老的河橋下通過。

examples.zh: 這項新計畫旨在彌合貧富之間的差距。

examples.zh: 學習語言有助於連結世界各地不同的文化。

examples.zh: 他們搭建了一個木製結構來跨越小溪。

examples.en: The manager gave a brief introduction before starting the meeting.
examples.zh: 經理在會議開始前做了簡短的介紹。

examples.en: We had a brief conversation at the coffee shop entrance.
examples.zh: 我們在咖啡廳入口處進行了短暫的交談。

examples.en: Please keep your report brief and to the point today.
examples.zh: 今天請讓你的報告保持簡短且切中要點。

examples.en: Sunlight made the whole living room look bright and warm today.
examples.zh: 陽光讓今天整間客廳看起來明亮又溫暖。

examples.en: She is a very bright student who learns new things quickly.
examples.zh: 她是一個學新事物很快的聰明學生。

examples.en: The artist used bright yellow paint to depict the morning sun.
examples.zh: 畫家使用鮮豔的黃色顏料來描繪朝陽。

examples.en: The young scientist came up with a brilliant idea for saving energy.
examples.zh: 這位年輕科學家想出了一個節省能源的絕妙點子。

examples.en: She gave a brilliant performance at the piano concert last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚在鋼琴音樂會上帶來了精彩的演出。

examples.en: The night sky was lit up by brilliant fireworks on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 跨年夜的夜空被燦爛的煙火照亮了。

examples.en: Please bring your umbrella because it might rain today.
examples.zh: 請帶你的雨傘，因為今天可能會下雨。

examples.en: The good news brought big smiles to their faces.
examples.zh: 這個好消息讓他們臉上露出了燦爛的笑容。

examples.en: Can you bring me a glass of water, please?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我拿一杯水過來嗎？

examples.en: The river becomes very broad as it reaches the sea.
examples.zh: 這條河流在接近入海口時變得非常寬闊。

examples.en: He has a broad knowledge of world history and art.
examples.zh: 他對世界歷史與藝術擁有廣泛的知識。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a broad overview of Taiwan's history.
examples.zh: 老師為我們概述了台灣歷史的大致脈絡。

examples.en: My older brother helps me with my math homework often.
examples.zh: 我哥哥經常幫我做數學作業。

examples.en: He played basketball with his younger brother in the park.
examples.zh: 他和弟弟在公園裡打籃球。

examples.en: Her brother works as a computer engineer at a big company.
examples.zh: 她的兄弟在一間大公司擔任電腦工程師。

examples.en: She wore a cozy brown coat on the chilly winter morning.
examples.zh: 她在寒冷的冬天早上穿了一件舒適的棕色外套。

examples.en: The cute little dog has brown fur and dark eyes.
examples.zh: 這隻可愛的小狗有著棕色的毛髮和深色的眼睛。

examples.en: They bought a comfortable brown leather sofa for their living room.
examples.zh: 他們為客廳買了一組舒適的棕色皮沙發。

examples.en: Brown is her favorite color for autumn clothes and shoes.
examples.zh: 棕色是她秋季衣服和鞋子的最愛顏色。

examples.en: The leaves changed from green to brown during the late fall.
examples.zh: 葉子在深秋時分從綠色變成了棕色。

examples.en: Mix red and green paint together to produce a warm brown.
examples.zh: 將紅色與綠色顏料混合在一起可調出溫暖的棕色。

examples.en: She used a soft brush to clean her shoes.
examples.zh: 她用軟刷清洗鞋子。

examples.en: The artist bought a new brush for painting.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家買了一支新的畫筆。

examples.en: Remember to wash the brush after using it.
examples.zh: 用完刷子後記得清洗。

examples.en: You should brush your teeth twice every day.
examples.zh: 你應該每天刷牙兩次。

examples.en: She brushed the jacket before hanging it up.
examples.zh: 她先把外套刷乾淨再掛起來。

examples.en: He brushed away the dust on the table.
examples.zh: 他刷掉了桌上的灰塵。

examples.en: A small green bug landed gently on the leaf.
examples.zh: 一隻綠色小蟲輕輕落在了樹葉上。

examples.en: The software developer spent hours fixing a tricky bug.
examples.zh: 軟體工程師花了數小時修復一個棘手的程式錯誤。

examples.en: I caught a stomach bug during my stay in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 我在台灣停留期間得了腸胃炎。

examples.en: The construction company will build a new hospital in this town.
examples.zh: 施工公司將在這個城鎮建造一座新醫院。

examples.en: It takes time and trust to build a strong friendship.
examples.zh: 建立堅固的友誼需要時間與信任。

examples.en: They built a birdhouse using wood and nails last weekend.
examples.zh: 上週末他們用木頭與釘子打造了一個鳥屋。

examples.en: The athlete has a strong and muscular build from training.
examples.zh: 這名運動員因為訓練而擁有強壯且肌肉發達的體型。

examples.en: He is a man of medium build with dark hair.
examples.zh: 他是一個中等身材、留著黑髮的男子。

examples.en: Her slim build makes her a very fast distance runner.
examples.zh: 她苗條的體型使她成為非常快速的長跑選手。

examples.en: That tall building is the highest office tower here.
examples.zh: 那棟高聳的建築物是這裡最高的辦公大樓。

examples.en: Workers are constructing a new apartment building nearby.
examples.zh: 工人們正在附近建造一棟新的公寓大樓。

examples.en: The historic building was renovated into a museum.
examples.zh: 這棟歷史悠久的建築物被翻新成了一座博物館。

examples.en: I bought a fresh pork bun for breakfast this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上買了一個新鮮的鮮肉包當早餐。

examples.zh: 她點了一個搭配柔軟芝麻麵包的漢堡。

examples.en: The teacher tied her hair back into a neat bun.
examples.zh: 老師把頭髮向後紮成一個整齊的髮髻。

examples.en: High housing costs create a heavy financial burden for young families.
examples.zh: 高昂的房價給年輕家庭帶來了沉重的財務負擔。

examples.en: Sharing your worries with good friends can lighten your emotional burden.
examples.zh: 與好朋友分享你的煩惱可以減輕你的情緒負擔。

examples.zh: 那隻老驢子馱著一大堆沉重的柴火上山。

examples.en: Please do not burden yourself with unnecessary guilt over the mistake.
examples.zh: 請不要因為這個錯誤而讓自己承受不必要的內疚負擔。

examples.zh: 過多的作業可能會加重本來就行程繁忙的學生的負擔。

examples.zh: 她的小生意失敗後，她背負了沉重的債務。

examples.zh: 乾柴會在炙熱的火爐中迅速燃燒。

examples.zh: 小心不要在火爐上燙傷手。

examples.zh: 強烈的陽光可以在幾分鐘內曬傷你的皮膚。

examples.zh: 立刻在輕微燙傷處沖冷水。

examples.zh: 醫生在她手上的燙傷處擦了一些藥膏。

examples.zh: 她在烤新鮮餅乾時受了輕微燙傷。

examples.zh: 水氣球砸到地面時爆裂了。

examples.zh: 聽到他傻傻的笑話後，她突然大笑起來。

examples.zh: 水管在寒冷的冬夜爆裂了。

examples.zh: 一陣突如其來的強光讓我們眼花了一秒鐘。

examples.zh: 她演講結束後，群眾爆出一陣掌聲。

examples.zh: 風暴期間我們聽到了巨大的雷聲。

examples.zh: 我每天早上七點半左右搭乘公車去上學。

examples.zh: 公車司機在車站小心停下讓乘客下車。

examples.zh: 市區觀光公車車站前有許多遊客在排隊。

examples.zh: 她決定開始自己的網路生意。

examples.zh: 許多小型企業在危機期間倒閉了。

examples.zh: 他上週去東京出差。

examples.zh: 這位成功的商人在東京擁有三家餐廳。

examples.en: The businessman often flies abroad to meet important clients.
examples.zh: 這位商人經常飛往國外會見重要客戶。

examples.en: My uncle is a hardworking businessman in the computer industry.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是電腦產業裡一位勤奮的企業家。

examples.en: The doctor is very busy with patients all morning.
examples.zh: 這位醫生整個上午都在忙著看病人。

examples.en: Friday afternoon is always the busiest time at work.
examples.zh: 星期五下午總是工作中最忙碌的時間。

examples.en: The main street was busy with shoppers and vehicles.
examples.zh: 這條大街上擠滿了購物者與車輛，十分繁忙。

examples.en: He studied hard, but he failed the exam.
examples.zh: 他努力讀書，但是考試沒通過。

examples.en: I wanted to go, but I was too tired.
examples.zh: 我想去，但我太累了。

examples.en: The coat is expensive, but it is high quality.
examples.zh: 這件大衣很貴，但品質很好。

examples.en: Everyone went to the party but John.
examples.zh: 除了約翰之外，大家都去參加派對了。

examples.en: There is nothing left in the fridge but water.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡除了水之外什麼都不剩。

examples.en: Nobody knew the answer but the teacher.
examples.zh: 除了老師之外，沒有人知道答案。

examples.en: She spread a thin layer of butter on her warm toast.
examples.zh: 她在溫熱的吐司上抹了一層薄薄的奶油。

examples.en: Melting butter in a hot pan is the first step of this recipe.
examples.zh: 在熱平底鍋中融化奶油是這道食譜的第一步。

examples.en: Baking these delicious cookies requires sugar, flour, and fresh butter.
examples.zh: 烘焙這些美味的餅乾需要糖、麵粉和新鮮奶油。

examples.en: A colorful butterfly landed gently on the fragrant garden rose.
examples.zh: 一隻色彩斑斕的蝴蝶輕輕停在芬芳的花園玫瑰上。

examples.en: We saw many beautiful butterflies fluttering in the sunny park.
examples.zh: 我們看到許多美麗的蝴蝶在陽光明媚的公園裡翩翩起舞。

examples.en: The life cycle of a butterfly includes several fascinating stages.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的生命週期包含幾個令人著迷的階段。

examples.en: A button fell off his shirt while playing sports.
examples.zh: 他在做運動時，襯衫上掉了一顆鈕扣。

examples.en: Press the red button to call the emergency center.
examples.zh: 按下紅色的按鈕來呼叫緊急中心。

examples.en: She sewed a new button onto her winter coat.
examples.zh: 她在她的冬天大衣上縫了一顆新鈕扣。

examples.en: I need to buy some fresh vegetables and fruits at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我需要去超市買一些新鮮蔬菜和水果。

examples.en: He saved money for six months to buy a new smartphone.
examples.zh: 他存了六個月的錢才買了一隻新智慧型手機。

examples.en: She bought a cup of hot coffee on her way to the office.
examples.zh: 她在去辦公室的路上買了一杯熱咖啡。

examples.en: She sat by the window and quietly read a novel all afternoon.
examples.zh: 她整個下午都坐在窗戶旁邊安靜地看小說。

examples.en: I usually go to work by subway to avoid morning traffic jams.
examples.zh: 我通常搭捷運上班，以避開早上的交通壅塞。

examples.en: Please make sure to finish your report by Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 請務必在星期五下午之前完成你的報告。

senses.zh: 在……旁邊；透過；搭乘；由；在……之前

examples.en: My mother bought a fresh head of cabbage at the market.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在市場買了一顆新鮮的高麗菜。

examples.en: We cooked stir-fried cabbage with garlic for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐煮了蒜炒高麗菜。

examples.en: Cabbage is a common vegetable in Taiwanese home cooking.
examples.zh: 高麗菜是台灣家庭料理中常見的蔬菜。

examples.en: The parrot chirped happily inside its large metal cage.
examples.zh: 這隻鸚鵡在牠的大鐵籠裡開心地叫著。

examples.en: Zoo keepers cleaned the tiger cage early in the morning.
examples.zh: 動物園管理員在大清早清潔老虎籠子。

examples.en: They opened the cage door to free the injured bird.
examples.zh: 他們打開籠門放走那隻受傷的鳥。

examples.en: My sister baked a delicious chocolate cake for my birthday.
examples.zh: 我姊姊為我的生日烤了一個美味的巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: Would you like a slice of strawberry cake with your tea?
examples.zh: 你想吃一片草莓蛋糕配茶嗎？

examples.en: The bakery decorates custom wedding cakes with fresh flowers.
examples.zh: 那家麵包店用鮮花裝飾客製化的結婚蛋糕。

examples.en: I hung a new scenic calendar on my home office wall.
examples.zh: 我在自家辦公室的牆上掛了一份新的風景日曆。

examples.en: Please check your calendar before booking the flight.
examples.zh: 訂機票前請先查看你的行事曆。

examples.en: She marked her birthday on the wall calendar with a star.
examples.zh: 她在牆上的日曆上用一顆星星標記了她的生日。

examples.en: I will call you as soon as I arrive at the station.
examples.zh: 我一到達車站就會打電話給你。

examples.en: The mother called her children to come inside for dinner.
examples.zh: 媽媽喊她的孩子們進來吃晚餐。

examples.en: Please call me Brad instead of my full name.
examples.zh: 請叫我布萊德，而不是我的全名。

examples.en: I received an important phone call from my doctor today.
examples.zh: 我今天接到了醫生打來的重要電話。

examples.en: We heard a strange bird call coming from the dense forest.
examples.zh: 我們聽到密林裡傳來奇怪的鳥鳴聲。

examples.en: It was a tough call, but we decided to cancel the trip.
examples.zh: 這是個艱難的決定，但我們決定取消行程。

examples.en: Please remain calm and follow the fire emergency instructions carefully.
examples.zh: 請保持冷靜並仔細遵循火災緊急指引。

examples.en: The sea was smooth and calm under the bright blue sky.
examples.zh: 在晴朗的藍天之下，大海平靜無波。

examples.en: Her voice sounded calm despite the stressful situation at work.
examples.zh: 儘管工作情況壓力很大，她的聲音聽起來依然平靜。

senses.zh: 冷靜的；平靜的；無風浪的

examples.en: Soft classical music helped calm the crying baby in the crib.
examples.zh: 柔和的古典樂幫助安撫了嬰兒床裡哭泣的嬰兒。

examples.en: Deep breathing exercises can calm your nerves before a public speech.
examples.zh: 深呼吸運動可以在公開演講前鎮定你的神經。

examples.en: The mother tried to calm her worried daughter with warm hugs.
examples.zh: 母親試著用溫暖的擁抱安撫憂心的女兒。

examples.en: A brief period of calm settled over the noisy classroom.
examples.zh: 短暫的平靜降臨在吵鬧的教室裡。

examples.en: Enjoy the quiet calm of the mountain air early in the morning.
examples.zh: 享受清晨山間空氣的寂靜安寧。

examples.en: The sea returned to calm after the storm passed.
examples.zh: 暴風雨離去後，大海恢復了平靜。

examples.en: The travelers rode camels across the hot and dusty desert.
examples.zh: 旅人們騎著駱駝穿越酷熱且塵土飛揚的沙漠。

examples.en: A camel can survive for many days without drinking water.
examples.zh: 駱駝可以在不喝水的情況下存活許多天。

examples.en: We saw a giant camel with two humps at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園裡看到一隻有兩個駝峰的巨型駱駝。

examples.en: He bought a new digital camera for his trip.
examples.zh: 他為旅行買了一台新的數位相機。

examples.en: Smile and look at the camera for the photo.
examples.zh: 微笑並看著相機拍照。

examples.en: The security camera recorded the whole incident.
examples.zh: 監視攝影機記錄下了整個事件。

examples.en: The children set up their tents at the camp.
examples.zh: 孩子們在營地搭起了他們的帳篷。

examples.en: My son is attending a science camp this summer.
examples.zh: 我兒子今年夏天要參加科學夏令營。

examples.en: We gathered around the fire at the camp.
examples.zh: 我們在營地的營火旁聚在一起。

examples.en: We decided to camp by the lake this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們決定這個週末在湖邊露營。

examples.en: They camped in the mountains for three days.
examples.zh: 他們在山裡露營了三天。

examples.en: It is fun to camp under the starry sky.
examples.zh: 在星空下露營很有趣。

examples.en: She can speak three languages fluently, including English and Japanese.
examples.zh: 她能流利地說三種語言，包括英語和日語。

examples.en: Can you help me move this heavy wooden desk to the corner?
examples.zh: 你能幫我把這張沉重的木桌搬到角落嗎？

examples.en: Students can borrow up to five books from the library each week.
examples.zh: 學生每週最多可以從圖書館借五本書。

examples.en: He opened a can of tomato soup for his quick lunch today.
examples.zh: 他今天打開了一罐番茄湯當作快速午餐。

examples.en: Please toss your empty soda can into the blue recycling bin.
examples.zh: 請將你喝完的汽水空罐扔進藍色回收桶。

examples.en: My mom bought several cans of tuna from the supermarket yesterday.
examples.zh: 我媽媽昨天在超市買了幾個鮪魚罐頭。

examples.en: They had to cancel the outdoor concert due to rain.
examples.zh: 因為下雨，他們不得不取消戶外音樂會。

examples.en: Please call the airline to cancel your flight reservation.
examples.zh: 請打電話給航空公司取消你的機位預訂。

examples.en: The manager decided to cancel the morning meeting.
examples.zh: 經理決定取消晨會。

examples.en: Doctors are working hard to find better treatments for cancer.
examples.zh: 醫生們正在努力尋找更好的癌症治療方法。

examples.en: Regular exercise can lower the risk of developing cancer.
examples.zh: 定期運動可以降低罹患癌症的風險。

examples.en: Her grandfather fought against cancer with great courage.
examples.zh: 她的祖父以極大的勇氣與癌症搏鬥。

examples.en: She blew out the candle on her birthday cake.
examples.zh: 她吹熄了生日蛋糕上的蠟燭。

examples.en: We lit a candle when the electricity went out yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天停電時，我們點燃了一根蠟燭。

examples.en: A small candle was burning softly on the wooden table.
examples.zh: 木桌上一根小蠟燭正微微燃燒著。

examples.en: He wore a red baseball cap to protect his eyes.
examples.zh: 他戴了一頂紅色的棒球帽來保護眼睛。

examples.en: Please screw the cap back onto the bottle after drinking.
examples.zh: 喝完水後請把蓋子旋回瓶子上。

examples.en: She put a warm woolen cap on her baby's head.
examples.zh: 她在她寶寶的頭上戴了一頂溫暖的毛線帽。

examples.en: The government decided to cap the price of gasoline this week.
examples.zh: 政府決定在本週限制汽油價格上限。

examples.en: Snow caps the high mountains throughout the cold winter season.
examples.zh: 整個寒冬季節，積雪覆蓋著高山之巔。

examples.en: He capped off his successful career with a grand award.
examples.zh: 他以一座隆重的獎項為他成功的職業生涯畫下句點。

examples.en: Taipei is the capital city and economic center of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台北是台灣的首都與經濟中心。

examples.en: The company needs more capital to expand its new business.
examples.zh: 這家公司需要更多資金來擴展新業務。

examples.en: Every sentence in English should begin with a capital letter.
examples.zh: 英文的每個句子都應該以大寫字母開頭。

examples.en: Please write your name in capital letters on this form.
examples.zh: 請在這張表單上用大寫字母寫下你的姓名。

examples.en: The city approved several major capital investment projects this year.
examples.zh: 這座城市今年核准了幾項重大的資本投資計畫。

examples.en: Remember that the word Monday always begins with a capital M.
examples.zh: 記得 Monday 這個字永遠以大寫的 M 開頭。

examples.en: My father bought a brand new red car last month.
examples.zh: 我父親上個月買了一輛全新的紅車。

examples.en: She parks her car inside the garage near the house.
examples.zh: 她把車停在房子附近的車庫裡。

examples.en: The train car was crowded with commuters during rush hour.
examples.zh: 尖峰時段火車車廂裡擠滿了通勤族。

examples.en: I sent my grandmother a birthday card last week.
examples.zh: 我上週寄了一張生日卡片給我的祖母。

examples.en: They gathered around the table to play a card game.
examples.zh: 他們聚集在桌子周圍玩紙牌遊戲。

examples.en: The businessman handed me his business card.
examples.zh: 那位商人遞給我他的名片。

examples.en: She really cares about the environment and plants trees every year.
examples.zh: 她真的很關心環境，每年都會種樹。

examples.en: My grandmother will care for our cat while we are on vacation.
examples.zh: 我們度假時，祖母會照顧我們的貓。

examples.en: I do not care which restaurant we go to for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 我不在乎我們今晚去哪家餐廳吃晚餐。

examples.en: You should take good care of your new bicycle.
examples.zh: 你應該好好照顧你的新腳踏車。

examples.en: Please handle this fragile glass vase with great care.
examples.zh: 請非常小心地拿這個易碎的玻璃花瓶。

examples.en: The nurses provided excellent care for all the patients.
examples.zh: 護理師們為所有病人提供了良好的照顧。

examples.en: Be careful when you walk on the slippery ice.
examples.zh: 在滑溜的冰上行走時要小心。

examples.en: She is a careful driver and never breaks speed limits.
examples.zh: 她是一位謹慎的駕駛，從不超速。

examples.en: Please make a careful check of your answers before turning them in.
examples.zh: 繳交答案之前，請仔細檢查一次。

examples.en: Rabbits love to eat crunchy raw carrot sticks.
examples.zh: 兔子喜歡吃爽脆的生胡蘿蔔條。

examples.en: She added chopped carrot to the rich vegetable soup.
examples.zh: 她在濃郁的蔬菜湯裡加入了切碎的胡蘿蔔。

examples.en: Eating fresh carrot is good for your eye health.
examples.zh: 吃新鮮胡蘿蔔對你的眼睛健康有好處。

examples.en: He helped his mother carry the heavy grocery bags.
examples.zh: 他幫媽媽提沉重的雜貨袋。

examples.en: Passengers are allowed to carry one bag onto the plane.
examples.zh: 乘客被允許攜帶一件包包上飛機。

examples.en: This small store does not carry imported goods.
examples.zh: 這家小店沒有販售進口商品。

examples.en: Children love watching this animated cartoon on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在星期六早上看這部卡通。

examples.en: The newspaper published a funny cartoon about daily life.
examples.zh: 這份報紙刊登了一幅關於日常生活的有趣漫畫。

examples.en: An artist drew a cartoon character on the birthday card.
examples.zh: 一位畫家在生日卡片上畫了一個卡通角色。

examples.en: In case of emergency, press the red button immediately.
examples.zh: 如果發生緊急情況，請立即按下紅鈕。

examples.en: The police are still investigating the theft case.
examples.zh: 警方仍在調查這起竊案。

examples.en: He put his glasses back into the protective case.
examples.zh: 他把眼鏡放回保護盒裡。

examples.en: Do you have enough cash to pay for the coffee?
examples.zh: 你有足夠的現金付咖啡錢嗎？

examples.en: The small store only accepts cash and no credit cards.
examples.zh: 這家小店只收現金，不接受信用卡。

examples.en: He withdrew some cash from the automatic teller machine.
examples.zh: 他從自動提款機領了一些現金。

examples.en: I went to the bank to cash my paycheck this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上去了銀行兌現我的薪水支票。

examples.en: You can cash the check at any branch of our bank.
examples.zh: 你可以在我們銀行的任何一家分行兌現這張支票。

examples.en: Can you cash this personal check for me right now?
examples.zh: 你現在能幫我把這張個人支票兌現嗎？

examples.en: The old castle stands on top of the steep hill.
examples.zh: 那座古老的城堡屹立在陡峭的山頂上。

examples.en: Many tourists visit the ancient castle every year.
examples.zh: 每年都有許多觀光客造訪那座古老的城堡。

examples.en: The king built a strong castle to protect his land.
examples.zh: 國王建造了一座堅固的城堡來保護他的領土。

examples.en: The sleeping cat curled up on the soft warm sofa.
examples.zh: 睡覺的貓咪捲縮在柔軟溫暖的沙發上。

examples.en: My cat loves to chase small rubber balls across room.
examples.zh: 我的貓喜歡在房間裡追逐橡皮小球。

examples.en: She adopted a homeless street cat from the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 她從動物收容所收養了一隻無家可歸的流浪貓。

examples.en: The young boy tried to catch the ball with one hand.
examples.zh: 那個年輕男孩試圖用單手接住球。

examples.en: We ran fast to catch the last bus back home.
examples.zh: 我們快速奔跑以趕上回家的末班公車。

examples.en: Put on a heavy jacket so you do not catch a cold.
examples.zh: 穿上厚外套，這樣你才不會感冒。

examples.en: He made a great catch near the end zone during the game.
examples.zh: 他在比賽期間於達陣區附近完成了一次精彩的接球。

examples.en: The fishermen brought back a large catch of fresh fish today.
examples.zh: 漁夫們今天帶回了大量捕獲的新鮮魚類。

examples.en: There must be a hidden catch behind this incredible special offer.
examples.zh: 這個不可思議的特別優惠背後一定有隱情。

examples.en: The police are investigating the primary cause of the accident.
examples.zh: 警方正在調查事故的主要原因。

examples.en: Heavy traffic was the main cause of his late arrival.
examples.zh: 嚴重塞車是他遲到的主要原因。

examples.en: They raised funds for a noble cause to help orphans.
examples.zh: 他們為幫助孤兒的高尚事業籌集資金。

examples.en: Strong winds caused severe damage to the wooden roof.
examples.zh: 強風對木製屋頂造成了嚴重損害。

examples.en: Eating too fast can cause uncomfortable stomach pain.
examples.zh: 吃太快可能會導致不舒服的胃痛。

examples.en: His careless mistake caused a long delay for the project.
examples.zh: 他的粗心錯誤導致專案大幅延誤。

examples.en: A beautiful crystal light hung from the high living room ceiling.
examples.zh: 一盞美麗的水晶燈掛在客廳高高的天花板上。

examples.en: Painters spent all afternoon painting the classroom ceiling bright white.
examples.zh: 油漆工花了一整個下午將教室的天花板粉刷成亮白色。

examples.en: The government placed a strict price ceiling on basic food supplies.
examples.zh: 政府對基本食品供應設定了嚴格的價格上限。

examples.en: We gathered to celebrate my grandmother's birthday.
examples.zh: 我們聚在一起慶祝我祖母的生日。

examples.en: The team celebrated their victory with a party.
examples.zh: 團隊舉辦派對慶祝他們的勝利。

examples.en: How do you usually celebrate the New Year?
examples.zh: 你通常如何慶祝新年？

examples.en: Red blood cells carry oxygen throughout the human body.
examples.zh: 紅血球在人體全身輸送氧氣。

examples.en: The prisoner was locked inside a small dark cell.
examples.zh: 犯人被關在一個黑暗的小牢房裡。

examples.en: Solar cells can turn sunlight into electricity for homes.
examples.zh: 太陽能電池能將陽光轉換成家用電力。

examples.en: She checked her cellphone for incoming messages during the break.
examples.zh: 她在休息時間檢查手機是否有新訊息。

examples.en: He dropped his new cellphone on the hard floor yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天把新手機掉到了堅硬的地板上。

examples.en: Please switch off your cellphone during the entire movie.
examples.zh: 請在整場電影放映期間關閉您的手機。

examples.en: One dollar is worth one hundred cents.
examples.zh: 一美元價值一百美分。

examples.en: The candy costs fifty cents at the corner shop.
examples.zh: 這顆糖果在街角小店售價五十美分。

examples.en: I don't have a single cent in my pocket.
examples.zh: 我口袋裡一毛錢也沒有。

examples.en: There is a large shopping mall in the center of town.
examples.zh: 鎮中心有一個大型購物中心。

examples.en: The community center offers free swimming classes for kids.
examples.zh: 社區中心為兒童提供免費的游泳課程。

examples.en: Place the flower vase right in the center of the table.
examples.zh: 把花瓶放在桌子的正中央。

examples.en: The discussion centered on how to improve customer service.
examples.zh: 討論集中在如何改善客戶服務上。

examples.en: Please center the title on the top of the cover page.
examples.zh: 請將標題置於封面頂部的中央。

examples.en: Her life centers around her family and her passion for music.
examples.zh: 她的生活圍繞著她的家庭以及對音樂的熱情。

examples.en: The seedling grew two centimeters higher in one week.
examples.zh: 幼苗在一週內長高了兩公分。

examples.en: Use a ruler to measure the line in centimeters.
examples.zh: 請用尺以公分來測量這條線。

examples.en: The box measures thirty centimeters long and twenty wide.
examples.zh: 這盒子長三十公分，寬二十公分。

examples.en: Our office is located in the central business district.
examples.zh: 我們的辦公室位於中央商業區。

examples.en: The central theme of the novel is forgiveness.
examples.zh: 這本小說的核心主題是原諒。

examples.en: Central heating keeps the entire building warm in winter.
examples.zh: 中央暖氣在冬天讓整棟建築物保持溫暖。

examples.en: This ancient castle was built in the sixteenth century.
examples.zh: 這座古老的城堡建於十六世紀。

examples.en: Technology has advanced significantly over the past century.
examples.zh: 科技在過去一個世紀中顯著進步。

examples.en: This old bridge has stood for more than a century.
examples.zh: 這座老橋已經屹立超過一個世紀了。

examples.en: I usually eat a bowl of cereal with fresh milk every morning.
examples.zh: 我通常每天早上吃一碗配新鮮牛奶的麥片。

examples.en: This chocolate cereal is very popular among young elementary students.
examples.zh: 這款巧克力麥片在國小低年級學生中非常受歡迎。

examples.en: Whole grain cereal is a healthy choice for breakfast.
examples.zh: 全穀麥片是早餐的健康選擇。

examples.en: I am certain that our team will win the match tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我確定我們的隊伍明天會贏得比賽。

examples.en: Certain animals hunt for food only during the dark night.
examples.zh: 某些動物只在黑夜裡獵食。

examples.en: Are you completely certain about the accuracy of these test figures?
examples.zh: 你對這些測試數據的準確性完全確定嗎？

examples.en: He locked his bicycle to the fence with a chain.
examples.zh: 他用鐵鏈把自行車鎖在圍籬上。

examples.en: A chain of events led to the sudden economic change.
examples.zh: 一連串事件導致了突然的經濟變化。

examples.en: She owns a successful chain of coffee shops.
examples.zh: 她擁有一家成功的連鎖咖啡店。

examples.en: The guard chained the heavy iron gate at night.
examples.zh: 警衛在晚上用鎖鏈鎖住了重鐵門。

examples.en: They chained the ladder to the wall for safety.
examples.zh: 為了安全起見，他們把梯子鎖在牆上。

examples.en: The boat was chained securely to the pier.
examples.zh: 船隻被牢牢地用鎖鏈繫在碼頭邊。

examples.en: He sat down on a comfortable wooden chair to read.
examples.zh: 他在一張舒適的木椅上坐下來閱讀。

examples.en: Please drag another chair over to the crowded dinner table.
examples.zh: 請拉另一張椅子到擁擠的餐桌旁。

examples.en: The office chair has adjustable height for better back support.
examples.zh: 這張辦公椅高度可調，以提供更好的背部支撐。

examples.en: The teacher wrote a sentence on the blackboard with white chalk.
examples.zh: 老師用白粉筆在黑板上寫了一個句子。

examples.en: Children drew colorful pictures on the sidewalk with bright chalk.
examples.zh: 孩子們用鮮豔的粉筆在人行道上畫彩色的圖畫。

examples.en: Please hand me a piece of yellow chalk for teaching.
examples.zh: 請遞給我一支黃色粉筆教學使用。

examples.en: Climbing the high mountain was a great physical challenge.
examples.zh: 攀登高山是一項巨大的體能挑戰。

examples.en: Learning a new language presents an exciting intellectual challenge.
examples.zh: 學習一門新語言帶來令人興奮的智慧挑戰。

examples.en: His theory faced a serious challenge from other scientists.
examples.zh: 他的理論面臨來自其他科學家的嚴肅質疑。

examples.en: He challenged his friend to a game of chess.
examples.zh: 他向朋友提出下棋的挑戰。

examples.en: The lawyer challenged the accuracy of the police witness statement.
examples.zh: 律師對警方的證人陳述準確性提出了質疑。

examples.en: The difficult math problem challenged even the smartest students.
examples.zh: 這道難題甚至考驗了最聰明的學生。

examples.en: This job interview is a great chance for him to advance his career.
examples.zh: 這次工作面試是他推進職涯的絕佳機會。

examples.en: There is a high chance of traffic jams during rush hour.
examples.zh: 尖峰時段很有可能發生交通塞車。

examples.en: I met my middle school classmate in Paris purely by chance.
examples.zh: 我在巴黎遇到國中同學純粹是機緣巧合。

examples.en: The weather can change quickly in the mountains.
examples.zh: 山上的天氣可能變化得很快。

examples.en: I need to change my clothes before going to dinner.
examples.zh: 去吃晚餐前，我需要換衣服。

examples.en: She changed her mind after talking with her family.
examples.zh: 與家人談過後，她改變了主意。

examples.en: The city has undergone a great change over the past decade.
examples.zh: 這座城市在過去十年中發生了巨大的變化。

examples.en: Here is your ticket and your change, sir.
examples.zh: 先生，這是您的車票和找您的零錢。

examples.en: Making small daily changes can improve your health over time.
examples.zh: 做出微小的日常改變，隨著時間推移能改善健康。

examples.en: He switched the TV channel to watch the morning news program.
examples.zh: 他轉台收看早間新聞節目。

examples.en: Ships carefully navigated through the narrow English Channel last night.
examples.zh: 船隻昨晚小心翼翼地航行通過狹窄的英吉利海峽。

examples.en: Social media provides an important channel for modern communication.
examples.zh: 社群媒體提供了現代通訊的重要管道。

examples.en: She decided to channel her energy into studying for exams.
examples.zh: 她決定把精力投注在準備考試上。

examples.en: The city built a long canal to channel water inland.
examples.zh: 這座城市興建了一條長運河將水引向內陸。

examples.en: The new program aims to channel more money into public schools.
examples.zh: 這項新計畫旨在將更多資金投入公立學校。

examples.en: Please read the third chapter of your textbook before class starts.
examples.zh: 上課前請閱讀你教科書的第三章。

examples.en: Graduating from high school marks the beginning of a new chapter.
examples.zh: 高中畢業標誌著人生新時期的開始。

examples.en: Each chapter in the novel ends with a suspenseful twist.
examples.zh: 小說中的每一章都以令人緊張的轉折收尾。

examples.en: Her honest character makes everyone trust her completely.
examples.zh: 她誠實的性格讓每個人都完全信任她。

examples.en: He played the main character in the high school play.
examples.zh: 他在這齣高中話劇中飾演主角。

examples.en: Learning Chinese characters requires a lot of daily writing practice.
examples.zh: 學習漢字需要大量的每日書寫練習。

examples.en: The hotel will charge extra fees for using the private parking space.
examples.zh: 使用飯店的私人停車位需要額外收費。

examples.en: Remember to charge your mobile phone before going out tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚出門前記得給你的手機充電。

examples.en: The police decided to charge the suspect with theft after investigation.
examples.zh: 警方經過調查後決定以竊盜罪控告嫌犯。

examples.en: There is no additional charge for delivering the books to your home.
examples.zh: 將書籍送到你家不需要支付額外費用。

examples.en: The experienced manager was put in charge of the marketing department.
examples.zh: 這位富經驗的經理被任命主管行銷部門。

examples.en: My laptop battery has a full charge and can last eight hours.
examples.zh: 我的筆記型電腦電池電量全滿，可以持續使用八小時。

examples.en: The teacher drew a pie chart on the board to show the results.
examples.zh: 老師在黑板上畫圓餅圖來展示結果。

examples.en: The captain checked the nautical chart before setting sail.
examples.zh: 船長在起航前檢查了航海圖。

examples.en: This sales chart shows a dramatic increase in revenue.
examples.zh: 這張銷售圖表顯示收益大幅增加。

examples.en: The doctor charted the patient's temperature every two hours.
examples.zh: 醫生每兩小時記錄一次病人的體溫。

examples.en: Scientists are trying to chart the deep ocean floor.
examples.zh: 科學家正試圖繪製深海的海底地圖。

examples.en: The team charted the progress of the project over six months.
examples.zh: 團隊記錄了該計畫六個月來的進度。

examples.en: The playful dog loves to chase colorful balls in the backyard.
examples.zh: 這隻貪玩的狗喜歡在後院追逐彩色的球。

examples.en: Police officers chased the thief down the busy narrow street.
examples.zh: 警官們沿著繁忙狹窄的街道追趕那名小偷。

examples.en: She encourages young students to chase their dreams with passion.
examples.zh: 她鼓勵年輕學生帶著熱情去追求自己的夢想。

examples.en: The cat gave chase when it saw a small mouse running.
examples.zh: 貓看到一隻小老鼠在跑時便展開了追趕。

examples.en: The action movie featured an exciting car chase through the city.
examples.zh: 這部動作片的特色是一場穿越市區、驚險刺激的飛車追逐。

examples.en: After a long chase, the police finally caught the dangerous suspect.
examples.zh: 經過一場漫長的追逐，警方終於逮到了那名危險的嫌犯。

examples.en: They bought cheap tickets for the late-night movie showing.
examples.zh: 他們買了深夜場電影的便宜門票。

examples.en: Eating at the school cafeteria is both healthy and cheap.
examples.zh: 在學校餐廳吃飯既健康又便宜。

examples.en: This shirt is made of cheap material that tears very easily.
examples.zh: 這件襯衫是用很容易破損的劣質布料做的。

examples.en: Never cheat on an exam during the school term.
examples.zh: 學期期間絕不能在考試中作弊。

examples.en: He was caught trying to cheat in the card game.
examples.zh: 他在紙牌遊戲中企圖欺騙時被抓到了。

examples.en: It is wrong to cheat customers out of money.
examples.zh: 詐騙顧客的錢是不對的。

examples.en: Nobody likes to play games with a cheat.
examples.zh: 沒有人喜歡和騙子一起玩遊戲。

examples.en: The coach called the rival team player a cheat.
examples.zh: 教練稱對手隊伍的球員為作弊者。

examples.en: He was known as a cheat in the market.
examples.zh: 他在市場上被公認為騙子。

examples.en: Please check your email inbox for the registration link now.
examples.zh: 現在請檢查你的電子郵件收件匣以取得註冊連結。

examples.en: Doctors check your temperature before you enter the clinic building.
examples.zh: 在你進入診所大樓前，醫師會檢查你的體溫。

examples.en: Remember to check off the completed tasks on your list.
examples.zh: 記得在清單上勾選已完成的任務。

examples.en: The mechanic performed a safety check on our family car.
examples.zh: 技師對我們的家用汽車進行了安全檢查。

examples.en: He wrote a check to pay for the furniture yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天開了一張支票付家具的錢。

examples.en: Excuse me, could we have the check for dinner, please?
examples.zh: 打擾一下，請幫我們結帳可以嗎？

examples.en: Thousands of excited fans cheered as the runner crossed the finish line.
examples.zh: 當跑者跨越終點線時，數千名興奮的球迷歡呼。

examples.en: We went to the stadium to cheer for our school team.
examples.zh: 我們去體育場為我們的校隊加油。

examples.en: Sending fresh flowers helped cheer her up while she was in the hospital.
examples.zh: 送鮮花在她住院期間幫她振作起心情。

examples.en: A loud cheer rose from the crowd when the team scored a goal.
examples.zh: 球隊進球時，人群中爆出一陣響亮的歡呼聲。

examples.en: The winning team returned home to cheers and loud applause.
examples.zh: 獲勝團隊在歡呼與熱烈掌聲中返家。

examples.en: The festive Christmas music brought cheer to the whole neighborhood.
examples.zh: 節慶聖誕音樂為整個社區帶來了喜悅。

examples.en: He loves to add extra cheese on his hot pizza.
examples.zh: 他喜歡在他的熱披薩上加額外的起司。

examples.en: French people enjoy eating various types of rich cheese daily.
examples.zh: 法國人喜歡每天食用各種豐富種類的乳酪。

examples.en: She melted some yellow cheese over the cooked pasta dish.
examples.zh: 她在煮好的義大利麵上融化了一些黃起司。

examples.en: Students conducted a chemical experiment in the lab.
examples.zh: 學生們在實驗室裡做了一個化學實驗。

examples.en: Wearing protective gear prevents exposure to harmful chemical substances.
examples.zh: 穿戴防護裝備可以防止接觸有害的化學物質。

examples.en: The factory processes raw materials through chemical reactions.
examples.zh: 這間工廠透過化學反應加工原料。

examples.en: Farmers should avoid using dangerous chemicals on crops.
examples.zh: 農夫應該避免在農作物上使用危險的化學物質。

examples.en: Store these household cleaning chemicals in a safe place.
examples.zh: 把這些家用清潔化學製品放在安全的地方。

examples.en: The lake was contaminated by industrial chemicals.
examples.zh: 這座湖泊受到了工業化學物質的污染。

examples.en: My grandfather taught me how to play chess when I was young.
examples.zh: 我祖父在我年輕時教我下西洋棋。

examples.en: They sat in the park and played a quiet game of chess.
examples.zh: 他們坐在公園裡下了一局平靜的西洋棋。

examples.en: She is the president of our high school chess club.
examples.zh: 她是我們高中西洋棋社的社長。

examples.en: The farmer feeds the chickens in the yard every morning.
examples.zh: 農夫每天早上在院子裡餵雞。

examples.en: We ordered crispy fried chicken for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 我們今晚點了酥脆的炸雞當晚餐。

examples.en: Grilled chicken salad is a popular choice for lunch.
examples.zh: 烤雞肉沙拉是午餐的熱門選擇。

examples.en: Unemployment is one of the chief issues facing the government.
examples.zh: 失業問題是政府面臨的主要議題之一。

examples.en: He was appointed as the chief executive officer of the company.
examples.zh: 他被任命為該公司的執行長。

examples.en: The chief reason for her success is continuous hard work.
examples.zh: 她成功的主要原因是持續不斷的努力。

examples.en: The police chief held a news conference about safety measures.
examples.zh: 警察局長就安全措施召開記者會。

examples.en: The tribal chief led the ceremony with deep solemn respect.
examples.zh: 部落首領懷著深深的莊嚴敬意主持典禮。

examples.en: He reported the progress directly to his department chief today.
examples.zh: 他今天直接向他的部門主管報告了進度。

examples.en: Every child needs a safe environment to grow up happily.
examples.zh: 每個小孩都需要一個安全的環境來快樂成長。

examples.en: She is an only child and has no brothers or sisters.
examples.zh: 她是獨生女，沒有兄弟姊妹。

examples.en: The young child fell asleep in her mother's gentle arms.
examples.zh: 這個小孩在她母親溫柔的懷抱中睡著了。

examples.en: He spent most of his childhood in a quiet seaside town.
examples.zh: 他的童年大部分時間都在一座安靜的海邊小鎮度過。

examples.en: Looking at old family photos brought back happy memories of childhood.
examples.zh: 翻看老家庭照片，勾起了許多童年的快樂回憶。

examples.en: She has been my best friend since early childhood.
examples.zh: 從幼年時期起，她就一直是我最好的朋友。

examples.en: Stop making childish excuses for your mistakes at work today.
examples.zh: 別再為你今天工作上的錯誤編造幼稚的藉口了。

examples.en: Throwing a tantrum is a very childish behavior for adults.
examples.zh: 對成年人來說發脾氣是一種非常孩子氣的行為。

examples.en: He gave a childish giggle when he saw the funny clown.
examples.zh: 當他看到搞笑的小丑時，發出了孩子氣的咯咯笑聲。

examples.en: He rested his chin on his hand while thinking deeply.
examples.zh: 他深思時把下巴靠在手上。

examples.en: She has a small dimple right on her chin.
examples.zh: 她的下巴正中央有一個小酒窩。

examples.en: The boxer received a heavy blow to the chin.
examples.zh: 那位拳擊手的下巴挨了一重擊。

examples.en: She carefully washed the valuable china after the dinner party.
examples.zh: 晚餐會結束後，她仔細洗了昂貴的瓷器。

examples.en: The museum exhibits fine china from the eighteenth century.
examples.zh: 這家博物館展出了十八世紀的精美瓷器。

examples.en: They received a set of delicate china as a wedding gift.
examples.zh: 他們收到了一套精美的陶瓷餐具作為結婚禮物。

examples.en: My sister loves to eat dark chocolate after every dinner.
examples.zh: 我妹妹喜歡在每頓晚餐後吃黑巧克力。

examples.en: She received a box of sweet chocolate on Valentine's Day.
examples.zh: 她在西洋情人節收到了一盒甜甜的巧克力。

examples.en: Hot chocolate is a wonderful drink on cold winter days.
examples.zh: 熱巧克力是寒冷冬日裡極棒的飲料。

examples.en: She baked a delicious chocolate cake for her brother's birthday.
examples.zh: 她為她兄弟的生日烤了一塊美味的巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: I ordered a cup of chocolate ice cream at the shop.
examples.zh: 我在商店點了一杯巧克力冰淇淋。

examples.en: The puppy has beautiful chocolate fur and bright dark eyes.
examples.zh: 這隻小狗擁有漂亮的深褐色毛髮和明亮的黑眼睛。

examples.en: Making the right career choice requires careful thought and research.
examples.zh: 做出正確的職業選擇需要仔細的思考與研究。

examples.en: The restaurant menu offers a wide choice of vegetarian dishes.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳的菜單提供了豐富的素食餐點選擇。

examples.en: You have no choice but to follow the safety rules here.
examples.zh: 除了遵守這裡的安全規定外，你別無選擇。

examples.en: You can choose any dessert from the bakery display.
examples.zh: 你可以從烘焙坊的展示櫃中選擇任何甜點。

examples.en: It was difficult to choose between two job offers.
examples.zh: 在兩份工作機會之間做出選擇很困難。

examples.en: She chose a red dress to wear to the birthday party.
examples.zh: 她挑選了一件紅洋裝穿去參加生日派對。

examples.en: Foreign tourists often practice how to use chopsticks when dining here.
examples.zh: 外國觀光客在本地用餐時經常練習如何使用筷子。

examples.en: She dropped one wooden chopstick on the floor by accident.
examples.zh: 她不小心把一根木筷子掉在地上。

examples.en: A pair of reusable chopsticks was provided with the lunch box.
examples.zh: 這盒便當隨附了一雙可重複使用的筷子。

examples.en: Many local residents attend church every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 許多當地居民每週日早晨都會去教堂禮拜。

examples.en: The old wooden church was built more than two hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 這座古老的木造教堂建於兩百多年前。

examples.en: They held a beautiful wedding ceremony in a small country church.
examples.zh: 他們在一座鄉間小教堂裡舉行了美好的婚禮。

examples.en: Draw a perfect circle on the paper with a compass.
examples.zh: 用圓規在紙上畫出一個完美的圓圈。

examples.en: She has a small circle of close friends from college.
examples.zh: 她有一小群大學時期的知心好友。

examples.en: The children sat in a large circle on the grass.
examples.zh: 孩子們在草地上圍坐成一個大圓圈。

examples.en: An eagle was circling high above the quiet green valley.
examples.zh: 一隻老鷹在寧靜的綠色山谷上空高高盤旋。

examples.en: Please circle the correct answer on the test paper.
examples.zh: 請在測驗卷上圈出正確答案。

examples.en: The satellite circles the Earth every ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 這顆衛星每九十分鐘繞地球一圈。

examples.en: New York is one of the largest cities in the world.
examples.zh: 紐約是世界上最大的城市之一。

examples.en: The public transit in this city is very convenient.
examples.zh: 這個城市的公共運輸非常方便。

examples.en: Many young people move to the city for better job opportunities.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人為了更好的工作機會搬到都市。

examples.en: He claims to know the secret behind that trick.
examples.zh: 他宣稱知道那個技巧背後的秘密。

examples.en: Passengers can claim lost luggage at counter number three.
examples.zh: 旅客可以在三號櫃檯認領遺失的行李。

examples.en: She claimed financial compensation after the car accident occurred.
examples.zh: 車禍發生後，她提出了賠償要求。

examples.en: His claim was backed up by official research evidence.
examples.zh: 他的主張得到了官方研究證據的支持。

examples.en: The insurance company processed her car accident claim quickly.
examples.zh: 保險公司迅速處理了她的車禍理賠申報。

examples.en: Scientists refuted the false medical claim in the news.
examples.zh: 科學家駁斥了新聞中錯誤的醫療主張。

examples.en: The audience began to clap at the end of performance.
examples.zh: 演出結束時觀眾開始拍手鼓掌。

examples.en: Children clapped their hands happily along with the music.
examples.zh: 孩子們跟著音樂開心拍手。

examples.en: Everyone clapped when she received the first place award.
examples.zh: 當她獲得第一名獎項時，每個人都鼓掌了。

examples.en: A loud clap of thunder shook the entire house.
examples.zh: 一聲響亮的雷鳴震動了整棟房屋。

examples.en: The teacher gave one clap, and the room fell quiet.
examples.zh: 老師拍了一下手，教室頓時安靜下來。

examples.en: He gave his friend an encouraging clap on the shoulder.
examples.zh: 他在朋友的肩膀上鼓勵地拍了一下。

examples.en: Our class has twenty-five students in total.
examples.zh: 我們班總共有二十五名學生。

examples.en: History class was canceled today because the teacher was ill.
examples.zh: 今天歷史課取消了，因為老師生病了。

examples.en: The museum attracts visitors from all social classes.
examples.zh: 這家博物館吸引了來自各個社會階級的訪客。

examples.en: This black dress is a classic example of elegant fashion.
examples.zh: 這件黑色洋裝是優雅時尚的經典範例。

examples.en: We watched a classic movie from the 1950s.
examples.zh: 我們觀看了一部 1950 年代的經典電影。

examples.en: He drives a restored classic sports car on weekends.
examples.zh: 他週末開著一輛修復的經典跑車。

examples.en: The novel is widely recognized as a timeless literary classic.
examples.zh: 這本小說被廣泛公認為永恆的文學經典名著。

examples.en: Pride and Prejudice is a romantic classic loved worldwide.
examples.zh: 《傲慢與偏見》是一部深受全球喜愛的浪漫經典作品。

examples.en: This symphony remains an enduring classic in music history.
examples.zh: 這首交響曲依然是音樂史上不朽的經典作品。

examples.en: My mother likes listening to classical music at night.
examples.zh: 我媽媽喜歡在晚上聽古典音樂。

examples.en: The theater staged a classical ballet performance last night.
examples.zh: 劇院昨晚上演了一場古典芭蕾舞演出。

examples.en: He studied classical Chinese literature at the local university.
examples.zh: 他在當地的大學學習中國古典文學。

examples.en: My classmate helped me solve the difficult math problem.
examples.zh: 我的同班同學幫我解決了這道數學難題。

examples.en: We planned a surprise birthday party for our classmate.
examples.zh: 我們為同班同學策劃了一個驚喜生日派對。

examples.en: She sits next to a new classmate in English class.
examples.zh: 英文課時，她坐在一位新同學旁邊。

examples.en: Make sure your hands are clean before eating your lunch.
examples.zh: 吃午餐前請確保你的雙手是乾淨的。

examples.en: The hotel room was very clean and well maintained.
examples.zh: 這間飯店房間非常乾淨且維護良好。

examples.en: Fresh air and clean water are basic human needs.
examples.zh: 新鮮空氣和乾淨的水是人類的基本需求。

examples.en: I usually clean my room every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我通常每週六早上打掃我的房間。

examples.en: Please clean the kitchen counter after preparing food.
examples.zh: 準備食物後請清潔廚房流理台。

examples.en: He cleaned his eyeglasses with a microfiber cloth.
examples.zh: 他用超細纖維布擦乾淨他的眼鏡。

examples.en: The teacher gave us clear instructions for the science project.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們這個科學專題清楚的說明。

examples.en: The weather is clear today, so we can go hiking in the mountains.
examples.zh: 今天天氣晴朗，所以我們可以去山上健行。

examples.en: The water in this mountain lake is clean and clear.
examples.zh: 這座高山湖泊的水非常乾淨且清澈。

examples.en: Please clear the dining table after you finish dinner.
examples.zh: 吃完晚餐後請清理餐桌。

examples.en: The police tried to clear the road so ambulances could pass.
examples.zh: 警方試圖清除道路障礙，好讓救護車通過。

examples.en: The fog cleared up gradually as the sun rose higher.
examples.zh: 隨著太陽升得更高，霧氣逐漸散去。

examples.en: The store clerk helped me find the right size for the shoes.
examples.zh: 店員幫我找到了合適尺寸的鞋子。

examples.en: She works as an office clerk in an international trading company.
examples.zh: 她在一間國際貿易公司擔任辦事員。

examples.en: The hotel clerk checked us in and gave us our room keys.
examples.zh: 飯店櫃檯人員為我們辦理入住，並給了我們房門鑰匙。

examples.en: The clever student found a simple way to solve the math puzzle.
examples.zh: 這個聰明的學生找到了一個簡單的方法來解決數學難題。

examples.en: He came up with a clever idea for the school science project.
examples.zh: 他為學校的科學專題想出了一個聰明的主意。

examples.en: It was clever of her to bring an extra umbrella.
examples.zh: 她多帶一把備用雨傘真是聰明。

examples.en: Click the link below to download the project file to your computer.
examples.zh: 點擊下方連結把專案檔案下載到你的電腦上。

examples.en: The door clicked shut behind him as he exited the office.
examples.zh: 他走出辦公室時，門在他身後喀噠一聲關上了。

examples.en: You must click twice on the icon to open the new software program.
examples.zh: 你必須在圖示上點兩下，才能開啟這個新的軟體程式。

examples.en: With just one click, you can order groceries online easily.
examples.zh: 只需點擊一下，你就可以輕鬆在線上訂購雜貨。

examples.en: She heard a quiet click when the seatbelt locked securely into place.
examples.zh: 當安全帶安全扣上時，她聽到了一聲輕微的喀噠聲。

examples.en: The mouse makes a sharp click every time you press the button.
examples.zh: 每次你按下按鈕，滑鼠都會發出清脆的喀噠聲。

examples.en: Taiwan has a humid subtropical climate with warm wet summers.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有潮濕的副熱帶氣候，夏季溫暖潮濕。

examples.en: Global climate change affects agricultural production and marine ecosystems.
examples.zh: 全球氣候變遷影響著農業生產與海洋生態系統。

examples.en: The economic climate has improved significantly over the past year.
examples.zh: 經濟景氣在過去一年有了顯著改善。

examples.en: The energetic monkeys climb trees very quickly in the wild.
examples.zh: 精力充沛的猴子在野生環境中爬樹非常快。

examples.en: We plan to climb the high mountain this coming weekend.
examples.zh: 我們計劃在這個即將到來的週末去爬那座高山。

examples.en: The room temperature began to climb steadily in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午房間的溫度開始穩定上升。

examples.en: It was a steep climb to reach the mountain top.
examples.zh: 到達山頂是一段陡峭的攀登歷程。

examples.en: After a long climb, they finally enjoyed the beautiful view.
examples.zh: 經過漫長的攀登，他們終於欣賞到了美麗的景色。

examples.en: The rapid climb in prices made housing very expensive here.
examples.zh: 物價的快速上漲使得這裡的住房非常昂貴。

examples.en: The wall clock in the living room strikes twelve times.
examples.zh: 客廳的壁鐘敲了十二下。

examples.en: I set my alarm clock for six thirty every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上把鬧鐘設定在六點半。

examples.en: The old clock on the tower tells the exact time.
examples.zh: 鐘樓上的老鐘指示著準確的時間。

examples.en: Workers must clock in before eight o'clock every morning.
examples.zh: 工人們每天早上八點前必須打卡上班。

examples.en: The runner clocked a new national record in the race.
examples.zh: 那位跑步選手在比賽中締造了新的全國紀錄。

examples.en: You need to clock out before leaving the office building.
examples.zh: 在離開辦公大樓之前你需要打卡下班。

examples.en: Please close the door behind you because it is getting cold.
examples.zh: 外面變冷了，請順手把門關上。

examples.en: The supermarket will close in fifteen minutes, so let us hurry.
examples.zh: 超市再過十五分鐘就要關門了，我們快一點吧。

examples.en: The store manager closed the shop early due to the typhoon.
examples.zh: 店經理因為颱風提早結束營業關店。

examples.en: They have been close friends since they attended high school together.
examples.zh: 他們自從一起上高中以來就一直是親密的朋友。

examples.en: Our new house is very close to the nearest subway station.
examples.zh: 我們的新家距離最近的捷運站非常靠近。

examples.en: Pay close attention to the safety rules explained by the teacher.
examples.zh: 密切注意老師所解釋的安全規則。

examples.en: The small dog walked close behind its owner along the street.
examples.zh: 那隻小狗沿著街道緊緊跟在主人後面走。

examples.en: Stand close together so everyone can fit inside the group photo.
examples.zh: 大家站近一點，這樣每個人才能拍進合照裡。

examples.en: She held her newborn baby close to keep him warm tonight.
examples.zh: 她把新生嬰兒緊緊抱在懷裡以保持溫暖。

examples.en: She used a wet cloth to wipe the dirty table.
examples.zh: 她用濕抹布把髒桌子擦乾淨。

examples.en: This elegant dress is made of high quality silk cloth.
examples.zh: 這件優雅的洋裝是由高品質的絲綢布料製成。

examples.en: Cut a small piece of cloth to repair the hole.
examples.zh: 剪一小塊布料來修補這個洞。

examples.en: She bought some comfortable clothes for her upcoming summer vacation.
examples.zh: 她為即將到來的暑假買了一些舒適的衣服。

examples.en: Please hang your clean clothes inside the bedroom closet nicely.
examples.zh: 請把你的乾淨衣服整齊地掛在臥室衣櫥裡。

examples.en: He changed into warm clothes after coming in from the rain.
examples.zh: 他從雨中進來後換上了溫暖的衣服。

examples.en: You should wear warm clothing when going outside in the winter.
examples.zh: 冬天出門時你應該穿著保暖的衣服。

examples.en: This store sells high-quality clothing for teenagers at reasonable prices.
examples.zh: 這家商店以合理的價格出售適合青少年的高品質服飾。

examples.en: Students packed their extra clothing in suitcases for the school trip.
examples.zh: 學生們把額外的衣服裝進行李箱準備校外教學。

examples.en: Dark clouds gathered in the sky before the storm started.
examples.zh: 暴風雨開始前，烏雲聚集在天空。

examples.en: The airplane flew high above the soft white clouds.
examples.zh: 飛機高高飛過柔軟的白雲之上。

examples.en: The sun was hidden behind a thick cloud all morning.
examples.zh: 整個早上太陽都躲在厚厚的雲層後面。

examples.en: It was a cool cloudy morning in early autumn.
examples.zh: 那是初秋一個涼爽的多雲早晨。

examples.en: The weather turns cloudy, so we might need umbrellas.
examples.zh: 天氣轉為陰天，所以我們可能需要雨傘。

examples.en: We could not see stars clearly through the cloudy sky.
examples.zh: 我們無法透過多雲的天空清晰看見星星。

examples.en: She joined the school photography club to learn creative camera skills.
examples.zh: 她加入了學校攝影社以學習創意的攝影技巧。

examples.en: Members of the fitness club can use the swimming pool anytime.
examples.zh: 健身俱樂部的會員可以隨時使用游泳池。

examples.en: The golfer chose a long club for his first shot.
examples.zh: 那位高爾夫球員為他的第一桿選了一支長球桿。

examples.en: They decided to club together to buy a gift for their teacher.
examples.zh: 他們決定合資一起買一份禮物給老師。

examples.en: We clubbed together to rent a bus for the school trip.
examples.zh: 我們合資租了一輛巴士辦校外旅行。

examples.en: Several small companies clubbed together to reduce high shipping costs.
examples.zh: 幾家小公司聯合起來以降低高昂的運輸成本。

examples.en: The old power plant burned coal to produce electricity.
examples.zh: 那座舊電廠燒煤炭來發電。

examples.en: Miners extracted coal from the deep underground mine.
examples.zh: 礦工們從深層地下礦坑開採煤炭。

examples.en: He threw another piece of coal onto the fire.
examples.zh: 他又扔了一塊煤炭到火堆裡。

examples.en: They drove along the beautiful west coast during vacation.
examples.zh: 他們在假期期間沿著美麗的西海岸開車。

examples.en: Lighthouses were built along the rocky coast to guide ships.
examples.zh: 岩石海岸沿線建有燈塔以引導船隻。

examples.en: Many tourists enjoy visiting the peaceful coast every summer.
examples.zh: 許多遊客每年夏天都喜歡造訪寧靜的海岸。

examples.en: The bicycle began to coast smoothly down the steep hill.
examples.zh: 自行車開始順暢地滑下陡峭的斜坡。

examples.en: The boat will coast into the harbor without its engine.
examples.zh: 船隻會在沒有引擎動力的情況下滑進港口。

examples.en: He managed to coast through the final round of tests.
examples.zh: 他成功輕鬆過關，順利通過最後一輪測試。

examples.en: You should wear a heavy coat in this freezing weather.
examples.zh: 在這種寒冷的天氣裡你應該穿件厚外套。

examples.en: She hung her red coat on the hook behind the door.
examples.zh: 她把她的紅色大衣掛在門後面的鉤子上。

examples.en: The dog has a shiny dark coat after a bath.
examples.zh: 那隻狗洗完澡後擁有光亮深色的毛皮。

examples.en: Coat the chicken pieces with flour before frying them in oil.
examples.zh: 在油炸雞肉塊之前，先給它們裹上一層麵粉。

examples.en: Dust coated all the old furniture in the abandoned wooden house.
examples.zh: 灰塵覆蓋了廢棄木屋裡所有的舊家具。

examples.en: Snow coated the roads during the cold winter night in the mountains.
examples.zh: 在山區寒冷的冬夜裡，積雪覆蓋了道路。

examples.en: She screamed when she spotted a big cockroach on the floor.
examples.zh: 當她看到地板上有隻大蟑螂時尖叫了起來。

examples.en: Cockroaches like to hide in warm, dark, and damp places.
examples.zh: 蟑螂喜歡躲在溫暖、陰暗又潮濕的地方。

examples.en: He used a special spray to get rid of cockroaches.
examples.zh: 他使用特殊的噴霧來驅除蟑螂。

examples.en: She drank a hot mug of cocoa on a winter evening.
examples.zh: 她在冬日夜晚喝了一馬克杯熱可可。

examples.en: Add two tablespoons of cocoa powder to the cake batter.
examples.zh: 在蛋糕麵糊中加入兩大匙可可粉。

examples.en: Hot cocoa with marshmallows is my favorite sweet drink.
examples.zh: 加了棉花糖的熱可可是我最喜歡的甜飲料。

examples.en: My dad drinks a cup of hot coffee every morning.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每天早上都會喝一杯熱咖啡。

examples.en: This coffee shop serves delicious homemade cakes.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡廳提供美味的手工蛋糕。

examples.en: Would you like some sugar or milk in your coffee?
examples.zh: 你的咖啡要加一些糖或牛奶嗎？

examples.en: He dropped a coin into the vending machine to buy a drink.
examples.zh: 他投了一枚硬幣到販賣機裡買飲料。

examples.en: I found a rare old coin in the garden.
examples.zh: 我在花園裡找到了一枚罕見的古老硬幣。

examples.en: She collected silver coins from many different countries.
examples.zh: 她收集了來自許多不同國家的銀幣。

examples.en: He ordered a glass of cold cola with ice cubes.
examples.zh: 他點了一杯加了冰塊的冰可樂。

examples.en: Drinking too much sugary cola is bad for teeth.
examples.zh: 喝太多含糖可樂對牙齒不好。

examples.en: She poured fizzy cola into a clean tall glass.
examples.zh: 她把有氣泡的可樂倒進一個乾淨的高玻璃杯裡。

examples.en: It is freezing cold outside so wear a heavy jacket.
examples.zh: 外面非常寒冷，所以請穿上一件厚外套。

examples.en: I prefer drinking cold water after running in the heat.
examples.zh: 在酷熱中跑步後，我偏好喝涼水。

examples.en: He gave me a cold response when I offered help.
examples.zh: 當我提供協助時，他給了我冷淡的回應。

examples.en: She stayed in bed because she caught a bad cold.
examples.zh: 她因為患了重感冒而躺在床上休息。

examples.en: Don't stand out in the cold without your coat.
examples.zh: 沒穿外套別站在寒風中。

examples.en: I have a cold, so I will stay home today.
examples.zh: 我感冒了，所以今天要待在家裡。

examples.en: He likes to collect old coins from different countries worldwide.
examples.zh: 他喜歡收集來自世界不同國家的舊硬幣。

examples.en: The teacher will collect the test papers at the end of class.
examples.zh: 老師將在下課時收取考卷。

examples.en: Dozens of volunteers came to collect trash along the beach.
examples.zh: 數十名志工前來撿拾海灘上的垃圾。

examples.en: My older sister plans to attend a famous college in North America next year.
examples.zh: 我姊姊計劃明年就讀北美一所著名的大學。

examples.en: He studied computer software engineering during his four memorable years in college.
examples.zh: 他在大學難忘的四年裡主修電腦軟體工程。

examples.en: The community college offers various evening courses for working adult students.
examples.zh: 這所社區學院為在職成年學生提供各種夜間課程。

examples.en: Fortunately, nobody was hurt in the traffic collision on the highway.
examples.zh: 所幸，在公路上的這起交通碰撞事故中沒有人受傷。

examples.en: Two bicycles had a minor collision at the corner of the street.
examples.zh: 兩輛腳踏車在街角發生了輕微碰撞。

examples.en: The sudden collision between the two ships caused severe damage.
examples.zh: 兩艘船之間突然發生的相撞造成了嚴重損壞。

examples.en: Bright yellow is my favorite color for spring and summer.
examples.zh: 亮黃色是我最喜歡的春夏顏色。

examples.en: The vibrant color of falling leaves turned the park red.
examples.zh: 落葉鮮豔的色彩將公園染成了紅色。

examples.en: She bought a box of paints with twelve distinct colors.
examples.zh: 她買了一盒包含十二種不同顏色的顏料。

examples.en: The girl loves to color pictures with crayons.
examples.zh: 女孩喜歡用蠟筆給圖畫著色。

examples.en: Sunsets color the evening sky in beautiful shades of orange.
examples.zh: 落日將傍晚的天空染成美麗的橘色調。

examples.en: He decided to color his hair brown before the interview.
examples.zh: 他決定在面試前把頭髮染成棕色。

examples.en: She used a fine wooden comb to untangle her hair.
examples.zh: 她用一把精緻的木梳來解開纏結的頭髮。

examples.en: Keep a small plastic comb inside your pocket while traveling.
examples.zh: 旅行時在口袋裡放一把小型塑膠梳子。

examples.en: He left his black comb on the bathroom marble sink.
examples.zh: 他把黑色梳子留在了浴室的大理石洗手台上。

examples.en: Please comb your hair neatly before going to school.
examples.zh: 去上學前請把頭髮梳理整齊。

examples.en: Police combed the forest for the missing child.
examples.zh: 警方搜遍森林尋找失蹤的孩子。

examples.en: She gently combs her dog's soft fur every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上都溫柔地梳理狗兒柔軟的毛。

examples.en: You need to combine flour, sugar, and eggs to make cake batter.
examples.zh: 你需要將麵粉、糖和雞蛋混合以製作蛋糕麵糊。

examples.en: The new phone app combines music streaming and social media features.
examples.zh: 這款新的手機應用程式結合了音樂串流和社群媒體功能。

examples.en: The two small companies decided to combine forces to expand markets.
examples.zh: 這兩家小公司決定合併力量以拓展市場。

examples.en: Please come to my birthday party this Saturday.
examples.zh: 這週六請來參加我的生日派對。

examples.en: The train will come in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 火車將在十分鐘內到達。

examples.en: New ideas often come when you are relaxing.
examples.zh: 新靈感常在你放鬆時出現。

examples.en: This leather sofa is very soft and comfortable to sit on.
examples.zh: 這張皮革沙發非常軟，坐起來很舒適。

examples.en: Wear comfortable shoes if you plan to walk all day.
examples.zh: 如果你打算走一整天的路，請穿舒適的鞋子。

examples.en: She felt relaxed and comfortable speaking with her close friend.
examples.zh: 與親密的朋友交談，她感到放鬆且自在。

examples.en: The boy loves reading a superhero comic after school.
examples.zh: 這個男孩喜歡放學後看超級英雄漫畫。

examples.en: She collects rare comic books from a local bookstore.
examples.zh: 她從當地書店收集稀有的漫畫書。

examples.en: This classic comic has been translated into twenty languages.
examples.zh: 這本經典漫畫已被翻譯成二十種語言。

examples.en: The actor is famous for his comic roles in movies.
examples.zh: 這名演員以電影中的喜劇角色聞名。

examples.en: His comic expressions made everyone in the room laugh aloud.
examples.zh: 他滑稽的表情讓房間裡的每個人都大笑起來。

examples.en: She enjoyed the comic atmosphere of local street theater.
examples.zh: 她很喜歡當地街頭劇場滑稽幽默的氛圍。

examples.en: The military soldiers obeyed the captain's direct command without any hesitation.
examples.zh: 士兵們毫不猶豫地服從了上尉的直接命令。

examples.en: She has an excellent command of spoken English after living abroad for years.
examples.zh: 在國外生活多年後，她精通英語口語。

examples.en: Type this command to restart the computer.
examples.zh: 輸入這個指令來重新啟動電腦。

examples.en: The experienced officer will command the police operations during the official parade.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的警官將在官方遊行期間指揮警務行動。

examples.en: He commands great respect from all his students due to his profound knowledge.
examples.zh: 由於他淵博的知識，他贏得了所有學生的極大尊重。

examples.en: The general commanded his troops to hold their defensive position until sunrise.
examples.zh: 將軍命令他的部隊守住防禦陣地直到日出。

examples.en: The street is located in the main commercial district.
examples.zh: 這條街道位於主要的商業區。

examples.en: The company launched a new commercial product last week.
examples.zh: 這間公司上週推出了一款新的商業產品。

examples.en: Commercial flights were delayed due to the heavy storm.
examples.zh: 商業航班因強烈風暴而延誤。

examples.en: A funny commercial played during the break in the match.
examples.zh: 球賽休息期間播放了一支有趣的廣告。

examples.en: The director filmed a TV commercial for a soft drink.
examples.zh: 導演為一款汽水拍攝了一支電視廣告。

examples.en: Viewers usually mute the TV when commercials start playing.
examples.zh: 電視廣告開始播放時，觀眾通常會開靜音。

examples.en: Colds are very common during the winter season.
examples.zh: 感冒在冬季非常常見。

examples.en: They discovered that they shared many common interests.
examples.zh: 他們發現彼此有許多共同興趣。

examples.en: It is common knowledge that water freezes at zero degrees.
examples.zh: 水在零度結冰是常識。

examples.en: She was hired by a major international software company.
examples.zh: 她獲一家大型國際軟體公司聘用。

examples.en: I enjoy the company of my close friends on weekends.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在週末享受知心朋友的陪伴。

examples.en: The company moved its headquarters to a new building.
examples.zh: 這家公司將總部搬遷至一棟新大樓。

examples.en: It is interesting to compare Taiwanese culture with Japanese culture.
examples.zh: 比較台灣文化與日本文化很有趣。

examples.en: You should compare prices before making such an expensive purchase.
examples.zh: 在購買這麼昂貴的東西之前，你應該先比較價格。

examples.en: Poets often compare love to a sweet rose in full bloom.
examples.zh: 詩人經常將愛情比擬為盛開的甜美玫瑰。

examples.en: We have a complete set of tools in the garage.
examples.zh: 我們車庫裡有一整套完整的工具。

examples.en: After months of hard work, the project is now complete.
examples.zh: 經過數月的努力工作，專案現在完成了。

examples.en: He gave a complete report on the financial situation.
examples.zh: 他對財務狀況提出了完整的報告。

examples.en: Students must complete the online test before Friday midnight.
examples.zh: 學生必須在週五午夜前完成線上測驗。

examples.en: She completed her master's degree in computer science last year.
examples.zh: 她去年完成了她的電腦科學碩士學位。

examples.en: The new bridge will be completed by the end of this month.
examples.zh: 新橋樑將在本月底前完工。

examples.en: The engine has a complex system of moving parts.
examples.zh: 這台引擎擁有一個複雜的運動零件系統。

examples.en: It was a complex problem that needed hours to solve.
examples.zh: 這是一個需要數小時才能解決的複雜問題。

examples.en: Her explanation made the complex subject much easier.
examples.zh: 她的解釋讓這個複雜的主題變得容易多了。

examples.en: The company moved into a modern office complex.
examples.zh: 該公司搬進了一棟現代化的辦公綜合大樓。

examples.en: A new sports complex is being constructed downtown.
examples.zh: 市中心正在興建一座新的體育綜合大樓。

examples.en: He developed an inferiority complex during middle school.
examples.zh: 他在國中時期產生了自卑情結。

examples.en: I need to buy a new computer for my university course.
examples.zh: 我需要為我的大學課程買一台新電腦。

examples.en: Our office computer system will be updated this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們辦公室的電腦系統將於本週末進行升級。

examples.en: He spends hours playing video games on his computer.
examples.zh: 他花了數小時在電腦上玩電子遊戲。

examples.en: The rising cost of fresh food is a growing concern for parents.
examples.zh: 新鮮食品價格上漲，讓家長們越來越擔心。

examples.en: Thank you for your sincere concern regarding my health condition this week.
examples.zh: 感謝你本週對我健康狀況的真誠關心。

examples.en: Environmental pollution has become a major concern for governments around the world.
examples.zh: 環境污染已成為世界各國政府關注的主要問題。

examples.en: The sudden increase in school absences concerns the primary school teacher deeply.
examples.zh: 學校缺席人數的突然增加讓這位國小老師深感不安。

examples.en: This upcoming policy change directly concerns all current employees in the office.
examples.zh: 即將發布的政策變更直接關係到辦公室的所有現職員工。

examples.en: Don't concern yourself with minor details when drafting your initial essay outline.
examples.zh: 在擬定初稿大綱時，不要過於操心微小的細節。

examples.en: The speaker will conclude the lecture with a quick summary.
examples.zh: 講者將會以簡短的總結結束這場講座。

examples.en: Scientists conclude that the test results are completely reliable.
examples.zh: 科學家得出結論，認為測試結果完全可靠。

examples.en: The two countries concluded a trade agreement last year.
examples.zh: 兩國去年締結了一項貿易協定。

examples.en: The vintage car is still in perfect condition.
examples.zh: 這輛古董車的車況依然完美。

examples.en: Good weather is a necessary condition for a successful hike.
examples.zh: 好天氣是成功健行的必要條件。

examples.en: Her medical condition improved after taking the medicine.
examples.zh: 服藥後，她的健康情形有所改善。

examples.en: He feels confident about passing the English speech contest tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他對通過明天的英語演講比賽感到很有信心。

examples.en: A confident smile can make a great impression during interviews.
examples.zh: 自信的微笑能在面試中留下極佳的印象。

examples.en: She is confident that her team will complete the project on time.
examples.zh: 她很有把握她的團隊會按時完成專案。

examples.en: The military conflict between the two nations caused great concern.
examples.zh: 兩國之間的軍事衝突引起了極大的關注。

examples.en: They resolved their interpersonal conflict through open and honest communication.
examples.zh: 他們透過公開且誠實的溝通解決了人際衝突。

examples.en: There is a conflict between my work and family schedules.
examples.zh: 我的工作與家庭時間表發生了衝突。

examples.en: His personal opinions conflict with the company's official policy.
examples.zh: 他的個人意見與公司的官方政策有所牴觸。

examples.en: The two scheduled events conflict with each other this Saturday.
examples.zh: 這兩個排定的活動在這個週六時間互相衝突。

examples.en: Her statements conflict with the evidence collected by the police.
examples.zh: 她的發言與警方收集到的證據相矛盾。

examples.en: We offered our warm congratulations to the newly married couple.
examples.zh: 我們向這對新婚夫妻獻上熱烈的祝賀。

examples.en: She received many messages of congratulation after passing her exam.
examples.zh: 她在通過考試後收到了許多恭喜訊息。

examples.en: Heartfelt congratulations on your promotion to senior marketing department manager.
examples.zh: 衷心恭喜你晉升為行銷部資深經理。

examples.en: There is a direct connection between diet and health.
examples.zh: 飲食與健康之間存在直接關係。

examples.en: My internet connection is very slow this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚我的網路連線非常慢。

examples.en: He missed his flight connection because of the delay.
examples.zh: 他因為班機延誤而錯過了轉機班次。

senses.zh: 連接；關係；網路連線；轉乘班次

examples.en: We should carefully consider all options before making a decision.
examples.zh: 我們在做決定之前應該仔細考慮所有選項。

examples.en: Many people consider him to be a very wise teacher.
examples.zh: 許多人認為他是一位非常聰明的老師。

examples.en: Please consider joining our school club this semester.
examples.zh: 這個學期請考慮加入我們的學校社團。

examples.en: After careful consideration, she decided to accept the job offer.
examples.zh: 經過仔細考慮後，她決定接受這份工作。

examples.en: She always shows consideration for her neighbors by keeping her music down.
examples.zh: 她總是把音樂音量調低，展現對鄰居的體貼。

examples.en: Cost is a major consideration when choosing a college dormitory.
examples.zh: 選擇大學宿舍時，費用是一個主要的考量。

examples.en: You should consult a doctor if the fever persists.
examples.zh: 如果持續發燒，你應該諮詢醫生。

examples.en: Before making a decision, I need to consult my team.
examples.zh: 在做出決定之前，我需要請教我的團隊。

examples.en: She consulted the dictionary to check the correct spelling.
examples.zh: 她查閱字典以確認正確的拼法。

examples.en: Please stay in contact with us while you are abroad.
examples.zh: 你在國外期間請與我們保持聯絡。

examples.en: Direct eye contact helps build trust during a job interview.
examples.zh: 在求職面試中，直接的眼神接觸有助於建立信任。

examples.en: She added her new colleague as a contact in her phone.
examples.zh: 她把新同事加為手機裡的聯絡人。

examples.en: You can contact our customer support team by email anytime.
examples.zh: 您可以隨時透過電子郵件聯絡我們的客戶支援團隊。

examples.en: The doctor will contact you as soon as test results arrive.
examples.zh: 一旦檢驗結果出來，醫生會立刻聯繫您。

examples.en: Please contact the front desk if you need extra towels.
examples.zh: 如果您需要額外的毛巾，請與櫃檯聯絡。

examples.en: This wooden box contains all of my old photos.
examples.zh: 這個木盒包含了我所有的舊照片。

examples.en: This bottle can contain up to two liters of water.
examples.zh: 這個瓶子最多可裝兩公升的水。

examples.en: Firefighters worked hard to contain the forest fire.
examples.zh: 消防員努力控制這場森林大火。

examples.en: Please continue your speech after the short break.
examples.zh: 短暫休息後，請繼續你的演講。

examples.en: Rain will continue throughout the rest of the week.
examples.zh: 這週接下來的日子都會持續下雨。

examples.en: The meeting will continue until five in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 會議將持續到下午五點。

examples.en: Both parties signed a formal contract for the project.
examples.zh: 雙方為該專案簽署了正式合約。

examples.en: Please read all terms in the contract before agreeing.
examples.zh: 同意前請閱讀合約中的所有條款。

examples.en: The employment contract is valid for two full years.
examples.zh: 這份僱用契約的效期為整整兩年。

examples.en: Metals expand when heated and contract when cooled down.
examples.zh: 金屬受熱時膨脹，冷卻時收縮。

examples.en: The company contracted a local firm to build offices.
examples.zh: 該公司與當地公司簽約來興建辦公室。

examples.en: Muscles contract automatically when you perform heavy lifting.
examples.zh: 當你進行重物提舉時，肌肉會自動收縮。

examples.en: The driver managed to control the car on the icy road.
examples.zh: 駕駛成功地在結冰的道路上控制住車輛。

examples.en: It is important to control your emotions during a heated debate.
examples.zh: 在激烈的辯論中控制好自己的情緒是很重要的。

examples.en: This simple remote device can control all the lights in the room.
examples.zh: 這個簡單的遙控裝置可以控制房間裡所有的燈。

examples.en: She lost control of her bicycle and fell into the grass.
examples.zh: 她失去了對自行車的控制而摔進草叢裡。

examples.en: The manager is currently in control of this major business project.
examples.zh: 經理目前掌握著這個重大商業專案的控制權。

examples.en: The remote control needs two new batteries to work properly again.
examples.zh: 遙控器需要兩顆新電池才能重新正常運作。

examples.en: Living near a subway station makes daily commuting very convenient.
examples.zh: 住在捷運站附近使每天通勤變得非常方便。

examples.en: Online shopping offers a fast and convenient way to buy goods.
examples.zh: 網路購物提供了一種快速且便利的購物管道。

examples.en: Please choose a time that is convenient for both of us to meet.
examples.zh: 請選擇一個我們雙方會面都方便的時間。

examples.en: We had a long conversation about future career plans.
examples.zh: 我們就未來的職涯規劃進行了一場長談。

examples.en: Listening carefully is essential for good daily conversation.
examples.zh: 仔細聆聽對於良好的日常交談至關重要。

examples.en: She started a friendly conversation with her new classmate.
examples.zh: 她與她的新同學展開了一場友善的對話。

examples.en: My mother likes to cook healthy meals for our family every day.
examples.zh: 我媽媽喜歡每天為我們家人烹煮健康的餐點。

examples.en: It takes about thirty minutes to cook this delicious vegetable soup.
examples.zh: 煮這道美味的蔬菜湯大約需要三十分鐘。

examples.en: He learned how to cook traditional Italian pasta from his grandfather.
examples.zh: 他向祖父學習如何烹調傳統的義大利麵。

examples.en: The head cook prepared a special dish for the honored guests.
examples.zh: 主廚為貴賓準備了一道特別的菜餚。

examples.en: He works as a professional cook in a popular local restaurant.
examples.zh: 他在一家熱門的在地餐廳擔任專業廚師。

examples.en: She is a talented cook who loves experimenting with new recipes.
examples.zh: 她是一位非常有天賦且喜歡嘗試新食譜的廚師。

examples.en: My grandmother baked fresh chocolate chip cookies for us.
examples.zh: 我祖母為我們烤了新鮮的巧克力片餅乾。

examples.en: He ate a crunchy cookie along with his afternoon tea.
examples.zh: 他配著下午茶吃了一片脆脆的餅乾。

examples.en: The boy asked if he could have another sweet cookie.
examples.zh: 那個男孩問他是否可以再吃一片甜餅乾。

examples.en: A cool autumn breeze blew gently through the open bedroom window.
examples.zh: 涼爽的秋風輕輕吹過開啟的臥室窗戶。

examples.en: He always stays cool and calm even under stressful work situations.
examples.zh: 即使在壓力很大的工作情況下，他總是保持沉著冷靜。

examples.en: That new electric sports car looks extremely cool and fast.
examples.zh: 那款新的電動跑車看起來非常酷炫且快速。

examples.en: Leave the freshly baked hot pie on the counter to cool down.
examples.zh: 把剛烤好的熱派放在檯面上冷卻一下。

examples.en: Drinking cold ice water will help cool you off after running.
examples.zh: 跑步過後喝冷冰水有助於幫你降溫。

examples.en: He took a deep breath to cool his angry temper down.
examples.zh: 他深呼吸一口氣以撫平憤怒的情緒。

examples.en: Please make a clear copy of this important document.
examples.zh: 請將這份重要文件印一份清晰的複本。

examples.en: I bought a rare copy of the classic novel today.
examples.zh: 我今天買了一本那部經典小說的珍本。

examples.en: Keep the original letter and send us a copy.
examples.zh: 保留信件正本，並寄給我們一份副本。

examples.en: Do not copy other students' work during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間切勿抄襲其他學生的作業。

examples.en: She copied the address carefully into her small notebook.
examples.zh: 她仔細地將地址抄寫進她的隨身筆記本裡。

examples.en: You can copy the files directly onto a flash drive.
examples.zh: 你可以直接把檔案複製到隨身碟上。

examples.en: We roasted some sweet corn on the grill during the barbecue.
examples.zh: 我們在烤肉時在烤架上烤了一些甜玉米。

examples.en: Farmers harvest fresh corn from the field in late summer.
examples.zh: 農夫在夏末從田裡收割新鮮玉米。

examples.en: Hot corn soup is my favorite warm dish on cold winter days.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬日裡，熱玉米濃湯是我最喜歡的溫暖料理。

examples.en: Meet me at the corner of the main street.
examples.zh: 在主幹道的轉角處跟我會合。
