examples.en: She placed a small desk in the corner of her bedroom.
examples.zh: 她在臥室的角落放了一張小書桌。

examples.en: The cat hid in the corner of the room.
examples.zh: 貓咪躲在房間的角落裡。

examples.en: Please make sure your email address is correct.
examples.zh: 請確保你的電子郵件地址是正確的。

examples.en: None of the students gave the correct answer to the question.
examples.zh: 沒有學生給出該問題的正確答案。

examples.en: Wearing a suit is the correct dress code for this event.
examples.zh: 穿著西裝是這場活動合適的穿著規範。

examples.en: The teacher spent two hours correcting our homework.
examples.zh: 老師花了兩個小時批改我們的作業。

examples.en: Please correct any spelling mistakes before printing the document.
examples.zh: 列印文件前請改正所有拼字錯誤。

examples.en: He politely corrected my pronunciation during our English lesson.
examples.zh: 在英文課上，他禮貌地糾正了我的發音。

examples.en: The new smartphone costs more than I expected to pay.
examples.zh: 這支新智慧型手機的花費比我預期的還要高。

examples.en: How much does a ticket to the concert cost?
examples.zh: 這場演唱會的門票需要花費多少錢？

examples.en: Careless mistakes can cost a company a lot of money.
examples.zh: 粗心的錯誤可能會讓一家公司付出昂貴代價。

examples.en: The total cost of the trip includes flights and hotels.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行的總費用包含了機票與飯店。

examples.en: They managed to reduce the production cost by ten percent.
examples.zh: 他們成功地將生產成本降低了百分之十。

examples.en: He saved his friend's life at the cost of his own health.
examples.zh: 他以付出自己健康為代價救了朋友的命。

examples.en: We bought a comfortable leather couch for the living room.
examples.zh: 我們為客廳買了一張舒適的皮長沙發。

examples.en: He fell asleep on the couch while watching television.
examples.zh: 他在看電視時在長沙發上睡著了。

examples.en: The dog loves to curl up on the soft couch.
examples.zh: 那隻狗喜歡蜷縮在柔軟的長沙發上。

examples.en: Can you count the number of students in the classroom?
examples.zh: 你能數一下教室裡有多少學生嗎？

examples.en: The young child can count from one to one hundred easily.
examples.zh: 這個幼童能輕鬆地從一數到一百。

examples.en: You can always count on me whenever you need support.
examples.zh: 每當你需要支持時，隨時可以依靠我。

examples.en: Keep an accurate count of all the items in stock.
examples.zh: 對庫存中的所有物品保持準確的計數。

examples.en: At the last count, over fifty people had registered.
examples.zh: 根據最後的統計，已有五十多人報名。

examples.en: After a quick count, we found twenty seats left.
examples.zh: 快速清點後，我們發現還剩二十個座位。

examples.en: Taiwan is a beautiful country with friendly people and great food.
examples.zh: 台灣是一個美麗的國家，擁有友善的人民和美味的食物。

examples.en: He traveled to many different countries during his summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他在暑假期間前往許多不同的國家旅行。

examples.en: They prefer living in the quiet country rather than the city.
examples.zh: 比起城市，他們更喜歡住在寧靜的鄉間。

examples.en: They love taking long bicycle rides through the peaceful countryside.
examples.zh: 他們喜歡騎著單車穿過寧靜的鄉村。

examples.en: The air in the countryside is clean and fresh compared to the city.
examples.zh: 與城市相比，鄉村的空氣乾淨又清新。

examples.en: Many people visit the countryside on weekends to enjoy the fresh air and nature.
examples.zh: 許多人在週末造訪郊外，享受新鮮空氣與大自然。

examples.en: The young couple walked hand in hand along the beach.
examples.zh: 這對年輕情侶手牽手走在海灘上。

examples.en: I will stay in Taipei for a couple of days.
examples.zh: 我會在台北待幾天。

examples.en: We bought a couple of books at the local bookstore.
examples.zh: 我們在當地的書店買了幾本書。

senses.zh: 一對夫妻；一對情侶；幾個

examples.en: It took a lot of courage to speak in public.
examples.zh: 公開演講需要很大的勇氣。

examples.en: She showed immense courage during the challenging recovery process.
examples.zh: 她在具挑戰性的康復過程中展現了巨大的勇氣。

examples.en: He gathered his courage and asked his boss for a raise.
examples.zh: 他鼓起勇氣向老闆要求加薪。

examples.en: I signed up for an online English grammar course this semester.
examples.zh: 我這學期報名了一門線上英文文法課程。

examples.en: The ship altered its course to avoid the approaching ocean storm.
examples.zh: 船隻改變了航線以避開逼近的海洋暴風雨。

examples.en: The waiter served the main course after we finished our soup.
examples.zh: 在我們喝完湯後，服務生端上了主菜。

examples.en: The judge entered the court and sat down quietly.
examples.zh: 法官進入法庭並安靜地坐下。

examples.en: We booked a basketball court for our school tournament.
examples.zh: 我們為學校錦標賽預訂了一座籃球場。

examples.en: Ancient kings welcomed foreign guests to their lavish court.
examples.zh: 古代國王在他們的奢華宮廷接待外國賓客。

examples.en: My cousin comes to visit us every summer holiday.
examples.zh: 我的表哥每個暑假都會前來拜訪我們。

examples.en: I sent a birthday gift to my cousin in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我寄了一份生日禮物給我台中的堂妹。

examples.en: We played board games with our cousins all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都和堂兄弟姊妹們玩桌遊。

examples.en: Snow began to cover the mountains late in the evening.
examples.zh: 傍晚時分，雪開始覆蓋山脈。

examples.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough or sneeze.
examples.zh: 咳嗽或打噴嚏時請遮住嘴巴。

examples.en: The textbook covers all important topics for the final examination.
examples.zh: 這本教科書涵蓋了期末考試的所有重要主題。

examples.en: The book has a colorful cover that attracts children easily.
examples.zh: 這本書有一個很容易吸引小孩的彩色封面。

examples.en: Put the cover back on the pot to keep the food warm.
examples.zh: 把蓋子放回鍋子上以保持食物溫暖。

examples.en: They sought cover under a tree during the heavy rainstorm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，他們在一棵樹下尋求遮蔽。

examples.en: The farmer milks the cow every morning.
examples.zh: 農夫每天早晨給乳牛擠奶。

examples.en: A brown cow was grazing peacefully in the field.
examples.zh: 一隻棕色的母牛在草地上平靜地吃草。

examples.en: Cows produce milk for people to drink.
examples.zh: 乳牛生產牛奶給人們飲用。

examples.en: The brave cowboy rode his horse across the wide ranch.
examples.zh: 英勇的牛仔騎著馬穿過遼闊的牧場。

examples.en: He wore a wide-brimmed cowboy hat and leather boots.
examples.zh: 他戴著一頂寬邊牛仔帽，穿著皮靴。

examples.en: Children watched a thrilling movie about cowboys in the West.
examples.zh: 孩子們看了一部關於西部牛仔的驚險電影。

examples.en: The child used a red crayon to color the apple on paper.
examples.zh: 小孩用紅蠟筆在紙上給蘋果塗色。

examples.en: Please put all your crayons back into the box when finished.
examples.zh: 畫完後請把所有蠟筆放回盒子裡。

examples.en: She drew a beautiful picture using colorful crayons in art class.
examples.zh: 她在美術課上用彩色蠟筆畫了一幅美麗的畫。

examples.en: It is crazy to drive so fast on an icy road.
examples.zh: 在結冰的道路上開這麼快真是太瘋狂了。

examples.en: My little brother is crazy about playing computer games.
examples.zh: 我弟弟對打電腦遊戲非常著迷。

examples.en: The crowd went crazy when the singer appeared on stage.
examples.zh: 當歌手出現在舞台上時，人群變得瘋狂起來。

examples.en: She added a spoonful of fresh cream to her coffee.
examples.zh: 她在咖啡裡加了一匙新鮮的鮮奶油。

examples.en: Apply this moisturizing cream to your face every single night.
examples.zh: 每天晚上塗抹這款保濕乳霜於臉上。

examples.en: Ice cream is my favorite sweet dessert during hot summer.
examples.zh: 冰淇淋是我在炎熱夏天最喜歡的甜點。

examples.en: The artist used bright colors to create a wonderful painting.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家使用鮮豔的顏色創作出一幅精彩的畫作。

examples.en: This new software helps users create professional websites very quickly.
examples.zh: 這款新軟體能幫助使用者非常快速地建立專業網站。

examples.en: Our primary goal is to create more job opportunities for students.
examples.zh: 我們的首要目標是為學生創造更多的工作機會。

examples.en: Police officers are working hard to prevent street crime in the city.
examples.zh: 警官們正努力防止城市中的街頭犯罪。

examples.en: Stealing money from others is considered a serious crime by law.
examples.zh: 偷竊他人的錢財在法律上被視為嚴重罪行。

examples.en: The crime rate dropped significantly over the past three years.
examples.zh: 過去三年間犯罪率顯著下降。

examples.en: The government took quick action to solve the economic crisis.
examples.zh: 政府採取迅速行動以解決經濟危機。

examples.en: Staying calm is essential when facing a sudden personal crisis.
examples.zh: 當面對突如其來的個人危機時，保持冷靜至關重要。

examples.en: The hospital faced a crisis when it ran out of beds during the flu season.
examples.zh: 這家醫院在流感季節病床不足時面臨了危機。

examples.en: Look both ways before you cross the busy street.
examples.zh: 穿越繁忙的街道前請先看左右兩邊。

examples.en: The bridge crosses a wide river near the mountains.
examples.zh: 這座橋跨越了靠山的一條寬廣河流。

examples.en: She crossed her legs while sitting on the chair.
examples.zh: 她坐在椅子上時雙腿交叉。

examples.en: There is a red cross on the front of the ambulance.
examples.zh: 救護車正面有一個紅十字符號。

examples.en: He wore a small silver cross around his neck.
examples.zh: 他戴了一條小的銀色十字架項鍊。

examples.en: Mark your answer with a cross in the box.
examples.zh: 在方格內畫個叉叉標記你的答案。

examples.en: Our teacher was cross because we forgot our homework.
examples.zh: 我們的老師很生氣，因為我們忘了帶作業。

examples.en: Please don't get cross with me for being late.
examples.zh: 請不要因為我遲到而對我生氣。

examples.en: She gave him a cross look and walked away.
examples.zh: 她生氣地看了他一眼後就走開了。

examples.en: A black crow landed silently on the wooden fence.
examples.zh: 一隻黑烏鴉安靜地停在木籬笆上。

examples.en: We heard a crow calling loudly from a tall pine tree.
examples.zh: 我們聽到一隻烏鴉在高聳的松樹上大聲叫喊。

examples.en: The clever crow used a stick to reach its food.
examples.zh: 這隻聰明的烏鴉用樹枝拿到了食物。

examples.en: A large crowd gathered around the street performer to watch the show.
examples.zh: 大批人群聚集在街頭藝人周圍觀看表演。

examples.en: The security officer pushed through the thick crowd to reach the gate.
examples.zh: 保全人員擠過擁擠的人群以抵達大門。

examples.en: The huge crowd cheered loudly when the singer appeared.
examples.zh: 歌手出現時，龐大的人群大聲歡呼。

examples.en: Many excited fans crowded into the stadium to watch the basketball game.
examples.zh: 許多興奮的球迷擠進體育場觀看籃球比賽。

examples.en: People crowded the narrow night market streets on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 星期五晚上，人們擠滿了狹窄的夜市街道。

examples.en: Do not crowd around the emergency exit during an evacuation practice.
examples.zh: 在疏散演習期間不要聚集在緊急出口附近。

examples.en: The baby started to cry when he felt hungry.
examples.zh: 寶寶感到餓的時候開始哭泣。

examples.en: She cried with joy when she passed the exam.
examples.zh: 她通過考試時高興得哭了。

examples.en: Someone cried for help from the burning building.
examples.zh: 有人從失火的大樓裡大聲呼救。

examples.en: We heard a loud cry from the backyard.
examples.zh: 我們聽到後院傳來一聲大喊。

examples.en: The mother comforted her baby after a long cry.
examples.zh: 媽媽在寶寶一陣長哭後安慰了他。

examples.en: A sudden cry broke the silence of the night.
examples.zh: 突如其來的喊叫聲打破了夜晚的寂靜。

examples.en: The festival is a major cultural event in our town.
examples.zh: 這場節慶活動是我們鎮上重大文化盛事。

examples.en: Traveling allows people to experience different cultural customs.
examples.zh: 旅行讓人們體驗不同的文化習俗。

examples.en: The museum protects valuable historical and cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 這間博物館保護著寶貴的歷史文化遺產。

examples.en: Learning about a new culture can open your eyes to the world.
examples.zh: 了解新文化可以拓寬你看世界的視野。

examples.en: Traditional culture plays an important role in shaping local customs.
examples.zh: 傳統文化在塑造在地習俗方面扮演重要角色。

examples.en: The city has a rich culture with many art museums.
examples.zh: 這座城市擁有豐富的文化，設有許多美術館。

examples.en: He drank a hot cup of tea to warm himself up.
examples.zh: 他喝了一杯熱茶來讓自己暖和起來。

examples.en: Add one cup of flour to the mixing bowl for the cake.
examples.zh: 在製作蛋糕的攪拌碗中加入一杯麵粉。

examples.en: The winner proudly raised the championship cup after the game.
examples.zh: 贏家在比賽後自豪地舉起了冠軍獎盃。

examples.en: She cupped her hands around her mouth and shouted for help.
examples.zh: 她用雙手罩住嘴巴並大聲呼救。

examples.en: He cupped the warm mug in his hands on the cold morning.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的早晨，他用雙手捧著溫熱的馬克杯。

examples.en: The mother cupped her child's soft face with gentle care.
examples.zh: 母親溫柔地用雙手捧起孩子柔嫩的臉龐。

examples.en: Scientists are working hard to cure rare tropical diseases.
examples.zh: 科學家正在努力治癒罕見的熱帶疾病。

examples.en: The medicine helped cure his sore throat in just a few days.
examples.zh: 這款藥物在短短幾天內幫他治癒了喉嚨痛。

examples.en: Doctors believe they can cure the boy's illness.
examples.zh: 醫生相信他們能治好這個男孩的病。

examples.en: Doctors hope to find an effective cure for the disease soon.
examples.zh: 醫生希望很快能找到該疾病的有效療法。

examples.en: Laughter is often called the best cure for stress.
examples.zh: 笑聲經常被稱為減壓的最佳良藥。

examples.en: There is currently no simple cure for the common cold.
examples.zh: 目前對於普通感冒並沒有簡單的治癒方法。

examples.en: The curious child asked many questions about the natural world.
examples.zh: 那個好奇的孩子問了許多關於自然界的問題。

examples.en: Cats are naturally curious animals that like to explore.
examples.zh: 貓天生就是喜歡探索的好奇動物。

examples.en: I am curious to know what will happen next.
examples.zh: 我很好奇接下來會發生什麼事。

examples.en: What is your current address and phone number?
examples.zh: 你目前的地址和電話號碼是什麼？

examples.en: Under current rules, visitors must register at the desk.
examples.zh: 根據現行規定，訪客必須在櫃檯登記。

examples.en: The current economic situation presents several difficult challenges.
examples.zh: 目前的經濟狀況帶來了幾個艱難的挑戰。

examples.en: The strong ocean current carried the boat away.
examples.zh: 強勁的海流把船隻帶走了。

examples.en: An electric current flows through the copper wires.
examples.zh: 電流穿過這些銅線。

examples.en: There is a strong current of opinion against the proposal.
examples.zh: 有一股反對該提案的強烈輿論趨勢。

examples.en: She pulled the curtain open to let the sunlight in.
examples.zh: 她拉開窗簾讓陽光透進來。

examples.en: The blue curtain matches the bedroom wall perfectly.
examples.zh: 藍色的窗簾和臥室的牆壁完美搭配。

examples.en: The red curtain rose as the stage play started.
examples.zh: 舞台劇開始時，紅色的帷幕升起了。

examples.en: It is a local custom to remove shoes before entering.
examples.zh: 進門前脫鞋是當地的習俗。

examples.en: We passed through customs smoothly at the international airport.
examples.zh: 我們在國際機場順利通過了海關。

examples.en: Every culture has its own unique customs and traditional holidays.
examples.zh: 每一種文化都有其獨特的習俗與傳統節日。

examples.en: He ordered a custom suit for his wedding ceremony.
examples.zh: 他為自己的婚禮訂製了一套西裝。

examples.en: The shop sells custom wooden furniture made by skilled workers.
examples.zh: 這家店販售由技術精湛的工匠製作的訂製木製家具。

examples.en: She received a custom necklace with her name carved on it.
examples.zh: 她收到了一條刻有她名字的客製化項鍊。

examples.en: The friendly shop owner greeted every customer with a smile.
examples.zh: 友善的店主笑臉迎人地招呼每一位顧客。

examples.en: Our primary goal is to improve customer satisfaction this year.
examples.zh: 我們今年的首要目標是提升客戶滿意度。

examples.en: A satisfied customer is likely to recommend our shop to friends.
examples.zh: 一位滿意的顧客很有可能會向朋友推薦我們的店家。

examples.en: She used sharp scissors to cut the colorful paper sheet.
examples.zh: 她用鋒利的剪刀剪彩色的紙張。

examples.en: He cut his finger while chopping vegetables for dinner yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天切菜做晚餐時弄傷了手指。

examples.en: The store manager decided to cut prices on all items.
examples.zh: 店長決定降價出售所有商品。

examples.en: Clean the small cut on your hand with soap and water.
examples.zh: 用肥皂水清洗你手上的小傷口。

examples.en: The doctor applied a bandage over the deep cut carefully.
examples.zh: 醫生小心翼翼地在深傷口上貼上繃帶。

examples.en: There was a sudden cut in the power supply last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚電力供應突然中斷了。

examples.en: The fluffy little kitten looked very cute playing with yarn.
examples.zh: 這隻毛茸茸的小貓玩著毛線球時看起來非常可愛。

examples.en: She bought a cute pencil case for her daughter's school.
examples.zh: 她為女兒上學買了一個可愛的鉛筆盒。

examples.en: That cute baby smiled brightly at everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 那個可愛的嬰兒對著房間裡的每個人燦爛地微笑。

examples.en: Water goes through a natural cycle in the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 水在大氣中經歷自然的循環。

examples.en: The life cycle of a butterfly is very fascinating.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的生命週期非常吸引人。

examples.en: He rides his cycle to school every sunny morning.
examples.zh: 他每個晴朗的早上都騎自行車去上學。

examples.en: We like to cycle along the river park on weekends.
examples.zh: 我們喜歡在週末沿著河濱公園騎自行車。

examples.en: Nutrients cycle through the forest soil and trees continuously.
examples.zh: 養分不斷地在森林土壤和樹木之間循環。

examples.en: She cycled five miles to reach the beach yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天騎了五英里的自行車到達海灘。

examples.en: Regular exercise is an important part of a daily routine.
examples.zh: 規律運動是每日例行公事的重要部分。

examples.en: Reading the daily newspaper helps him stay informed on world news.
examples.zh: 閱讀每日報紙有助於他了解世界新聞。

examples.en: She keeps a daily record of her meals and calorie intake.
examples.zh: 她記錄每日餐點與熱量攝取。

examples.en: The bus leaves for the city center twice daily.
examples.zh: 前往市中心的公車每天發車兩次。

examples.en: She waters the flowers in her garden daily.
examples.zh: 她每天替花園裡的花澆水。

examples.en: Prices at the local fish market change daily depending on supply.
examples.zh: 當地魚市場的價格每日根據供應量而變化。

examples.en: He subscribes to a popular daily to keep up with the news.
examples.zh: 他訂閱了一份熱門日報來掌握新聞動態。

examples.en: The local daily reported on our school's victory in the basketball tournament.
examples.zh: 當地的日報報導了我們學校在籃球錦標賽中獲勝的消息。

examples.en: She placed an advertisement in the daily to sell her car.
examples.zh: 她在日報上刊登廣告出售她的汽車。

examples.en: The heavy storm caused severe damage to many seaside homes.
examples.zh: 強烈的暴風雨對許多海邊住宅造成了嚴重的損害。

examples.en: Smoking causes permanent damage to your lungs and overall health.
examples.zh: 抽菸對你的肺部和整體健康會造成永久的傷害。

examples.en: The company repaired the damage done to the car.
examples.zh: 公司修復了汽車所受到的損壞。

examples.en: Strong UV rays can damage your skin during the summer.
examples.zh: 強烈的紫外線會在夏天傷害你的皮膚。

examples.en: Careless handling might damage the fragile glassware inside the box.
examples.zh: 不小心處理可能會損壞箱子裡易碎的玻璃器皿。

examples.en: The flood waters threatened to damage the historical town center.
examples.zh: 洪水威脅著要損壞歷史悠久的小鎮中心。

examples.en: They love to dance to energetic music on Friday nights.
examples.zh: 他們喜歡在週五晚上跟著有活力的音樂跳舞。

examples.en: She learned how to dance ballet when she was very young.
examples.zh: 她很年輕時就學過如何跳芭蕾舞。

examples.en: The yellow leaves dance gracefully in the cool autumn wind.
examples.zh: 黃葉在涼爽的秋風中優雅地翩翩起舞。

examples.en: The annual school dance will be held in the big gymnasium.
examples.zh: 一年一度的校園舞會將在大體育館舉行。

examples.en: She showed us a beautiful traditional dance from her home country.
examples.zh: 她向我們展示了來自她家鄉的優美傳統舞蹈。

examples.en: Learning this classic dance step takes a lot of patient practice.
examples.zh: 學習這個經典舞步需要大量耐心的練習。

examples.en: The talented dancer performed gracefully on the stage.
examples.zh: 這位有天賦的舞者在舞台上優雅地表演。

examples.en: She has trained hard to become a professional ballet dancer.
examples.zh: 她努力訓練以成為一名專業的芭蕾舞者。

examples.en: A group of street dancers attracted a huge crowd yesterday.
examples.zh: 一群街舞舞者昨天吸引了大批人群。

examples.en: The warning sign alerts visitors to the potential danger of falling rocks.
examples.zh: 警告標示提醒遊客注意落石的潛在危險。

examples.en: Firefighters face immense physical danger every time they answer a fire emergency call.
examples.zh: 消防員每次出動執行火警任務時，都面臨著巨大的身體危險。

examples.en: Many rare animals are in danger of dying out.
examples.zh: 許多稀有動物正面臨滅絕的危險。

examples.en: It is dangerous to swim in the ocean during a typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風期間在海洋裡游泳是危險的。

examples.en: Driving at high speed on slippery roads is extremely dangerous.
examples.zh: 在濕滑的道路上高速行駛極其危險。

examples.en: Wild animals can become dangerous if they feel trapped or threatened.
examples.zh: 野生動物如果感到受困或受威脅，可能會變得危險。

examples.en: It gets dark early in the evening during winter.
examples.zh: 冬季傍晚天黑得早。

examples.en: She wore a dark blue suit to the job interview.
examples.zh: 她穿了一套深藍色套裝去參加求職面試。

examples.en: The room was dark until he switched on the lamp.
examples.zh: 在開燈之前，房間裡一片黑暗。

examples.en: Children are sometimes afraid of the dark.
examples.zh: 小孩有時會害怕黑暗。

examples.en: We should try to reach the campsite before dark.
examples.zh: 我們應該嘗試天黑前到達營地。

examples.en: He sat alone in the dark listening to music.
examples.zh: 他獨自坐在黑暗中聽音樂。

examples.en: The research team collected valuable data from their field study.
examples.zh: 研究團隊從他們的田野調查中收集了寶貴的資料。

examples.en: We need to analyze the sales data before making a decision.
examples.zh: 我們需要在做決定前分析銷售數據。

examples.en: All sensitive customer data is stored securely on cloud servers.
examples.zh: 所有敏感的客戶資料都安全地儲存在雲端伺服器中。

examples.en: What is the exact date of your graduation ceremony?
examples.zh: 你畢業典禮的確切日期是什麼時候？

examples.en: He took her out on a romantic date by the river.
examples.zh: 他帶她去河邊進行了一次浪漫的約會。

examples.en: Dried dates are often used as a natural sweetener in desserts.
examples.zh: 椰棗乾常在甜點中用作天然甜味劑。

examples.en: They have been dating for two years and plan to marry.
examples.zh: 他們已經交往約會兩年，並計劃結婚。

examples.en: Remember to date the document before signing your name.
examples.zh: 簽名前請記得在文件上記錄日期。

examples.en: The letter was dated March the tenth.
examples.zh: 這封信的日期註明為三月十日。

examples.en: They have a young daughter who loves to play soccer.
examples.zh: 他們有一個喜歡踢足球的年幼女兒。

examples.en: His daughter is studying computer science at a university.
examples.zh: 他的女兒正在大學攻讀資訊工程。

examples.en: She proudly showed everyone a photo of her daughter.
examples.zh: 她自豪地向大家展示她女兒的照片。

examples.en: I work eight hours a day from Monday to Friday.
examples.zh: 我從週一到週五每天工作八小時。

examples.en: It was a sunny day, so we went to the beach.
examples.zh: 那天是個晴天，所以我們去了海灘。

examples.en: Owls sleep during the day and hunt at night.
examples.zh: 貓頭鷹在白天睡覺，在夜晚獵食。

examples.en: The winter frost left all flowers in the garden dead.
examples.zh: 冬天的霜凍讓花園裡所有的花朵都枯萎死亡了。

examples.en: My cellphone battery is dead so I cannot call.
examples.zh: 我的手機電池沒電失效了，所以我無法打電話。

examples.en: The street was completely dead late on Sunday night.
examples.zh: 週日深夜這條街道完全沒有生氣。

examples.en: The deaf student uses sign language to communicate.
examples.zh: 這位聽障學生使用手語交流。

examples.en: He became deaf in one ear after a fever.
examples.zh: 他發燒後有一隻耳朵變聾了。

examples.en: Special doorbells with lights help deaf people at home.
examples.zh: 帶有燈光的特殊門鈴能在家中幫助聽障人士。

examples.en: The two companies signed a business deal this morning.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司今天早上簽署了一項商業交易。

examples.en: You get a great deal if you buy two tickets together.
examples.zh: 如果你一起買兩張票，會划算很多。

examples.en: It was an unfair deal, but they had no other choice.
examples.zh: 這是一筆不公平的交易，但他們別無選擇。

examples.en: How do you plan to deal with this difficult problem?
examples.zh: 你打算如何處理這個棘手的問題？

examples.en: It is my turn to deal the cards for our board game.
examples.zh: 輪到我發桌遊的牌了。

examples.en: This chapter deals with the history of the ancient kingdom.
examples.zh: 本章探討這個古老王國的歷史。

examples.en: She wrote a letter to her dear old friend.
examples.zh: 她寫了一封信給她親愛的老朋友。

examples.en: My dear child, please listen carefully to my advice.
examples.zh: 我親愛的孩子，請仔細聽我的建議。

examples.en: Living in the central city area can be very dear.
examples.zh: 居住在市中心區域可能會非常昂貴。

examples.en: Oh dear! I forgot my house keys at home.
examples.zh: 天啊！我把家門鑰匙忘在家裡了。

examples.en: Dear me, what a terrible mess in this room!
examples.zh: 天啊，這個房間裡真是亂七八糟！

examples.en: Oh dear, I hope you feel better very soon.
examples.zh: 天啊，我希望你能很快感覺好一點。

examples.en: Good night, my dear, and sleep well.
examples.zh: 晚安，親愛的，好好睡。

examples.en: Thank you for your warm help, you are a dear.
examples.zh: 謝謝你熱情的幫助，你真是一個親切的人。

examples.en: Come and sit next to me, my dear.
examples.zh: 親愛的，過來坐我旁邊。

examples.en: The sudden death of the famous singer shocked many fans.
examples.zh: 那位著名歌手的突然逝世震驚了許多歌迷。

examples.en: Scientists are investigating the cause of death of the whale.
examples.zh: 科學家們正在調查這隻鯨魚的死亡原因。

examples.en: She grieved the death of her beloved grandfather for months.
examples.zh: 她為摯愛的祖父過世哀悼了好幾個月。

examples.en: The politicians held an intense debate on the global economy.
examples.zh: 政治家們針對全球經濟展開了激烈的辯論。

examples.en: There is an ongoing public debate about social media.
examples.zh: 關於社群媒體存在著一場持續進行中的公眾討論。

examples.en: Students participated in a friendly debate during English class.
examples.zh: 學生們在英文課上參加了一場友善的辯論。

examples.en: They debated whether to accept the new job offer.
examples.zh: 他們商量著是否要接受這份新工作。

examples.en: Experts debate the long-term impact of climate change.
examples.zh: 專家們正在討論氣候變遷的長期影響。

examples.en: We debated the options for our next family vacation.
examples.zh: 我們討論了下一次家庭假期的各種選項。

examples.en: He worked hard to pay off student loan debt.
examples.zh: 他努力工作以還清學生貸款債務。

examples.en: The company accumulated heavy debt after several years.
examples.zh: 公司在經歷幾年後累積了重大的債務。

examples.en: I owe a deep debt of gratitude to my family.
examples.zh: 我對家人欠下了深厚的感激之情。

examples.en: She needs time to decide which university she will attend.
examples.zh: 她需要時間決定要就讀哪一所大學。

examples.en: We decided to stay home because it was raining heavily outside.
examples.zh: 我們決定待在家裡，因為外面正下著大雨。

examples.en: The jury will decide the outcome of the court trial today.
examples.zh: 陪審團今天將決定法庭審判的結果。

examples.en: Buying a house is one of the biggest decisions in life.
examples.zh: 買房是人生中最大的決定之一。

examples.en: The committee reached a final decision after hours of debate.
examples.zh: 委員會經過數小時的辯論後達成了最終決定。

examples.en: We respect the judge's fair decision regarding the contract case.
examples.zh: 我們尊重法官關於合約案的公正判決。

examples.en: The water in this mountain lake is extremely cold and deep.
examples.zh: 這座高山湖泊的水極度冰冷且深。

examples.en: He took a deep breath before stepping onto the stage to give his speech.
examples.zh: 上台演講前，他深深地吸了一口氣。

examples.en: She painted the bedroom walls a deep shade of dark blue.
examples.zh: 她把臥室牆壁刷成了深藍色。

examples.en: The ancient treasure was buried deep under the ground for centuries.
examples.zh: 這件古老的寶藏被深埋在地下好幾個世紀。

examples.en: He was deep in thought and did not notice my entrance into the office.
examples.zh: 他沉思得非常入神，沒有注意到我進了辦公室。

examples.en: They hiked deep into the forest to find the hidden waterfall.
examples.zh: 他們徒步深入森林尋找隱藏的瀑布。

examples.en: A graceful deer ran across the quiet forest path.
examples.zh: 一隻優雅的鹿跑過了安靜的森林小徑。

examples.en: We spotted several deer grazing in the green meadow.
examples.zh: 我們看到幾隻鹿在綠色的草地上吃草。

examples.en: Visitors to Nara can feed tame deer in the park.
examples.zh: 去奈良的遊客可以在公園裡餵食溫馴的鹿。

examples.en: This dictionary clearly defines many difficult words.
examples.zh: 這本字典清楚地定義了許多難字。

examples.en: You should define your personal goals clearly before starting a project.
examples.zh: 在開始專案前，你應該明確界定自己的個人目標。

examples.en: Can you define the word "friendship" in your own words?
examples.zh: 你能用自己的話替「友誼」這個詞下定義嗎？

examples.en: Water freezes when the temperature drops to zero degrees.
examples.zh: 當溫度降至零度時水會結冰。

examples.en: She earned a master's degree in computer science last year.
examples.zh: 她去年獲得了電腦科學碩士學位。

examples.en: Success depends to a high degree on your personal effort.
examples.zh: 成功在很大程度上取決於個人的努力。

examples.en: Heavy rain delayed the departure of our flight.
examples.zh: 大雨延誤了我們航班的起飛。

examples.en: Do not delay reporting any safety problems to the manager.
examples.zh: 不要耽擱向經理回報任何安全問題。

examples.en: They decided to delay the meeting until next Monday.
examples.zh: 他們決定把會議推遲到下星期一。

examples.en: Traffic jams caused a long delay on the highway.
examples.zh: 交通堵塞在高速公路上造成了長時間的延誤。

examples.en: We apologized for the slight delay in processing orders.
examples.zh: 我們為處理訂單上的輕微延誤致歉。

examples.en: There will be a train delay due to track maintenance.
examples.zh: 由於軌道維修，火車將會延誤。

examples.en: My grandmother prepared a delicious dinner for the entire family.
examples.zh: 我祖母為全家準備了一頓美味可口的晚餐。

examples.en: Freshly baked bread from the bakery smells delicious every morning.
examples.zh: 麵包店現烤的麵包每天早上聞起來都香噴噴的。

examples.en: We enjoyed a delicious meal at the seafood restaurant yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天在海鮮餐廳享用了一頓美味的餐點。

examples.en: The mail carrier will deliver the package tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 郵差明天早上會遞送這個包裹。

examples.en: This online store promises to deliver goods within two days.
examples.zh: 這家網購商店承諾會在兩天內送達商品。

examples.en: The mayor delivered a short speech at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 市長在開幕典禮上發表了簡短的演說。

examples.en: The online order is scheduled for home delivery tomorrow.
examples.zh: 這筆網路訂單預計明天進行到府遞送。

examples.en: Free delivery is available for orders over fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 消費滿五十美元即可享有免費運送。

examples.en: The express delivery arrived in less than an hour.
examples.zh: 快遞不到一小時就送達了。

examples.en: You should visit the dentist every six months.
examples.zh: 你應該每六個月去看一次牙醫。

examples.en: The dentist examined my teeth and filled a cavity.
examples.zh: 牙醫檢查了我的牙齒，並補了一顆蛀牙。

examples.en: Young children are often afraid of going to the dentist.
examples.zh: 幼童經常害怕去看牙醫。

examples.en: The suspect denied any involvement in the crime.
examples.zh: 嫌犯否認與這起犯罪有任何牽連。

examples.en: No one can deny that she is a talented singer.
examples.zh: 沒有人能否認她是一位有天份的歌手。

examples.en: The guard denied entry to visitors who lacked a pass.
examples.zh: 警衛拒絕無通行證的訪客進入。

examples.en: She leads the sales department in our company's Taipei office.
examples.zh: 她在我們公司台北辦公室領導銷售部門。

examples.en: My older brother studies in the physics department at university.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在大學物理學系就讀。

examples.en: Please contact our customer service department for help.
examples.zh: 如需協助，請聯絡我們的客服部門。

examples.en: Many young children depend heavily on their parents for daily care.
examples.zh: 許多幼童在日常照顧上高度依賴父母。

examples.en: Our outdoor picnic plan will depend on the local weather conditions tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們戶外野餐的計劃將取決於明天當地的天氣狀況。

examples.en: Success usually depends on hard work and practice.
examples.zh: 成功通常取決於努力與練習。

examples.en: The scientists measured the depth of the lake.
examples.zh: 科學家們測量了這座湖的深度。

examples.en: The water in the swimming pool reaches a depth of two meters.
examples.zh: 游泳池裡的水深達到兩公尺。

examples.en: His speech revealed great depth of thought and profound understanding.
examples.zh: 他的演講展現了極大的思想深度與深刻理解。

examples.en: Can you describe what the missing bag looks like?
examples.zh: 你能描述一下遺失的包包長什麼樣子嗎？

examples.en: The teacher asked us to describe our summer vacation.
examples.zh: 老師要我們描述我們的暑假生活。

examples.en: Words cannot describe how happy I am today.
examples.zh: 語言無法形容我今天有多高興。

examples.en: The customer gave a detailed description of the lost bag.
examples.zh: 顧客詳細描述了遺失的袋子。

examples.en: Please read the job description carefully before submitting your application.
examples.zh: 遞交申請前，請仔細閱讀職缺說明。

examples.en: His description of the hotel was very accurate and helpful.
examples.zh: 他對這家飯店的描述非常準確且有幫助。

examples.en: Camels can survive for weeks in the hot and dry desert.
examples.zh: 駱駝可以在炎熱乾燥的沙漠中生存數週。

examples.en: The Sahara Desert stretches across many countries in northern Africa.
examples.zh: 撒哈拉沙漠橫跨北非許多國家。

examples.en: Travelers should carry plenty of clean water when crossing the desert.
examples.zh: 旅人在穿越沙漠時應該攜帶充足的乾淨水。

examples.en: The loyal dog would never desert its master in times of trouble.
examples.zh: 忠誠的狗絕不會在困難時拋棄牠的主人。

examples.en: Soldiers were warned not to desert their positions during the operation.
examples.zh: 士兵們被警告在行動期間不得擅離職守。

examples.en: Many people desert big cities to seek quiet lives in rural villages.
examples.zh: 許多人離開大城市去農村村莊尋求安靜的生活。

examples.en: The talented architect was hired to design a modern museum for the city.
examples.zh: 這位才華洋溢的建築師受僱為該城市設計一座現代博物館。

examples.en: Students were asked to design their own websites for the final computer project.
examples.zh: 學生們被要求為電腦期末專題設計自己的網站。

examples.en: Engineers worked hard to design a safer car for young families.
examples.zh: 工程師們努力工作，為年輕家庭設計更安全的汽車。

examples.en: The sleek design of this new smartphone attracts many young consumers.
examples.zh: 這款新智慧型手機時尚的設計吸引了許多年輕消費者。

examples.en: She chose a simple floral design for her bedroom curtains this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天，她為臥室窗簾選擇了簡約的花卉圖案。

examples.en: The building's unique architectural design received several prestigious international awards.
examples.zh: 這棟建築獨特的建築設計榮獲了數項著名的國際大獎。

examples.en: Please clean up the messy paper stacks on your wooden desk.
examples.zh: 請清理你木製書桌上凌亂的紙張堆。

examples.en: He sits at his computer desk for eight hours every weekday.
examples.zh: 他每個工作天都在電腦桌前坐八個小時。

examples.en: The teacher placed the test papers carefully on her desk.
examples.zh: 老師將試卷小心地放在她的講桌上。

examples.en: Please pay attention to every small detail of the contract.
examples.zh: 請注意合約中的每一個小細節。

examples.en: The travel agent explained the details of the tour package.
examples.zh: 旅行社專員解釋了套裝行程的詳情。

examples.en: His report covers all important details of the project development.
examples.zh: 他的報告涵蓋了專案開發的所有重要細節。

examples.en: The user guide details how to set up the software.
examples.zh: 這份使用指南詳細說明了如何設定軟體。

examples.en: She detailed her experiences during her trip across Europe last summer.
examples.zh: 她詳細說明了去年夏天橫跨歐洲旅行時的經歷。

examples.en: The manager detailed the new work procedures to all staff.
examples.zh: 經理向全體員工詳細說明了新的工作流程。

examples.en: The company plans to develop a new software application this year.
examples.zh: 這間公司計畫今年開發一款新的軟體應用程式。

examples.en: She wants to develop good reading habits during the summer vacation.
examples.zh: 她想在暑假期間培養良好的閱讀習慣。

examples.en: Children develop language skills by listening to their parents speak daily.
examples.zh: 小孩透過每天聽父母說話來發展語言能力。

examples.en: Please dial the emergency number if you need help.
examples.zh: 如果你需要幫助，請撥打緊急電話號碼。

examples.en: She dialed the hotel front desk to order breakfast.
examples.zh: 她撥電話到飯店櫃檯點早餐。

examples.en: I accidentally dialed the wrong phone number this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上不小心撥錯了電話號碼。

examples.en: Turn the temperature dial to increase the room heating.
examples.zh: 轉動溫度旋鈕以增加房間暖氣。

examples.en: The numbers on the clock's dial glow in the dark.
examples.zh: 時鐘面盤上的數字在黑暗中會發光。

examples.en: He checked the pressure dial on the machine every hour.
examples.zh: 他每小時檢查一次機器上的壓力錶。

examples.en: He bought a sparkling diamond ring for his engagement.
examples.zh: 他買了一枚閃亮耀眼的鑽戒作為訂婚禮物。

examples.en: Diamond is known to be the hardest natural mineral on Earth.
examples.zh: 鑽石是地球上已知最堅硬的天然礦物。

examples.en: The road sign was painted in the shape of a yellow diamond.
examples.zh: 這個路標被塗成了黃色菱形。

examples.en: She writes in her personal diary before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 她在睡覺前會在個人日記裡記錄。

examples.en: I locked my secret diary inside the top desk drawer.
examples.zh: 我把我祕密日記鎖在書桌最上方的抽屜裡。

examples.en: Keeping a diary is a great way to practice writing.
examples.zh: 寫日記是練習寫作的好方法。

examples.en: You should look up unfamiliar vocabulary in an online dictionary.
examples.zh: 你應該在線上字典中查閱不熟悉的字彙。

examples.en: The English-Chinese dictionary on my desk is thick and heavy.
examples.zh: 我書桌上的這本英漢字典又厚又重。

examples.en: Our teacher encouraged us to use an English dictionary during reading.
examples.zh: 我們的老師鼓勵我們在閱讀時使用英文字典。

examples.en: The old trees began to die after the long severe drought.
examples.zh: 在經歷長時間的嚴重乾旱後，老樹開始枯萎死亡。

examples.en: Her beloved dog died peacefully at home late last night.
examples.zh: 她心愛的狗昨晚深夜在家中安詳離世。

examples.en: The phone battery will die if you keep playing games.
examples.zh: 如果你繼續玩遊戲，手機電池就會沒電。

examples.en: A balanced diet is essential for maintaining good health.
examples.zh: 均衡的日常飲食對於維持良好健康至關重要。

examples.en: She is on a low-sugar diet to lose weight.
examples.zh: 她正採取低糖飲食來減重。

examples.en: Fresh vegetables form a major part of his daily diet.
examples.zh: 新鮮蔬菜構成了他日常飲食的主要部分。

examples.en: There is a big difference between the two products.
examples.zh: 這兩件產品之間有很大的差別。

examples.en: Good education can make a huge difference in life.
examples.zh: 良好的教育能對人生產生巨大的改變。

examples.en: They settled their differences through a friendly conversation.
examples.zh: 他們透過友好的對話解決了彼此的分歧。

examples.en: My twin brothers have very different personalities.
examples.zh: 我的雙胞胎兄弟個性非常不同。

examples.en: We tried three different types of pizza at the party.
examples.zh: 我們在派對上嘗試了三種不同的披薩。

examples.en: Her new school is completely different from her old one.
examples.zh: 她的新學校和舊學校完全不同。

examples.en: This physics problem was very difficult for most students to solve.
examples.zh: 這道物理題對大多數學生來說非常困難。

examples.en: Learning a new foreign language can be difficult at first.
examples.zh: 剛開始學習一門新的外語可能會很艱難。

examples.en: They made a difficult decision to move to another country.
examples.zh: 他們做出了移居另一個國家的艱難決定。

examples.en: We had great difficulty finding a parking space downtown.
examples.zh: 我們在市中心找停車位遇到很大的困難。

examples.en: She managed to overcome every difficulty with hard work.
examples.zh: 她憑藉努力成功克服了每一個困難。

examples.en: The student experienced some difficulty in understanding the lesson.
examples.zh: 那名學生在理解這堂課時遇到一些困難。

examples.en: Dogs like to dig deep holes in the garden dirt.
examples.zh: 狗喜歡在花園的泥土裡挖深洞。

examples.en: Workers had to dig through the rock to build the tunnel.
examples.zh: 工人必須挖掘岩石以建造隧道。

examples.en: They plan to dig a new well near the farm.
examples.zh: 他們計劃在農場附近挖一口新井。

examples.en: Our whole family usually has dinner together at seven o'clock every evening.
examples.zh: 我們全家通常在每天晚上七點一起吃晚餐。

examples.en: She cooked a delicious dinner for her birthday party last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚為她的生日派對煮了一頓美味的晚餐。

examples.en: They invited us to a formal dinner at the downtown hotel.
examples.zh: 他們邀請我們去市中心的飯店參加正式的晚宴。

examples.en: There is no direct flight between these two small cities.
examples.zh: 這兩座小城市之間沒有直飛航班。

examples.en: She gave a direct answer to his difficult question immediately.
examples.zh: 她立刻對他的難題給出了直接的回答。

examples.en: He prefers a direct style of communication in business meetings.
examples.zh: 他在商務會議中偏好直率的溝通風格。

examples.en: Can you direct me to the nearest metro station entrance?
examples.zh: 你能指引我去最近的捷運站入口嗎？

examples.en: The famous director decided to direct a new action movie.
examples.zh: 這位知名導演決定執導一部新的動作電影。

examples.en: Police officers were needed to direct traffic at the intersection.
examples.zh: 需要警察在十字路口指揮交通。

examples.en: This train goes direct to the international airport terminal station.
examples.zh: 這班列車直接開往國際機場航廈站。

examples.en: The sunlight shines direct into our living room every morning.
examples.zh: 陽光每天早上直接照進我們的客廳。

examples.en: You can report any problem direct to the department manager.
examples.zh: 你可以把任何問題直接回報給部門經理。

examples.en: The sign points in the direction of the nearest metro station.
examples.zh: 指示牌指向最近捷運站的方向。

examples.en: Please follow the directions on the packet when cooking noodles.
examples.zh: 煮麵時請遵循包裝上的說明書指引。

examples.en: Under the direction of the coach, the team won championships.
examples.zh: 在教練的指引下，該團隊贏得了總冠軍。

examples.en: The film director won an award for his latest movie.
examples.zh: 這位電影導演憑藉其最新作品獲獎。

examples.en: She was appointed as the new sales director of the firm.
examples.zh: 她被任命為該公司的新銷售主管。

examples.en: The board of directors met to discuss the financial annual budget.
examples.zh: 董事會開會討論年度財務預算。

examples.en: Put your dirty clothes into the washing machine right away.
examples.zh: 立刻把你的髒衣服放進洗衣機裡。

examples.en: His shoes were dirty after walking on the muddy path.
examples.zh: 走過泥濘的小路後，他的鞋子變髒了。

examples.en: Do not touch food with dirty hands.
examples.zh: 不要用髒手碰食物。

examples.en: Be careful not to dirty your white shirt with soup.
examples.zh: 小心不要用湯弄髒你的白襯衫。

examples.en: Playing outside in the rain will dirty your brand new shoes.
examples.zh: 在雨天外面玩耍會弄髒你的全新鞋子。

examples.en: The muddy water dirtied the living room floor completely.
examples.zh: 泥水把客廳地板徹底弄髒了。

examples.en: I respect your opinion, but I disagree with you.
examples.zh: 我尊重你的意見，但我不同意你的看法。

examples.en: Members disagreed on how to spend the club budget.
examples.zh: 成員們對於如何使用社團預算持異議。

examples.en: Certain seafood always disagrees with my sensitive stomach.
examples.zh: 某些海鮮總是與我敏感的胃不合。

senses.zh: 不同意；意見不合；（食物）不適合

examples.en: The sun disappeared behind the thick clouds at dusk.
examples.zh: 黃昏時太陽消失在厚厚的雲層後面。

examples.en: My keys seem to disappear whenever I am in a hurry.
examples.zh: 每當我趕時間時，我的鑰匙似乎就會消失。

examples.en: The magician made the rabbit disappear inside his hat.
examples.zh: 魔術師讓兔子在他的帽子裡消失了。

examples.en: Scientists discovered a new species of frog in the rainforest.
examples.zh: 科學家在熱帶雨林中發現了一種新的青蛙物種。

examples.en: She was shocked to discover that her wallet was missing.
examples.zh: 發現錢包不見時，她感到非常震驚。

examples.en: We hope to discover effective solutions to environmental issues soon.
examples.zh: 我們希望儘快找出解決環境問題的有效方案。

examples.en: Scientists made an important discovery about space.
examples.zh: 科學家對太空有了重大的發現。

examples.en: The discovery of oil brought wealth to the small region.
examples.zh: 石油的發現給這個小地區帶來了財富。

examples.en: Her unexpected discovery of the old diary surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 她意外發現那本舊日記讓大家都感到驚訝。

examples.en: The committee will discuss the project proposal tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 委員會將在明天早上討論這份專案企劃案。

examples.en: We need to discuss our travel plans for the summer vacation.
examples.zh: 我們需要討論暑假的旅遊計畫。

examples.en: Students gathered in groups to discuss the topic of environmental protection.
examples.zh: 學生們分組聚在一起討論環境保護議題。

examples.en: The committee held a detailed discussion about the budget plan.
examples.zh: 委員會對預算計畫進行了詳細的討論。

examples.en: After hours of active discussion, they reached a consensus.
examples.zh: 經過數小時的積極討論，他們達成了共識。

examples.en: Our class had a lively discussion on climate change today.
examples.zh: 我們班今天對氣候變遷展開了熱烈的討論。

examples.en: Washing hands regularly can prevent the spread of infectious disease.
examples.zh: 定期洗手可以預防傳染病的傳播。

examples.en: Doctors are working hard to find a cure for this disease.
examples.zh: 醫生們正努力尋找治療這種疾病的方法。

examples.en: A healthy diet helps lower the risk of heart disease.
examples.zh: 健康的飲食有助於降低罹患心臟病的風險。

examples.en: Please wash your dish after finishing your meal.
examples.zh: 吃完飯後請把你的盤子洗乾淨。

examples.en: Steamed fish is a traditional dish served during the festival.
examples.zh: 蒸魚是節慶期間供應的傳統菜餚。

examples.en: She prepared a delicious pasta dish for her guests.
examples.zh: 她為客人準備了一道美味的義大利麵菜餚。

examples.en: The store displays new clothes in the front window.
examples.zh: 這家商店在櫥窗展示新衣服。

examples.en: The monitor can display high-resolution images clearly.
examples.zh: 這台螢幕能清晰地顯示高畫質影像。

examples.en: She displayed extraordinary courage during the emergency situation.
examples.zh: 她在緊急狀況下展現了非凡的勇氣。

examples.en: There is a special display of ancient art at the museum.
examples.zh: 博物館正有一場古代藝術的特別展覽。

examples.en: The smartphone features a large colorful display screen.
examples.zh: 這款智慧型手機配有色彩鮮豔的大顯示螢幕。

examples.en: We watched a brilliant fireworks display by the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊觀賞了精彩的煙火表演。

examples.en: What is the exact distance between Taipei and Kaohsiung?
examples.zh: 台北和高雄之間的確切距離是多少？

examples.en: He saw a lighthouse shining faintly in the distance.
examples.zh: 他看到遠處有一座燈塔發出微弱的光。

examples.en: The hotel is within walking distance of the beach.
examples.zh: 這家飯店到海灘只要走路就能到。

examples.en: We could hear the faint sound of distant thunder.
examples.zh: 我們聽到遠處傳來微弱的雷聲。

examples.en: He plans to travel to a distant country next summer.
examples.zh: 他計劃明年夏天前往一個遙遠的國家旅行。

examples.en: She gave a polite but distant smile to the strangers.
examples.zh: 她對陌生人報以禮貌但冷淡的微笑。

examples.en: We can divide the birthday cake into eight pieces.
examples.zh: 我們可以把生日蛋糕分成八塊。

examples.en: A high wall divides the garden into two sections.
examples.zh: 一面高牆將花園隔成兩個區域。

examples.en: If you divide twelve by three, you get four.
examples.zh: 十二除以三等於四。

examples.en: She works as a senior manager in the sales division.
examples.zh: 她在業務部門擔任資深經理。

examples.en: Students practiced long division problems in math class.
examples.zh: 學生們在數學課上練習長除法題目。

examples.en: There is a deep division of opinions regarding the proposal.
examples.zh: 對於這項提案存在著深刻的意見分歧。

examples.en: Students must do their homework carefully before going out to play.
examples.zh: 學生出去玩之前必須仔細做作業。

examples.en: What do you plan to do during the coming weekend holiday?
examples.zh: 你打算在即將到來的週末假期做什麼？

examples.en: She promised to do her best to solve the customer problem.
examples.zh: 她承諾會盡力解決顧客的問題。

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient carefully and prescribed some medicine.
examples.zh: 醫生仔細地檢查了病人並開了一些藥。

examples.en: You should see a doctor if your high fever continues until tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果你的高燒持續到明天，你應該去看醫生。

examples.en: After five years of hard study, she finally became a doctor of physics.
examples.zh: 經過五年的努力研究，她終於成為了物理學博士。

examples.en: Our dog always barks happily when we return home.
examples.zh: 我們的狗在我們回家時總是開心地叫。

examples.en: She walks her dog in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨都在公園裡遛狗。

examples.en: The friendly dog wagged its tail at the visitors.
examples.zh: 那隻友善的狗對著訪客搖尾巴。

examples.en: The little girl combed the blonde hair of her doll.
examples.zh: 小女孩幫她的洋娃娃梳理金髮。

examples.en: She received a handmade porcelain doll as a birthday gift.
examples.zh: 她收到一個手作瓷洋娃娃作為生日禮物。

examples.en: This old traditional doll has been passed down for generations.
examples.zh: 這個古老的傳統洋娃娃已經代代相傳。

examples.en: The movie ticket costs ten dollars per person this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午電影票每人十美元。

examples.en: He donated a hundred dollars to the charitable organization yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天向慈善機構捐贈了一百美元。

examples.en: The exchange rate of the US dollar changed slightly today.
examples.zh: 美金匯率今天略有變動。

examples.en: The airline operates both domestic and international passenger flights.
examples.zh: 這間航空公司營運國內與國際客運航班。

examples.en: She shared the burden of domestic chores with her husband.
examples.zh: 她與丈夫分擔家務負擔。

examples.en: Cats and dogs are common domestic pets in many families.
examples.zh: 貓和狗是許多家庭中常見的家養寵物。

examples.en: Please lock the front door before you go to sleep.
examples.zh: 請在睡覺前鎖上大門。

examples.en: Someone is knocking at the back door.
examples.zh: 有人正在敲後門。

examples.en: She opened the door to welcome her guests.
examples.zh: 她打開門迎接她的客人。

examples.en: Remember to place a small dot over the letter i when writing lowercase.
examples.zh: 書寫小寫字母時，切記要在字母 i 上方點一個小圓點。

examples.en: From the plane, the island looked like a tiny dot in the sea.
examples.zh: 從飛機上看，這座島就像海上的一個小點。

examples.en: She wore a white summer dress covered with cute dark blue polka dots.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件印滿深藍色可愛圓點的白色夏季洋裝。

examples.en: They booked a spacious double room for their vacation at the resort.
examples.zh: 他們在度假村為他們的假期預訂了一間寬敞的雙人房。

examples.en: The door is equipped with a secure double lock for safety protection.
examples.zh: 門配備了安全的雙重鎖以提供安全保護。

examples.en: He receives a double portion of dessert because today is his birthday.
examples.zh: 因為今天是他的生日，所以他獲得了雙份甜點。

examples.en: The store aims to double its product sales over the next quarter.
examples.zh: 該店旨在下一季度將其產品銷售額翻倍。

examples.en: Her continuous effort doubled her chances of winning the school competition prize.
examples.zh: 她不懈的努力使她贏得學校比賽獎項的機會翻倍。

examples.en: The population of the small town doubled in less than ten years.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮的人口在不到十年的時間裡增長了一倍。

examples.en: Her output is double that of any other worker in the team.
examples.zh: 她的產出是團隊中任何其他工人的兩倍。

examples.en: He looks so much like his brother that he could be his double.
examples.zh: 他看起來太像他哥哥了，簡直可以是他的替身。

examples.en: She earned double what she made last year thanks to her promotion.
examples.zh: 由於升職，她的收入是去年的兩倍。

examples.en: There is no doubt that she will pass the exam.
examples.zh: 毫無疑問，她一定會通過考試。

examples.en: I have some doubt about the accuracy of these figures.
examples.zh: 我對這些數據的準確性持有一些懷疑。

examples.en: His honest explanation removed all doubt from her mind.
examples.zh: 他誠實的解釋化解了她心中所有的懷疑。

examples.en: I doubt whether the store will open on rainy days.
examples.zh: 我懷疑這家店在下雨天是否會營業。

examples.en: She never doubted his loyalty throughout their long friendship.
examples.zh: 在他們長久的友誼中，她從未懷疑過他的忠誠。

examples.en: Many experts doubt the feasibility of this project proposal.
examples.zh: 許多專家懷疑這個專案提議的可行性。

examples.en: A white dove is often considered a symbol of peace.
examples.zh: 白鴿通常被視為和平的象徵。

examples.en: The dove landed softly on the wooden fence post.
examples.zh: 鴿子輕輕地停在木圍籬柱頭上。

examples.en: They released a pair of doves during the wedding ceremony.
examples.zh: 他們在婚禮儀式上放飛了一對鴿子。

examples.en: Please sit down and open your books.
examples.zh: 請坐下並打開你們的書本。

examples.en: The sun went down behind the mountains.
examples.zh: 太陽在山後落下了。

examples.en: Prices came down after the holiday season.
examples.zh: 假期結束後價格下降了。

examples.en: They walked down the street to the bakery.
examples.zh: 他們沿著這條街走到麵包店。

examples.en: Water ran down the window pane during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間水沿著窗戶玻璃流下。

examples.en: Drive down this road for two miles.
examples.zh: 沿著這條路往前開兩英里。

examples.en: You can download the mobile application for free today.
examples.zh: 你今天可以免費下載這個手機應用程式。

examples.en: It takes only a minute to download the document file.
examples.zh: 下載這個文件檔案只需要一分鐘。

examples.en: She downloaded her favorite album to listen to offline.
examples.zh: 她下載了她最喜歡的專輯以便離線收聽。

examples.en: The software download finished successfully on my laptop computer.
examples.zh: 軟體下載在我的筆記型電腦上順利完成。

examples.en: Please check your downloads folder for the PDF manual.
examples.zh: 請檢查你的下載資料夾以取得 PDF 手冊。

examples.en: The app reached one million downloads in its first month.
examples.zh: 這款應用程式在上線的第一個月就達到了一百萬次下載量。

examples.en: My parents are waiting for us downstairs in the living room.
examples.zh: 我父母正在樓下客廳等我們。

examples.en: She walked downstairs slowly while holding the wooden handrail.
examples.zh: 她握著木製扶手緩慢地走下樓。

examples.en: Please go downstairs and check if the front door is locked.
examples.zh: 請到樓下檢查前門是否鎖好了。

examples.en: The downstairs neighbor complained about the loud noise last night.
examples.zh: 樓下的鄰居抱怨昨晚的巨響。

examples.en: We transformed the downstairs room into a quiet home office.
examples.zh: 我們把樓下的房間改造成一個安靜的居家辦公室。

examples.en: The downstairs bathroom is currently undergoing a complete renovation.
examples.zh: 樓下的洗手間目前正在進行全面翻修。

examples.en: The whole downstairs was flooded after the heavy rainstorm.
examples.zh: 在大暴雨之後，整個樓下都被水淹了。

examples.en: They cleaned the downstairs before the guests arrived for dinner.
examples.zh: 他們在客人來吃晚餐前清潔了樓下。

examples.en: All rooms in the downstairs need a fresh coat of paint.
examples.zh: 樓下的所有房間都需要重新刷漆。

examples.en: My mother bought a dozen eggs from the local supermarket.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在當地的超級市場買了一打雞蛋。

examples.en: The bakery sells freshly baked donuts by the dozen.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店一打一打地販售現烤甜甜圈。

examples.en: There were a dozen students waiting outside the classroom.
examples.zh: 有十二個學生在教室外面等待。

examples.en: The fantasy novel tells a story about a friendly green dragon.
examples.zh: 這本奇幻小說講述了一個關於一隻友善綠龍的故事。

examples.en: People row colorful boats during the Dragon Boat Festival in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 人們在台灣端午節期間划著繽紛的龍舟。

examples.en: An ancient giant dragon guarded the hidden treasure inside the cave.
examples.zh: 一隻古老的巨龍守護著山洞裡藏著的寶藏。

examples.en: She is studying modern English drama at the university.
examples.zh: 她正在大學研讀現代英國戲劇。

examples.en: My mother loves watching historical drama series every night.
examples.zh: 我媽媽每天晚上都喜歡看歷史連續劇。

examples.en: There was a lot of drama in the office after the manager quit.
examples.zh: 經理辭職後，辦公室裡發生了不少風波。

senses.zh: 戲劇；連續劇；戲劇性事件

examples.en: The young artist loves to draw landscapes with colorful pencils.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的藝術家喜歡用彩色鉛筆畫風景。

examples.en: Please draw a straight line across the paper using your ruler.
examples.zh: 請用你的直尺在紙上畫出一條直線。

examples.en: The loud street performance drew a large crowd of curious spectators.
examples.zh: 那場響亮的街頭表演吸引了大批好奇的觀眾。

examples.en: The soccer game ended in a two-to-two draw after full time.
examples.zh: 足球比賽完場後以二比二平局結束。

examples.en: The winner of the lucky raffle will be chosen by random draw.
examples.zh: 幸運抽獎的得主將通過隨機抽籤選出。

examples.en: Both teams played hard, but the match resulted in a draw.
examples.zh: 兩隊都很拚，但這場比賽最終以平手收場。

examples.en: I keep my passports and important documents locked in the desk drawer.
examples.zh: 我把護照和重要文件鎖在桌子的抽屜裡。

examples.en: He pulled open the kitchen drawer to find a sharp pair of scissors.
examples.zh: 他拉開廚房的抽屜尋找一把剪刀。

examples.en: She organized her colorful socks neatly in the top bedroom drawer.
examples.zh: 她把彩色襪子整齊地收拾在臥室最上層的抽屜裡。

examples.en: Her ultimate dream is to travel around the whole world.
examples.zh: 她的終極夢想是環遊全世界。

examples.en: I had a strange dream about flying last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚做了一個關於飛行的奇怪夢境。

examples.en: Hard work is necessary to make your dreams come true.
examples.zh: 要讓你的夢想實現，努力是必要的。

examples.en: She dreams of becoming a professional musician one day.
examples.zh: 她夢想著有一天能成為專業音樂家。

examples.en: I often dream about my childhood home in the countryside.
examples.zh: 我經常夢見自己鄉下的老家。

examples.en: Don't just dream about success; work hard for it.
examples.zh: 不要只夢想成功，要為此努力付出。

examples.en: She bought a beautiful red dress for the wedding party.
examples.zh: 她為婚禮派對買了一件漂亮的紅洋裝。

examples.en: Her mother made a custom dress for her school graduation.
examples.zh: 她媽媽為她的學校畢業典禮做了一件訂製連身裙。

examples.en: The blue dress looks very nice on you today.
examples.zh: 這件藍色洋裝今天穿在你身上好看。

examples.en: He got up early and dressed quickly for work.
examples.zh: 他很早起床並迅速穿好衣服去上班。

examples.en: Children love to dress up in costumes on Halloween night.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在萬聖節晚上打扮成各種造型。

examples.en: She always dresses neatly when going to an interview.
examples.zh: 她去面試時總是穿戴整齊。

examples.en: You should drink plenty of water after exercising in the heat.
examples.zh: 在大熱天運動後，你應該多喝水。

examples.en: He likes to drink hot coffee every morning before work.
examples.zh: 他喜歡每天上班前喝一杯熱咖啡。

examples.en: Cats usually prefer to drink clean water from a bowl.
examples.zh: 貓咪通常比較喜歡喝碗裡的乾淨水。

examples.en: Would you like a cold drink after walking in the sun?
examples.zh: 在大太陽下行走後，你想來杯冷飲嗎？

examples.en: The menu offers a wide variety of soft drinks and juices.
examples.zh: 菜單提供種類繁多的軟性飲料與果汁。

examples.en: They met at a quiet cafe for a quick drink and chat.
examples.zh: 他們在一間安靜的咖啡館見面，喝杯飲料聊聊天。

examples.en: My father drives to his office in the city every day.
examples.zh: 我父親每天開車去市區的辦公室。

examples.en: She is learning how to drive a manual car.
examples.zh: 她正在學習如何駕駛手排車。

examples.en: The loud noise is driving me crazy right now.
examples.zh: 那巨大的噪音現在快把我逼瘋了。

examples.en: It is a two-hour drive from Taipei to Taichung.
examples.zh: 從台北到台中大約有兩小時的車程。

examples.en: Save your files on an external hard drive for backup.
examples.zh: 將你的檔案儲存在外接硬碟上以進行備份。

examples.en: Her strong drive for success made her work very hard.
examples.zh: 她對成功的強烈企圖心促使她非常努力工作。

examples.en: The bus driver stopped at the traffic light carefully.
examples.zh: 公車司機在紅綠燈前小心停了下來。

examples.en: He works as a taxi driver in the city center.
examples.zh: 他在市中心擔任計程車司機。

examples.en: The race car driver accelerated around the sharp corner.
examples.zh: 賽車手在急轉彎處加速過彎。

examples.en: She accidentally dropped her glass coffee mug on the floor.
examples.zh: 她不小心把玻璃馬克杯掉到了地上。

examples.en: Temperatures will drop significantly throughout the night across the country.
examples.zh: 全國氣溫將在夜間顯著下降。

examples.en: He dropped his daughter off at school before driving home.
examples.zh: 他在開車回家前把女兒送到了學校。

examples.en: A heavy drop of rain fell on her pale cheek.
examples.zh: 一滴沉重的雨滴落在她蒼白的臉頰上。

examples.en: There was a sudden drop in sales during last winter.
examples.zh: 上個冬天銷售額出現了突然下降。

examples.en: Add a small drop of food coloring to the water.
examples.zh: 在水裡加入一小滴食用色素。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a new drug for high blood pressure.
examples.zh: 醫生開了一款針對高血壓的新藥物。

examples.en: Keep all prescription drugs out of the reach of children.
examples.zh: 請將所有處方藥放在孩童拿不到的地方。

examples.en: Police officers work hard to stop illegal drug trading.
examples.zh: 警察努力遏止非法毒品交易。

examples.en: He plays the drum in a rock band with his high school friends.
examples.zh: 他和高中朋友在一個搖滾樂團裡打鼓。

examples.en: The rhythmic sound of the drum beat echoed through the hall.
examples.zh: 鼓擊的節奏聲在大廳裡迴盪。

examples.en: Workers stored the liquid chemical inside a large steel drum.
examples.zh: 工人將液體化學品儲存在一個大鋼桶裡。

examples.en: Raindrops began to drum loudly against the bedroom window.
examples.zh: 雨滴開始響亮地連續敲擊著臥室窗戶。

examples.en: He drummed his fingers nervously on the wooden desk while waiting.
examples.zh: 等待時，他緊張地用手指在木桌上敲打。

examples.en: The marching band drummed enthusiastically during the parade.
examples.zh: 遊行期間，行進樂隊熱情地擊鼓。

examples.en: My skin gets very dry during the cold winter weather.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬天天氣裡，我的皮膚變得非常乾燥。

examples.en: Hang your wet clothes outside in the sun to get them dry.
examples.zh: 把你的濕衣服掛在外面曬太陽弄乾。

examples.en: The natural climate in this desert region is extremely dry.
examples.zh: 這個沙漠地區的自然氣候極度乾燥。

examples.en: Use a clean towel to dry your hands after washing them.
examples.zh: 洗完手後用乾淨的毛巾把手擦乾。

examples.en: The wet paint on the wall will dry in a few hours.
examples.zh: 牆上的濕漆會在幾個小時內完全乾透。

examples.en: She dried her hair with a hair dryer before going to bed.
examples.zh: 她上床睡覺前用吹風機吹乾頭髮。

examples.en: Put the wet laundry into the clothes dryer now.
examples.zh: 現在把濕衣服放進衣物烘乾機裡吧。

examples.en: She dried her long hair using an electric dryer.
examples.zh: 她使用一支電動吹風機吹乾了長髮。

examples.en: The dryer stopped automatically when the cycle ended.
examples.zh: 烘乾機在行程結束時自動停止了。

examples.en: A small yellow duck was swimming peacefully in the pond.
examples.zh: 一隻黃色的小鴨在池塘裡悠閒地游泳。

examples.en: We saw a flock of wild ducks flying south today.
examples.zh: 我們今天看到一群野鴨向南飛去。

examples.en: The children love feeding bread to the ducks at the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在公園餵鴨子吃麵包。

examples.en: He had to duck his head to enter the low door.
examples.zh: 他必須低頭蹲身才能進入那扇矮門。

examples.en: She quickened her step to duck under the umbrella.
examples.zh: 她加快腳步躲到雨傘底下。

examples.en: The baseball hit the wall right after he ducked.
examples.zh: 在他及時蹲下低頭後，棒球隨即擊中了牆壁。

examples.en: The final history report is due by five o'clock next Friday.
examples.zh: 最終歷史報告需在下週五下午五點前繳交。

examples.en: The train is due to arrive in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 火車預計十分鐘後到達。

examples.en: The hardworking team received the respect and praise that was due.
examples.zh: 這支勤奮的團隊獲得了應得的尊重與讚揚。

examples.en: The lecture was so dull that many students fell asleep.
examples.zh: 這場講座太枯燥乏味了，許多學生都睡著了。

examples.en: This knife is too dull to cut the fresh meat properly.
examples.zh: 這把刀太鈍了，沒辦法好好切新鮮肉品。

examples.en: The sky looked gray and dull on that cold rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 在那個寒冷下雨的下午，天空看起來陰暗又沉悶。

senses.zh: 枯燥乏味的；鈍的；暗淡的

examples.en: Please keep your mobile phones silent during the class.
examples.zh: 課堂期間請保持手機靜音。

examples.en: It rained continuously during our entire vacation in Kenting.
examples.zh: 在我們去墾丁的整個假期期間，雨下個不停。

examples.en: He fell fast asleep during the long boring lecture.
examples.zh: 他在漫長無聊的講座期間沉沉睡去。

examples.en: It is the duty of every guard to secure the building.
examples.zh: 維護大樓安全是每位警衛的職責。

examples.en: She felt a strong moral duty to tell the truth.
examples.zh: 她感到有強烈的道德義務說出事實。

examples.en: You must pay customs duty when importing electronic items.
examples.zh: 進口電子物品時必須支付關稅。

examples.en: Each student in the classroom received a new notebook yesterday.
examples.zh: 教室裡的每一個學生昨天都收到了一本新筆記本。

examples.en: Each ticket costs two hundred dollars for the music concert.
examples.zh: 這場音樂會的每張門票售價兩百元。

examples.en: Please check each answer carefully before turning in your test paper.
examples.zh: 交卷前請仔細檢查每一個答案。

examples.en: The students each chose a different storybook to read in class.
examples.zh: 學生們在課堂上各自挑選了一本不同的故事書來讀。

examples.en: The twins got a nice present, and each was very happy.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎得到了很好的禮物，兩個人都很開心。

examples.en: We all have our own opinions, and each has its value.
examples.zh: 我們都有自己的意見，而且各有其價值。

examples.en: A majestic eagle soared high above the snowy mountain.
examples.zh: 一隻雄偉的老鷹在雪山高空翱翔。

examples.en: The sharp eye of the eagle spotted a fish below.
examples.zh: 老鷹敏銳的眼睛發現了下方的魚。

examples.en: Eagles are a famous symbol of freedom in culture.
examples.zh: 老鷹在文化中是自由的著名象徵。

examples.en: Whisper the secret in my ear so no one hears.
examples.zh: 在我耳朵旁輕聲說這個祕密，這樣就沒人聽到了。

examples.en: The dog perked up its ears at the sound.
examples.zh: 狗狗聽到聲音後豎起了耳朵。

examples.en: He put his hands over his ears because of the noise.
examples.zh: 因為太吵，他把雙手蓋在耳朵上。

examples.en: We caught an early train to avoid the morning traffic.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘早班火車以避開早上的交通潮。

examples.en: The museum displays early photographs of the city.
examples.zh: 這間博物館展出了這座城市的早期照片。

examples.en: We had an early dinner before going to the concert.
examples.zh: 我們在去聽音樂會之前提早吃了晚餐。

examples.en: He woke up early to watch the sunrise at the beach.
examples.zh: 他早起去海灘看日出。

examples.en: Please arrive early to get a good seat for the show.
examples.zh: 請提早到達以取得表演的好座位。

examples.en: The bus arrived early, so we did not have to wait long.
examples.zh: 公車提早抵達，所以我們不必等很久。

examples.en: He works overtime to earn extra money for college.
examples.zh: 他加班工作以賺取額外的大學學費。

examples.en: She earned a reputation as an honest business manager.
examples.zh: 她贏得了誠實經理人的好名聲。

examples.en: How much does a software engineer earn a year?
examples.zh: 一名軟體工程師每年賺多少錢？

examples.en: She lost her silver earring while she was shopping.
examples.zh: 她在購物時弄丟了她的銀耳環。

examples.en: These shiny earrings match her blue dress very well.
examples.zh: 這些閃亮的耳環非常配她的藍色洋裝。

examples.en: He bought a pair of pearl earrings for his mother.
examples.zh: 他買了一對珍珠耳環給他媽媽。

examples.en: The Earth revolves around the Sun once every three hundred and sixty-five days.
examples.zh: 地球每三百六十五天繞太陽公轉一次。

examples.en: The farmer dug up the rich black earth to plant spring vegetables.
examples.zh: 農夫掘開肥沃的黑土來種植春季蔬菜。

examples.en: Astronauts viewed the beautiful blue Earth from space aboard the station.
examples.zh: 太空人從太空站上俯瞰美麗的藍色地球。

examples.en: A powerful earthquake struck the island early yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 昨天清晨一場強烈地震襲擊了這座島嶼。

examples.en: Students practiced safety drills in case an earthquake happens.
examples.zh: 學生們練習安全演練以防發生地震。

examples.en: The earthquake caused severe damage to several ancient wooden buildings.
examples.zh: 這場地震對幾棟古老木造建築造成了嚴重損壞。

examples.en: He passed the driving test with ease because he practiced daily.
examples.zh: 因為每天練習，他輕鬆通過了駕照考試。

examples.en: The quiet atmosphere put all the nervous students at ease.
examples.zh: 安靜的氛圍讓所有緊張的學生感到放鬆。

examples.en: Many shoppers like this app for its ease of use.
examples.zh: 許多購物者喜歡這款應用程式，因為操作簡單。

examples.en: Taking a warm bath helped to ease her muscle pain.
examples.zh: 洗個熱水澡有助於減輕她的肌肉酸痛。

examples.en: The music helped ease his anxiety before the job interview.
examples.zh: 音樂有助於緩和他在求職面試前的焦慮。

examples.en: The new subway line will ease traffic congestion in the city.
examples.zh: 新捷運路線將減緩城市的交通壅塞。

examples.en: The sun rises in the east every morning.
examples.zh: 太陽每天早晨從東方升起。

examples.en: Taiwan is located in the east of Asia.
examples.zh: 台灣位於亞洲的東部。

examples.en: They traveled toward the east coast for holiday.
examples.zh: 他們前往東海岸度假。

examples.en: We took the east gate to enter the park.
examples.zh: 我們走東門進入公園。

examples.en: The east coast of the island has beautiful beaches.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼的東海岸有美麗的沙灘。

examples.en: The east wind brought chilly weather.
examples.zh: 東風帶來了寒冷的天氣。

examples.en: Drive east for three blocks to reach the bank.
examples.zh: 向東開三個街區即可到達銀行。

examples.en: The birds flew east for the winter migration.
examples.zh: 鳥類向東飛行以進行冬遷。

examples.en: We walked east along the riverbank.
examples.zh: 我們沿著河岸向東走。

examples.en: Taiwan has beautiful natural mountain coastline along its eastern coast.
examples.zh: 台灣東部海岸沿線擁有美麗的山海自然風光。

examples.en: Eastern philosophy emphasizes harmony between humans and natural environment.
examples.zh: 東方哲學強調人與自然環境之間的和諧。

examples.en: We visited several small fishing villages in the eastern district yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天造訪了東區的幾個小漁村。

examples.en: The math test was very easy for most of the students.
examples.zh: 這門數學測驗對大多數學生來說非常容易。

examples.en: It is easy to find the location using this map app.
examples.zh: 使用這個地圖應用程式很容易找到地點。

examples.en: She leads an easy life in a quiet countryside village.
examples.zh: 她在一個安靜的鄉村小鎮過著輕鬆的生活。

examples.en: We usually eat dinner together as a family around seven o'clock.
examples.zh: 我們通常在七點左右全家一起吃晚餐。

examples.en: Rabbits love to eat fresh carrots and green vegetables.
examples.zh: 兔子喜歡吃新鮮的胡蘿蔔和青菜。

examples.en: You should not eat too many sweet desserts before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 你不應該在睡前吃太多甜點。

examples.en: Please do not stand too close to the edge of the cliff.
examples.zh: 請不要站得太靠近懸崖邊緣。

examples.en: The sharp edge of the broken glass cut his index finger slightly.
examples.zh: 碎玻璃的鋒利邊緣割傷了他的食指。

examples.en: She carefully lined up the edge of the paper before folding it.
examples.zh: 她在摺紙前仔細對齊了紙張的邊緣。

examples.en: The publisher released a revised edition of the English textbook.
examples.zh: 出版商推出了這本英文教科書的修訂版。

examples.en: I bought a limited edition of my favorite novel.
examples.zh: 我買了我最喜歡的小說的限量版。

examples.en: The morning edition of the local newspaper arrived on time.
examples.zh: 地方報紙的早報如期送達。

examples.en: Good education provides young people with better future opportunities.
examples.zh: 良好的教育為年輕人提供更好的未來機會。

examples.en: She finished her higher education at a well-known university.
examples.zh: 她在一家知名大學完成了高等教育。

examples.en: The government invested more money in public education this year.
examples.zh: 政府今年在公立教育上投入了更多資金。

examples.en: The new medicine had an immediate effect on his fever.
examples.zh: 這種新藥對他的發燒立刻產生了效果。

examples.en: Pollution has a negative effect on the global marine environment.
examples.zh: 污染對全球海洋環境造成負面影響。

examples.en: The special lighting effect made the stage look truly magical.
examples.zh: 特殊的燈光效果讓舞台看起來真的很神奇。

examples.en: The new policy will effect significant changes in our department.
examples.zh: 這項新政策將會在我們部門引起重大改變。

examples.en: They hope to effect a peaceful resolution to the disagreement.
examples.zh: 他們希望能實現這場爭議的和平解決。

examples.en: The new manager was able to effect improvements in overall efficiency.
examples.zh: 新任經理成功促成了整體效率的提升。

examples.en: Regular exercise is an effective way to relieve mental stress.
examples.zh: 定期運動是減輕精神壓力的有效方法。

examples.en: The new law will become effective starting from next January.
examples.zh: 這項新法律將從明年一月起生效。

examples.en: She adopted an effective study strategy to improve her math grade.
examples.zh: 她採用了有效的學習策略來提升數學成績。

examples.en: Passing the final examination requires a lot of time and effort.
examples.zh: 通過期末考試需要花費大量的時間與努力。

examples.en: Despite her best efforts, she could not win the race.
examples.zh: 儘管她盡了最大的努力，她還是沒能贏得比賽。

examples.en: The team put a lot of effort into organizing the charity event.
examples.zh: 團隊投入了許多心力籌辦這場慈善活動。

examples.en: I usually eat a boiled egg and milk for breakfast every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上通常吃一個煮熟的蛋並喝牛奶。

examples.en: The mother bird sat carefully on her egg in the nest.
examples.zh: 母鳥小心地坐在鳥巢裡的蛋上。

examples.en: Crack one egg into the bowl and mix it with flour.
examples.zh: 打一個蛋進碗裡，並將它與麵粉混合。

examples.en: You can park your car on either side of the street.
examples.zh: 你可以把車停在街道的任意一側。

examples.en: Either team has a fair chance to win the championship tonight.
examples.zh: 任一隊伍今晚都有公平的機會贏得總冠軍。

examples.en: We can take either bus route to reach the station.
examples.zh: 我們可以搭乘任一公車路線到達車站。

examples.en: You can choose either coffee or tea with your breakfast.
examples.zh: 你的早餐可以選擇咖啡或茶。

examples.en: Either you leave now, or you will miss the bus.
examples.zh: 你要麼現在就出發，要麼就會錯過公車。

examples.en: We will go abroad either in July or in August.
examples.zh: 我們要麼在七月出國，要麼在八月出國。

examples.en: If you do not want to go, I will not either.
examples.zh: 如果你不想去，我也不要去。

examples.en: He does not like mushrooms, and his brother does not either.
examples.zh: 他不喜歡香菇，他的哥哥也不喜歡。

examples.en: I have not seen that movie, and she has not either.
examples.zh: 我還沒看過那部電影，她也還沒看過。

examples.en: We should show respect to the elder members of the family.
examples.zh: 我們應該尊重家中的長輩。

examples.en: Her elder brother works as a software engineer here.
examples.zh: 她的哥哥在這裡擔任軟體工程師。

examples.en: My elder sister is studying in Japan.
examples.zh: 我姊姊正在日本念書。

examples.en: Tribal elders gathered together to discuss important community matters.
examples.zh: 部落的長者們聚在一起討論重要的社區事務。

examples.en: We asked the village elder for advice on farming.
examples.zh: 我們向村裡的長者請教關於務農的建議。

examples.en: She learned traditional songs from her elders at home.
examples.zh: 她在家向長輩們學習傳統歌曲。

examples.en: Electric vehicles are becoming more and more popular in big cities.
examples.zh: 電動車在大城市裡越來越普及。

examples.en: She boils water every morning using a portable electric kettle.
examples.zh: 她每天早上使用攜帶式電水壺煮水。

examples.en: The company produces high-quality electric guitars for professional musicians.
examples.zh: 這間公司為專業音樂家生產高品質的電吉他。

examples.en: The house suffered damage due to an electrical wiring problem.
examples.zh: 這棟房子因電線問題而受損。

examples.en: He bought new electrical appliances for his kitchen this week.
examples.zh: 他這週為廚房購買了新的電器。

examples.en: An electrician came to repair the electrical outlet in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 一位電工前來修理廚房的電源插座。

examples.en: The gentle elephant sprayed water using its long trunk.
examples.zh: 那隻溫和的大象用長鼻子噴水。

examples.en: The African elephant is the largest land animal on Earth.
examples.zh: 非洲象是地球上最大的陸地動物。

examples.en: We saw a family of wild elephants during the safari.
examples.zh: 我們在野生動物觀賞之旅中看到了一群野生大象。

examples.en: Is there anything else you need from the store?
examples.zh: 你還需要從商店買其他什麼東西嗎？

examples.en: Nobody else volunteered to help with the project.
examples.zh: 沒有其他任何人自願幫忙這個專案。

examples.en: Let us go somewhere else for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 我們今晚去其他地方吃晚餐吧。

examples.en: I sent an email to my teacher this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上寄了一封電子郵件給老師。

examples.en: Please check your inbox for the confirmation email.
examples.zh: 請檢查你的收件匣是否有確認電子郵件。

examples.en: He received an urgent email from his boss.
examples.zh: 他收到來自老闆的緊急電子郵件。

examples.en: I will email the meeting document to you soon.
examples.zh: 我很快就會把會議文件寄電子郵件給你。

examples.en: Please email me if you have any further questions.
examples.zh: 如果你有任何其他問題，請寄電子郵件給我。

examples.en: She emailed the detailed itinerary to all travelers.
examples.zh: 她把詳細的行程寄電子郵件給所有旅客。

examples.en: Music can evoke strong emotions of joy and sadness.
examples.zh: 音樂能引發喜悅與悲傷的強烈情緒。

examples.en: Her voice shook with emotion as she received the award.
examples.zh: 她領獎時，聲音因激動而顫抖。

examples.en: It is healthy to express your emotions freely at home.
examples.zh: 在家裡自由表達自己的情感是健康的。

examples.en: Our teacher always emphasizes the importance of good study habits.
examples.zh: 我們的老師總是強調良好學習習慣的重要性。

examples.en: The report emphasizes that we must protect our natural environment.
examples.zh: 這份報告強調我們必須保護我們的自然環境。

examples.en: She spoke slowly to emphasize key points in her presentation.
examples.zh: 她說得很慢，以強調簡報中的要點。

examples.en: The new tech company plans to employ fifty software engineers next year.
examples.zh: 這家新科技公司計劃明年僱用五十名軟體工程師。

examples.en: The factory employs local workers to make handmade furniture.
examples.zh: 這間工廠僱用在地工人製作手工傢俱。

examples.en: Teachers employ interactive games to make the English lesson more engaging.
examples.zh: 老師使用互動遊戲，讓英文課變得更有趣。

examples.en: The company hired fifty new employees for its software department.
examples.zh: 這家公司為其軟體部門招聘了五十名新員工。

examples.en: Every full-time employee receives health insurance and paid vacation.
examples.zh: 每位正職員工都能獲得健康保險與有薪假期。

examples.en: She is a hard-working employee who always arrives on time.
examples.zh: 她是一位勤奮的員工，總是準時到班。

examples.en: The employer provides medical insurance for all full-time workers.
examples.zh: 雇主為所有正職員工提供醫療保險。

examples.en: She asked her former employer for a recommendation letter.
examples.zh: 她向她的前雇主索取推薦信。

examples.en: A good employer listens to the suggestions of staff.
examples.zh: 好的雇主會聽取員工的建議。

examples.en: My water bottle was completely empty after the long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，我的水壺完全空了。

examples.en: We walked through the empty streets late at night.
examples.zh: 我們在深夜裡走過空無一人的街道。

examples.en: He gave an empty promise that nobody really believed.
examples.zh: 他給出了一個根本沒人相信的空頭支票。

examples.en: Please empty the trash bin before you leave today.
examples.zh: 今天離開前請清空垃圾桶。

examples.en: She emptied her school bag to clean out old paper.
examples.zh: 她倒空了書包以清理舊紙張。

examples.en: Workers emptied the water tank for its annual inspection.
examples.zh: 工人排空了水箱以進行年度檢查。

examples.en: This new software will enable us to complete the project faster.
examples.zh: 這款新軟體能讓我們更快完成專案。

examples.en: Regular practice enables students to speak English with confidence.
examples.zh: 定期練習能讓學生有自信地說英文。

examples.en: Modern technology enables people to work from almost anywhere.
examples.zh: 現代科技使人們幾乎可以在任何地方工作。

examples.en: Teachers always encourage students to ask questions freely.
examples.zh: 老師總是鼓勵學生自由提問。

examples.en: My parents encourage me to pursue my interest in music.
examples.zh: 我父母鼓勵我追求對音樂的興趣。

examples.en: Good habits encourage better focus during exam preparation.
examples.zh: 良好的習慣能在備考期間促進更好的專注力。

examples.en: We stayed until the end of the concert late last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚一直待到演唱會結束為止。

examples.en: Walk to the end of the long hallway and turn left.
examples.zh: 走到長走廊的盡頭然後向左轉。

examples.en: They achieved their primary goal at the end of this year.
examples.zh: 他們在今年年底實現了他們的首要目標。

examples.en: The movie will end in about ten minutes from now.
examples.zh: 這部電影在大約十分鐘後就會結束。

examples.en: They decided to end the long discussion and make a choice.
examples.zh: 他們決定結束這場漫長的討論並做出選擇。

examples.en: The rainy season usually ends by late spring in this region.
examples.zh: 該地區的雨季通常會在春末結束。

examples.en: The novel had a surprising ending nobody could predict.
examples.zh: 這本小說有個沒人能預測到的驚喜結局。

examples.en: Movie critics praised the emotional ending of this new drama.
examples.zh: 電影影評人稱讚了這齣新戲劇令人感動的結尾。

examples.en: They lived happily ever after in the story's ending.
examples.zh: 他們在故事的結局裡過著幸福快樂的生活。

examples.en: The brave soldiers defended their hometown against the enemy.
examples.zh: 英勇的士兵們保護他們的家鄉抵禦敵人。

examples.en: Ignorance is often considered the greatest enemy of progress.
examples.zh: 無知常被認為是進步的最大敵人。

examples.en: They managed to escape from the enemy camp in the dark.
examples.zh: 他們成功在黑暗中逃離了敵人的營地。

examples.en: Eating a nutritious breakfast provides energy for the whole morning.
examples.zh: 吃營養的早餐為整個早晨提供精力。

examples.en: Solar panels absorb sunlight and convert it into electrical energy.
examples.zh: 太陽能板吸收陽光並將其轉化為電能。

examples.en: Young children always seem to have endless energy.
examples.zh: 小孩子似乎總是有用不完的精力。

examples.en: The powerful airplane engine roared loudly as it accelerated.
examples.zh: 強大的飛機引擎在加速時發出巨大的轟鳴聲。

examples.en: He opened the car hood to inspect the steaming engine block.
examples.zh: 他打開車蓋檢查冒著蒸氣的引擎組件。

examples.en: Regular oil changes keep your vehicle's engine running smoothly.
examples.zh: 定期更換機油可維持您車輛的引擎運作順暢。

examples.en: My older brother works as a software engineer in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在台北擔任軟體工程師。

examples.en: The civil engineer inspected the new bridge before it opened.
examples.zh: 土木工程師在大橋通車前進行了檢查。

examples.en: We need an experienced engineer to solve this technical issue.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位很有經驗的工程師來解決這個技術問題。

examples.en: The team engineered a new system to reduce energy waste.
examples.zh: 團隊設計了一套新系統來減少能源浪費。

examples.en: They managed to engineer a clever solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 他們成功謀劃出一個聰明的解決方案。

examples.en: The company engineered a lightweight bicycle for racing.
examples.zh: 這家公司設計了一款用於比賽的輕量化自行車。

examples.en: We really enjoy walking along the beach in the evening.
examples.zh: 我們非常享受傍晚沿著海灘散步。

examples.en: I hope you enjoy your holiday trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 我希望你享受去日本的度假旅行。

examples.en: She enjoys reading mystery novels in her free time.
examples.zh: 她空閒時喜歡閱讀推理小說。

examples.en: We have enough time to eat lunch before the movie starts.
examples.zh: 我們在電影開始前有足夠的時間吃午餐。

examples.en: There were not enough chairs in the room for all the guests.
examples.zh: 房間裡沒有足夠的椅子給所有客人坐。

examples.en: Do you have enough money to buy a ticket for the concert?
examples.zh: 你有足夠的錢買一張演唱會門票嗎？

examples.en: He spoke clearly enough for everyone in the back row to hear.
examples.zh: 他說得夠清楚，讓後排的每個人都能聽見。

examples.en: The weather is warm enough for us to go swimming today.
examples.zh: 今天的天氣夠暖和，我們可以去游泳。

examples.en: Surprisingly, she finished the difficult test quickly enough.
examples.zh: 令人驚訝的是，她相當快速地完成了這項艱難的測驗。

examples.en: I have eaten enough and cannot take another bite of dessert.
examples.zh: 我已經吃飽了，甜點一口也吃不下了。

examples.en: Enough has been said about this topic, so let's move on.
examples.zh: 關於這個話題說得已經夠多了，我們繼續下一個吧。

examples.en: Two slices of bread will be enough for my breakfast.
examples.zh: 兩片吐司對我的早餐來說就足夠了。

examples.en: Please knock on the door before you enter the principal's office.
examples.zh: 進入校長室之前請先敲門。

examples.en: Enter your account password to log into the online system.
examples.zh: 輸入你的帳戶密碼以登入線上系統。

examples.en: Many talented artists entered the national drawing competition this year.
examples.zh: 今年許多有天賦的藝術家參加了全國繪畫比賽。

examples.en: The entire family gathered to celebrate Grandma's birthday.
examples.zh: 全家人聚集在一起慶祝祖母的生日。

examples.en: He spent the entire afternoon repairing his old bicycle in the garage.
examples.zh: 他花了一整下午在車庫修理他的舊腳踏車。

examples.en: The entire village was covered in a thick layer of snow.
examples.zh: 整個村莊被覆蓋在一層厚厚的雪中。

examples.en: Please meet me at the main entrance of the museum.
examples.zh: 請在博物館的大門入口處與我會合。

examples.en: The staff checked our passes at the gallery entrance.
examples.zh: 工作人員在展覽館入口檢查了我們的通行證。

examples.en: Entrance to the park is free for children under twelve.
examples.zh: 十二歲以下的兒童可免費進入公園。

examples.en: Please put your handwritten letter inside the paper envelope before mailing it.
examples.zh: 寄出前請將你的手寫信放入紙信封內。

examples.en: He sealed the envelope carefully and put a postage stamp on it.
examples.zh: 他仔細封好信封並貼上郵票。

examples.en: The invitation arrived in a gold envelope with her name printed on it.
examples.zh: 邀請函裝在一個印有她名字的金黃色信封裡寄達。

examples.en: We should reduce plastic waste to protect our natural environment.
examples.zh: 我們應該減少塑膠垃圾以保護我們的自然環境。

examples.en: The new elementary school creates a comfortable learning environment for children.
examples.zh: 這所新小學為孩子們營造了一個舒適的學習環境。

examples.en: Air pollution poses a serious threat to the urban environment.
examples.zh: 空氣污染對都市環境構成了嚴重威脅。

examples.en: Plastic pollution causes serious environmental damage to marine life.
examples.zh: 塑膠污染對海洋生物造成嚴重的環境傷害。

examples.en: The group aims to raise public environmental awareness.
examples.zh: 該團體旨在提高大眾的環保意識。

examples.en: We should adopt environmental protection habits in our daily lives.
examples.zh: 我們應該在日常生活中養成環境保護的習慣。

examples.en: Both teams received an equal amount of time to complete the challenge.
examples.zh: 兩隊獲得了相等的時間來完成挑戰。

examples.en: All citizens should enjoy equal opportunities in education and employment.
examples.zh: 所有公民在教育和就業方面都應該享有平等的機會。

examples.en: Divide the birthday cake into eight equal slices for the children.
examples.zh: 把生日蛋糕切成大小相等的八塊，分給孩子們。

examples.en: Two plus three equals five in basic math equations.
examples.zh: 在基礎數學算式中，二加三等於五。

examples.en: No performance this evening could equal her amazing piano solo.
examples.zh: 今晚沒有任何演出比得上她令人驚嘆的鋼琴獨奏。

examples.en: Her score on the quiz equaled mine, so we shared first place.
examples.zh: 她的小考成績和我的一樣，所以我們並列第一名。

examples.en: Use an eraser to clean up the pencil marks on the page.
examples.zh: 用橡皮擦清除頁面上鉛筆痕跡。

examples.en: I borrowed an eraser from my classmate during class.
examples.zh: 在上課期間我向同班同學借了一塊橡皮擦。

examples.en: The teacher wiped the blackboard with a large eraser.
examples.zh: 老師用一塊大板擦擦乾淨黑板。

examples.en: There is a spelling error in the second paragraph of your essay.
examples.zh: 你的文章第二段有一個拼字錯誤。

examples.en: The computer program stopped working due to a system error.
examples.zh: 電腦程式因為系統錯誤而停止運作。

examples.en: Human error was the main cause of the train accident.
examples.zh: 人為錯誤是這起火車事故的主要原因。

examples.en: The little bird escaped from the open cage yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 小鳥昨天早上從打開的籠子裡逃跑了。

examples.en: They managed to escape the burning building without any injury.
examples.zh: 他們設法逃離了火災建築物且沒有受傷。

examples.en: We went to the beach to escape the summer heat.
examples.zh: 我們去海灘躲避夏日的酷熱。

examples.en: Reading fantasy books offers a pleasant escape from daily stress.
examples.zh: 閱讀奇幻書籍提供了遠離日常壓力的一種愉快逃避。

examples.en: The clever thief made a narrow escape from police officers.
examples.zh: 這個聰明的竊賊險些從警察手中逃脫。

examples.en: The cat made a quick escape through the open window.
examples.zh: 貓咪從敞開的窗戶迅速逃走了。

examples.en: I love eating fruit in summer, especially fresh watermelon.
