examples.zh: 我喜歡在夏天吃水果，尤其是新鮮的西瓜。

examples.en: This coat was designed especially for extremely cold winter days.
examples.zh: 這件大衣是特別為極度寒冷的冬日所設計的。

examples.en: She was especially happy because she passed her driving test.
examples.zh: 她特別高興，因為她通過了駕照考試。

examples.en: Students were asked to write a short essay about nature.
examples.zh: 學生們被要求寫一篇關於自然的短文。

examples.en: Her English essay won first prize in the national competition.
examples.zh: 她的英文文章在全國比賽中獲得頭獎。

examples.en: Please hand in your history essay before Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 請在週五下午前交出你的歷史短文。

examples.en: The family gathered for a big feast on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 全家人在聖誕節前夕聚在一起享用大餐。

examples.en: On the eve of the examination, she reviewed her notes.
examples.zh: 在考試前夕，她複習了自己的筆記。

examples.en: People held a huge party on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 人們在跨年夜舉辦了盛大的派對。

examples.en: He finished the difficult task even faster than his manager expected.
examples.zh: 他完成這項艱巨任務的速度甚至比主管預期的更快。

examples.en: She did not even say goodbye before leaving the party early.
examples.zh: 她提早離開派對前甚至沒有說再見。

examples.en: Even young kids can learn this simple card game very quickly.
examples.zh: 甚至連小孩子都能非常快速地學會這個簡單的紙牌遊戲。

examples.en: Two, four, six, and eight are all even numbers in math.
examples.zh: 二、四、六、八在數學中都是偶數。

examples.en: Make sure the ground is even before pitching your camping tent.
examples.zh: 搭設露營帳篷前請確保地面是平坦的。

examples.en: The two teams played well and kept the final score even.
examples.zh: 兩隊表現出色，使最終比分保持平手。

examples.en: We went for a relaxing stroll along the river this evening.
examples.zh: 今天傍晚我們沿著河邊散步放鬆。

examples.en: The cool evening breeze refreshed everyone after a hot day.
examples.zh: 炎熱的一天過後，涼爽的晚風讓每個人神清氣爽。

examples.en: They gathered around the dining table for a pleasant evening.
examples.zh: 他們圍坐在餐桌旁度過愉快的夜晚。

examples.en: The school organized a fundraising event for charity last week.
examples.zh: 學校上週舉辦了一場慈善募款活動。

examples.en: The annual sports event attracted thousands of local citizens.
examples.zh: 這項年度體育賽事吸引了數千名在地市民。

examples.en: The wedding was a joyful event for both families.
examples.zh: 這場婚禮對雙方家庭來說都是一件令人喜悅的盛事。

examples.en: Have you ever visited the famous National Palace Museum in Taipei?
examples.zh: 你曾經造訪過台北著名的國立故宮博物院嗎？

examples.en: This is the best action movie I have ever seen in theaters.
examples.zh: 這是我在電影院看過最好看的動作片。

examples.en: Nothing exciting ever happens in this quiet little mountain town.
examples.zh: 在這個安靜的小山城裡從未發生過令人興奮的事。

examples.en: Every student in the class passed the final English exam.
examples.zh: 班上的每一個學生都通過了期末英文考試。

examples.en: The bus leaves the station every fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 公車每十五分鐘從車站發車一次。

examples.en: She reads every single page of the newspaper every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上讀報紙的每一頁。

examples.en: Everyone in the class completed the assignment.
examples.zh: 班上的每個人都完成了作業。

examples.en: Everyone was happy with the decision made yesterday.
examples.zh: 每個人都對昨天做出的決定感到滿意。

examples.en: I hope everyone has a wonderful weekend.
examples.zh: 我希望每個人都有個美好的週末。

examples.en: Everything on the menu at this local restaurant looks delicious.
examples.zh: 這家在地餐廳菜單上的每樣東西看起來都很美味。

examples.en: She packed everything she needed for the weekend trip into one bag.
examples.zh: 她把週末旅行所需的一切東西都打包進同一個包包裡。

examples.en: Health is more important than everything else in our lives.
examples.zh: 在我們的生活中，健康比其他任何事物都重要。

examples.en: The movie features an evil villain with dark plans.
examples.zh: 這部電影以一個帶有黑暗計劃的邪惡反派為特色。

examples.en: The evil witch put a spell on the princess.
examples.zh: 邪惡的巫婆對公主施了魔法。

examples.en: He gave an evil smile before closing the door.
examples.zh: 他在關門前露出了邪惡的笑容。

examples.en: The story describes the constant fight between good and evil.
examples.zh: 故事描述了善與惡之間不斷的鬥爭。

examples.en: Poverty is one of the biggest evils in society.
examples.zh: 貧窮是社會上最大的禍害之一。

examples.en: We must prevent such evil from happening in society.
examples.zh: 我們必須防止此類惡行在社會中發生。

examples.en: Could you tell me the exact time of the meeting?
examples.zh: 你能告訴我會議的確切時間嗎？

examples.en: The scientist needed exact measurements for her chemistry experiment.
examples.zh: 這位科學家在化學實驗中需要精確的測量數據。

examples.en: I do not remember his exact words from last night.
examples.zh: 我不記得他昨晚講的確切字句了。

examples.en: Students spent weeks preparing for the final medical school examination.
examples.zh: 學生們花了好幾週準備醫學院的期末考試。

examples.en: A thorough physical examination is recommended before joining the sports team.
examples.zh: 建議在加入運動隊伍前進行全面的身體檢查。

examples.en: Close examination of the contract revealed several minor typing errors.
examples.zh: 仔細審查合約後，發現了幾處輕微的打字錯誤。

examples.en: The doctor will examine your throat to see if it is infected.
examples.zh: 醫生會檢查你的喉嚨，看看是否發炎。

examples.en: The committee will examine the proposal carefully before making a final decision.
examples.zh: 委員會在做出最終決定前，將仔細審查這項提案。

examples.en: Customs officers examined all bags arriving from the international flight.
examples.zh: 海關人員檢查了所有來自國際航班的行李。

examples.en: Can you give me a clear example of this rule?
examples.zh: 你能給我一個關於這個規則的清晰例子嗎？

examples.en: The teacher wrote an example sentence on the board.
examples.zh: 老師在黑板上寫了一個例句。

examples.en: Parents should set a positive example for their children.
examples.zh: 父母應該為孩子樹立積極的榜樣。

examples.en: She got an excellent score on the final exam.
examples.zh: 她在期末考取得了極佳的成績。

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for its excellent customer service.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳以其優秀的顧客服務而聞名。

examples.en: That is an excellent idea for our school project!
examples.zh: 對於我們的學校專案來說，那是一個極好的點子！

examples.en: Everyone attended the meeting except the chief sales officer.
examples.zh: 除了業務長之外，大家都參加了會議。

examples.en: The shop is open every day except Sunday.
examples.zh: 這家店除了星期日之外天天營業。

examples.en: I like all vegetables except carrots.
examples.zh: 除了胡蘿蔔外，我喜歡所有蔬菜。

examples.en: The upcoming school trip excites most of the junior high students.
examples.zh: 即將到來的校外教學讓大多數國中生感到興奮。

examples.en: The news of the concert excited fans all over the city.
examples.zh: 音樂會的消息讓全城歌迷都感到興奮。

examples.en: Good movies always excite my interest in learning foreign languages.
examples.zh: 好電影總能激起我學習外語的興趣。

examples.en: The children were excited about going to the amusement park.
examples.zh: 孩子們對去遊樂園感到很興奮。

examples.en: She was excited to receive a thoughtful gift from her friend.
examples.zh: 她收到朋友送的貼心禮物感到很興奮。

examples.en: The excited crowd cheered loudly when the game finally started.
examples.zh: 當比賽終於開始時，興奮的人群大聲歡呼。

examples.en: Watching the basketball final live was an exciting experience for fans.
examples.zh: 現場觀看籃球決賽對球迷來說是一次令人興奮的體驗。

examples.en: She received an exciting job offer from an international technology firm.
examples.zh: 她收到了來自一家國際科技公司的令人興奮的求職錄取通知。

examples.en: The novel has an exciting story filled with unexpected plot turns.
examples.zh: 這本小說有一個令人興奮的故事，充滿了意想不到的情節轉折。

examples.en: Please excuse me for being late to the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會遲到了，請原諒我。

examples.en: The teacher excused the sick student from gym class.
examples.zh: 老師准許生病的學生不必上體育課。

examples.en: Nothing can excuse such rude behavior toward guests.
examples.zh: 沒有任何理由可以原諒對客人如此無禮的行為。

examples.en: He made up a lame excuse for missing class.
examples.zh: 他為曠課編造了一個蹩腳的藉口。

examples.en: Heavy traffic is not an acceptable excuse for tardiness.
examples.zh: 交通擁擠不是遲到可接受的理由。

examples.en: She offered no excuse and accepted her fault directly.
examples.zh: 她沒有找任何藉口，直接承認了自己的過錯。

examples.en: Regular exercise is essential for maintaining good health.
examples.zh: 定期運動對於保持健康至關重要。

examples.en: Complete the math exercise on page twenty for homework.
examples.zh: 完成第二十頁的數學練習作為作業。

examples.en: Morning exercises help me stay active throughout the day.
examples.zh: 晨間操有助於我整天保持活力。

examples.en: She likes to exercise in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 她喜歡每天早上在公園運動。

examples.en: You should exercise your muscles after sitting for hours.
examples.zh: 久坐幾個小時後，你應該鍛鍊一下肌肉。

examples.en: Dogs need space to run and exercise every day.
examples.zh: 狗每天需要空間來奔跑和運動。

examples.en: Many mysterious creatures exist deep under the dark ocean floor.
examples.zh: 許多神秘的生物存在於漆黑的海底深處。

examples.en: Dinosaurs used to exist on Earth millions of years ago.
examples.zh: 恐龍在數百萬年前曾經存在於地球上。

examples.en: Scientists wonder if life can exist on other distant planets.
examples.zh: 科學家想知道生命是否能存在於其他遙遠的行星上。

examples.en: Scientists are searching for signs of alien existence in space.
examples.zh: 科學家在太空尋找外星生命存在的跡象。

examples.en: The old wooden bridge came into existence long ago.
examples.zh: 這座古老的木橋很久以前就出現了。

examples.en: Do you believe in the existence of ghosts?
examples.zh: 你相信鬼魂的存在嗎？

examples.en: Please follow the green signs to locate the nearest emergency exit immediately.
examples.zh: 請立刻跟隨綠色指示牌找到最近的緊急出口。

examples.en: The actor made a dramatic exit from the stage after his final speech.
examples.zh: 這名演員說完最後一段台詞後，戲劇性地退場了。

examples.en: Take the second exit on the right when you reach the roundabout.
examples.zh: 當你到達環島時，請從右側的第二個出口駛出。

examples.en: Passengers should exit the train through the doors on the left side.
examples.zh: 乘客應從左側的車門下車。

examples.en: Please make sure to save your document before you exit the program.
examples.zh: 離開程式之前，請務必先儲存您的文件。

examples.en: The audience began to exit the theater as soon as the movie ended.
examples.zh: 電影一結束，觀眾就開始離開影廳。

examples.en: We expect the train to arrive on time this evening.
examples.zh: 我們預期火車今晚會準時到達。

examples.en: She didn't expect to see her classmate at the market.
examples.zh: 她沒想到會在市場遇到她的同學。

examples.en: Teachers expect all students to follow basic classroom rules.
examples.zh: 老師要求所有學生遵守基本的教室規則。

examples.en: Travel expenses will be covered by the company during business trips.
examples.zh: 出差期間的差旅開銷將由公司負擔。

examples.en: They cut unnecessary expenses to save money every month.
examples.zh: 他們減少不必要的開支，以便每個月存錢。

examples.en: Buying a new car is a major expense for a family.
examples.zh: 買新車對一個家庭來說是一筆重大支出。

examples.en: Buying a new sports car can be very expensive.
examples.zh: 買一輛新的跑車可能會非常昂貴。

examples.en: She wore an expensive diamond watch to the formal party.
examples.zh: 她戴著一隻昂貴的鑽石手錶去參加正式派對。

examples.en: Eating at fancy restaurants is too expensive for students.
examples.zh: 在高級餐廳用餐對學生來說太昂貴了。

examples.en: Traveling abroad alone was an unforgettable experience for the young student.
examples.zh: 獨自出國旅行對這位年輕學生來說是一次難忘的經歷。

examples.en: She has extensive work experience in managing international business projects.
examples.zh: 她在管理國際商業專案方面擁有豐富的工作經驗。

examples.en: Learning from personal failure is a valuable life experience for everyone.
examples.zh: 從個人的失敗中學習對每個人來說都是寶貴的人生經驗。

examples.en: Visitors can experience traditional local culture during the annual festival.
examples.zh: 遊客可以在一年一度的節慶期間體驗傳統的在地文化。

examples.en: The small town experienced severe flooding after the heavy rainfall.
examples.zh: 這座小鎮在大雨過後經歷了嚴重的水災。

examples.en: Many young adults experience stress when searching for their first job.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人在尋找第一份工作時都會經歷壓力。

examples.en: The company invited a computer security expert to inspect the network.
examples.zh: 該公司邀請了一位電腦安全專家來檢查網路。

examples.en: She is a leading expert on rare tropical plant species.
examples.zh: 她是稀有熱帶植物物種方面的頂尖專家。

examples.en: Consult an expert before investing money in complex financial markets.
examples.zh: 在將資金投資於複雜的金融市場之前，請諮詢專家。

examples.en: Under his expert guidance, the students won first place in the competition.
examples.zh: 在他的專業指導下，學生們贏得了比賽的第一名。

examples.en: The doctor provided expert medical advice to the injured patient.
examples.zh: 醫生為受傷病患提供了專業的醫療建議。

examples.en: She displayed expert skill in handling the delicate scientific equipment.
examples.zh: 她在操作精密的科學設備時展現了熟練的技巧。

examples.en: The teacher tried to explain the complex math rule clearly.
examples.zh: 老師試圖將這個複雜的數學規則解釋清楚。

examples.en: Can you explain why you were late for school today?
examples.zh: 你能解釋一下為什麼你今天上學遲到嗎？

examples.en: He used a simple chart to explain his new project.
examples.zh: 他用一張簡單的圖表來說明他的新專案。

examples.en: She used art to express her deep feelings and emotions.
examples.zh: 她用藝術來表達她深層的感受與情緒。

examples.en: Please express your opinion clearly during the team meeting.
examples.zh: 請在團隊會議期間清晰表達你的意見。

examples.en: He sent a card to express his gratitude to the teacher.
examples.zh: 他寄了一張卡片向老師表示感謝。

examples.en: We took the express to Kaohsiung and arrived in just ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘快車前往高雄，只花了九十分鐘就到了。

examples.en: The package was sent by express and arrived the next day.
examples.zh: 包裹以快遞寄出，隔天就到了。

examples.en: The airport express reaches the downtown terminal in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 機場快線二十分鐘內可到達市中心終點站。

examples.en: This package was delivered using our fastest express service.
examples.zh: 這包包裹是使用我們最快速的快遞服務送達的。

examples.en: Passengers can use the express lane to clear security fast.
examples.zh: 旅客可以使用快速通道快速通過安檢。

examples.en: The policy was created with the express purpose of helping students.
examples.zh: 該政策建立的明確目的就是為了幫助學生。

examples.en: Her facial expression changed as soon as she heard the news.
examples.zh: 她一聽到消息，臉上的表情就變了。

examples.en: Writing poetry is a creative expression of feelings and inner thoughts.
examples.zh: 寫詩是一種情感與內心想法的創意表達。

examples.en: Piece of cake is a common English expression meaning very easy.
examples.zh: 「Piece of cake」是一個常見的英文短語，意思是輕而易舉。

examples.en: Do you need an extra blanket for the bed?
examples.zh: 你的床需要一條額外的毯子嗎？

examples.en: He works extra hours to earn more money.
examples.zh: 他加班工作以賺取更多的錢。

examples.en: The teacher gave the class extra time to finish.
examples.zh: 老師給了全班額外的時間來完成。

examples.en: You should be extra careful when driving in rain.
examples.zh: 雨天開車時你應該格外小心。

examples.en: The soup tastes extra delicious with fresh herbs added.
examples.zh: 加了新鮮香草後，這湯喝起來特別美味。

examples.en: She felt extra tired after the long hiking trip.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行長途跋涉後，她感到格外疲倦。

examples.en: Breakfast is included so there are no hidden extras.
examples.zh: 早餐已包含在內，因此沒有隱藏的額外費用。

examples.en: He worked as a movie extra during his summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他在暑假期間擔任電影臨時演員。

examples.en: Air conditioning is a paid extra in this apartment.
examples.zh: 冷氣在這間公寓是額外付費項目。

examples.en: She closed her left eye to look through a microscope.
examples.zh: 她閉上左眼看顯微鏡。

examples.en: The bright sun made him close his eyes.
examples.zh: 刺眼的陽光讓他閉上了眼睛。

examples.en: Keep a watchful eye on a young child near the water.
examples.zh: 在水邊時要密切留意照顧小孩子。

examples.en: He raised one eyebrow in surprise when he heard the unexpected news.
examples.zh: 聽到這個出乎意料的消息時，他驚訝地抬起一邊眉毛。

examples.en: She accidentally shaved off part of her left eyebrow this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上不小心刮掉了左邊的一部分眉毛。

examples.en: Sweat ran down his forehead and was stopped by his eyebrow.
examples.zh: 汗水從他的額頭流下，被他的眉毛擋住了。

examples.en: She washed her face with cold water to wake up in the morning.
examples.zh: 她早上用冷水洗臉來提神。

examples.en: A bright smile appeared on his face when he received the gift.
examples.zh: 當他收到禮物時，臉上露出了燦爛的微笑。

examples.en: The clock face has Roman numerals on it.
examples.zh: 鐘面上有羅馬數字。

examples.en: Our classroom window faces east, so we get bright sunlight every morning.
examples.zh: 我們教室的窗戶朝東，所以每天早晨都有明亮的陽光。

examples.en: You must be brave enough to face your mistakes and correct them.
examples.zh: 你必須夠勇敢去面對自己的錯誤並加以改正。

examples.en: The house faces a quiet park with many tall green trees.
examples.zh: 這棟房子面向一個擁有許多高大綠樹的安靜公園。

examples.en: It is a proven fact that smoking damages your lungs.
examples.zh: 吸菸會損害肺部是一個經證實的事實。

examples.en: The reporter checked all the facts before publishing the news.
examples.zh: 記者在發表新聞前核對了所有的事實。

examples.en: In fact, I have already finished all my homework today.
examples.zh: 事實上，我今天已經完成了所有的作業。

examples.en: Price is an important factor when choosing a new smartphone.
examples.zh: 選擇新智慧型手機時，價格是一個重要因素。

examples.en: Hard work and good luck were major factors in success.
examples.zh: 努力工作與好運是成功的主要因素。

examples.en: Environmental factors can influence the growth rate of green plants.
examples.zh: 環境因素會影響綠色植物的生長速度。

examples.en: The factory produces thousands of bicycles every month.
examples.zh: 這家工廠每個月生產數千輛自行車。

examples.en: Many local workers are employed at the automobile factory.
examples.zh: 許多在地工人受僱於這家汽車工廠。

examples.en: Strict safety rules must be followed inside the factory.
examples.zh: 工廠內部必須嚴格遵守安全守則。

examples.en: He studied hard because he did not want to fail the exam.
examples.zh: 他努力讀書，因為他不想考試不及格。

examples.en: The brake system failed while the car was on the hill.
examples.zh: 車子在山坡上時煞車系統故障了。

examples.en: Many startups fail within their first year of business.
examples.zh: 許多新創公司在創業的第一年內就失敗了。

examples.en: A grade below sixty is considered a fail in this course.
examples.zh: 在這門課程中，六十分以下的成績被視為不及格。

examples.en: The test result showed two passes and one fail.
examples.zh: 考試結果顯示兩科通過、一科不及格。

examples.en: Students who get a fail must retake the course.
examples.zh: 不及格的學生必須重修這門課。

examples.en: Learning from failure is essential for personal growth.
examples.zh: 從失敗中學習對個人成長至關重要。

examples.en: The flight was delayed due to engine failure.
examples.zh: 航班因引擎故障而延誤。

examples.en: Despite his best efforts, the project ended in failure.
examples.zh: 儘管他盡了最大努力，該專案最終仍以失敗告終。

examples.en: The teacher ensured every student got a fair chance.
examples.zh: 老師確保每位學生都能獲得公平的機會。

examples.en: Five hundred dollars seems like a fair price here.
examples.zh: 五百美元在這裡似乎是一個合理的價格。

examples.en: We had fair weather during our vacation in Kenting.
examples.zh: 我們在墾丁的假期中都有晴朗的天氣。

examples.en: The annual job fair attracted thousands of young graduates.
examples.zh: 一年一度的就業展覽會吸引了數千名年輕畢業生。

examples.en: Children had fun riding the Ferris wheel at the fair.
examples.zh: 孩子們在園遊會上搭摩天輪玩得很開心。

examples.en: Our school is holding a book fair in the library.
examples.zh: 我們學校正在圖書館舉辦書展。

examples.en: Yellow leaves begin to fall from the trees in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天時黃葉開始從樹上落下。

examples.en: He slipped on the icy sidewalk and fell down hard.
examples.zh: 他在結冰的人行道上滑倒並重重跌了一跤。

examples.en: Oil prices fell sharply after the announcement yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 昨天早上宣布消息後，油價急劇下跌。

examples.en: We plan to visit Japan in the fall to see the red leaves.
examples.zh: 我們計畫秋天訪問日本賞楓。

examples.en: The old man suffered a dangerous fall on the stairs.
examples.zh: 這位老人在樓梯上危險地摔了一跤。

examples.en: There was a sudden fall in temperature over the weekend.
examples.zh: 週末期間氣溫突然下降。

examples.en: The student marked the answer as false on the history test.
examples.zh: 學生在歷史測驗中將答案標記為錯誤的。

examples.en: Spreading false information on social media can confuse many people easily.
examples.zh: 在社群媒體上散播虛假資訊很容易使許多人混淆。

examples.en: He gave a false name to the receptionist at the hotel.
examples.zh: 他向飯店接待員給了一個假的名字。

examples.en: My family gathers together for dinner every Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 我們家人每個星期天晚上都會聚在一起吃晚餐。

examples.en: She came from a very large and close family.
examples.zh: 她來自一個非常龐大且關係親密的家庭。

examples.en: He bought a comfortable house for his growing family.
examples.zh: 他為他不斷擴大的家庭買了一棟舒適的房子。

examples.en: Taiwan is famous for its delicious night market food.
examples.zh: 台灣以美味的夜市小吃聞名。

examples.en: The famous singer drew thousands of fans to the concert.
examples.zh: 這位著名歌手吸引了數千名歌迷來到演唱會。

examples.en: This historic temple is a famous tourist destination here.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的寺廟是這裡著名的觀光景點。

examples.en: Turn on the electric fan to cool down the hot room quickly.
examples.zh: 打開電風扇以快速讓炎熱的房間降溫。

examples.en: Thousands of excited football fans cheered loudly in the stadium.
examples.zh: 數千名興奮的球迷在體育場內大聲歡呼。

examples.en: She has been a huge fan of this famous singer since middle school.
examples.zh: 她從國中起就是這位知名歌手的超級粉絲。

examples.en: She used a folded magazine to fan herself in the heat.
examples.zh: 在酷熱中，她用一本摺起來的雜誌替自己搧風。

examples.en: Gentle sea breezes fanned our faces as we walked along the beach.
examples.zh: 當我們沿著海灘散步時，微柔的海風吹拂著我們的臉。

examples.en: He fanned the campfire to make the flames burn brighter.
examples.zh: 他對著營火搧風，讓火焰燒得更旺。

examples.en: How far is your house from the school?
examples.zh: 你的家離學校有多遠？

examples.en: We walked far into the mountains yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 我們昨天早上走進山裡很遠的地方。

examples.en: She lives far away from the city center.
examples.zh: 她住得離市中心很遠。

examples.en: They live on the far side of the river.
examples.zh: 他們住在河的另一邊。

examples.en: The library is located at the far end of the hallway.
examples.zh: 圖書館位於走廊的盡頭。

examples.en: She sat at the far corner of the room.
examples.zh: 她坐在房間最遠的角落。

examples.en: My uncle owns a large farm in the countryside.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在鄉下擁有一座大農場。

examples.en: We saw many sheep and cows on the organic farm.
examples.zh: 我們在有機農場上看到了許多綿羊和乳牛。

examples.en: Fresh vegetables are sent daily from the farm to the market.
examples.zh: 新鮮蔬菜每天從農場運送到市場。

examples.en: His family has farmed this fertile land for three generations.
examples.zh: 他家已經在這片肥沃的土地上務農三代了。

examples.en: Many young people return home to farm organic crops now.
examples.zh: 現在許多年輕人返回家鄉種植有機作物。

examples.en: They farm pigs and chickens to earn a decent living.
examples.zh: 他們養豬養雞來維持體面的生活。

examples.en: The hardworking farmer gets up early to tend his crops.
examples.zh: 勤勞的農夫很早起床照料作物。

examples.en: Local farmers grow organic vegetables and sell them at market.
examples.zh: 在地農民種植有機蔬菜並在市場販售。

examples.en: The farmer harvested tons of golden wheat before the rain.
examples.zh: 農夫在下雨前收割了數噸黃金小麥。

examples.en: She works as a designer in the fashion industry.
examples.zh: 她在時尚界擔任設計師。

examples.en: Wide-leg pants have come back into fashion recently.
examples.zh: 寬褲最近又重新流行起來。

examples.en: The magazine features the latest spring fashion trends.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌特別報導了最新的春季流行趨勢。

examples.en: He is the fastest runner on the school track team.
examples.zh: 他是學校田徑隊裡跑得最快的選手。

examples.en: We took the fast train to arrive at our destination early.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘快速列車，以便提早抵達目的地。

examples.en: This new computer has a very fast processing speed.
examples.zh: 這台新電腦擁有非常快的處理速度。

examples.en: Drive fast or we will miss our flight at the airport.
examples.zh: 開快一點，否則我們會錯過機場的航班。

examples.en: Hold fast to the railing while walking down the stairs.
examples.zh: 走下樓梯時請緊緊抓住扶手。

examples.en: The tired baby fell fast asleep in his mother's arms.
examples.zh: 疲憊的寶寶在媽媽懷裡很快就熟睡了。

examples.en: Some people fast for medical tests in the morning.
examples.zh: 有些人為了早上的醫療檢查而禁食。

examples.en: They fast for religious reasons during the special holy month.
examples.zh: 他們在特殊的聖月期間因宗教原因進行齋戒。

examples.en: The patient was instructed to fast overnight before the surgery.
examples.zh: 病人被指示在手術前禁食一整夜。

examples.en: The fat cat slept peacefully on the soft sofa.
examples.zh: 那隻肥胖的貓平靜地睡在柔軟的沙發上。

examples.en: Avoid eating too much fried food high in fat.
examples.zh: 避免吃太多脂肪含量高的炸物。

examples.en: He wants to lose weight because he feels fat.
examples.zh: 他想減重，因為他覺得自己變胖了。

examples.en: Animal fat is used in traditional baking recipes sometimes.
examples.zh: 動物脂肪有時會用於傳統的烘焙食譜中。

examples.en: Daily exercise helps burn excess body fat effectively.
examples.zh: 每天運動有助於有效燃燒多餘的體脂肪。

examples.en: Check the total fat content listed on the food package.
examples.zh: 檢查食品包裝上記載的總脂肪含量。

examples.en: They believed it was fate that brought them together.
examples.zh: 他們相信是命運讓他們相聚。

examples.en: The fate of the town's historic landmark hangs in the balance.
examples.zh: 鎮上歷史地標的命運懸而未決。

examples.en: He accepted his fate with calmness and great dignity.
examples.zh: 他平靜且非常尊嚴地接受了自己的命運。

examples.en: My father taught me how to ride a bicycle years ago.
examples.zh: 多年前我父親教我如何騎自行車。

examples.en: Her father works as an experienced engineer in a big company.
examples.zh: 她父親在一家大公司擔任經驗豐富的工程師。

examples.en: The loving father read a bedtime story to his young children.
examples.zh: 這位慈愛的父親向他的幼童朗讀睡前故事。

examples.en: It was my fault that we missed the morning train.
examples.zh: 我們錯過了早班火車是我的過錯。

examples.en: Every human being has minor faults that can be forgiven.
examples.zh: 每個人都有可以被原諒的小缺點。

examples.en: Engineers discovered a technical fault in the power supply line.
examples.zh: 工程師在供電線路中發現了技術故障。

examples.en: Could you please do me a favor and carry this box?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我一個忙，搬這個箱子嗎？

examples.en: The mayor is currently in favor of the public transport plan.
examples.zh: 市長目前支持公共運輸計畫。

examples.en: He owes his teacher a huge favor for helping him graduate.
examples.zh: 他欠老師一個天大的人情，因為老師幫助他順利畢業。

examples.en: Many voters favor the candidate who promises lower taxes.
examples.zh: 許多選民支持承諾減稅的候選人。

examples.en: Parents should not favor one child over another at home.
examples.zh: 父母在家不應該偏愛其中一個孩子勝過另一個。

examples.en: Warm weather favors the growth of these tropical plants.
examples.zh: 溫暖的天氣有利於這些熱帶植物的生長。

examples.en: Chocolate ice cream is my favorite dessert on hot summer days.
examples.zh: 巧克力冰淇淋是我在炎熱夏天最喜愛的甜點。

examples.en: What is your favorite subject to study in high school?
examples.zh: 你在高中最喜愛的學習科目是什麼？

examples.en: This scenic park is her favorite place for a morning jog.
examples.zh: 這座風景優美的公園是她最喜愛的晨跑地點。

examples.en: Among all these books, this novel is my personal favorite.
examples.zh: 在所有這些書中，這本小說是我個人的最愛。

examples.en: The experienced runner is the clear favorite to win the race.
examples.zh: 這位經驗豐富的跑者顯然是贏得比賽的大熱門。

examples.en: Add this useful website to your browser favorites for quick access.
examples.zh: 將這個實用的網站加入瀏覽器最愛以便快速造訪。

senses.zh: 最喜愛的人事物；有望獲勝者

examples.en: She tried to overcome her fear of public speaking gracefully.
examples.zh: 她努力優雅地克服對公開演講的恐懼。

examples.en: The child held his mother's hand tightly in fear of the dark.
examples.zh: 孩子因為怕黑，緊緊握住媽媽的手。

examples.en: She felt a wave of fear before stepping onto the stage.
examples.zh: 她在登上舞台前感到一陣恐懼。

examples.en: Many people fear making mistakes when learning a foreign language.
examples.zh: 許多人在學習外語時害怕犯錯。

examples.en: You should not fear trying new things in your life.
examples.zh: 你不應該害怕在生活中嘗試新事物。

examples.en: Farmers fear that the cold weather will destroy their crops.
examples.zh: 農夫們害怕寒冷的天氣會摧毀他們的作物。

examples.en: The main feature of this new phone is its battery life.
examples.zh: 這支新手機的主要特色是它的電池續航力。

examples.en: Her facial features closely resemble those of her older sister.
examples.zh: 她的面貌特徵與她的姊姊非常相似。

examples.en: This application includes a useful search feature for fast navigation.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式包含一個有用的搜尋功能以利快速瀏覽。

examples.en: The museum concert will feature several world-famous musicians tonight.
examples.zh: 博物館今晚的音樂會將以幾位世界著名的音樂家為特色。

examples.en: The new action movie features a popular young actor.
examples.zh: 這部新的動作電影由一位受歡迎的年輕演員主演。

examples.en: The menu features local organic vegetables and fresh seafood.
examples.zh: 菜單以當地的有機蔬菜和新鮮海鮮為特色。

examples.en: You must pay an entrance fee before entering the museum.
examples.zh: 進入博物館前，你必須支付入場費。

examples.en: The lawyer charges a high fee for legal advice.
examples.zh: 這位律師收取高額的法律諮詢費。

examples.en: There is an extra delivery fee for international orders.
examples.zh: 國際訂單需支付額外運費。

examples.en: Don't forget to feed the cat before leaving home.
examples.zh: 出門前別忘了給貓餵食。

examples.en: The mother feeds her baby every three hours.
examples.zh: 那位媽媽每三個小時餵一次寶寶。

examples.en: Farmers feed their cows fresh green grass every morning.
examples.zh: 農夫每天早上用新鮮的綠草餵牛。

examples.en: I feel tired after working all day in the office.
examples.zh: 在辦公室工作了一整天後，我感到很累。

examples.en: This silk scarf feels soft and smooth.
examples.zh: 這條絲巾摸起來很柔軟平滑。

examples.en: She felt a sense of relief when the exam was over.
examples.zh: 考試結束時，她感到鬆了一口氣。

examples.en: The jacket has a smooth and comfortable feel.
examples.zh: 這件夾克有著平滑且舒適的觸感。

examples.en: I like the friendly feel of this small bookstore.
examples.zh: 我喜歡這家小書店溫馨的感覺。

examples.en: Get a feel for the car before driving on the highway.
examples.zh: 上高速公路前，先熟悉一下這台車的駕駛感覺。

examples.en: She had a sudden feeling that someone was coming.
examples.zh: 她突然有一種有人要來的感覺。

examples.en: I share your deep feeling of sadness about the news.
examples.zh: 我對這個新聞懷有與你相同的深切悲傷感受。

examples.en: Hot soup gives a warm comfortable feeling inside the body.
examples.zh: 喝熱湯會給身體內部帶來溫暖舒適的感覺。

examples.en: He encouraged his fellow students to join the club.
examples.zh: 他鼓勵他的同學加入這個社團。

examples.en: She shared her travel stories with fellow passengers on the train.
examples.zh: 她在火車上與同行的乘客分享她的旅行故事。

examples.en: We must show kindness toward our fellow human beings.
examples.zh: 我們必須對我們的同胞展現善意。

examples.en: He is a friendly fellow who always greets everyone warmly.
examples.zh: 他是一個總是溫暖地向大家打招呼的好傢伙。

examples.en: She was chosen as a research fellow at the university.
examples.zh: 她獲選為該大學的研究員。

examples.en: Look at that poor fellow standing alone in the rain.
examples.zh: 看看那個單獨站在雨中的可憐傢伙。

examples.en: The hospital opened a special clinic for female patients.
examples.zh: 這家醫院為女性患者開設了特別門診。

examples.en: Female lions usually work together to hunt large animals.
examples.zh: 母獅通常會合作捕獵大型動物。

examples.en: She was the first female president of this famous university.
examples.zh: 她是這所著名大學的第一位女性校長。

examples.en: Females outnumber males in this particular adult evening class.
examples.zh: 在這個特別的成人夜校班級中，女性人數多於男性。

examples.en: This medical center provides healthcare services specifically for females.
examples.zh: 這間醫療中心專門為女性提供醫療保健服務。

examples.en: Among these puppies, three are males and two are females.
examples.zh: 在這些幼犬中，三隻是公的，兩隻是母的。

examples.en: The annual music festival attracts thousands of fans.
examples.zh: 一年一度的音樂節吸引了數千名歌迷。

examples.en: Families gather to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
examples.zh: 家人們聚在一起慶祝元宵節。

examples.en: Street vendors sold delicious snacks during the festival.
examples.zh: 街頭攤販在節慶期間販售美味的小吃。

examples.en: The child had a high fever and was advised to rest.
examples.zh: 這名孩子發高燒，被建議多休息。

examples.en: Her mother checked her temperature with a thermometer because she had a fever.
examples.zh: 她媽媽因為她發燒，用體溫計量了她的體溫。

examples.en: Baseball fever spread across the nation during the championship series.
examples.zh: 在總冠軍賽期間，棒球狂熱蔓延了全國。

examples.en: Only a few people attended the morning lecture today.
examples.zh: 今天只有很少人參加早上的講座。

examples.en: He has few friends in the new city he moved to.
examples.zh: 在他搬到的新城市裡，他幾乎沒有朋友。

examples.en: There were few errors in her final essay.
examples.zh: 她的期末論文裡幾乎沒有錯誤。

examples.en: Many were invited, but only a few actually came.
examples.zh: 許多人被邀請，但實際上只有少數人前來。

examples.en: A few of the apples in the basket were rotten.
examples.zh: 籃子裡的蘋果有少數幾顆爛掉了。

examples.en: Few of the students arrived on time for the first class.
examples.zh: 很少學生準時到第一堂課。

examples.en: Green rice fields stretched across the wide country landscape.
examples.zh: 綠油油的稻田延伸穿過廣闊的鄉村景色。

examples.en: Students gathered on the sports field for morning exercise.
examples.zh: 學生們聚集在操場上做晨操。

examples.en: Dr. Wang is a leading expert in the field of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 王博士是人工智慧領域的頂尖專家。

examples.en: The two boys started to fight over a new toy.
examples.zh: 這兩個男孩開始為了新玩具打架。

examples.en: Doctors continue to fight against rare diseases in clinical trials.
examples.zh: 醫生們持續透過臨床試驗對抗罕見疾病。

examples.en: They fight frequently about minor money matters at home.
examples.zh: 他們在家裡經常為微小的金錢事務爭吵。

examples.en: A fight broke out between two students after school.
examples.zh: 放學後，兩名學生打了起來。

examples.en: She showed great determination in her fight against a serious illness.
examples.zh: 她在與重病的抗爭中表現出了極大的決心。

examples.en: The boxing fight ended with a spectacular knockout today.
examples.zh: 這場拳擊爭鬥在今天以精彩的擊倒結束。

examples.en: Sales figures increased significantly in the third quarter.
examples.zh: 銷售數字在第三季顯著增加。

examples.en: She maintains a healthy figure by swimming every week.
examples.zh: 她透過每週游泳保持健康的身材。

examples.en: Historical figures are remembered in local heritage museums.
examples.zh: 歷史人物會在當地的文化博物館中被銘記。

examples.en: I figure that we will arrive before seven o'clock.
examples.zh: 我認為我們會在七點以前到達。

examples.en: Experts figure the total repair costs will be high.
examples.zh: 專家估算總維修費用會很高。

examples.en: She figured out the difficult math problem at last.
examples.zh: 她終於解出了那道難解的數學題目。

examples.en: Please save your document file before closing the computer program.
examples.zh: 關閉電腦程式前，請儲存你的文件檔案。

examples.en: The secretary put the report in a blue file.
examples.zh: 秘書把報告放進一個藍色的資料夾。

examples.en: I need to organize these office paper files by date.
examples.zh: 我需要按日期整理這些辦公室紙本檔案。

examples.en: You need to file your annual tax return before May.
examples.zh: 你需要在五月前提出年度報稅。

examples.en: The clerk filed the documents alphabetically in the official archive.
examples.zh: 職員將文件按字母順序歸檔於官方檔案庫中。

examples.en: The victim decided to file a complaint with the police station.
examples.zh: 受害者決定向警察局提出投訴。

examples.en: Please fill this glass with cold drinking water for me.
examples.zh: 請幫我把這個玻璃杯裝滿冷飲用水。

examples.en: You need to fill out this application form completely.
examples.zh: 你需要完整填寫這份申請表格。

examples.en: The sweet smell of freshly baked bread filled the room.
examples.zh: 剛出爐的麵包香味充滿了整個房間。

examples.en: Tomorrow is the final deadline for submitting the project report.
examples.zh: 明天是繳交專案報告的最後期限。

examples.en: The teacher announced the final results of the exam today.
examples.zh: 老師今天公布了考試的最終結果。

examples.en: After long negotiations, they reached a final agreement.
examples.zh: 經過長時間的談判，他們達成了最終協議。

examples.en: Students are studying hard in the library for their finals.
examples.zh: 學生們正在圖書館裡努力準備期末考。

examples.en: Both teams worked hard to reach the basketball final.
examples.zh: 兩支隊伍都努力奮戰以打進籃球決賽。

examples.en: He scored the winning goal in the tournament final.
examples.zh: 他在錦標賽決賽中射入了致勝的一球。

examples.en: After hours of waiting, the train finally arrived at the platform.
examples.zh: 經過數小時的等待，火車終於到達了月台。

examples.en: She worked hard for years and finally achieved her dream.
examples.zh: 她努力多年，終於實現了她的夢想。

examples.en: Finally, add a pinch of salt to complete the dish.
examples.zh: 最後加入少許鹽巴以完成這道菜。

examples.en: I cannot find my house keys anywhere in my room.
examples.zh: 我在房間裡哪裡都找不到我的房屋鑰匙。

examples.en: Scientists found a rare species of frog in the rainforest.
examples.zh: 科學家在熱帶雨林中發現了一種稀有的青蛙品種。

examples.en: I find learning foreign languages both challenging and very fun.
examples.zh: 我覺得學習外國語言既有挑戰性又非常有趣。

examples.en: This ancient gold coin was a remarkable archaeological find.
examples.zh: 這枚古代金幣是一個卓越的考古發現。

examples.en: The vintage jacket I bought at the market was a great find.
examples.zh: 我在市集買到的這件復古外套真是個超值的寶物。

examples.en: The researchers shared their latest finds at the conference.
examples.zh: 研究人員在研討會上分享了他們的最新發現。

examples.en: I feel fine today and am ready to start working.
examples.zh: 我今天感覺很好，準備好開始工作了。

examples.en: We went for a walk on a fine sunny morning.
examples.zh: 我們在一個晴朗陽光的早晨去散步。

examples.en: The sands on this tropical island beach are very fine.
examples.zh: 這個熱帶島嶼沙灘上的沙子非常細緻。

senses.zh: 好的；優秀的；晴朗的；細微的

examples.en: He had to pay a heavy fine for speeding yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天因為超速不得不繳納巨額罰款。

examples.en: Returning library books late will result in a daily fine.
examples.zh: 逾期歸還圖書館書籍將會產生每日罰款。

examples.en: The court imposed a traffic fine on the careless driver.
examples.zh: 法院對這名粗心的駕駛處以交通罰款。

examples.en: She wears a delicate gold ring on her ring finger.
examples.zh: 她在無名指上戴著一枚精緻的金戒指。

examples.en: He cut his index finger while slicing fresh onions.
examples.zh: 他在切新鮮洋蔥時割傷了食指。

examples.en: The baby held onto her mother's pinky finger tightly.
examples.zh: 小嬰兒緊緊握住媽媽的小指頭。

examples.en: Please finish your homework before watching television tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚看電視前請完成你的作業。

examples.en: They expect to finish building the bridge by next spring.
examples.zh: 他們預計明年春天前完成橋樑建造工程。

examples.en: He managed to finish the marathon in under three hours.
examples.zh: 他成功在三小時內跑完了馬拉松。

examples.en: The runners sprinted hard toward the finish line.
examples.zh: 跑者們奮力衝向終點線。

examples.en: The wooden table has a beautiful smooth shiny finish.
examples.zh: 這張木桌有著美麗平滑且亮麗的表面飾面。

examples.en: It was an exciting finish to a very close match.
examples.zh: 這是一場非常拉鋸的比賽的精采結尾。

examples.en: They sat around the fire to keep warm.
examples.zh: 他們圍坐在火堆旁取暖。

examples.en: Firefighters arrived quickly to put out the apartment fire.
examples.zh: 消防員迅速趕到撲滅公寓火災。

examples.en: Smoke rose into the sky from the burning forest fire.
examples.zh: 煙霧從燃燒的森林大火中升入空中。

examples.en: The hunter prepared to fire his rifle at the target.
examples.zh: 獵人準備向目標開火。

examples.en: The boss decided to fire the lazy worker yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 老闆昨天下午決定解僱這名懶惰的工人。

examples.en: They will fire off fireworks during the New Year celebration.
examples.zh: 他們將在跨年慶典期間發射煙火。

examples.en: She got a job at a famous law firm in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北一家知名的法律事務所找到了工作。

examples.en: The accounting firm audits financial records for several international companies.
examples.zh: 這家會計師事務所為幾家國際公司審計財務記錄。

examples.en: The firm announced plans to open a new branch in Kaohsiung next year.
examples.zh: 這家公司宣布明年將在高雄開設新的分公司。

examples.en: A firm handshake leaves a good impression during job interviews.
examples.zh: 求職面試時，堅定有力的握手會留下良好的印象。

examples.en: Make sure the ladder is placed on firm ground before climbing.
examples.zh: 攀爬前確保梯子放置在堅固的地面上。

examples.en: The mattress is firm enough to support your back comfortably.
examples.zh: 這床墊夠結實，能舒適地支撐你的背部。

examples.en: This is my first time visiting a foreign country.
examples.zh: 這是我第一次造訪外國。

examples.en: January is the first month of the calendar year.
examples.zh: 一月是日曆年的第一個月份。

examples.en: Who was the first person to finish the math exam?
examples.zh: 誰是第一個完成數學考試的人？

examples.en: You must finish your homework first before playing games.
examples.zh: 玩遊戲之前，你必須先完成功課。

examples.en: First, wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water.
examples.zh: 首先，用肥皂和水澈底洗手。

examples.en: When I arrived at the hotel, I checked in first.
examples.zh: 我到達飯店時，先辦理了入住登記。

examples.en: She was the first in her class to pass the test.
examples.zh: 她是班上第一個通過測試的人。

examples.en: Our team won first place in the basketball tournament.
examples.zh: 我們的球隊在籃球錦標賽中獲得了第一名。

examples.en: It was a first for our family to travel together abroad.
examples.zh: 這是我們全家第一次一起出國旅行。

examples.en: We saw many colorful fish while swimming in the ocean.
examples.zh: 我們在海裡游泳時看到了許多色彩斑斕的魚。

examples.en: Fresh fish is a main ingredient in traditional coastal dishes.
examples.zh: 新鮮魚肉是傳統沿海料理的主要食材。

examples.en: My brother feeds the fish in his tank every morning before school.
examples.zh: 我弟弟每天上學前都會餵他魚缸裡的魚。

examples.en: My grandfather loves to fish by the quiet river on weekends.
examples.zh: 我祖父喜歡在週末到安靜的河邊釣魚。

examples.en: Local fishermen fish for salmon during the autumn season.
examples.zh: 當地的漁民在秋季捕撈鮭魚。

examples.en: He spent all morning fishing, but he did not catch anything.
examples.zh: 他花了一整早上釣魚，但什麼也沒釣到。

examples.en: The old fisherman sailed his small boat out to sea.
examples.zh: 老漁夫開著他的小船出海。

examples.en: An experienced fisherman knows the best spots to catch large fish.
examples.zh: 一位有經驗的漁夫知道捕獲大魚的最佳地點。

examples.en: The fisherman mended his fishing net carefully on the shore.
examples.zh: 漁夫在岸上細心地修補他的漁網。

examples.en: These new running shoes fit my feet perfectly.
examples.zh: 這些新跑鞋非常合我的腳。

examples.en: The old key does not fit into this lock.
examples.zh: 這把舊鑰匙插不進這個鎖頭裡。

examples.en: We tried to fit all the books into one box.
examples.zh: 我們試著把所有的書裝進同一個箱子裡。

examples.en: He works out regularly to stay fit and strong.
examples.zh: 他定期運動以保持健康強壯。

examples.en: She is fit for the manager position in our team.
examples.zh: 她適合擔任我們團隊的經理職位。

examples.en: Swimming is a great exercise to keep yourself fit.
examples.zh: 游泳是保持自己健康的好運動。

examples.en: The mechanic managed to fix the broken car engine.
examples.zh: 技師成功修理好了損壞的汽車引擎。

examples.en: Please fix the shelf firmly to the wall.
examples.zh: 請把架子牢牢地固定在牆上。

examples.en: I will fix a quick breakfast of eggs and toast.
examples.zh: 我會準備一份雞蛋與吐司的快速早餐。

examples.en: The national flag was raised in front of the school entrance.
examples.zh: 國旗在校門前升起。

examples.en: Fans waved small flags during the energetic football match.
examples.zh: 球迷在熱烈的足球比賽中揮舞著小旗子。

examples.en: A bright red flag marked the end of the racing track.
examples.zh: 一面鮮紅色的旗幟標示著賽道的終點。

examples.en: The farmland in this valley is completely flat for miles around.
examples.zh: 這座山谷裡的農地方圓數英里完全是平坦的。

examples.en: We had to stop our road trip because of a flat tire.
examples.zh: 因為車胎洩氣了，我們不得不暫停我們的公路旅行。

examples.en: Spread the wet sweater on a flat surface to dry.
examples.zh: 把濕毛衣攤放在平坦的表面上晾乾。

examples.en: She rented a small comfortable flat near her university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的大學附近租了一間舒適的小公寓。

examples.en: Their family lives in a flat on the third floor.
examples.zh: 他們一家人住在三樓的一間公寓。

examples.en: Finding an affordable flat in the city center can be difficult.
examples.zh: 要在市中心找到價格合理的公寓可能很困難。

examples.en: Our flight to Tokyo was delayed due to heavy fog.
examples.zh: 我們飛往東京的班機因大霧而延誤。

examples.en: The direct flight from Taipei to London takes twelve hours.
examples.zh: 從台北直飛倫敦的航班需要十二個小時。

examples.en: He booked a first-class flight for his summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他為暑假訂了一張頭等艙機票。

examples.en: Please do not leave your dirty clothes on the bedroom floor.
examples.zh: 請不要把你的髒衣服扔在臥室地板上。

examples.en: Our office is located on the third floor of this building.
examples.zh: 我們的辦公室位於這棟大樓的三樓。

examples.en: She swept the kitchen floor right after finishing her dinner prep.
examples.zh: 她做完晚餐準備後立刻掃了廚房的地板。

examples.en: Fresh spring water flows down the green mountain valley.
examples.zh: 新鮮的泉水流下綠色的山谷。

examples.en: Traffic began to flow smoothly after the accident was cleared.
examples.zh: 事故排除後，交通開始順暢流動。

examples.en: Warm air flows through the heating vents during the winter.
examples.zh: 冬天時暖空氣穿過暖氣孔流動。

examples.en: Dams help control the natural flow of river water during heavy rains.
examples.zh: 大壩有助於在大雨期間控制河水的自然流量。

examples.en: The steady flow of information keeps all department members updated.
examples.zh: 穩定的資訊流通讓所有部門成員隨時掌握最新消息。

examples.en: The doctor checked the blood flow in the patient's left leg.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了病患左腿的血液流動狀況。

examples.en: He bought a bouquet of red flowers for his wife.
examples.zh: 他買了一束紅花送給妻子。

examples.en: Cherry trees are covered with pink flowers in the park during spring.
examples.zh: 春天時，公園裡的櫻花樹開滿粉紅色的花。

examples.en: Bees fly from flower to flower collecting sweet nectar.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花朵間飛舞採集甜美的花蜜。

examples.en: Many students missed school last week because of the seasonal flu.
examples.zh: 上週許多學生因為季節性流感而缺課。

examples.en: Getting a flu shot every autumn helps protect you against viruses.
examples.zh: 每年秋天打流感疫苗有助於保護你抵禦病毒。

examples.en: He stayed in bed for three days while recovering from the flu.
examples.zh: 他在從流感康復期間臥床休息了三天。

examples.en: Birds fly to warm southern areas during the winter.
examples.zh: 鳥類在冬天會飛往溫暖的南方地區。

examples.en: Our family will fly to Tokyo for vacation next week.
examples.zh: 我們一家人下週將搭乘飛機去東京度假。

examples.en: The colorful kite flew high up in the blue sky.
examples.zh: 彩色的風箏在藍天中高高飛翔。

examples.en: A noisy fly was buzzing around the dinner table.
examples.zh: 一隻吵鬧的蒼蠅在餐桌周圍嗡嗡作響。

examples.en: Please close the window screen to keep flies out.
examples.zh: 請關上紗窗以擋住蒼蠅。

examples.en: The frog caught a fly with its long quick tongue.
examples.zh: 青蛙用牠長而敏捷的舌頭抓住了蒼蠅。

examples.en: You need to focus on your studies during class time.
examples.zh: 你在上課時間需要專注於課業。

examples.en: Adjust the camera lens to focus on the flower sharply.
examples.zh: 調整相機鏡頭以對焦在花朵上。

examples.en: The team will focus their efforts on expanding foreign markets.
examples.zh: 團隊將把努力集中在拓展海外市場上。

examples.en: Environmental protection is the main focus of this international conference.
examples.zh: 環保是這次國際會議的主要焦點。

examples.en: The image was completely out of focus due to shaking.
examples.zh: 由於晃動，影像完全失焦了。

examples.en: He lost his focus after working for ten straight hours.
examples.zh: 連續工作十個小時後，他失去了注意力。

examples.en: Heavy fog covered the entire valley early in the morning.
examples.zh: 清晨時分，濃霧籠罩了整個山谷。

examples.en: The thick fog made it very hard for drivers to see.
examples.zh: 濃霧使得駕駛人非常難以看清路況。

examples.en: The airplane flight was delayed due to the dense mountain fog.
examples.zh: 班機因為山區濃霧而延誤了。

examples.en: Some local folk gathered in the park to enjoy morning exercise.
examples.zh: 一些當地人們聚集在公園享受晨練。

examples.en: I plan to visit my folks in the countryside this weekend.
examples.zh: 我計劃這個週末去鄉下拜訪我的家人。

examples.en: Many young folk prefer shopping online rather than in physical stores.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人喜好網路購物勝過實體店家。

examples.en: They performed traditional folk dances during the cultural festival.
examples.zh: 他們在文化節期間表演了傳統民間舞蹈。

examples.en: My grandfather loves listening to old Taiwanese folk music.
examples.zh: 我祖父喜歡聽老台灣民間音樂。

examples.en: The museum exhibits ancient folk art from various mountain regions.
examples.zh: 該博物館展出來自各個山區的古代民間藝術。

examples.en: The little ducklings follow their mother everywhere near the pond.
examples.zh: 小鴨子們在池塘附近到處跟隨著牠們的媽媽。

examples.en: Drivers must strictly follow traffic rules to ensure public safety.
examples.zh: 駕駛人必須嚴格遵循交通規則以確保公共安全。

examples.en: I could not follow the speaker's logic because he spoke too fast.
examples.zh: 我聽不懂講者的邏輯，因為他說得太快了。

examples.en: Please read the following instructions carefully before starting the test.
examples.zh: 開始測驗前請仔細閱讀下述說明。

examples.en: We decided to leave the city on the following morning.
examples.zh: 我們決定隔天早上離開這座城市。

examples.en: The following table shows the monthly sales performance of our team.
examples.zh: 下表顯示了我們團隊的每月銷售績效。

examples.en: Following the lecture, students asked several interesting questions.
examples.zh: 在講座之後，學生們提出了幾個有趣的問題。

examples.en: He returned to work following a short vacation in Japan.
examples.zh: 在日本度過短暫假期後，他回到了工作崗位。

examples.en: The air became fresh and cool following the rainstorm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨之後，空氣變得清新涼爽。

examples.en: The popular writer has a large following among young readers.
examples.zh: 這位熱門作家在年輕讀者中有一大群追隨者。

examples.en: The rock band gained a strong following after their first concert.
examples.zh: 這支搖滾樂團在第一場演唱會後獲得了大批支持者。

examples.en: Her food blog has built up a loyal following over the years.
examples.zh: 這些年來，她的美食部落格建立了忠實的追隨者群體。

examples.en: Fresh food is essential for maintaining good health.
examples.zh: 新鮮食物對於維持良好健康至關重要。

examples.en: Italian food is my favorite type of cuisine.
examples.zh: 義大利食物是我最喜歡的料理類型。

examples.en: They donated food to the local homeless shelter.
examples.zh: 他們向當地的收容所捐贈食物。

examples.en: Do not listen to him because he is acting like a fool.
examples.zh: 不要聽他的，因為他現在行為像個傻瓜。

examples.en: Only a fool would drive at high speeds in heavy rain.
examples.zh: 只有傻瓜才會在大雨中高速開車。

examples.en: He made a complete fool of himself at the company party.
examples.zh: 他在公司派對上讓自己徹底淪為笑柄。

examples.en: You cannot fool me with that simple trick ever again.
examples.zh: 你休想再用那個簡單的招數愚弄我。

examples.en: Her warm smile fooled everyone into trusting her with their money.
examples.zh: 她溫暖的微笑欺騙了所有人，把錢信任地交給她。

examples.en: Stop trying to fool yourself about this very serious situation now.
examples.zh: 現在別再嘗試欺騙自己面對這個非常嚴重的處境了。

examples.en: It was foolish to walk outside during the heavy typhoon rain.
examples.zh: 在颱風大雨中走在戶外是愚蠢的。

examples.en: He made a foolish decision to spend all his savings online.
examples.zh: 他做出了一個把所有積蓄花在網路上的愚蠢決定。

examples.en: She felt foolish after confusing the dates of the important exam.
examples.zh: 在搞混重要考試的日期後，她覺得自己很傻。

examples.en: He accidentally stepped on my foot while we were dancing.
examples.zh: 我們跳舞時，他不小心踩到了我的腳。

examples.en: The basketball player is over six feet tall and very agile.
examples.zh: 這位籃球員身高超過六英呎，而且非常敏捷。

examples.en: We decided to cover the short distance to the market on foot.
examples.zh: 我們決定徒步走完這段到市場的短距離。

examples.en: Millions of fans watch the world football championship match.
examples.zh: 數百萬球迷觀看世界足球錦標賽賽事。

examples.en: He kicked the football high across the green field.
examples.zh: 他把足球高高踢過綠色草地。

examples.en: Students play football together every weekend afternoon at school.
examples.zh: 學生們每個週末下午都在學校一起踢足球。

examples.en: I bought a special birthday gift for my mother last week.
examples.zh: 我上週給媽媽買了一份特別的生日禮物。

examples.en: We have been waiting at the bus stop for more than half an hour.
examples.zh: 我們已經在公車站牌等了半個多小時。

examples.en: Tainan is famous for its delicious traditional street food and snacks.
examples.zh: 台南以其美味的傳統街頭美食和小吃而聞名。

examples.en: The force of the strong wind knocked over several wooden fences.
examples.zh: 強風的力量吹倒了幾面木製籬笆。

examples.en: Gravity is the physical force that keeps objects on the ground.
examples.zh: 地心引力是將物體維持在地面上的物理力量。

examples.en: Police officers used reasonable force to arrest the suspect safely.
examples.zh: 警官使用了合理的武力安全地逮捕了嫌犯。

examples.en: Parents should not force their children to choose a specific major.
examples.zh: 父母不應該強迫孩子選擇特定主修。

examples.en: Heavy rain forced the organizers to cancel the outdoor concert.
examples.zh: 大雨逼迫主辦單位取消了戶外音樂會。

examples.en: He had to force the jammed locker door open with a metal tool.
examples.zh: 他不得不使用金屬工具強行撬開卡住的置物櫃門。

examples.en: Learning a foreign language requires daily practice and lots of patience.
examples.zh: 學習一門外國語言需要每天練習和大量的耐心。

examples.en: Many foreign tourists visit the famous night market every evening.
examples.zh: 每天晚上都有許多外國遊客造訪這座著名的夜市。

examples.en: The company trades with several foreign partners in Europe and Asia.
examples.zh: 該公司與歐洲和亞洲的多個外國夥伴進行貿易。

examples.en: The kind foreigner asked me for directions to the station.
examples.zh: 那位友善的外國人向我詢問前往車站的方向。

examples.en: Many foreigners visit Taipei 101 when traveling in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 許多外國人在台灣旅遊時會造訪台北101。

examples.en: She helped the lost foreigner find his hotel nearby.
examples.zh: 她幫那位迷路的外國人找到了他住的飯店，就在附近。

examples.en: Many wild animals live safely inside the protected national pine forest.
examples.zh: 許多野生動物安全地生活在受保護的國家松樹森林裡。

examples.en: We went hiking along a scenic trail through the dense forest.
examples.zh: 我們沿著穿過濃密森林的風景步道去健行。

examples.en: Smoke filled the sky as a wildfire spread across the dry forest.
examples.zh: 當野火在乾燥的森林中蔓延時，濃煙彌漫了天空。

examples.en: Don't forget to lock the front door before leaving.
examples.zh: 出門前別忘了鎖上大門。

examples.en: I completely forgot her name when I met her.
examples.zh: 我遇到她時完全忘記了她的名字。

examples.en: He forgot his keys on the kitchen counter again.
examples.zh: 他又把鑰匙忘在廚房檯面上了。

examples.en: She decided to forgive her brother for breaking her favorite cup.
examples.zh: 她決定原諒弟弟打破她最喜歡的杯子。

examples.en: Please forgive me for being late for the morning meeting.
examples.zh: 請原諒我晨會遲到了。

examples.en: It takes courage to apologize and forgive others for their mistakes.
examples.zh: 道歉和原諒別人的錯誤都需要勇氣。

examples.en: Use a fork and knife to eat your steak at dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐吃牛排時請使用叉子和餐刀。

examples.en: She accidentally dropped her stainless steel fork on the clean floor.
examples.zh: 她不小心把不鏽鋼叉子掉到了乾淨的地板上。

examples.en: Take the left path when you reach the fork in the road.
examples.zh: 當你到達路口岔路時走左邊那一條路。

examples.en: Please fill out this registration form before joining.
examples.zh: 加入前請先填寫這份報名表格。

examples.en: Ice is simply water in a solid form.
examples.zh: 冰只是固體形式的水。

examples.en: The cloud took the form of a big dragon.
examples.zh: 雲朵形成了大龍的形狀。

examples.en: Clouds form when warm air rises into the sky.
examples.zh: 當熱空氣升到空中時就會形成雲朵。

examples.en: Students decided to form a new study group.
examples.zh: 學生們決定建立一個新的學習小組。

examples.en: They formed a long line outside the theater.
examples.zh: 他們在戲院外排成了一條長龍。

examples.en: All guests were asked to wear formal attire to the dinner party.
examples.zh: 所有賓客都被要求穿著正式服裝出席晚宴。

examples.en: He sent a formal apology letter to his business client yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天寄了一封正式的道歉信給他的商業客戶。

examples.en: Students need formal permission from the principal to leave campus early.
examples.zh: 學生早退需要獲得校長的正式許可。

examples.en: The former president gave an inspiring speech at a university yesterday.
examples.zh: 前任總統昨天在大學發表了一篇鼓舞人心的演講。

examples.en: She ran into her former classmate at a coffee shop unexpectedly.
examples.zh: 她在咖啡館意外遇到了她以前的同學。

examples.en: In former times, people used oil lamps to illuminate homes.
examples.zh: 在以前的時代，人們使用油燈來照亮家園。

examples.en: The small pendulum swung back and forth inside the wall clock.
examples.zh: 小擺錘在壁鐘裡來回擺動。

examples.en: Green leaves and colorful flowers burst forth during the spring season.
examples.zh: 綠葉和繽紛的花朵在春季盛開綻放。

examples.en: They set forth on a long journey across the quiet ocean.
examples.zh: 他們啟程展開橫跨平靜海洋的長途旅程。

examples.en: He stepped forward boldly to accept the achievement award.
examples.zh: 他勇敢地向前跨步去接受成就獎。

examples.en: I look forward to hearing from you very soon.
examples.zh: 我期待很快能收到你的回音。

examples.en: Push the main lever forward to start the machine.
examples.zh: 將主操縱桿向前推以啟動機器。

examples.en: The forward seats offer a better view of the stage.
examples.zh: 前部的座位提供了更好的舞台視野。

examples.en: The forward part of the train is usually less crowded.
examples.zh: 列車的前段車廂通常比較不擁擠。

examples.en: The driver moved the seat to a more forward position.
examples.zh: 駕駛把座椅調到比較前面的位置。

examples.en: Please forward this email to the general manager quickly.
examples.zh: 請快點將這封電子郵件轉發給總經理。

examples.en: They will forward your official mail to your new address.
examples.zh: 他們會把你的官方信件轉寄到你的新地址。

examples.en: She forwarded the message to all team members.
examples.zh: 她把這則訊息轉寄給了所有團隊成員。

examples.en: They decided to found a new company together.
examples.zh: 他們決定一起創立一家新公司。

examples.en: The famous university was founded more than a century ago.
examples.zh: 那所著名的大學建校於一個多世紀以前。

examples.en: She helped found a local charity to help poor kids.
examples.zh: 她協助創立了一個當地的慈善機構來幫助貧困兒童。

examples.en: A clever wild fox walked quietly through the dense forest.
examples.zh: 一隻聰明的野生狐狸安靜地穿過密林。

examples.en: The red fox has a bushy tail and sharp ears.
examples.zh: 紅狐狸擁有蓬鬆的尾巴和尖尖的耳朵。

examples.en: We saw a small fox hunting in the snow yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天看到一隻小狐狸在雪地裡獵食。

examples.en: Admission to the museum is completely free today.
examples.zh: 今天進入這家博物館是完全免費的。

examples.en: Everyone has the right to be free.
examples.zh: 每個人都有享有自由的權利。

examples.en: Are you free to have coffee with me tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你明天有空和我一起喝杯咖啡嗎？

examples.en: They freed the wild bird back into the forest.
examples.zh: 他們將那隻野鳥放回森林。

examples.en: The new software update will free up computer storage.
examples.zh: 這項新軟體更新將會釋放出電腦儲存空間。

examples.en: Rescue workers freed trapped passengers from the stuck elevator.
examples.zh: 救援人員將受困的乘客從卡住的電梯中釋放出來。

examples.en: Children under five years old can travel free here.
examples.zh: 五歲以下的兒童在這裡可以免費搭乘。

examples.en: The store delivers online purchases free to your home.
examples.zh: 這家商店免費將網路購買的商品送到你家。

examples.en: Food samples are given out free at the market.
examples.zh: 食品試吃樣品在市場免費發放。

examples.en: Everyone values the freedom to express their opinions.
examples.zh: 每個人都重視表達自己意見的自由。

examples.en: The birds enjoyed their freedom after escaping from the cage.
examples.zh: 鳥兒從籠子逃脫後享受著自由。

examples.en: Students enjoy the freedom of choosing their elective subjects.
examples.zh: 學生享有選擇選修科目的自由。

examples.en: I like to buy fresh bread from the local bakery.
examples.zh: 我喜歡從當地的麵包店買新鮮的麵包。

examples.en: Open the window to let some fresh air into the room.
examples.zh: 打開窗戶讓一些清新的空氣進入房間。

examples.en: She started her new job with a fresh and enthusiastic mindset.
examples.zh: 她抱著全新的熱情心態開始了新工作。

examples.en: She went to the movies with her best friend.
examples.zh: 她和她最好的朋友一起去看電影。

examples.en: It is easy to make friends when you are friendly.
examples.zh: 當你很友善時，很容易交到朋友。

examples.en: My friend helped me move to a new apartment.
examples.zh: 我的朋友幫我搬到了新公寓。

examples.en: Our new neighbor greeted us with a friendly smile this morning.
examples.zh: 我們的新鄰居今天早上以友善的微笑向我們打招呼。

examples.en: The hotel staff members were exceptionally helpful and friendly to us.
examples.zh: 飯店的工作人員對我們非常親切且樂於助人。

examples.en: It is important to maintain a friendly relationship with your classmates.
examples.zh: 與你的同班同學保持友善的關係是很重要的。

examples.en: Their deep friendship has lasted for more than twenty unforgettable years now.
examples.zh: 他們的深厚友誼如今已經持續了二十多個難忘的年頭。

examples.en: True friendship requires mutual trust, honesty, and continuous support through difficulties.
examples.zh: 真正的友誼需要相互信任、誠實以及在困境中的持續支持。

examples.en: We celebrated our long friendship with a special reunion dinner last Saturday night.
examples.zh: 上週六晚上，我們舉辦了特別的聚餐來慶祝我們長久的友情。

examples.en: He ordered a burger and a large portion of fries.
examples.zh: 他點了一份漢堡和一份大包薯條。

examples.en: These hot fries taste great with tomato ketchup on top.
examples.zh: 這些熱騰騰的薯條沾蕃茄醬吃味道很好。

examples.en: Do you want some fries to go with your sandwich?
examples.zh: 你想要一些薯條來配你的三明治嗎？

examples.en: A small green frog jumped into the pond with a splash.
examples.zh: 一隻小綠青蛙撲通一聲跳進了池塘裡。

examples.en: We could hear frogs croaking loudly near the lake at night.
examples.zh: 夜晚時我們可以聽到青蛙在湖邊大聲叫著。

examples.en: The young boy tried to catch a frog in the garden.
examples.zh: 那個年輕男孩試圖在花園裡抓住一隻青蛙。

examples.en: Our new English teacher comes from a small town in Canada.
examples.zh: 我們的新英文老師來自加拿大的一個小鎮。

examples.en: The convenience store is only a five-minute walk from my house.
examples.zh: 那家便利商店距離我家步行只需五分鐘。

examples.en: She received a long letter from her pen pal in Germany.
examples.zh: 她收到一封來自德國筆友的長信。

examples.en: The teacher asked the student to sit in the front of the classroom.
examples.zh: 老師要求那位學生坐在教室的前方。

examples.en: There is a beautiful garden in the front of our house.
examples.zh: 我們房子前面有一個美麗的花園。

examples.en: The picture on the front of the magazine caught my attention immediately.
examples.zh: 雜誌正面的圖片立刻吸引了我的注意。

examples.en: The front door was locked, so we had to use the back entrance.
examples.zh: 大門被鎖上了，所以我們不得不使用後門。

examples.en: He sat in the front seat next to the driver during the road trip.
examples.zh: 在公路旅行中，他坐在司機旁邊的前座。

examples.en: My car's front lights need to be replaced after the minor accident.
examples.zh: 在小事故發生後，我車子的前燈需要更換。

examples.en: Eating fresh fruit daily provides essential vitamins for the body.
examples.zh: 每天吃新鮮水果可以為身體提供必需的維生素。

examples.en: The market stall sold a wide variety of fruit.
examples.zh: 市場攤位販售各種各樣的水果。

examples.en: The tree produced abundant sweet fruit this harvest season.
examples.zh: 這棵樹在這個採收季結出了豐碩甜美的果實。

examples.en: Heat some olive oil in the pan and fry the eggs gently.
examples.zh: 在平底鍋裡加熱一些橄欖油，然後輕柔地煎雞蛋。

examples.en: My mother used to fry potatoes until they became golden and crispy.
examples.zh: 我母親過去常常炸馬鈴薯，直到它們變得金黃酥脆。

examples.en: He learned how to fry vegetables properly in a traditional Asian wok.
examples.zh: 他學會了如何在傳統的亞洲炒鍋中妥善地炒蔬菜。

examples.en: Would you like some crispy French fries with your beef burger today?
examples.zh: 你今天想拿些酥脆的薯條來搭配你的牛肉堡嗎？

examples.en: The restaurant serves fresh fish and hot fries with a homemade sauce.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應新鮮的魚和熱騰騰的薯條配自製醬料。

examples.en: She ordered a small side of fries to share with her friend.
examples.zh: 她點了一份小份的薯條與她的朋友分享。

examples.en: The glass is full of fresh orange juice for the guest.
examples.zh: 杯子裡裝滿了給客人的新鮮柳橙汁。

examples.en: I cannot eat any dessert because I am completely full now.
examples.zh: 我吃不下任何甜點了，因為我現在完全吃飽了。

examples.en: The tour bus was full of excited tourists from around the world.
examples.zh: 遊覽車上擠滿了來自世界各地興奮的觀光客。

examples.en: Playing board games with friends is always a lot of fun.
examples.zh: 和朋友玩桌上遊戲總是帶來很多樂趣。

examples.en: We had so much fun at the water park yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們昨天下午在水上樂園玩得非常開心。

examples.en: Learning new hobbies can bring a lot of fun into life.
examples.zh: 學習新嗜好可以給生活帶來許多樂趣。

examples.en: Going to the night market was a very fun evening activity.
examples.zh: 逛夜市是一項非常有意思且愉快的夜間活動。

examples.en: She is a fun person to hang out with after class.
examples.zh: 她是一個放學後跟她相處很有趣的人。

examples.en: We had a fun time dancing and singing at the party.
examples.zh: 我們在派對上跳舞唱歌，度過了愉快的時光。

examples.en: The main function of heart valves is directing blood flow.
examples.zh: 心臟瓣膜的主要功能是引導血液流動。

examples.en: This button performs a second function when you hold it down.
examples.zh: 按住這個按鈕時，會執行第二項功能。

examples.en: Many guests attended the annual charity function last night.
examples.zh: 許多賓客昨晚出席了這場年度慈善典禮。

examples.en: The laptop cannot function properly without a full charge.
examples.zh: 這台筆記型電腦如果沒有充飽電就無法正常運作。

examples.en: This small room can function as a temporary home office.
examples.zh: 這間小房間可以充當臨時的居家辦公室。

examples.en: Our brain continues to function even while we sleep.
examples.zh: 即使在我們睡覺時，大腦仍會繼續運作。

examples.en: The comedian told a funny story that made everyone laugh out loud.
examples.zh: 那位喜劇演員講了一個有趣的故事，讓大家哈哈大笑。

examples.en: My cat often acts in a funny way when playing with a box.
examples.zh: 我的貓在玩盒子時常做出滑稽的舉動。

examples.en: There is a funny smell in the kitchen; we should check the fridge.
examples.zh: 廚房裡有一股奇怪的味道，我們應該檢查一下冰箱。

examples.en: They bought new wooden furniture for the newly renovated apartment.
examples.zh: 他們為新裝修的公寓購買了新的木製家具。

examples.en: Living room furniture includes a comfortable sofa and armchair.
examples.zh: 客廳家具包括一張舒適的沙發和單人沙發椅。

examples.en: Moving heavy wooden furniture requires at least two strong people.
examples.zh: 搬運重型木製家具至少需要兩個強壯的人。

examples.en: We need to walk a bit further to reach the station.
examples.zh: 我們需要再走遠一點才能到達車站。

examples.en: We will discuss this topic further in our next meeting.
examples.zh: 我們會在下一次會議中進一步討論這個主題。

examples.en: The store is located further down the main street.
examples.zh: 那間店家位於主要街道更往前走的地方。

examples.en: Please contact us if you need further information about the tour.
examples.zh: 如果您需要更多關於此行程的資訊，請聯絡我們。

examples.en: No further explanation was given by the manager.
examples.zh: 經理沒有給出進一步的解釋。

examples.en: There will be no further delay in the project schedule.
examples.zh: 專案進度將不會有進一步的延誤。

examples.en: She took evening classes to further her career in business.
examples.zh: 她上夜間課程以促進她的商業職涯發展。

examples.en: The charity works hard to further education in rural areas.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構努力推動偏鄉地區的教育。

examples.en: New technology will further the progress of scientific research.
examples.zh: 新科技將會促進科學研究的進展。

examples.en: She is working hard to build a bright future for her family.
examples.zh: 她正在努力為家人創造光明的前景。

examples.en: No one can accurately predict what will happen in the future.
examples.zh: 沒有人能準確預測未來會發生什麼事。

examples.en: Investments in green energy are essential for our future.
examples.zh: 對綠色能源的投資對我們的未來至關重要。

examples.en: We discussed our future business plans during the executive meeting.
examples.zh: 我們在高階主管會議上討論了我們未來的商業計劃。

examples.en: Please save this contact information for future reference.
examples.zh: 請儲存此聯絡資訊以備未來參考。

examples.en: She has a clear plan for her future career.
examples.zh: 她對自己未來的職涯有清楚的規劃。

examples.en: He hopes to gain useful practical experience from this internship.
examples.zh: 他希望從這次實習中獲得有用的實務經驗。

examples.en: She gained ten pounds after eating too much rich dessert.
examples.zh: 吃太多濃郁甜點後，她體重增加了十磅。

examples.en: The company gained many new international customers this past year.
examples.zh: 這家公司在過去一年中獲得了許多新的國際客戶。

examples.en: The financial gain from the property investment was substantial this year.
examples.zh: 今年房產投資獲得的財務收益相當豐厚。

examples.en: Weight gain is common if you do not exercise regularly daily.
examples.zh: 如果你不每天定期運動，體重增加是很常見的。

examples.en: As the saying goes, no pain, no gain.
examples.zh: 俗話說，一分耕耘，一分收穫。

examples.en: Children love to play this exciting game in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在公園裡玩這個刺激的遊戲。

examples.en: Our school won the final basketball game of the season.
examples.zh: 我們學校贏得了本賽季最後一場籃球比賽。

examples.en: Board games are great for family gatherings on rainy days.
examples.zh: 桌上遊戲非常適合雨天的家庭聚會。

examples.en: Please remember to take out the garbage before you sleep.
examples.zh: 睡覺前請記得把垃圾拿出去倒。

examples.en: The street was clean without any garbage on the ground.
examples.zh: 街道很乾淨，地面上沒有任何垃圾。

examples.en: We should separate recyclable items from household garbage properly.
examples.zh: 我們應該妥善將可回收物品與家庭垃圾分開。

examples.en: Beautiful roses are blooming in her garden.
examples.zh: 美麗的玫瑰在她的花園裡盛開。

examples.en: He grows fresh organic vegetables in his backyard garden.
examples.zh: 他在後院菜園區種植新鮮有機蔬菜。

examples.en: We sat on a bench in a public botanical garden.
examples.zh: 我們坐在公共植物園的長椅上。

examples.en: The gardener prunes the rose bushes every spring morning.
examples.zh: 園丁每個春天的早晨都會修剪玫瑰叢。

examples.en: An experienced gardener knows how to treat sick plants.
examples.zh: 有經驗的花匠知道如何治療生病的植物。

examples.en: My grandfather is a keen gardener who grows vegetables.
examples.zh: 我祖父是一位熱衷於種植蔬菜的園丁。

examples.en: She added three cloves of garlic to the pasta sauce.
examples.zh: 她在義大利麵醬汁裡加入了三瓣大蒜。

examples.en: Fresh garlic gives a wonderful flavor to the roast chicken.
examples.zh: 新鮮的大蒜能給烤雞帶來絕佳的風味。

examples.en: My mother always buys organic garlic from the local market.
examples.zh: 我媽媽總是在當地市場購買有機大蒜。

examples.en: Please close the front gate so the dog stays in the yard.
examples.zh: 請關上前門，好讓狗留在院子裡。

examples.en: Passengers should proceed to gate twelve for immediate boarding.
examples.zh: 旅客請前往十二號登機門準備立即登機。

examples.en: The old stone castle was protected by a heavy iron gate.
examples.zh: 這座古老的石造城堡受一座沉重的鐵門所保護。

examples.en: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch fireworks.
examples.zh: 一大群人聚集在廣場上看煙火。

examples.en: Students gather information from books for their research papers.
examples.zh: 學生從書本中收集資訊以撰寫研究論文。

examples.en: She gathered her belongings and left the office at five.
examples.zh: 她收拾好個人物品，在五點離開了辦公室。

examples.en: The general public is advised to stay indoors during the typhoon.
examples.zh: 建議一般大眾在颱風期間待在室內。

examples.en: She gave a general description of the missing black purse.
examples.zh: 她對遺失的黑色皮包做了總體的描述。

examples.en: There is a general belief that good sleep improves memory.
examples.zh: 大家普遍認為良好的睡眠能改善記憶力。

examples.en: The brave general led his troops to victory in battle.
examples.zh: 那位勇敢的將軍帶領他的部隊在戰役中取得勝利。

examples.en: The retired army general wrote a famous book about military strategy.
examples.zh: 那位退休的陸軍將軍寫了一本關於軍事策略的著名著作。

examples.en: Soldiers saluted the army general as he entered the room.
examples.zh: 當陸軍將軍進入房間時，士兵們向他敬禮。

examples.en: The generous manager bought lunch for the entire office staff.
examples.zh: 那位大方的經理為全辦公室員工買了午餐。

examples.en: He made a generous donation to help the local animal shelter.
examples.zh: 他做出慷慨的捐款來幫助當地的動物收容所。

examples.en: Thank you for your generous hospitality during our stay here.
examples.zh: 感謝在我們停留期間你們慷慨的款待。

examples.en: A gentle breeze blew softly through the open window.
examples.zh: 一陣微風從打開的窗戶輕柔吹過。

examples.en: He gave his daughter a gentle pat on the shoulder.
examples.zh: 他輕輕拍了拍女兒的肩膀。

examples.en: She was very gentle when handling the newborn puppy.
examples.zh: 她照顧初生的小狗時非常溫柔。

examples.en: The kind gentleman held the door open for everyone.
examples.zh: 那位仁慈的紳士幫大家把門拉開。

examples.en: He always behaves like a true gentleman.
examples.zh: 他的舉止總是像個真正的紳士。

examples.en: An elderly gentleman asked me for directions to the station.
examples.zh: 一位年長的先生向我詢問去車站的方向。

examples.en: I need to get a new pair of shoes for running.
examples.zh: 我需要買一雙新的跑步鞋。

examples.en: She got a lovely birthday gift from her best friend today.
examples.zh: 她今天收到了好朋友送的精美生日禮物。

examples.en: Call me as soon as you get to the train station.
examples.zh: 你一到達火車站就立刻打電話給我。

examples.en: Legend says a ghost haunts the top floor of the castle.
examples.zh: 傳說有鬼魂出沒在這座城堡的頂樓。

examples.en: The children told scary ghost stories around the campfire tonight.
examples.zh: 孩子們今晚在營火旁講著嚇人的鬼故事。

examples.en: He was terrified as if he had seen a ghost.
examples.zh: 他驚恐萬分，彷彿看到了鬼魂。

examples.en: The fairy tale features a friendly giant who lives in the clouds.
examples.zh: 這篇童話故事描繪了一位住在雲端的友善巨人。

examples.en: The tech giant announced its new product line this morning.
examples.zh: 這家科技巨頭今天早上宣布了其新產品線。

examples.en: The tall basketball player looked like a giant next to me.
examples.zh: 那位高大的籃球員站在我旁邊就像個巨人。

examples.en: They built a giant statue in the center of the square.
examples.zh: 他們在廣場的中央建造了一座巨大的雕像。

examples.en: The kids had fun playing with a giant beach ball today.
examples.zh: 孩子們今天玩巨大的沙灘球，玩得很開心。

examples.en: A giant panda was resting peacefully in the shade of the bamboo.
examples.zh: 一隻大貓熊在竹林的陰涼處安靜地休息。

examples.en: She wrapped the birthday gift with colorful paper.
examples.zh: 她用彩紙包裝了生日禮物。

examples.en: He received a silver watch as a graduation gift.
examples.zh: 他收到一只銀手錶作為畢業禮物。

examples.en: The young boy has a natural gift for playing music.
examples.zh: 這個年輕男孩擁有演奏音樂的天賦。

examples.en: The tall giraffe stretched its long neck to eat tree leaves.
examples.zh: 高大的長頸鹿伸長脖子吃樹葉。

examples.en: Children were excited to see a baby giraffe at the zoo.
examples.zh: 孩子們在動物園看到小長頸鹿感到非常興奮。

examples.en: A giraffe can sleep while standing up in the wild grassland.
examples.zh: 長頸鹿可以在野生草原上一邊站立一邊睡覺。

examples.en: The little girl wore a pretty pink hat to school.
examples.zh: 那個小女孩戴了一頂漂亮的粉紅色帽子去上學。

examples.en: A smart girl won first prize in the national science contest.
examples.zh: 一位聰明的女孩在全國科學競賽中獲得了一等獎。

examples.en: The girl danced gracefully on the stage during the show.
examples.zh: 表演期間，那個女孩在舞台上優雅地跳舞。

examples.en: My grandmother gave me a beautiful watch on my graduation day.
examples.zh: 我祖母在我畢業那天送了我一隻漂亮的手錶。

examples.en: Can you give me directions to the nearest subway station?
examples.zh: 你可以告訴我怎麼走去最近的捷運站嗎？

examples.en: The teacher will give us a short quiz at the beginning of class.
examples.zh: 老師會在上課開始時給我們一次小測驗。

examples.en: I am very glad to hear that you passed.
examples.zh: 聽到你通過了，我感到非常高興。

examples.en: She was glad to see her old friend again.
examples.zh: 能再次見到她的老朋友，她感到很高興。

examples.en: We are glad that the heavy rainstorm has passed.
examples.zh: 我們很高興嚴重的暴風雨已經過去了。

examples.en: He poured a clean glass of water for his guest.
examples.zh: 他為客人倒了一杯乾淨的水。

examples.en: The window is made of thick, clear glass.
examples.zh: 這扇窗戶是用厚實的透明玻璃製成的。

examples.en: Broken glass covered the floor after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，破碎的玻璃散落一地。

examples.en: He needs to wear reading glasses when he looks at tiny text.
examples.zh: 他看小字體時需要戴閱讀用眼鏡。

examples.en: She took off her glasses and cleaned the lenses with a cloth.
examples.zh: 她摘下眼鏡並用布清潔鏡片。

examples.en: Please fill these three glasses with fresh water for our guests.
examples.zh: 請幫我們的客人把這三個玻璃杯倒滿新鮮的水。

examples.en: He put on a thick glove before touching the cold ice.
examples.zh: 他碰觸冰冷的冰塊前戴上了厚手套。

examples.en: She lost one glove on her way to the office this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上在去辦公室的路上掉了一隻手套。

examples.en: Baseball players always wear a leather glove during their official games.
examples.zh: 棒球員在正式比賽時總是戴著皮革手套。

examples.en: Use strong glue to fix the broken toy model.
examples.zh: 使用強效膠水來修復損壞的玩具模型。

examples.en: She accidentally spilled glue on her wooden desk.
examples.zh: 她不小心把膠水倒在了木桌上。

examples.en: This bottle of craft glue dries very fast.
examples.zh: 這瓶手作膠水乾得很快。

examples.en: Please glue the two paper pieces together carefully.
examples.zh: 請小心地將這兩張紙黏合在一起。

examples.en: He glued the picture onto the poster board.
examples.zh: 他把圖片黏在海報板上。

examples.en: She glued the broken wooden handle back on.
examples.zh: 她把斷掉的木製把手黏回去了。

examples.en: I need to go to the market to buy groceries.
examples.zh: 我需要去市場買食材。

examples.en: We plan to go hiking in the high mountains tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們計劃明天去高山健行。

examples.en: The milk will go bad if left outside the fridge.
examples.zh: 牛奶如果放在冰箱外面會變質。

examples.en: Give it a go and see if you can succeed.
examples.zh: 試一試，看看你是否能成功。

examples.en: It is your go to roll the dice in this board game.
examples.zh: 在這個桌遊中輪到你擲骰子了。

examples.en: Have another go at solving this difficult math puzzle now.
examples.zh: 現在再嘗試解決這個困難的數學難題吧。

examples.en: My primary goal is to pass the English exam this semester.
examples.zh: 我這學期的主要目標是通過英文考試。

examples.en: The soccer player kicked the ball directly into the goal.
examples.zh: 這名足球員把球直接踢進了球門。

examples.en: She scored the winning goal in the last minute of play.
examples.zh: 她在比賽最後一分鐘踢進了致勝球。

examples.en: A white goat was grazing peacefully on the grassy hill.
examples.zh: 一隻白山羊正悠閒地在長滿青草的小山丘上吃草。

examples.en: The farmer milked his goat every morning to make fresh cheese.
examples.zh: 農夫每天早上給他的山羊擠奶以製作新鮮起司。

examples.en: Children enjoyed feeding small pieces of carrot to the friendly goat.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡把小塊的紅蘿蔔餵給那隻溫馴的山羊。

examples.en: Ancient Greeks believed in many different gods and goddesses.
examples.zh: 古希臘人信仰許多不同的神祇與女神。

examples.en: People in the village prayed to God for rain during the drought.
examples.zh: 乾旱期間，村裡的人們祈求上帝降雨。

examples.en: Zeus was considered the most powerful god in Greek mythology.
examples.zh: 宙斯被視為希臘神話中威力最強大的神明。

examples.en: The museum displays ancient treasures made of solid gold.
examples.zh: 這間博物館展出了由純金製成的古代寶物。

examples.en: The athlete won a gold medal in the running race.
examples.zh: 這位運動員在跑步比賽中贏得了一面金牌。

examples.en: Prices of gold went up significantly in the global market.
examples.zh: 全球市場上的黃金價格大幅上漲。

examples.en: She wore an elegant gold watch on her left wrist.
examples.zh: 她左手腕上戴著一只優雅的金錶。

examples.en: The autumn leaves painted the hills with a gold color.
examples.zh: 秋葉將丘陵染上了金黃色。

examples.en: He bought his wife a beautiful gold ring for their anniversary.
examples.zh: 他買了一枚美麗的金戒指給妻子作為週年紀念。

examples.en: The sunset cast a warm golden light over the beach.
examples.zh: 日落向沙灘投下溫暖的金黃色光芒。

examples.en: She wore a golden necklace that glittered under the room light.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條在室內燈光下閃閃發光的黃金項鍊。

examples.en: This is a golden opportunity for your future career development.
examples.zh: 這是你未來職涯發展的大好良機。

examples.en: She is a good student who works very hard.
examples.zh: 她是一位非常努力的好學生。

examples.en: Eating fresh apples every day is good for health.
examples.zh: 每天吃新鮮蘋果對健康有好處。

examples.en: Have a good time at the birthday party tonight!
examples.zh: 今晚在生日派對上玩得開心！

examples.en: Goodbye, my dear friend, and have a safe journey back home.
examples.zh: 再見了，我親愛的朋友，祝你回家路上平安。

examples.en: She waved and said goodbye to her colleagues at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 她在公車站向同事們揮手道別。

examples.en: Say goodbye to your teacher before you leave the classroom today.
examples.zh: 今天離開教室前，要跟你的老師說再見。

examples.en: It is never easy to say a final goodbye to someone you love.
examples.zh: 向你所愛的人做最後的告別從來都不是一件容易的事。

examples.en: They exchanged emotional goodbyes at the airport before her flight departed.
examples.zh: 在她的班機起飛前，他們在機場情緒激動地互相道別。

examples.en: A wave of sadness washed over him during their quick goodbye.
examples.zh: 在他們簡短的道別中，一股悲傷湧上了他的心頭。

examples.en: A white goose was swimming peacefully on the farm pond.
examples.zh: 一隻白鵝在農場的池塘裡平靜地游泳。

examples.en: The loud goose honked at the visitors near the park.
examples.zh: 那隻大聲的鵝向公園附近的遊客嘎嘎叫。

examples.en: We saw a wild goose flying south for the winter season.
examples.zh: 我們看到一隻野生大雁飛向南方過冬。

examples.en: The elected leaders govern the nation with fairness and justice.
examples.zh: 民選領導人公平公正地治理國家。

examples.en: Rules are established to govern the behavior of company employees.
examples.zh: 制定規則是為了管理公司員工的行為。

examples.en: Economic laws govern the supply and demand in the market.
examples.zh: 經濟規律支配著市場上的供給與需求。

examples.en: The local government announced plans to build a new public park.
examples.zh: 當地政府宣布了興建新公共公園的計畫。

examples.en: Citizens expect the government to improve public transportation systems.
examples.zh: 民眾期待政府改善大眾運輸系統。

examples.en: The government passed new laws to protect the natural environment.
examples.zh: 政府通過了新法律來保護自然環境。

examples.en: She was very happy because she got a good grade on the test.
examples.zh: 她非常高興，因為她在考試中得了好成績。

examples.en: My younger brother is currently in the fifth grade.
examples.zh: 我的弟弟目前就讀五年級。

examples.en: Students must maintain high grades to join the basketball team.
examples.zh: 學生必須保持優良成績才能加入籃球隊。

examples.en: The teacher spent the whole evening grading the English essays.
examples.zh: 老師花了整個晚上批改英文作文。

examples.en: Workers grade the apples based on their size and quality.
examples.zh: 工人根據蘋果的大小和品質來進行分級。

examples.en: The assignments will be graded on a scale of one to ten.
examples.zh: 作業將按一到十分的標準評分。

examples.en: There was a gradual improvement in his physical health.
examples.zh: 他的身體健康有了逐漸的改善。

examples.en: The path has a gradual slope leading uphill.
examples.zh: 這條步道有一段平緩的斜坡通往山上。

examples.en: Learning a foreign language is a gradual process.
examples.zh: 學習外語是一個漸進的過程。

examples.en: Farmers harvested fields of golden grain in autumn.
examples.zh: 農夫們在秋天收割一片片的金色穀物。

examples.en: Whole grain bread is rich in healthy fiber.
examples.zh: 全穀麵包富含健康的膳食纖維。

examples.en: A grain of sand got into my eye at the beach.
examples.zh: 在海灘上有一粒沙子跑進了我的眼睛。

examples.en: One egg weighs about fifty grams on average.
examples.zh: 一顆雞蛋平均重量約五十公克。

examples.en: Add two hundred grams of flour to the bowl.
examples.zh: 在碗裡加入兩百公克的麵粉。

examples.en: This letter weighs less than twenty grams.
examples.zh: 這封信重不到二十公克。

examples.en: The city held a grand parade to celebrate the holiday.
examples.zh: 這座城市舉辦了盛大的遊行來慶祝節日。

examples.en: They stayed at a grand hotel near the city center.
examples.zh: 他們住在市中心附近一家宏偉的大飯店。

examples.en: The museum was built with a grand entrance hall.
examples.zh: 這間博物館建有一座宏偉的入口大廳。

examples.en: My grandfather loves to spend his afternoons gardening.
examples.zh: 我的祖父喜歡在下午時光從事園藝。

examples.en: Her grandfather served as a pilot during the war.
examples.zh: 她的祖父在戰爭期間曾擔任飛行員。

examples.en: We visited our grandfather at his country house.
examples.zh: 我們去鄉下的房子拜訪了我們的祖父。

examples.en: My grandmother bakes delicious homemade cookies for us.
examples.zh: 我祖母為我們烘焙美味的手工餅乾。

examples.en: We visit our grandmother every Sunday afternoon with family.
examples.zh: 我們每週日下午都會和家人一起拜訪祖母。

examples.en: Her grandmother loves working in her vegetable garden every day.
examples.zh: 她的祖母每天都喜歡在她的蔬菜花園裡忙碌。

examples.en: She washed a bunch of fresh purple grapes for dessert.
examples.zh: 她洗了一串新鮮的紫葡萄作為點心。

examples.en: Farmers harvest the grapes in the vineyard in autumn.
examples.zh: 農夫們在秋天採收葡萄園裡的葡萄。

examples.en: This juice is made from sweet green grapes without sugar.
examples.zh: 這款果汁是由甜美綠葡萄製成，不加糖。

examples.en: Green grass covers the wide field in the early spring season.
examples.zh: 早春季節時，綠草覆蓋了廣闊的田野。

examples.en: The children loved running barefoot on the soft green grass.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡赤腳在柔軟的綠草地上奔跑。

examples.en: Please do not step on the grass in the public park.
examples.zh: 請勿踩踏公園裡的草地。

examples.en: The sky turned gray before the heavy rain started.
examples.zh: 大雨開始前，天空變成了灰色。

examples.en: My grandfather has gray hair and wears glasses.
examples.zh: 我的祖父留著灰白頭髮，戴著眼鏡。

examples.en: She bought a simple gray sweater for the winter.
examples.zh: 她為冬天買了一件簡單的灰色毛衣。

examples.en: Gray is a popular color for modern office furniture.
examples.zh: 灰色是現代辦公室家具流行的顏色。

examples.en: The room was painted in a light shade of gray.
examples.zh: 這間房間塗上了淺灰色調。

examples.en: The painter mixed black and white to make gray.
examples.zh: 畫家把黑色和白色混合調成灰色。

examples.en: We had a great time at the concert last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚在演唱會過得非常愉快。

examples.en: The Great Wall is one of the world's most famous sites.
examples.zh: 萬里長城是世界上最著名的景點之一。

examples.en: She did a great job on her final presentation.
examples.zh: 她在期末簡報中表現得極好。

examples.en: The field was covered with fresh green grass after the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨過後，草地覆蓋著新鮮的綠草。

examples.en: Don't eat those bananas yet because they are still green.
examples.zh: 先別吃那些香蕉，因為它們還是綠的。

examples.en: Using public transportation is a green way to travel around the city.
examples.zh: 搭乘大眾運輸工具是城市內旅行的一種環保方式。

examples.en: She likes to wear green because it reminds her of nature.
examples.zh: 她喜歡穿綠色，因為這讓她聯想到大自然。
