examples.en: The artist mixed yellow and blue paint to make a dark green.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家將黃色與藍色顏料混合以調出暗綠色。

examples.en: The vibrant green of the forest looked amazing in the morning light.
examples.zh: 森林生機盎然的綠色在晨光下看起來美極了。

examples.en: She smiled warmly to greet her new neighbors.
examples.zh: 她面帶微笑，熱情地向新鄰居打招呼。

examples.en: Students greet their teacher when she enters the room.
examples.zh: 當老師進入教室時，學生們向她問好。

examples.en: He greeted his old school friend with a hug.
examples.zh: 他用一個擁抱問候了他的老校友。

examples.en: The ground was wet because it rained heavily all night long.
examples.zh: 地面是濕的，因為整晚都在下大雨。

examples.en: Children love playing on the grassy ground in the city park.
examples.zh: 小朋友們喜歡在城市公園的草地上玩耍。

examples.en: The school has a large sports ground for physical education classes.
examples.zh: 學校有一個大型體育場地用於體育課。

examples.en: The airline grounded all flights due to the severe winter storm.
examples.zh: 航空公司因嚴重的冬季風暴而停飛所有航班。

examples.en: Parents grounded their teenager for staying out past midnight.
examples.zh: 父母因為青少年孩子過了午夜才回家而禁止他外出。

examples.en: Good teachers ground their lessons in practical everyday examples.
examples.zh: 優秀的老師會把課程奠基於實用的日常生活實例上。

examples.en: A small group of students was discussing the project.
examples.zh: 一小群學生正在討論這個專案。

examples.en: Our tour group will visit three historical cities tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們的旅行團明天將參觀三座歷史城市。

examples.en: The teacher divided the class into four study groups.
examples.zh: 老師把全班分成四個學習小組。

examples.en: The librarian grouped the books according to their subject.
examples.zh: 圖書館員根據主題將書籍分類歸組。

examples.en: Students were grouped together based on their language level.
examples.zh: 學生們根據語言能力水平被分在一組。

examples.en: People grouped around the musician to hear him play.
examples.zh: 人們聚集在那位音樂家周圍聆聽他的演奏。

examples.en: Fresh tomatoes grow best in warm sunny garden soil.
examples.zh: 新鮮番茄在溫暖陽光充足的花園土壤中生長得最好。

examples.en: Local farmers grow organic vegetables without using chemicals.
examples.zh: 在地農夫不使用化學藥劑種植有機蔬菜。

examples.en: Young children usually grow taller every year.
examples.zh: 小孩子通常每年都會長高。

examples.en: Proper nutrition is essential for the healthy growth of young children.
examples.zh: 適當的營養對於幼童的健康成長至關重要。

examples.en: The company experienced rapid growth over the past two years.
examples.zh: 該公司在過去兩年經歷了快速成長。

examples.en: Sunlight and rain promote the rapid growth of garden plants.
examples.zh: 陽光和雨水促進花園植物的快速生長。

examples.en: A security guard stands on duty at the bank entrance all day.
examples.zh: 一名安全警衛整天在銀行入口處值勤。

examples.en: The night guard checked every locked door in the facility.
examples.zh: 夜間警衛檢查了設施中的每一扇鎖住的門。

examples.en: Always wear a mouth guard when you play basketball.
examples.zh: 打籃球時一定要戴護齒。

examples.en: Two trained dogs guard private property against intruders every night.
examples.zh: 兩隻訓練有素的狗每晚守衛私人地產抵禦入侵者。

examples.en: Soldiers were ordered to guard the bridge at all costs.
examples.zh: 士兵們接到命令要不惜一切代價守衛這座橋樑。

examples.en: She closely guarded her secret research data from competitors.
examples.zh: 她緊緊保衛著她的秘密研究數據，防止競爭對手獲取。

examples.en: Fresh guava is a very popular fruit in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 新鮮芭樂在台灣是非常受歡迎的水果。

examples.en: She sliced a crisp guava for dessert after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後，她切了一顆脆芭樂當甜點。

examples.en: Guava juice tastes sweet and refreshing on hot summer days.
examples.zh: 在炎熱的夏天，芭樂汁喝起來甜美又消暑。

examples.en: Can you guess how many jelly beans are in the jar?
examples.zh: 你能猜猜罐裡有多少顆軟糖嗎？

examples.en: I guess we should leave now to avoid the traffic jam.
examples.zh: 我猜想我們現在應該離開以避免交通堵塞。

examples.en: She guessed the correct answer without any hesitation or hint.
examples.zh: 她沒有任何猶豫或提示就猜出了正確答案。

examples.en: My initial guess turned out to be completely accurate.
examples.zh: 我最初的猜測證明是完全準確的。

examples.en: If you don't know the answer, just make your best guess.
examples.zh: 如果你不知道答案，就做出你最好的猜測。

examples.en: Take a wild guess at the total weight of the giant pumpkin.
examples.zh: 對巨型南瓜的總重量做個大膽猜測吧。

examples.en: The hotel staff welcomed each arriving guest with fresh juice.
examples.zh: 飯店員工用新鮮果汁歡迎每位到達的住客。

examples.en: Over one hundred guests were invited to the formal wedding banquet.
examples.zh: 超過一百位賓客獲邀參加這場正式的婚宴。

examples.en: Our house guest stayed with us for three pleasant days.
examples.zh: 來我們家作客的客人，愉快地和我們共度了三天。

examples.en: Our tour guide showed us all the famous sights in the city.
examples.zh: 我們的導遊帶我們參觀了這座城市所有的著名景點。

examples.en: This study guide contains useful tips for the upcoming final exam.
examples.zh: 這本研讀指南包含了針對即將到來的期末考的實用技巧。

examples.en: He followed the step-by-step guide to install the new software.
examples.zh: 他遵循逐步指南來安裝新軟體。

examples.en: The bright stars guided the sailors safely back to the harbor.
examples.zh: 明亮的星星引導水手們安全返回港口。

examples.en: She kindly guided the lost tourist to the nearest subway station.
examples.zh: 她熱心引導迷路的遊客前往最近的捷運站。

examples.en: Parents should guide their children to form good reading habits.
examples.zh: 父母應該引導孩子養成良好的閱讀習慣。

examples.en: He plays the acoustic guitar very well at parties.
examples.zh: 他在派對上吉他彈得非常好。

examples.en: She started learning to play the electric guitar last month.
examples.zh: 她上個月開始學習彈電吉他。

examples.en: The musician tuned his guitar before starting the song.
examples.zh: 那位音樂家在開始演奏歌曲前先幫吉他調音。

examples.en: Kids had fun playing with a water gun in the backyard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在後院玩水槍玩得很開心。

examples.en: The sound of the starting gun made the runners jump forward.
examples.zh: 起跑槍聲一響，跑者便向前衝出。

examples.en: She used a hot glue gun to fix the broken toy.
examples.zh: 她用熱熔膠槍修復了損壞的玩具。

examples.en: He is a friendly guy who always helps his neighbors.
examples.zh: 他是個友善的人，總是幫助鄰居。

examples.en: Hey guys, what time are we meeting at the movie theater?
examples.zh: 嗨，大家，我們幾點在電影院碰面？

examples.en: The new guy in our class plays basketball very well.
examples.zh: 我們班上的新同學籃球打得非常好。

examples.en: Reading books before bedtime is a good daily habit.
examples.zh: 睡前看書是一個很好的日常習慣。

examples.en: He tried hard to break his bad habit of smoking.
examples.zh: 他努力改掉吸菸的壞習慣。

examples.en: Developing healthy eating habits takes time and strong willpower.
examples.zh: 養成健康的飲食習慣需要時間和堅強的意志力。

examples.en: She brushed her long black hair before going out.
examples.zh: 她出門前梳了梳她長長的黑髮。

examples.en: He decided to cut his hair shorter for the summer.
examples.zh: 他決定為了夏天把頭髮剪短一點。

examples.en: There is cat hair all over the sofa.
examples.zh: 沙發上滿是貓咪的毛髮。

examples.en: He went to the local barbershop to get a fresh haircut.
examples.zh: 他去當地的理髮店剪了一個嶄新的髮型。

examples.en: Your new haircut looks really stylish and fits you very well.
examples.zh: 你的新髮型看起來真時尚，非常適合你。

examples.en: She decided to get a short haircut for the hot summer.
examples.zh: 她決定在炎熱的夏天剪短髮。

examples.en: He cut the large red apple into two halves.
examples.zh: 他把那顆紅蘋果切成兩半。

examples.en: More than half of the students passed the English test.
examples.zh: 超過一半的學生通過了英語測驗。

examples.en: Our team scored two goals in the second half.
examples.zh: 我們隊在下半場攻進了兩球。

examples.en: I will need half an hour to finish this report.
examples.zh: 我需要半個小時來完成這份報告。

examples.en: She ate half a sandwich and saved the rest.
examples.zh: 她吃了一半的三明治，把剩下的留了起來。

examples.en: Half the seats in the theater were completely empty.
examples.zh: 戲院裡一半的座位完全是空著的。

examples.en: Students lined up in the long hall before entering the classroom.
examples.zh: 學生們在進入教室前於長廊排隊。

examples.en: The wedding reception was held in a spacious hotel dining hall.
examples.zh: 婚宴在一家飯店寬敞的宴會廳舉行。

examples.en: Please leave your wet shoes near the entrance hall of the house.
examples.zh: 請把濕鞋子放在房子玄關附近。

examples.en: I ordered a fresh ham and cheese sandwich for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我點了一份新鮮的火腿起司三明治當早餐。

examples.en: We usually bake a whole ham for our family dinner.
examples.zh: 我們通常會烤一整塊火腿作為家庭晚餐。

examples.en: Add some sliced ham to the salad for extra flavor.
examples.zh: 在沙拉裡加入一些火腿片以增添風味。

examples.en: I ordered a juicy beef hamburger and fries for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐點了一個多汁的牛肉漢堡和薯條。

examples.en: This restaurant is famous for its delicious homemade hamburgers.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳以其美味的手工漢堡聞名。

examples.en: He likes to put extra cheese on his hamburger.
examples.zh: 他喜歡在漢堡上加額外的起司。

examples.en: He raised his hand to ask a question in class.
examples.zh: 他在課堂上舉手發問。

examples.en: She held her daughter's hand while crossing the busy street.
examples.zh: 過繁忙的馬路時，她牽著女兒的手。

examples.en: Wash your hands thoroughly with soap before having every meal.
examples.zh: 每餐吃飯前都要用肥皂徹底洗手。

examples.en: Please hand me the salt shaker across the dining table.
examples.zh: 請把餐桌對面的鹽罐遞給我。

examples.en: Students should hand in their homework assignments by Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 學生應在週五下午前繳交功課。

examples.en: The clerk handed the store receipt to the customer politely.
examples.zh: 店員禮貌地把店家發票遞給顧客。

examples.en: Our manager knows how to handle difficult customer complaints.
examples.zh: 我們的經理知道如何處理棘手的顧客抱怨。

examples.en: Please handle these fragile glass vases with extreme care.
examples.zh: 請極為小心地拿取這些易碎的玻璃花瓶。

examples.en: He learned to handle heavy machinery on the farm.
examples.zh: 他在農場學會了操作重型機械。

examples.en: Turn the door handle clockwise to enter the room.
examples.zh: 順時針轉動門把手以進入房間。

examples.en: The handle of this wooden spoon broke into two pieces.
examples.zh: 這支木匙的柄斷成了兩截。

examples.en: She gripped the suitcase handle firmly before boarding.
examples.zh: 她在上車前緊緊握住了行李箱的把手。

examples.en: The handsome actor smiled warmly at his fans on stage.
examples.zh: 那位英俊的男演員在舞台上對粉絲溫和地微笑。

examples.en: He received a handsome reward for returning the lost wallet.
examples.zh: 他因歸還遺失的皮夾而獲得了一筆相當豐厚的報酬。

examples.en: She complimented him on his handsome suit at the dinner.
examples.zh: 她在晚宴上誇獎他那身帥氣的西裝。

senses.zh: 英俊的；帥氣的；相當大的

examples.en: Please hang your coat in the closet by the door.
examples.zh: 請把你的外套掛在門邊的衣櫥裡。

examples.en: A beautiful painting hangs on the living room wall.
examples.zh: 客廳牆上掛著一幅美麗的畫作。

examples.en: They hung colorful lights around the garden for the party.
examples.zh: 他們為了派對在花園四周掛上了彩色燈飾。

examples.en: Accidents can happen if you do not pay attention while driving.
examples.zh: 如果你開車不專心，事故就可能發生。

examples.en: What happened to your bicycle after the heavy rain yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天下大雨後，你的腳踏車怎麼了？

examples.en: I happened to see my old classmate at the train station.
examples.zh: 我碰巧在火車站遇到我的老同學。

examples.en: The happy children played games together in the sunny park today.
examples.zh: 快樂的孩子們今天一起在陽光明媚的公園裡玩遊戲。

examples.en: We wish you a very happy birthday and continuous good health.
examples.zh: 我們祝你生日快樂且身體持續健康。

examples.en: She is completely happy with her current job position and salary.
examples.zh: 她對她目前的工作職位和薪水感到非常滿意。

examples.en: The coconut shell is very hard to break open.
examples.zh: 椰子殼非常硬，很難打碎。

examples.en: This exam was much harder than we had expected.
examples.zh: 這次考試比我們預期的要困難得多。

examples.en: She is a hard worker who always finishes tasks early.
examples.zh: 她是一個努力工作的人，總是提早完成任務。

examples.en: Students must study hard to enter a top university.
examples.zh: 學生們必須努力學習才能考上頂尖的大學。

examples.en: It rained hard all night and flooded the low streets.
examples.zh: 昨晚下起了大雨，淹沒了低窪街道。

examples.en: He tried hard to remember the name of his neighbor.
examples.zh: 他努力想回想起他鄰居的名字。

examples.en: I could hardly hear what the speaker was saying inside.
examples.zh: 我幾乎聽不到演講者在裡面說什麼。

examples.en: There was hardly any traffic on the highway early today.
examples.zh: 今天一大早高速公路上幾乎沒有什麼車輛。

examples.en: She hardly ever eats fast food because she prefers healthy meals.
examples.zh: 她幾乎從不吃速食，因為她更喜歡健康餐點。

examples.en: He wore a warm wool hat during the cold winter.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬天裡，他戴著一頂溫暖的毛線帽。

examples.en: She put on a straw hat to protect her face.
examples.zh: 她戴上一頂草帽以保護臉部。

examples.en: The strong wind blew his hat off his head suddenly.
examples.zh: 強風突然吹掉了他頭上的帽子。

examples.en: I hate waking up early on cold rainy winter mornings.
examples.zh: 我討厭在寒冷下雨的冬天早上早起。

examples.en: She hates eating onions in her salad at lunch time.
examples.zh: 她討厭午餐時在沙拉裡吃到洋蔥。

examples.en: They hate to see animals being treated poorly by people.
examples.zh: 他們討厭看到動物被人類惡劣對待。

examples.en: Love is always much stronger than hate in human hearts.
examples.zh: 在人類心中，愛總是比恨強大得多。

examples.en: There is no place for hate in a friendly classroom.
examples.zh: 在友善的教室裡，沒有仇恨的容身之處。

examples.en: He felt no hate toward those who had hurt him.
examples.zh: 他對那些傷害過他的人並不怨恨。

examples.en: They have two cute dogs and a big garden behind their house.
examples.zh: 他們有兩隻可愛的狗，房子後面還有一個大花園。

examples.en: Let's have a quick lunch together at the nearby café.
examples.zh: 讓我們一起在附近的咖啡館吃個快速的午餐吧。

examples.en: I have a very busy schedule full of meetings every Monday.
examples.zh: 我每週一都有非常忙碌且排滿開會的行程。

examples.en: He is studying hard for the final exam.
examples.zh: 他正為了期末考努力複習。

examples.en: My brother said he would call me later.
examples.zh: 我哥哥說他待會兒會打電話給我。

examples.en: He works as a doctor in a local hospital.
examples.zh: 他在當地的一家醫院擔任醫生。

examples.en: He nodded his head in complete agreement with the proposal.
examples.zh: 他點頭完全同意這項提案。

examples.en: She hit her head accidentally against the low ceiling frame.
examples.zh: 她的頭部不小心撞到了低矮的天花板框架上。

examples.en: The head of the department chaired the annual strategy conference.
examples.zh: 部門首腦主持了一年一度的策略會議。

examples.en: We should head toward the train station right now.
examples.zh: 我們現在應該立刻朝火車站行進。

examples.en: She will head the international research team next month.
examples.zh: 她將於下個月主管這個國際研究團隊。

examples.en: Dark clouds indicate a heavy thunderstorm is heading our way.
examples.zh: 烏雲表明一場強烈的雷陣雨正朝著我們的方向而來。

examples.en: I have a terrible headache after working at the computer.
examples.zh: 在電腦前工作後，我頭痛得厲害。

examples.en: Taking an aspirin helped relieve her throbbing headache quickly.
examples.zh: 服用阿斯匹靈有助於快速緩解她抽痛的頭痛。

examples.en: Finding a reliable handyman was a big headache for us.
examples.zh: 找到一個可靠的水電工對我們來說是一件令人頭痛的事。

examples.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to your overall health.
examples.zh: 規律運動對你的整體健康很有益處。

examples.en: Eating vegetables is good for your health.
examples.zh: 吃蔬菜對你的健康有好處。

examples.en: She had to stop working due to poor health.
examples.zh: 她因為健康狀況不佳而不得不停止工作。

examples.en: Eating fresh vegetables daily is essential for a healthy body.
examples.zh: 每天吃新鮮蔬菜對於健康的身體至關重要。

examples.en: She leads a very active and healthy lifestyle through exercise.
examples.zh: 她透過運動過著非常活躍且健康的生活方式。

examples.en: The doctor confirmed that the baby is in healthy condition.
examples.zh: 醫生確認嬰兒處於健康的狀況。

examples.en: Speak louder please, because I cannot hear you clearly.
examples.zh: 請說大聲一點，因為我聽不太清楚你的聲音。

examples.en: Did you hear the strange noise coming from the backyard last night?
examples.zh: 你昨晚有聽到後院傳來的奇怪聲音嗎？

examples.en: I was surprised to hear that she won the English speech contest.
examples.zh: 聽說她贏得英文演講比賽，我很驚訝。

examples.en: Regular cardiovascular exercise keeps your heart healthy and strong.
examples.zh: 定期的心肺運動能保持你的心臟健康與強壯。

examples.en: She has a kind heart and is always willing to help others.
examples.zh: 她有一顆善良的心，總是願意幫助他人。

examples.en: The old castle is situated in the very heart of the city.
examples.zh: 這座古老的城堡位於這座城市的最核心地帶。

examples.en: The intense heat of the summer sun made everyone feel exhausted.
examples.zh: 夏日陽光的酷熱讓每個人都感到精疲力竭。

examples.en: Turn down the heat on the stove so the soup does not boil over.
examples.zh: 把爐火調小，這樣湯才不會溢出來。

examples.en: The radiator produces enough heat to keep the whole room warm.
examples.zh: 電暖器產生的熱量足以讓整個房間保持溫暖。

examples.en: She heated some milk in a small saucepan for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她用小鍋子加熱了一些牛奶作為早餐。

examples.en: You can heat up the leftover pizza in the oven for five minutes.
examples.zh: 你可以把剩下的披薩放進烤箱加熱五分鐘。

examples.en: Solar panels absorb sunlight and heat water for the household.
examples.zh: 太陽能板吸收陽光並為家庭加熱水。

examples.en: After a long day at work, a hot bath is heaven.
examples.zh: 忙碌工作一整天後，泡個熱水澡簡直是天堂。

examples.en: This tropical island feels like heaven on earth.
examples.zh: 這個熱帶島嶼感覺就像人間天堂。

examples.en: Believers pray to go to heaven after their lives end.
examples.zh: 信徒祈禱在生命結束後能升入天堂。

examples.en: This wooden box is too heavy for one person to lift.
examples.zh: 這個木箱太重了，一個人搬不動。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused severe traffic delays throughout the entire city today.
examples.zh: 今天的大雨造成整座城市嚴重的交通延誤。

examples.en: His breathing was heavy after he ran up the steep stairs.
examples.zh: 跑上陡峭的樓梯後，他的呼吸變得很沉重。

examples.en: The doctor measured the boy's height and weight.
examples.zh: 醫生量了那個男孩的身高與體重。

examples.en: The plane is flying at a height of ten thousand meters.
examples.zh: 飛機正在一萬公尺的高空飛行。

examples.en: He is nervous because of the extreme height of the bridge.
examples.zh: 因為這座橋極高，他感到很緊張。

examples.en: The red rescue helicopter flew high over the mountain yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 紅色救援直升機昨天早上飛越了山頂上空。

examples.en: Traffic police use a helicopter to monitor busy highway conditions.
examples.zh: 交通警察使用直升機監控繁忙的公路狀況。

examples.en: A noisy helicopter landed safely on top of the hospital roof.
examples.zh: 一架噪音很大的直升機安全降落在醫院屋頂上。

examples.en: Hello, how are you doing this morning?
examples.zh: 哈囉，你今天早上過得怎麼樣？

examples.en: Say hello to your parents for me when you get home.
examples.zh: 你回家後幫我向你的父母問好。

examples.en: Hello! Is anyone there in the office?
examples.zh: 哈囉！辦公室裡有人在嗎？

examples.en: Can you help me carry these heavy boxes upstairs?
examples.zh: 你能幫我把這些重箱子搬到樓上嗎？

examples.en: She always helps her classmates with their math problems.
examples.zh: 她總是協助同班同學解決數學問題。

examples.en: This new software helps users organize their daily schedules easily.
examples.zh: 這款新軟體能協助使用者輕鬆規劃每日行程。

examples.en: Thank you very much for all your help with the event.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你在這次活動中給予的所有幫助。

examples.en: The patient called for help when he felt sudden pain.
examples.zh: 病人感到突發疼痛時立刻呼叫求助。

examples.en: With the help of a map, we found the restaurant easily.
examples.zh: 在地圖的協助下，我們輕鬆找到了那家餐廳。

examples.en: The staff at the hotel were polite and extremely helpful.
examples.zh: 飯店的工作人員很有禮貌而且非常樂於助人。

examples.en: Thank you for giving me such helpful advice on my project.
examples.zh: 謝謝你為我的專案提供這麼有幫助的建議。

examples.en: You will find this dictionary very helpful for learning English.
examples.zh: 你會發現這本字典對於學習英文非常有幫助。

examples.en: The brown hen lays an egg every morning.
examples.zh: 這隻棕色的母雞每天早上都會下一顆蛋。

examples.en: We saw several hens feeding on seeds around the farmyard.
examples.zh: 我們看到幾隻母雞在農場庭院周圍吃著種子。

examples.en: The hen protected her tiny chicks under her warm wings.
examples.zh: 母雞在她溫暖的翅膀下保護著她的小雞。

examples.en: Please sit here while you wait for the doctor.
examples.zh: 等待醫生時請坐在這裡。

examples.en: I have lived here in Taipei for more than five years.
examples.zh: 我已經住在台北這裡超過五年了。

examples.en: Come here and look at this colorful butterfly in the garden.
examples.zh: 過來這裡看花園裡這隻色彩斑斕的蝴蝶。

examples.en: The brave firefighter was hailed as a hero by citizens.
examples.zh: 這位勇敢的消防員被市民譽為英雄。

examples.en: He is the main hero of the popular adventure story.
examples.zh: 他是這本熱門冒險故事裡的主角。

examples.en: Her grandfather was her biggest hero while she was growing up.
examples.zh: 在她成長的過程中，她的祖父是她最大的英雄。

examples.en: The shy cat likes to hide under the bed when guests arrive.
examples.zh: 那隻害羞的貓在客人來時喜歡躲在床下。

examples.en: He tried to hide his disappointment with a smile.
examples.zh: 他試圖用微笑掩飾他的失望。

examples.en: Where did you hide the extra keys to the house?
examples.zh: 你把房子多餘的鑰匙藏在哪裡了？

examples.en: The mountain is too high for us to climb in one day.
examples.zh: 這座山太高了，我們無法在一天內攀登。

examples.en: The store offers high-quality products at reasonable prices.
examples.zh: 這家商店以合理的價格提供高品質的產品。

examples.en: She is suffering from high blood pressure and needs rest.
examples.zh: 她患有高血壓，需要休息。

examples.en: The eagle flew high above the snow-capped mountains.
examples.zh: 老鷹在覆雪的山脈高空飛翔。

examples.en: Please hold the poster up high so everyone can see it.
examples.zh: 請把海報舉高，這樣大家才看得到。

examples.en: The kite flew high in the sky over the beach.
examples.zh: 風箏在海灘上空高高飛翔。

examples.en: The movie was highly recommended by many famous film critics.
examples.zh: 這部電影受到了許多知名影評人的高度推薦。

examples.en: She is a highly intelligent student who solves problems easily.
examples.zh: 她是一位非常聰明的學生，能輕鬆解決問題。

examples.en: His contributions were highly valued by the company.
examples.zh: 他的貢獻受到公司高度重視。

examples.en: Cars speed along the coastal highway under the bright sun.
examples.zh: 汽車在明亮陽光下沿著沿海公路疾馳。

examples.en: There was a long traffic delay on the national highway.
examples.zh: 國道公路上出現了長時間的交通延誤。

examples.en: Engineers built a new highway connecting the two major cities.
examples.zh: 工程師建造了一條連接這兩座主要城市的新公路。

examples.en: We plan to hike up the mountain early tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我們計劃明天清晨徒步健行上山。

examples.en: The bank decided to hike interest rates by two percent.
examples.zh: 銀行決定將利率大幅調升百分之二。

examples.en: They hiked through the national park for four straight hours.
examples.zh: 他們在國家公園裡連續健行了四個小時。

examples.en: They took a long hike through the forest last weekend.
examples.zh: 他們上週末在森林裡進行了一次長途健行。

examples.en: A sharp hike in fuel prices surprised all local drivers.
examples.zh: 燃料價格的急劇上漲讓所有在地駕駛感到驚訝。

examples.en: After a challenging mountain hike, everyone rested by the lake.
examples.zh: 在一次富有挑戰性的山區健行之後，大家在湖邊休息。

examples.en: They walked up the hill to see the sunset.
examples.zh: 他們爬上小山去看日落。

examples.en: A beautiful house sits on top of the hill.
examples.zh: 一棟美麗的房子坐落在山頂上。

examples.en: Children love running down the grassy hill.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡從長滿草的小山丘上跑下來。

examples.en: She put her hands on her hips while waiting in line.
examples.zh: 她排隊等待時雙手叉腰。

examples.en: The elderly man injured his hip after falling on the ice.
examples.zh: 這位老人在冰上滑倒後傷到了髖部。

examples.en: Measure around the widest part of your hips to get an accurate pants size.
examples.zh: 測量臀部最寬的部分以取得準確的長褲尺寸。

examples.en: A large hippopotamus was resting peacefully in the cool muddy river.
examples.zh: 一隻大河馬正安靜地在涼爽的泥濘河流中休息。

examples.en: Children were excited to see the hungry hippopotamus open its mouth.
examples.zh: 孩子們看到那隻飢餓的河馬張開嘴巴時感到很興奮。

examples.en: The zookeeper fed fresh vegetables to the hippopotamus.
examples.zh: 動物園管理員把新鮮蔬菜餵給河馬吃。

examples.en: The museum displays many valuable historical artifacts from ancient times.
examples.zh: 博物館展出了許多來自古代的珍貴歷史文物。

examples.en: She loves reading historical novels set during the Renaissance period.
examples.zh: 她喜歡閱讀設定在文藝復興時期的歷史小說。

examples.en: Preserving this old temple is of great historical importance.
examples.zh: 保護這座老廟具有重大歷史重要性。

examples.en: She is studying European history at the university.
examples.zh: 她正在大學攻讀歐洲歷史。

examples.en: The ancient castle has a long and interesting history.
examples.zh: 這座古老的城堡有著悠久且有趣的歷史。

examples.en: The two countries have a shared cultural history.
examples.zh: 這兩個國家擁有共同的文化歷史。

examples.en: The batter managed to hit the baseball far into the outfield.
examples.zh: 打擊手成功把棒球擊到了遠方的外野。

examples.en: Be careful not to hit your head on the low doorway.
examples.zh: 當心不要把頭撞到低矮的門框。

examples.en: A powerful typhoon hit the coastal city late last night.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風於昨晚深夜襲擊了這座沿海城市。

examples.en: The new song became an instant hit on the radio stations.
examples.zh: 這首新歌立刻成為廣播電台的熱門曲目。

examples.en: The player got a crucial hit in the final inning.
examples.zh: 這名球員在最後一局擊出了關鍵的一支安打。

examples.en: Her latest novel was a major commercial hit around the world.
examples.zh: 她最新的小說在全球獲得了巨大的商業成功。

senses.zh: 打擊；熱門事物；成功的作品

examples.en: My favorite hobby is collecting stamps from different countries.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的嗜好是收集來自不同國家的郵票。

examples.en: Gardening is a relaxing hobby that helps reduce daily stress.
examples.zh: 園藝是一種令人放鬆的興趣，有助於減輕日常壓力。

examples.en: He picked up photography as a new hobby during his vacation.
examples.zh: 他在假期期間把攝影當成了一種新興趣。

examples.en: Please hold my hand while we cross the busy street.
examples.zh: 我們穿過繁忙的街道時，請握住我的手。

examples.en: The school will hold an annual sports meeting next month.
examples.zh: 學校將於下個月舉辦一年一度的運動會。

examples.en: This small bag can hold all your personal travel items.
examples.zh: 這個小包包可以裝下你所有的個人旅行用品。

examples.en: Keep a firm hold on the railing while walking down stairs.
examples.zh: 走下樓梯時，請緊緊握住扶手。

examples.en: The police officer lost his hold on the fleeing suspect.
examples.zh: 警官對逃逸嫌犯失去控制。

examples.en: She grabbed a tight hold of her mother's coat in fear.
examples.zh: 她害怕地緊緊抓住媽媽的外套。

examples.en: He dug a deep hole in the soil to plant a tree.
examples.zh: 他在土壤裡挖了一個深洞來種樹。

examples.en: There is a small hole in my favorite cotton sock today.
examples.zh: 今天我最喜歡的棉襪上有個小洞。

examples.en: The rabbit ran into its underground hole to hide safely.
examples.zh: 兔子跑進地下的洞穴裡安全躲藏。

examples.en: Christmas is a major holiday celebrated by many people around the world.
examples.zh: 聖誕節是全球許多人慶祝的重要節日。

examples.en: Our family is planning to go to Japan during the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 我們全家打算在暑假期間去日本。

examples.en: Monday is a public holiday, so all offices and banks will be closed.
examples.zh: 星期一是國定假日，所以所有辦公室和銀行都會放假。

examples.en: After a long trip, it feels good to be home.
examples.zh: 長途旅行後，回到家的感覺真好。

examples.en: They bought their dream home near the ocean last month.
examples.zh: 他們上個月在海洋附近買下了夢想中的家。

examples.en: Taiwan is home to many unique species of wildlife.
examples.zh: 台灣是許多獨特野生動物物種的棲息地。

examples.en: Please call me as soon as you arrive home safely.
examples.zh: 你安全到家後請立刻打電話給我。

examples.en: I stayed home all weekend to rest and read books.
examples.zh: 我整個週末都待在家休息和看書。

examples.en: She walked home after school with her friends.
examples.zh: 她放學後和朋友走路回家。

examples.en: Students must finish their math homework before going out to play.
examples.zh: 學生在出去玩之前必須完成數學作業。

examples.en: The teacher assigned a lot of reading homework for the weekend.
examples.zh: 老師為週末佈置了大量的閱讀功課。

examples.en: She spent two full hours working on her science project homework.
examples.zh: 她花了整整兩個小時做科學專題作業。

examples.en: He is an honest man who always tells the truth.
examples.zh: 他是一個總是說實話的誠實男人。

examples.en: Thank you for giving me your honest opinion on this.
examples.zh: 謝謝你對這件事給予我誠實的意見。

examples.en: An honest answer is always better than a sweet lie.
examples.zh: 誠實的回答總是比甜言蜜語的謊言更好。

examples.en: Bees collect nectar from flowers to make honey.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂從花朵中收集花蜜來製造蜂蜜。

examples.en: I put a spoonful of honey into my green tea.
examples.zh: 我在綠茶裡加了一匙蜂蜜。

examples.en: Honey, can you pass me the newspaper on the table?
examples.zh: 寶貝，你能把桌上的報紙拿給我嗎？

examples.en: The little rabbit hopped across the green lawn happily.
examples.zh: 小兔子開心地蹦蹦跳跳穿過綠色草坪。

examples.en: He hopped on one foot because his shoe came off.
examples.zh: 因為鞋子脫落了，他用單腳跳著。

examples.en: A small bird hopped onto the wooden bench beside me.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥跳上了我身旁的木製長椅。

examples.en: It is only a short hop by plane between the two cities.
examples.zh: 這兩座城市之間搭飛機只是短短一趟飛行。

examples.en: The boy took a hop over the mud puddle.
examples.zh: 男孩一躍跳過了那灘泥水。

examples.en: We decided to take a quick hop over to Taiwan.
examples.zh: 我們決定搭短程飛機去台灣一趟。

examples.en: I hope to pass the entrance exam and get into a good university.
examples.zh: 我希望通過入學考試並考上好大學。

examples.en: We hope that the rainy weather will clear up before our picnic tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們希望雨天能在明天野餐前放晴。

examples.en: She hopes that her parents will let her adopt a stray dog.
examples.zh: 她希望父母會同意她收養一隻流浪狗。

examples.en: The new medicine gives patients hope for a full recovery.
examples.zh: 這種新藥給了患者完全康復的希望。

examples.en: Never lose hope even when you face difficult challenges in life.
examples.zh: 即使在生活中遇到艱難的挑戰，也絕不要失去希望。

examples.en: There is little hope of finding his lost wallet in the crowd.
examples.zh: 在人群中找回他遺失的皮夾希望渺茫。

examples.en: He rode his horse across the open green field.
examples.zh: 他騎著他的馬穿過開闊的綠色田野。

examples.en: Horses were widely used for transportation in the past.
examples.zh: 過去馬被廣泛用於交通運輸。

examples.en: The brown horse galloped fast along the sea beach.
examples.zh: 那匹棕色的馬沿著海灘快速奔馳。

examples.en: The injured runner was taken to the hospital immediately.
examples.zh: 受傷的跑者被立刻送往了醫院。

examples.en: She works as a senior nurse in a hospital.
examples.zh: 她在一家醫院擔任資深護理師。

examples.en: The local hospital offers free health checks every year.
examples.zh: 當地的醫院每年都提供免費的健康檢查。

examples.en: The generous host greeted all his party guests at the door.
examples.zh: 這位慷慨的主人在門口招呼所有的派對客人。

examples.en: She works as a popular television talk show host currently.
examples.zh: 她目前擔任熱門電視談話節目主持人。

examples.en: Our host in Kyoto prepared a traditional Japanese breakfast for us.
examples.zh: 京都招待我們的主人為我們準備了傳統的日式早餐。

examples.en: Our school will host the regional science fair this year.
examples.zh: 我們學校今年將主辦區域科學展覽會。

examples.en: They offered to host foreign exchange students during summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他們主動提議在暑假期間寄宿款待外籍交換學生。

examples.en: He was asked to host the annual school graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 他被邀請主持每年的學校畢業典禮。

examples.en: It was extremely hot outside in the afternoon sun today.
examples.zh: 今天下午太陽下外面極其炎熱。

examples.en: Be careful when drinking this hot cup of black tea.
examples.zh: 喝這杯熱紅茶時要小心。

examples.en: This traditional spicy soup is too hot for me to eat.
examples.zh: 這道傳統辣湯對我來說太辣了，吃不下。

examples.en: We booked a luxury hotel near the beach for our summer vacation.
examples.zh: 我們為暑假預訂了海灘附近的一家豪華飯店。

examples.en: The hotel staff greeted us with warm smiles at the entrance.
examples.zh: 飯店員工在入口處以溫暖的笑容迎接我們。

examples.en: Check-out time at this hotel is before eleven in the morning.
examples.zh: 這家飯店的退房時間是上午十一點前。

examples.en: The meeting lasted for more than an hour this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上的會議持續了一個多小時。

examples.en: We will arrive at our destination in half an hour.
examples.zh: 我們將在半小時內到達目的地。

examples.en: She studies English for one hour every day.
examples.zh: 她每天學一小時的英文。

examples.en: They bought a spacious two-story house with a small garden.
examples.zh: 他們買了一棟帶有小花園的寬敞兩層樓房子。

examples.en: Our house is located close to the subway station.
examples.zh: 我們的房子位於靠近捷運站的地方。

examples.en: We painted the outside walls of the house light yellow.
examples.zh: 我們把房子外牆漆成了淺黃色。

examples.en: She is a dedicated housewife who takes great care of her family.
examples.zh: 她是一位盡責的家庭主婦，把家人照顧得很好。

examples.en: My mother worked as a housewife after my younger brother was born.
examples.zh: 我弟弟出生後，我媽媽就擔任家庭主婦。

examples.en: The local center holds cooking classes specifically designed for housewives.
examples.zh: 當地中心專門為家庭主婦舉辦烹飪課程。

examples.en: How do you go to school every day?
examples.zh: 你每天怎麼去上學？

examples.en: She explained how the machine works for us.
examples.zh: 她向我們解釋了這台機器是如何運作的。

examples.en: How long does it take to get there by bus?
examples.zh: 搭公車到那裡需要花多少時間？

examples.en: He was tired; however, he continued working on his project.
examples.zh: 他很累，然而，他仍繼續處理他的計畫。

examples.en: The food was expensive; however, it tasted wonderful.
examples.zh: 食物很貴，然而，味道非常美妙。

examples.en: You can solve this puzzle however you like.
examples.zh: 你可以用任何你喜歡的方式解開這個謎題。

examples.en: They built a huge shopping mall near the central train station.
examples.zh: 他們在中央火車站附近建造了一座巨大的購物中心。

examples.en: Winning the competition was a huge success for the young team.
examples.zh: 贏得比賽對這支年輕團隊而言是極大的成功。

examples.en: A huge crowd gathered to watch the spectacular outdoor music show.
examples.zh: 一大群民眾聚集觀看這場壯觀的戶外音樂秀。

examples.en: Human activity has a huge impact on our climate.
examples.zh: 人類活動對我們的氣候有著巨大的影響。

examples.en: Making small mistakes is a normal human trait.
examples.zh: 犯小錯是正常的人性。

examples.en: The human body needs water to work properly.
examples.zh: 人體需要水才能正常運作。

examples.en: Humans have explored outer space for several decades now.
examples.zh: 人類探索外太空已經有好幾十年了。

examples.en: Dogs have lived alongside humans for thousands of years.
examples.zh: 狗與人類共同生活了數千年。

examples.en: All humans deserve to be treated with respect everywhere.
examples.zh: 所有人在任何地方都值得被尊重對待。

examples.en: Despite winning many awards, the scientist remained humble about his achievements.
examples.zh: 儘管贏得了許多獎項，這位科學家對自己的成就依然保持謙虛。

examples.en: The famous artist grew up in a humble home in the countryside.
examples.zh: 這位著名的藝術家在鄉下一個簡陋的家中長大。

examples.en: In my humble opinion, we should spend more time reviewing the notes.
examples.zh: 依我拙見，我們應該花更多時間複習筆記。

examples.en: More than two hundred guests attended the wedding party.
examples.zh: 超過兩百名賓客參加了婚禮派對。

examples.en: The temperature reached nearly one hundred degrees today.
examples.zh: 今天的氣溫幾乎達到了華氏一百度。

examples.en: She saved several hundred dollars to buy a new laptop.
examples.zh: 她存了數百美元來買一台新筆記型電腦。

examples.en: There are one hundred questions on the final history test.
examples.zh: 期末歷史測驗有一百道題目。

examples.en: The ancient building is over three hundred years old.
examples.zh: 這棟古老的建築已有三百多年的歷史。

examples.en: He ran a hundred meters in less than twelve seconds.
examples.zh: 他在不到十二秒的時間內跑完了一百公尺。

examples.en: I am so hungry that I could eat a huge meal right now.
examples.zh: 我肚子好餓，現在可以吃下一大頓飯。

examples.en: The hungry stray dog looked for food near the back door.
examples.zh: 那隻飢餓的流浪狗在後門附近尋找食物。

examples.en: Young students are often hungry for knowledge and new skills.
examples.zh: 年輕的學生往往渴望知識與新技能。

examples.en: Wild animals hunt for food at night in the forest.
examples.zh: 野獸夜晚會在森林裡獵食。

examples.en: She is hunting for a new apartment near her office.
examples.zh: 她正在尋找她辦公室附近的新公寓。

examples.en: The police are still hunting for the thief who robbed the store.
examples.zh: 警方仍在追捕搶劫那間商店的小偷。

examples.en: The treasure hunt was the most exciting activity of the camp.
examples.zh: 尋寶活動是營隊中最令人興奮的活動。

examples.en: They started a hunt for talented singers in the city.
examples.zh: 他們在這座城市展開了一場尋找有潛力歌手的活動。

examples.en: The police officer continued the hunt for the stolen car.
examples.zh: 警官繼續進行對那輛失竊汽車的搜尋。

examples.en: The hunter tracked animal footprints through the deep forest.
examples.zh: 獵人穿過深山森林追蹤動物的足跡。

examples.en: Ancient hunters relied on sharp spears to hunt food.
examples.zh: 古代的獵人依靠銳利的矛來獵取食物。

examples.en: The hunter returned home safely before the sun set.
examples.zh: 獵人在太陽下山之前安全回到了家。

examples.en: Hurry up or we will miss the last train home.
examples.zh: 快一點，不然我們會錯過回家的末班火車。

examples.en: She hurried through her breakfast to arrive at school on time.
examples.zh: 她匆忙吃完早餐以按時到達學校。

examples.en: Don't hurry me while I am trying to finish this task.
examples.zh: 當我試圖完成這項任務時不要催促我。

examples.en: In his hurry to leave, he forgot his car keys.
examples.zh: 在他急著離開時，他忘了拿車鑰匙。

examples.en: There is no hurry, so please take your time.
examples.zh: 不用急，請慢慢來。

examples.en: She was in a big hurry and left without saying goodbye.
examples.zh: 她非常匆忙，沒道別就離開了。

examples.en: He hurt his left knee while playing soccer yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 他昨天下午踢足球時弄傷了左膝蓋。

examples.en: My head hurts badly because I did not sleep well.
examples.zh: 我頭疼得厲害，因為我沒有睡好。

examples.en: Cruel words can hurt people more deeply than physical injuries.
examples.zh: 殘忍的言語比肉體傷害更容易深層地傷害人。

examples.en: The hurt dog was taken to the vet immediately.
examples.zh: 受傷的狗立刻被送往獸醫院。

examples.en: She felt hurt when her friends forgot her birthday.
examples.zh: 當朋友忘記她的生日時，她感到受傷。

examples.en: No passengers were hurt in the minor train accident.
examples.zh: 這起輕微的火車事故中沒有乘客受傷。

examples.en: Her husband works as a software engineer for a tech firm.
examples.zh: 她的丈夫在一家科技公司擔任軟體工程師。

examples.en: She and her husband enjoy hiking in the mountains on weekends.
examples.zh: 她和她的丈夫喜歡在週末去山上健行。

examples.en: He is a loving husband and a devoted father to three children.
examples.zh: 他是一位慈愛的丈夫，也是三個孩子盡責的父親。

examples.en: I usually go jogging in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我通常每天早上在公園慢跑。

examples.en: I am preparing for the English speaking contest next week.
examples.zh: 我正在準備下週的英語口說比賽。

examples.en: When I arrived at the station, the train had left.
examples.zh: 當我到達車站時，火車已經開走了。

examples.en: Would you like some ice in your lemon tea?
examples.zh: 你的檸檬茶裡要加一些冰塊嗎？

examples.en: The road was covered with a thin layer of ice.
examples.zh: 道路被一層薄冰所覆蓋。

examples.en: The child slipped on the ice and fell down.
examples.zh: 小孩在冰上滑倒了。

examples.en: That is a brilliant idea for our school science project.
examples.zh: 這對我們的學校科學專題來說是一個絕妙的主意。

examples.en: I have no idea where I left my house keys.
examples.zh: 我完全不知道我把家裡鑰匙放在哪裡了。

examples.en: The team spent hours discussing new marketing ideas.
examples.zh: 團隊花了數小時討論新的行銷想法。

examples.en: The sunny warm weather is ideal for a picnic.
examples.zh: 晴朗溫暖的天氣非常適合野餐。

examples.en: She found an ideal job that matches her skills.
examples.zh: 她找到了一份符合自己技能的理想工作。

examples.en: This quiet room is an ideal place for studying.
examples.zh: 這間安靜的房間是讀書的理想場所。

examples.en: He works hard to achieve his highest personal ideal.
examples.zh: 他努力工作以實現他最高的個人理想。

examples.en: They fought bravely for their political ideals during war.
examples.zh: 他們在戰爭期間為他們的政治理想勇敢奮戰。

examples.en: Her noble ideals inspired many young people in her community.
examples.zh: 她高尚的理想啟發了社群裡的許多年輕人。

examples.en: Please present your ID card to prove your identity at check-in.
examples.zh: 辦理報到時請出示你的身分證件以證明身分。

examples.en: Traditional festivals help people keep their cultural identity.
examples.zh: 傳統節慶幫助人們保有自己的文化認同。

examples.en: He wants to protect his personal identity on social media networks.
examples.zh: 他想在社群網路平台上保護自己的個人身分。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the outdoor picnic.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我們將取消戶外野餐。

examples.en: Please let me know if you need any help.
examples.zh: 如果你需要任何協助，請讓我知道。

examples.en: I wonder if she will attend the dinner party tonight.
examples.zh: 我想知道她今晚是否會參加晚宴。

examples.en: You should not ignore the safety warnings posted on the wall.
examples.zh: 你不應該忽視貼在牆上的安全警告。

examples.en: He chose to ignore the negative comments on his social media.
examples.zh: 他選擇不理會自己社群媒體上的負面留言。

examples.en: The lazy student ignored the teacher's advice about studying hard.
examples.zh: 那個怠惰的學生忽視了老師關於勤奮學習的建議。

examples.en: My classmate was ill yesterday and stayed home resting.
examples.zh: 我同學昨天生病了，待在家裡休息。

examples.en: Smoking can have serious ill effects on human lungs.
examples.zh: 吸菸可能對人體肺部造成嚴重的不良影響。

examples.en: She nursed her ill grandfather with great care every day.
examples.zh: 她每天都細心照料她生病的祖父。

examples.en: She uploaded a high-resolution image to the company website.
examples.zh: 她把一張高解析度影像上傳到公司網站。

examples.en: The mirror showed a clear image of his tired face.
examples.zh: 鏡子清楚顯現出他疲憊面容的影像。

examples.en: The famous company works hard to maintain its public image.
examples.zh: 這家知名公司努力維持其公眾形象。

examples.en: I can hardly imagine living in a world without internet.
examples.zh: 我幾乎無法想像生活在一個沒有網路的世界。

examples.en: Try to imagine what the future city will look like.
examples.zh: 試著想像未來的城市會是什麼樣子。

examples.en: She imagined herself winning the first prize in the competition.
examples.zh: 她想像自己獲得了比賽的頭獎。

examples.en: The teacher stressed the importance of reading books every day.
examples.zh: 老師強調了每天閱讀書籍的重要性。

examples.en: Clean drinking water is of high importance to human health.
examples.zh: 乾淨的飲用水對人類健康至關重要。

examples.en: She did not realize the importance of the meeting until later.
examples.zh: 她直到後來才意識到那場會議的重要性。

examples.en: It is important to wear a helmet while riding.
examples.zh: 騎車時配戴安全帽是很重要的。

examples.en: Clean water is important for all living things.
examples.zh: 乾淨的水對所有生物都很重要。

examples.en: She received an important phone call from her doctor.
examples.zh: 她接到了來自醫生的一通重要電話。

examples.en: The young student gave an impressive presentation to the audience.
examples.zh: 這位年輕學生給觀眾帶來了一場令人印象深刻的簡報。

examples.en: The team achieved impressive results despite many challenges this year.
examples.zh: 儘管今年面臨許多挑戰，該團隊仍取得了令人欽佩的成果。

examples.en: The hotel features an impressive view of the entire city.
examples.zh: 這家飯店擁有可俯瞰整座城市、令人印象深刻的景色。

senses.zh: 給人深刻印象的；令人欽佩的

examples.en: Listening to English podcasts can improve your pronunciation.
examples.zh: 收聽英文播客可以改善你的發音。

examples.en: The company hopes to improve product quality this year.
examples.zh: 公司希望今年能提高產品品質。

examples.en: Her health has greatly improved since she started exercising.
examples.zh: 自從開始運動後，她的健康狀況大有改進。

examples.en: The office keys are in the top drawer of the wooden desk.
examples.zh: 辦公室鑰匙在木桌最上面的抽屜裡。

examples.en: We plan to visit Taiwan in the month of October this year.
examples.zh: 我們計劃在今年十月份造訪台灣。

examples.en: She likes to read comic books in her spare time at home.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在家裡的空閒時間看漫畫書。

examples.en: Please come in and take a seat near the open window.
examples.zh: 請進來並坐在靠窗的位置。

examples.en: The teacher walked in with a big stack of test papers.
examples.zh: 老師拿著一大疊考卷走了進來。

examples.en: Is anybody in at the office at this late hour tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚這麼晚的時間辦公室裡還有人在嗎？

examples.en: The newborn puppy is only a few inches long.
examples.zh: 那隻剛出生的幼犬只有幾英吋長。

examples.en: Water rose several inches during the heavy rainstorm last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚大暴雨期間，水面上升了數英吋。

examples.en: He bought a computer monitor with a twenty-four-inch screen.
examples.zh: 他買了一台二十四吋的電腦螢幕。

examples.en: Traffic inched forward slowly during the evening rush hour.
examples.zh: 在傍晚的尖峰時段，車流緩慢地向前挪動。

examples.en: The climber inched up the steep rock wall with great care.
examples.zh: 登山者非常小心地沿著陡峭的岩壁緩慢向上攀爬。

examples.en: The deadline is inching closer every day.
examples.zh: 截止日期每天都在逐步逼近。

examples.en: The total price of the hotel booking includes full breakfast.
examples.zh: 飯店預訂的總價包含全套早餐。

examples.en: Please include your contact details in the job application email.
examples.zh: 請在求職郵件中包含你的聯絡方式。

examples.en: Our tour package includes round trip flight and hotel accommodation.
examples.zh: 我們的旅遊套裝行程包括來回機票與飯店住宿。

examples.en: He donates ten percent of his monthly income to charity.
examples.zh: 他將自己每月收入的百分之十捐給慈善機構。

examples.en: The family is looking for ways to generate extra income.
examples.zh: 這個家庭正在尋找創造額外收益的方法。

examples.en: Tax is calculated based on your total annual income.
examples.zh: 稅金是根據你的年度總收入來計算的。

examples.en: The company plans to increase its sales in the upcoming quarter.
examples.zh: 公司計劃在接下來的季度提高銷售額。

examples.en: Regular exercise can help increase your physical strength and energy.
examples.zh: 定期運動有助於增加你的體力和活力。

examples.en: High demand caused the price of fresh vegetables to increase quickly.
examples.zh: 高需求導致新鮮蔬菜的價格迅速增加。

examples.en: The company saw a steady increase in user numbers this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年看到使用者數量穩步增長。

examples.en: There was a sudden increase in traffic during the evening rush.
examples.zh: 在傍晚高峰時段，交通流量突然增加。

examples.en: An increase in temperature signaled the arrival of warm summer weather.
examples.zh: 氣溫上升標誌著溫暖夏天天氣的到來。

examples.en: The exam was indeed difficult, but most students passed.
examples.zh: 這場考試確實很難，但大多數學生都通過了。

examples.en: Thank you very much; that was helpful advice indeed.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你，那確實是一個有用的建議。

examples.en: It was indeed a pleasure to meet you after so long.
examples.zh: 能在這麼久之後見到你確實是一件令人愉快的事。

examples.en: Living alone in a foreign country taught her great financial independence.
examples.zh: 獨自居住在國外教會了她極大的財務獨立。

examples.en: The country celebrated fifty years of national independence with fireworks.
examples.zh: 該國放煙火慶祝國家獨立五十週年。

examples.en: Encouraging children's independence helps them build strong confidence early.
examples.zh: 鼓勵孩子的自主性有助於他們早期建立強大的自信。

examples.en: She became completely financially independent after landing a good job.
examples.zh: 她在找到一份好工作後，經濟上完全獨立了。

examples.en: The small island nation became an independent country last century.
examples.zh: 這個小島國在上個世紀成為了一個獨立的國家。

examples.en: Students are encouraged to be independent thinkers in college.
examples.zh: 學生在大學被鼓勵成為獨立思考者。

examples.en: Red signs on the road indicate that drivers must stop immediately.
examples.zh: 道路上的紅色標誌指示駕駛人必須立即停止。

examples.en: Recent survey results indicate a growing interest in healthy organic food.
examples.zh: 最近的調查結果顯示出對健康有機食品日益增長的興趣。

examples.en: Please indicate your choice on the form by marking an X.
examples.zh: 請在表格上畫個 X 以指出你的選擇。

examples.en: Each student will receive individual attention from the helpful teacher.
examples.zh: 每位學生都會得到那位熱心老師的個別關照。

examples.en: They served the dessert in small individual dishes for everyone.
examples.zh: 他們用小巧的個人盤子為大家端上甜點。

examples.en: She has a very individual style of painting colorful landscapes.
examples.zh: 她繪製繽紛風景畫的風格非常獨特。

examples.en: The rights of the individual must be protected by law.
examples.zh: 個人的權利必須受到法律保護。

examples.en: Every individual in society can make a positive contribution.
examples.zh: 社會中的每一個個體都能做出積極的貢獻。

examples.en: He is a highly talented individual with great promise.
examples.zh: 他是一位極具才華、前途無量的人。

examples.en: The semiconductor industry plays a critical role in Taiwan's economy.
examples.zh: 半導體產業在台灣經濟中扮演著關鍵角色。

examples.en: Tourism is a major industry in this scenic coastal town.
examples.zh: 觀光業是這個風景優美的海岸小鎮的主要產業。

examples.en: The movie industry attracts millions of young people every year.
examples.zh: 電影產業每年吸引數以百萬計的年輕人。

examples.en: High inflation has caused food prices to rise rapidly this year.
examples.zh: 高通貨膨脹導致今年食物價格快速上漲。

examples.en: Many central banks raise interest rates to slow down high inflation.
examples.zh: 許多中央銀行提高利率以緩解高通貨膨脹。

examples.en: People are worried about how inflation affects their monthly family budget.
examples.zh: 人們很擔心通貨膨脹會如何影響他們的每月家庭預算。

examples.en: Parents have a deep influence on children's personality.
examples.zh: 父母對孩子的性格有深遠的影響。

examples.en: The politician used his political influence to support the bill.
examples.zh: 這名政治家利用他的政治影響力支持該法案。

examples.en: Her musical style shows a clear influence from jazz.
examples.zh: 她的音樂風格顯示出受到爵士樂的明顯影響。

examples.en: Social media can strongly influence how people shop.
examples.zh: 社群媒體會強烈影響人們的購物方式。

examples.en: The bad weather will not influence our decision.
examples.zh: 壞天氣不會影響我們的決定。

examples.en: A good teacher can positively influence a student's life.
examples.zh: 一位好老師可以積極感化學生的一生。

examples.en: The pen ran out of blue ink during the English exam.
examples.zh: 英文考試期間，這支筆的藍色墨水用完了。

examples.en: Traditional calligraphers use black ink made from natural materials.
examples.zh: 傳統書法家使用由天然材料製成的黑墨水。

examples.en: We need to order new color ink cartridges for the printer.
examples.zh: 我們需要為印表機訂購新的彩色墨水匣。

examples.en: She called the hotel reception to inquire about room availability tomorrow.
examples.zh: 她打電話給飯店前台，詢問明天是否還有空房。

examples.en: I would like to inquire about the prices of your English courses.
examples.zh: 我想詢問一下貴機構英文課程的價格。

examples.en: Police officers arrived at the scene to inquire about the accident.
examples.zh: 警察趕到現場，調查詢問這起事故的情況。

examples.en: A small green insect landed on the broad leaf.
examples.zh: 一隻綠色小昆蟲停在大葉片上。

examples.en: Insects play a crucial role in pollinating flowers naturally.
examples.zh: 昆蟲在大自然中替花朵授粉扮演著關鍵角色。

examples.en: We sprayed insect repellent to keep the bugs away.
examples.zh: 我們噴了防蚊液來驅趕蟲子。

examples.en: Keep your house keys inside your bag so you do not lose them.
examples.zh: 把家裡鑰匙放在包包裡面，這樣就不會弄丟。

examples.en: The cute dog is sleeping inside its cozy wooden house.
examples.zh: 那隻可愛的狗正在牠舒適的小木屋裡面睡覺。

examples.en: They stayed inside the coffee shop during the heavy rainstorm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間他們待在咖啡館裡面。

examples.en: It was cold outside, so everyone went inside to get warm.
examples.zh: 外面很冷，所以大家都進到室內取暖。

examples.en: Please check what is inside before opening this large cardboard box.
examples.zh: 打開這個大紙箱前請檢查裡面裝了什麼。

examples.en: It was raining, so the children stayed inside all afternoon.
examples.zh: 當時在下雨，所以孩子們整個下午都待在室內。

examples.en: The inside of the house was completely renovated early last year.
examples.zh: 這棟房子的內部在去年初經過了全面翻修。

examples.en: Paint the inside of the cabinet white to match your bedroom.
examples.zh: 把櫥櫃的內部漆成白色以配合你的臥室風格。

examples.en: He knows the inside details of the corporate system very well.
examples.zh: 他非常了解企業系統內部的細節。

examples.en: My grandmother always insists that we eat a huge breakfast.
examples.zh: 我奶奶總是堅持要我們吃一頓豐盛的早餐。

examples.en: He insisted on paying for the entire dinner last night.
examples.zh: 他昨晚堅持要支付整頓晚餐的費用。

examples.en: She insists that she turned off the stove before leaving.
examples.zh: 她堅稱自己在離開前已經關掉了瓦斯爐。

examples.en: This report provides a clear instance of effective communication skills.
examples.zh: 這份報告提供了一個有效溝通技巧的清晰實例。

examples.en: In most instances, customer complaints are handled within one day.
examples.zh: 在大多數情況下，顧客的抱怨會在一天內處理完畢。

examples.en: Let me give you an instance to explain my point.
examples.zh: 讓我給你舉一個例子來解釋我的觀點。

examples.en: The new app provides instant messaging for users worldwide.
examples.zh: 這款新應用程式為全球使用者提供即時通訊。

examples.en: He made a quick cup of instant coffee before leaving home.
examples.zh: 他在出門前快速沖了一杯即溶咖啡。

examples.en: The novel became an instant success right after its official publication.
examples.zh: 這本小說在正式出版後獲得了立即的成功。

examples.en: For an instant, I thought I saw a familiar face.
examples.zh: 有那麼一瞬間，我以為看到了熟悉的面孔。

examples.en: The fireworks lit up the sky for a magical instant.
examples.zh: 煙火在神奇的剎那間照亮了夜空。

examples.en: She recognized her childhood friend the instant he stepped inside.
examples.zh: 就在他踏進室內的瞬間，她認出了童年好友。

examples.en: He did not go out; instead, he stayed home.
examples.zh: 他沒有外出，而是待在家裡。

examples.en: We had tea instead of coffee after our meal.
examples.zh: 我們餐後喝的是茶而不是咖啡。

examples.en: If you cannot come, send a representative instead.
examples.zh: 如果你不能來，請派一名代表代替。

examples.en: Please follow the instructions carefully before you start assembling the chair.
examples.zh: 在開始組裝椅子之前，請仔細遵循指示。

examples.en: The teacher gave clear instructions on how to complete the homework.
examples.zh: 老師針對如何完成作業給出了明確的說明。

examples.en: She received instruction in music from a very famous piano teacher.
examples.zh: 她跟隨一位非常著名的鋼琴老師學習音樂。

examples.en: The piano is her favorite musical instrument to play at home.
examples.zh: 鋼琴是她在家中最喜歡彈奏的樂器。

examples.en: Surgeons must sterilize all medical instruments before performing surgery.
examples.zh: 外科醫師在進行手術前必須消毒所有醫療儀器。

examples.en: Scientists used a delicate measurement instrument to collect atmospheric data.
examples.zh: 科學家使用精密測量儀器收集大氣數據。

examples.en: Teachers encourage students to interact with each other during class.
examples.zh: 老師鼓勵學生在課堂上彼此互動。

examples.en: These chemical substances interact with each other to produce heat.
examples.zh: 這些化學物質相互作用產生熱能。

examples.en: The software allows users to interact with 3D models easily.
examples.zh: 這套軟體允許使用者輕鬆與 3D 模型互動。

examples.en: She showed a strong interest in learning traditional Chinese painting.
examples.zh: 她對學習傳統水墨畫展現出濃厚的興趣。

examples.en: The bank offers a high interest rate on long-term savings.
examples.zh: 這家銀行對長期存款提供較高的利率。

examples.en: The policy was created to protect the best interests of taxpayers.
examples.zh: 這項政策的制定是為了保護納稅人的最佳利益。

examples.en: Science fiction movies always interest my younger brother a lot.
examples.zh: 科幻電影總是讓我弟弟非常感興趣。

examples.en: Does this ancient history course interest you at all?
examples.zh: 這門古代歷史課程有讓你感興趣嗎？

examples.en: The manager tried to interest potential clients in the project.
examples.zh: 經理試圖讓潛在客戶對這個專案產生興趣。

examples.en: She is very interested in learning about foreign cultures.
examples.zh: 她對了解外國文化非常感興趣。

examples.en: If you are interested in joining our club, please sign here.
examples.zh: 如果您有興趣加入我們的社團，請在此簽名。

examples.en: Many students were interested in the robotics science exhibition.
examples.zh: 許多學生對機器人科學展覽感興趣。

examples.en: The professor gave an interesting lecture on ancient Egyptian history.
examples.zh: 教授發表了一場關於古埃及歷史的有趣講座。

examples.en: I read an interesting story about ocean exploration yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天讀了一篇關於海洋探索的有趣故事。

examples.en: It is interesting to observe how animals adapt to winter.
examples.zh: 觀察動物如何適應冬天是非常有趣的。

examples.en: The company launched an internal investigation to find the problem.
examples.zh: 公司展開了內部調查以找出問題所在。

examples.en: Doctors checked the patient for any signs of internal bleeding.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查該患者是否有任何內出血的跡象。

examples.en: She is responsible for managing internal communication within the team.
examples.zh: 她負責管理團隊內部的溝通。

examples.en: Many students from different countries attend this international school.
examples.zh: 許多來自不同國家的學生就讀這所國際學校。

examples.en: The airport handles hundreds of international flights every day.
examples.zh: 這座機場每天處理數百個國際航班。

examples.en: They signed an international agreement to reduce ocean pollution.
examples.zh: 他們簽署了一項國際協議以減少海洋污染。

examples.en: You can search for useful information easily on the internet.
examples.zh: 你可以在網際網路上輕鬆搜尋實用資訊。

examples.en: Our home internet connection was down for two whole hours.
examples.zh: 我們家裡的網路連線中斷了整整兩個小時。

examples.en: Many small businesses sell their unique products over the internet.
examples.zh: 許多小型企業透過網際網路銷售他們獨特的產品。

examples.en: He has a job interview with a software company tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他明天有一家軟體公司的求職面試。

examples.en: The reporter conducted a brief interview with the famous singer.
examples.zh: 記者對這位知名歌手進行了簡短的採訪。

examples.en: She prepared thoroughly for her university entrance interview.
examples.zh: 她為大學入學面試做了充分準備。

examples.en: The manager will interview five applicants for the open position.
examples.zh: 經理將面試五位該職缺的應徵者。

examples.en: Journalists came to interview the award winning scientist today.
examples.zh: 記者們今天前來採訪這位獲獎的科學家。

examples.en: They interviewed local residents about the new transportation project.
examples.zh: 他們就這項新交通計畫採訪了當地居民。

examples.en: The thief jumped into the car and drove away quickly.
examples.zh: 小偷跳進車裡並迅速開走。

examples.en: She poured the hot water into a big blue mug.
examples.zh: 她把熱水倒進一個藍色的大馬克杯裡。

examples.en: The caterpillar transformed into a colorful butterfly after a few weeks.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲在幾週後蛻變成了色彩斑斕的蝴蝶。

examples.en: Allow me to introduce my new colleague, David, to the entire marketing team.
examples.zh: 請允許我向整個行銷團隊介紹我的新同事大衛。

examples.en: The government plans to introduce new environmental regulations to reduce city pollution.
examples.zh: 政府計劃引入新的環境法規，以減少城市污染。

examples.en: The teacher introduced an interesting book to the class during the reading hour.
examples.zh: 老師在閱讀課上向全班介紹了一本有趣的書。

examples.en: The speaker gave a brief introduction before starting the talk.
examples.zh: 講者在開始演講前做了簡短的介紹。

examples.en: I read the introduction of the textbook to understand the topic.
examples.zh: 我閱讀了教科書的引言以了解主題。

examples.en: The introduction of smartphones changed how people communicate daily.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機的引進改變了人們日常的溝通方式。

examples.en: They invited all their close friends to the party.
examples.zh: 他們邀請了所有好朋友來參加派對。

examples.en: She invited me to have dinner at her home.
examples.zh: 她邀請我到她家一起吃晚餐。

examples.en: We should invite the new neighbor to join us.
examples.zh: 我們應該邀請新鄰居加入我們。

examples.en: Did you receive an invite to the company gala?
examples.zh: 你有收到公司晚會的邀請函嗎？

examples.en: She sent out the party invites yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她昨天下午發出了派對邀請函。

examples.en: I received an online invite to their store opening.
examples.zh: 我收到了他們店家開幕的線上邀請函。

examples.en: This bridge is built with strong steel and iron.
examples.zh: 這座橋樑是用堅固的鋼和鐵建造的。

examples.en: She bought a modern steam iron to smooth clothes.
examples.zh: 她買了一個現代蒸氣熨斗來熨平衣服。

examples.en: Iron is an essential mineral for healthy human blood.
examples.zh: 鐵是人體健康血液必需的礦物質。

examples.en: He ironed his white shirt for a job interview this morning.
examples.zh: 他為了今天早上的求職面試熨燙了他的白襯衫。

examples.en: My mother irons all school uniforms on Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在週日晚上熨燙所有的學校制服。

examples.en: Please iron out the wrinkles on the tablecloth.
examples.zh: 請熨平桌布上的皺褶。

examples.en: Taiwan is a beautiful island surrounded by the sea.
examples.zh: 台灣是一座被大海環繞的美麗島嶼。

examples.en: They spent their summer vacation on a tropical island.
examples.zh: 他們在一座熱帶島嶼度過了暑假。

examples.en: The island is home to many unique species of birds.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼是許多獨特鳥類的棲息地。

examples.en: Where is my phone? I left it on the dining table.
examples.zh: 我的手機在哪裡？我把它留在餐桌上了。

examples.en: Look at that cute cat; it is sleeping on the sofa.
examples.zh: 看那隻可愛的貓，牠正在沙發上睡覺。

examples.en: It is raining heavily outside, so take an umbrella with you.
examples.zh: 外面下著大雨，所以帶把傘吧。

examples.en: Please check every item on the shopping list before leaving.
examples.zh: 離開前請核對購物清單上的每一件物品。

examples.en: The total price for these three items is five hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 這三件商品的總價是五百元。

examples.en: There is one important item on our meeting agenda today.
examples.zh: 我們今天的會議議程上有一個重要項目。

examples.en: You should wear a warm jacket because it is very cold outside.
examples.zh: 外面很冷，你應該穿件保暖的夾克。

examples.en: He put his wallet into the inside pocket of his leather jacket.
examples.zh: 他把皮夾放進皮夾克的內側口袋裡。

examples.en: She hung her jacket on the coat rack near the entrance.
examples.zh: 她把夾克掛在入口附近的衣帽架上。

examples.en: My mother spread sweet strawberry jam on a slice of fresh toast.
examples.zh: 媽媽把甜甜的草莓果醬塗在一片新鮮吐司上。

examples.en: We were stuck in a heavy traffic jam on the highway this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我們在高速公路上遇上了嚴重的交通擁塞。

examples.en: I like to eat yogurt mixed with natural homemade blueberry jam.
examples.zh: 我喜歡吃優格搭配天然的手作藍莓果醬。

examples.en: The paper got jammed in the office printer again.
examples.zh: 紙又卡在辦公室的印表機裡了。

examples.en: Hundreds of people jammed into the train station during rush hour.
examples.zh: 尖峰時刻，數百人擠進了火車站。

examples.en: He managed to jam all his clothes into the small traveling suitcase.
examples.zh: 他設法將所有衣服擠進小旅行箱裡。

examples.en: He broke his jaw after falling off his bicycle last Sunday.
examples.zh: 上星期天他從腳踏車上摔下來後弄斷了下巴。

examples.en: The tiger opened its powerful jaw and let out a loud roar.
examples.zh: 老虎張開強有力的下顎，發出一聲巨吼。

examples.en: She felt a sharp pain in her jaw while chewing food.
examples.zh: 她在咀嚼食物時感覺下巴劇烈疼痛。

examples.en: He likes to wear comfortable blue jeans on casual weekends at home.
examples.zh: 他喜歡在居家休閒的週末穿舒適的藍色牛仔褲。

examples.en: She bought a fashionable pair of jeans at the shopping mall.
examples.zh: 她在購物中心買了一條時尚的牛仔褲。

examples.en: These dark jeans match perfectly with your white cotton shirt today.
examples.zh: 這條深色牛仔褲今天和你的白色棉質襯衫完美搭配。

examples.en: After graduating from college, he got a full-time job at a software company.
examples.zh: 大學畢業後，他在一家軟體公司找到了一份全職工作。

examples.en: Cleaning the bathroom is not an easy job for young children.
examples.zh: 清潔浴室對幼童來說不是一項容易的任務。

examples.en: Congratulations on doing a great job on your final oral presentation.
examples.zh: 祝賀你在期末口頭報告中表現得非常出色。

examples.en: I like to jog around the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我喜歡每天早晨繞著公園慢跑。

examples.en: She gently jogged his elbow to get his attention.
examples.zh: 她輕推了他的手肘，引起他的注意。

examples.en: They jog together along the river bank after work.
examples.zh: 他們下班後一起沿著河堤慢跑。

examples.en: He went for a quick jog before eating breakfast.
examples.zh: 他在吃早餐前去慢跑了一下。

examples.en: A daily jog is great for improving heart health.
examples.zh: 每天慢跑對於改善心臟健康非常棒。

examples.en: She enjoys a quiet jog in the cool morning air.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在涼爽的晨氣中安靜慢跑。

examples.en: Would you like to join us for dinner this evening?
examples.zh: 你今晚想和我們一起吃晚餐嗎？

examples.en: She decided to join the school drama club this semester.
examples.zh: 她決定這個學期加入學校的話劇社。

examples.en: A new bridge joins the two parts of the town.
examples.zh: 一座新橋連結了小鎮的兩個部分。

examples.en: The old man suffers from pain in his knee joint.
examples.zh: 這位老人忍受著膝關節的疼痛。

examples.en: Carefully apply glue to strengthen the wooden furniture joint.
examples.zh: 小心地塗上膠水，以加強木製家具的接合處。

examples.en: Swelling in her finger joints made writing difficult.
examples.zh: 手指關節腫脹讓她寫字很困難。

examples.en: The two companies formed a joint venture to build software.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司成立了一家合資企業來開發軟體。

examples.en: They held a joint press conference to announce the agreement.
examples.zh: 他們舉行了聯合記者會來宣布協議。

examples.en: The couple opened a joint bank account after marriage.
examples.zh: 這對夫妻結婚後開立了一個共同銀行帳戶。

examples.en: He told a funny joke that made everyone laugh out loud.
examples.zh: 他講了一個有趣的笑話，讓大家哈哈大笑起來。

examples.en: Do not take it seriously because it was just a joke.
examples.zh: 別太認真，因為那只是一個玩笑。

examples.en: She enjoys sharing light jokes with her classmates during lunch break.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在午休時間與同學分享輕鬆的笑話。

examples.en: Are you serious or are you just joking with me?
examples.zh: 你是認真的還是只是在和我開玩笑？

examples.en: They laughed and joked together all through the long evening.
examples.zh: 整個漫長的夜晚，他們都在一起笑鬧開玩笑。

examples.en: He joked about his poor cooking skills at the dinner.
examples.zh: 他在晚餐時拿自己糟糕的廚藝開玩笑。

examples.en: She writes in her personal journal every evening before sleeping.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上睡覺前都會寫個人日記。

examples.en: The university professor published his latest study in a medical journal.
examples.zh: 這位大學教授在一家醫學期刊上發表了他最新的研究。

examples.en: Keep a travel journal to remember all the details of your trips.
examples.zh: 記錄一份旅行日誌以記住你旅行的所有細節。

examples.en: The birth of their baby brought immense joy to the family.
examples.zh: 他們寶寶的出生給這個家庭帶來了巨大的喜悅。

examples.en: Playing music with friends is a great joy for him.
examples.zh: 與朋友一起演奏音樂對他來說是一大樂趣。

examples.en: Tears of joy ran down her face when she won.
examples.zh: 當她獲勝時，喜悅的淚水流下了她的臉龐。

examples.en: The judge listened to both sides before making a final ruling.
examples.zh: 法官在做出最終裁決前傾聽了雙方的陳述。

examples.en: An international judge listened carefully to every contestant in the piano contest.
examples.zh: 一位國際評審在鋼琴比賽中仔細聆聽每位參賽者的演奏。

examples.en: The line judge signaled that the tennis ball was out.
examples.zh: 線審示意網球已經出界。

examples.en: You should not judge a book solely by its front cover.
examples.zh: 你不應該單憑封面來判斷一本書。

examples.en: A panel of culinary experts will judge the baking contest.
examples.zh: 一組烹飪專家將擔任這場烘焙比賽的評審。

examples.en: It is difficult to judge how long the renovation will take.
examples.zh: 很難判斷整修需要花費多久時間。

examples.en: You need to use good judgment when making important decisions.
examples.zh: 在做出重大決定時，你需要運用良好的判斷。

examples.en: The judge delivered his final judgment in the courtroom.
examples.zh: 法官在法庭上宣布了最終判決。

examples.en: In my judgment, this plan needs more careful consideration.
examples.zh: 依我的判斷，這個計劃需要更審慎的考量。

examples.en: Freshly squeezed orange juice is my favorite morning drink.
examples.zh: 現擠的柳橙汁是我最喜歡的早晨飲料。

examples.en: Add a splash of lemon juice to enhance the flavor.
examples.zh: 加入少許檸檬汁以提升風味。

examples.en: The roasted meat was tender and full of savory juice.
examples.zh: 烤肉很嫩，而且充滿美味的肉汁。

examples.en: The kids love to jump on the bed when their parents are away.
examples.zh: 孩子們趁父母不在時喜歡在床上跳躍。

examples.en: She jumped over the puddle to keep her shoes clean.
examples.zh: 她跳過水坑以保持鞋子乾淨。

examples.en: House prices jumped rapidly during the past few years.
examples.zh: 房價在過去幾年中急遽上漲。

examples.en: He made a clean jump over the high fence.
examples.zh: 他乾淨俐落地跳過了高籬笆。

examples.en: There was a sudden jump in temperature this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上氣溫突然大幅上升。

examples.en: The long jump is her favorite track and field event.
examples.zh: 跳遠是她最喜歡的田徑項目。

examples.en: I was just checking my email when the telephone rang.
examples.zh: 電話響起時，我剛好在檢查電子郵件。

examples.en: Don't worry about it, because it was just an accident.
examples.zh: 別擔心，因為那只是一場意外。

examples.en: The train has just left the station a minute ago.
examples.zh: 火車在一分鐘前剛離開車站。

examples.en: The judge gave a just sentence based on the evidence.
examples.zh: 法官根據證據給出了公正的判決。

examples.en: Everyone deserves a fair and just trial in court.
examples.zh: 每個人在法庭上都值得獲得公平公正的審判。

examples.en: They fought for a more just society for all citizens.
examples.zh: 他們為所有公民爭取一個更公正的社會。

examples.en: Judges must work hard to ensure justice for all.
examples.zh: 法官必須努力確保所有人的正義。

examples.en: The brave hero fought to bring justice to the city.
examples.zh: 勇敢的英雄奮戰，為城市帶來正義。

examples.en: People demanded justice after the unfair decision was made.
examples.zh: 那項不公平的決定做出後，人們要求伸張正義。

examples.en: Please keep your room clean and tidy.
examples.zh: 請保持你的房間乾淨整潔。

examples.en: Please keep the receipt in case you need to return the item.
examples.zh: 請保留收據，以便需要退貨時使用。

examples.en: Store fresh milk in the refrigerator to keep it from spoiling.
examples.zh: 將新鮮牛奶存放在冰箱裡以保存它不變質。

examples.en: The keeper at the zoo fed the hungry lions early this morning.
examples.zh: 動物園飼養員今天一大早餵食了飢餓的獅子。

examples.en: The keeper of the old library looks after thousands of rare books.
examples.zh: 這座古老圖書館的保管人負責照管數千本珍貴書籍。

examples.en: The keeper dived and caught the ball just before it crossed the line.
examples.zh: 守門員撲過去，在球越過球門線前接住了它。

examples.en: He likes to dip his crispy French fries into ketchup.
examples.zh: 他喜歡用酥脆的薯條沾番茄醬。

examples.en: Please pass me the bottle of ketchup on the table.
examples.zh: 請把桌上的那瓶番茄醬遞給我。

examples.en: My sister poured too much ketchup on her fried rice.
examples.zh: 我妹妹在她的炒飯上倒了太多的番茄醬。

examples.en: I left my house key on the dining table.
examples.zh: 我把我的房子鑰匙忘在餐桌上了。

examples.en: Practice is the key to mastering a new language.
examples.zh: 練習是掌握一門新語言的關鍵。

examples.en: He turned the key in the lock and opened the door.
examples.zh: 他轉動鎖裡的鑰匙並打開了門。

examples.en: Timing is a key factor in successful investments.
examples.zh: 時機是成功投資的關鍵因素。

examples.en: She played a key role in the company's project.
examples.zh: 她在公司的專案中扮演了關鍵角色。

examples.en: The manager presented the key points of the report.
examples.zh: 經理報告了這份報告的關鍵要點。

examples.en: The football player kicked the ball directly into the goal.
examples.zh: 足球員直接把球踢進了球門。

examples.en: Please do not kick the back of my seat during the flight.
examples.zh: 在飛行過程中請不要踢我椅子的後背。

examples.en: He kicked off his shoes as soon as he returned home.
examples.zh: 他一回到家就踢掉了鞋子。

examples.en: The goalkeeper saved a powerful kick from the opponent player.
examples.zh: 守門員救出了對手球員的強勁一踢。

examples.en: She gets a kick out of riding fast roller coasters.
examples.zh: 她搭乘快速雲霄飛車能獲得很大樂趣。

examples.en: The horse gave a strong kick to the wooden fence.
examples.zh: 那匹馬對木籬笆給了一記強力的踢擊。

examples.en: The kids are playing happily together in the local neighborhood park.
examples.zh: 孩子們正在社區公園裡一起快樂地玩耍。

examples.en: She works at a daycare center taking care of young kids.
examples.zh: 她在一家托兒所工作，照顧幼小的孩子。

examples.en: Every kid in the classroom was excited about the field trip.
examples.zh: 教室裡的每個小孩都對戶外教學感到興奮。

examples.en: Do not get upset because I was only kidding with you.
examples.zh: 別生氣，因為我剛才只是在跟你開玩笑。

examples.en: You cannot kid me about your final exam score this time.
examples.zh: 這次你別想拿期末考分數來騙我。

examples.en: Are you kidding me about winning the lottery grand prize today?
examples.zh: 關於今天獲得彩券頭獎這件事，你是在跟我開玩笑嗎？

examples.en: The heavy frost could kill the young plants in spring.
examples.zh: 嚴霜可能會殺死春天幼小的植物。

examples.en: We played board games to kill time at the airport.
examples.zh: 我們在機場玩桌遊來打發時間。

examples.en: Walking in these tight shoes is starting to kill my feet.
examples.zh: 穿這雙緊腳的鞋子走路開始讓我的腳痛死了。

examples.en: A kilogram is equal to one thousand grams.
examples.zh: 一公斤等於一千公克。

examples.en: She bought a kilogram of fresh apples at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市場買了一公斤的新鮮蘋果。

examples.en: The package weighs roughly two kilograms.
examples.zh: 這個包裹重量大約兩公斤。

examples.en: She is a kind teacher who always listens to students.
examples.zh: 她是一位總是傾聽學生心聲的仁慈老師。

examples.en: Thank you for your kind assistance during my trip today.
examples.zh: 感謝你今天在我旅行期間的熱心協助。

examples.en: It was very kind of you to invite us to dinner.
examples.zh: 你邀請我們吃晚餐真是太熱心友善了。

examples.en: What kind of music do you like listening to most?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡聽哪一類音樂？

examples.en: There are many different kinds of tropical fruits in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣有許多不同種類的熱帶水果。

examples.en: This new store sells all kinds of stationery and gifts.
examples.zh: 這家新商店販售各種文具與禮品。

examples.en: The wise king ruled his peaceful country for years.
examples.zh: 明智的國王統治了他和平的國家多年。

examples.en: The crown was placed on top of the king's head.
examples.zh: 王冠被戴在了國王的頭頂上。

examples.en: In chess, protecting your king is the main goal.
examples.zh: 在西洋棋中，保護你的國王是首要目標。

examples.en: She kissed her daughter on the cheek before going to work.
examples.zh: 她去上班前親了女兒的臉頰。

examples.en: The little boy kissed his grandmother goodbye at the airport.
examples.zh: 小男孩在機場親吻祖母道別。

examples.en: The proud father kissed his newborn baby on the forehead.
examples.zh: 驕傲的父親親吻了新生寶寶的額頭。

examples.en: He gave his wife a gentle kiss before leaving the house.
examples.zh: 他在出門前給了妻子一個溫柔的吻。

examples.en: Their first kiss took place under a giant oak tree.
examples.zh: 他們的初吻發生在一棵巨大橡樹下。

examples.en: She blew a kiss to the crowd from the stage.
examples.zh: 她在舞台上向人群拋了一個吻。

examples.en: My father is preparing dinner in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我父親正在廚房準備晚餐。

examples.en: The apartment features a spacious and modern kitchen.
examples.zh: 這間公寓具有寬敞且現代化的廚房。

examples.en: Please clean the kitchen counter after cooking.
examples.zh: 煮完飯後請清理廚房流理台。

examples.en: Children love to fly a kite in the park on windy days.
examples.zh: 小朋友喜歡在有風的日子裡到公園放風箏。

examples.en: The colorful kite was flying high in the blue sky.
examples.zh: 那隻色彩繽紛的風箏在藍天中飛得很高。

examples.en: My grandfather taught me how to make a paper kite yesterday.
examples.zh: 我爺爺昨天教我如何做紙風箏。

examples.en: He hurt his right knee while playing basketball.
examples.zh: 他在打籃球時弄傷了右膝蓋。

examples.en: The water came up to my knees as I waded.
examples.zh: 當我涉水時，水淹到了我的膝蓋。

examples.en: She bent her knees before lifting the heavy box.
examples.zh: 她在搬起重箱子前彎曲了膝蓋。

examples.en: Be careful when using that sharp knife to cut vegetables.
examples.zh: 使用那把鋒利的刀子切菜時要小心。

examples.en: He used a butter knife to spread jam on his toast.
examples.zh: 他用奶油刀把果醬抹在吐司上。

examples.en: Set the table with a fork, a spoon, and a steak knife.
examples.zh: 在餐桌上擺好叉子、湯匙與牛排刀。

examples.en: Please knock on the door before you enter the teacher's office.
examples.zh: 進入教師辦公室前請先敲門。

examples.en: The clumsy cat accidentally knocked the glass off the desk.
examples.zh: 那隻笨拙的貓不小心把玻璃杯撞落書桌。

examples.en: Someone is knocking loudly on our front gate right now.
examples.zh: 現在有人正在大聲敲我們的前門。

examples.en: I heard a strange knock on the window during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間我聽到窗戶傳來奇怪的敲擊聲。

examples.en: She answered the door after she heard three quick knocks.
examples.zh: 她在聽到三聲急促的敲門聲後去開門。

examples.en: Give a firm knock on the door before walking inside.
examples.zh: 走進去之前先堅定地敲一下門。

examples.en: Do you know the correct answer to this complex math question?
examples.zh: 你知道這道複雜數學題目的正確答案嗎？

examples.en: I have known my best friend since we were in elementary school.
examples.zh: 我們讀國小起我就認識我最好的朋友了。

examples.en: She knows how to play the piano and guitar very well.
examples.zh: 她知道怎麼把鋼琴和吉他彈得很好。

examples.en: Reading books is a great way to gain new knowledge.
examples.zh: 讀書是獲取新知識的好方法。

examples.en: He has a vast knowledge of world history and politics.
examples.zh: 他對世界歷史與政治擁有廣博的學識。

examples.en: To my knowledge, the store closes at nine tonight.
examples.zh: 據我所知，那家店今晚九點關門。

examples.en: The plant died due to a lack of sufficient sunlight and water.
examples.zh: 該植物因缺乏足夠的陽光和水而枯死。

examples.en: Her poor performance on the test was caused by a lack of preparation.
examples.zh: 她在測試上的不良表現是由於缺乏準備造成的。

examples.en: Lack of sleep can lead to poor concentration during work hours.
examples.zh: 缺乏睡眠會導致工作時間專注力不佳。

examples.en: The new candidate lacks experience in international business operations.
examples.zh: 這位新應徵者缺乏國際商業營運的經驗。

examples.en: Some small villages still lack access to clean drinking water.
examples.zh: 一些小村莊仍然缺少獲取乾淨飲用水的管道。

examples.en: The room lacks adequate lighting for reading books comfortably.
examples.zh: 這間房間缺少足夠的照明以舒服地閱讀書籍。

examples.en: A polite young lady helped the old man cross the busy street.
examples.zh: 一位有禮貌的年輕女士幫助老先生過繁忙的馬路。

examples.en: Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome our special speaker for this evening.
examples.zh: 各位女士與先生，請歡迎我們今晚的特別主講人。

examples.en: The kind lady offered her seat on the crowded bus to a pregnant woman.
examples.zh: 這位善良的女士在擁擠的公車上把座位讓給了一位孕婦。

examples.en: A bright red ladybug landed gently on my arm.
examples.zh: 一隻鮮紅色的瓢蟲輕輕停在我的手臂上。

examples.en: Gardeners like ladybugs because they eat harmful insects.
examples.zh: 園丁喜歡瓢蟲，因為牠們會吃害蟲。

examples.en: The little girl spotted a tiny ladybug on the leaf.
examples.zh: 小女孩在葉子上發現了一隻小巧的瓢蟲。

examples.en: We went swimming in the clear blue water of the lake.
examples.zh: 我們去湖泊清澈的藍水中游泳。

examples.en: There is a beautiful wooden house by the peaceful mountain lake.
examples.zh: 在寧靜的高山湖邊有一棟美麗的木屋。

examples.en: They rented a small boat to row across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 他們租了一艘小船划過寧靜的湖泊。

examples.en: The little lamb followed its mother across the field.
examples.zh: 小羊跟著媽媽穿過田野。

examples.en: We had grilled lamb chops for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 我們今晚晚餐吃了烤羊肉排。

examples.en: Lamb is a popular meat in many Middle Eastern countries.
examples.zh: 羊肉在許多中東國家是很受歡迎的肉類。

examples.en: She turned on the desk lamp to study for exams.
examples.zh: 她打開檯燈準備考試。

examples.en: A street lamp lit up the quiet road at night.
examples.zh: 一盞路燈在夜晚照亮了靜謐的道路。

examples.en: He bought an antique lamp at the local night market.
examples.zh: 他在在地夜市買了一盞古董燈。

examples.en: The farmer bought a plot of fertile land to grow vegetables.
examples.zh: 農夫買了一塊肥沃的土地來種植蔬菜。

examples.en: After weeks at sea, sailors were thrilled to see land.
examples.zh: 在海上度過數週後，水手們看到陸地時感到非常興奮。

examples.en: Most of the land in this area is used for farming.
examples.zh: 這一帶大部分的土地都用來種田。

examples.en: The passenger airplane will land at the airport in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 客機將在十分鐘後降落於機場。

examples.en: A colorful butterfly landed smoothly on my shoulder this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，一隻色彩斑斕的蝴蝶平穩地降落在我的肩膀上。

examples.en: The gymnast managed to land gracefully after a complex vault flip.
examples.zh: 體操運動員在完成複雜的跳馬翻滾後成功優雅著陸。

examples.en: They walked down a quiet narrow lane in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他們走在鄉間一條安靜狹窄的小巷裡。

examples.en: Vehicles must stay within their marked lane on the highway.
examples.zh: 車輛在公路上必須保持在標示的車道內。

examples.en: Cyclists are encouraged to use the bike lane.
examples.zh: 鼓勵騎腳踏車的人使用自行車道。

examples.en: English is a global language spoken in many countries worldwide.
examples.zh: 英語是一門在世界許多國家被使用的全球性語言。

examples.en: Learning a foreign language requires daily practice and continuous patience.
examples.zh: 學習一門外語需要每天練習與持續的耐心。

examples.en: Body language can reveal a lot about how a person feels.
examples.zh: 肢體語言可以透露出許多關於一個人感受的訊息。

examples.en: Children carried colorful paper lanterns during the festival.
examples.zh: 孩子們在節慶期間提著五彩繽紛的紙燈籠。

examples.en: We hung red lanterns outside the house for the New Year.
examples.zh: 我們在房子外面掛了紅燈籠來過年。

examples.en: The camper lit a lantern inside the dark tent.
examples.zh: 露營者在黑暗的帳篷裡點亮了提燈。

examples.en: The cute kitten fell asleep comfortably on her warm lap.
examples.zh: 可愛的小貓咪在她溫暖的大腿上舒服地睡著了。

examples.en: The runner completed the final lap and won the race.
examples.zh: 這名跑者完成了最後一圈並贏得了比賽。

examples.en: She placed her napkin gently on her lap before eating.
examples.zh: 她在用餐前將餐巾溫柔地放在大腿上。

senses.zh: 大腿（坐姿時）；（跑道的）一圈

examples.en: Soft ocean waves lapped gently against the sandy beach.
examples.zh: 柔和的海浪輕拍著沙灘。

examples.en: The fast swimmer lapped other competitors in the pool.
examples.zh: 這名快速的游泳選手在泳池裡領先其他競爭對手一圈。

examples.en: The dog lapped up the milk from the bowl quickly.
examples.zh: 小狗很快把碗裡的牛奶舔光了。

examples.en: They live in a large house with a beautiful green garden.
examples.zh: 他們住在一間帶有美麗綠色花園的大房子裡。

examples.en: A large crowd of people gathered to watch the outdoor concert.
examples.zh: 一大群民眾聚集在一起觀看這場戶外演唱會。

examples.en: He ordered a large coffee to stay awake during the flight.
examples.zh: 他點了一杯大杯咖啡，以便在飛行期間保持清醒。

examples.en: December is the last month of the year on the calendar.
examples.zh: 十二月是日曆上一年的最後一個月。

examples.en: I missed the last bus and had to take a taxi home.
examples.zh: 我錯過了末班公車，只好搭計程車回家。

examples.en: What was the title of the last book you read recently?
examples.zh: 你最近讀的上一本書，書名是什麼？

examples.en: He came last in the running race at school yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 他昨天下午在學校的跑步比賽中獲得最後一名。

examples.en: When did you last see your middle school classmates in person?
examples.zh: 你上次親自見到你的國中同學是什麼時候？

examples.en: You should always save the best news for last in speeches.
examples.zh: 在演講中你應該總是把最好的消息留在最後講。

examples.en: The important meeting lasted for more than two full hours today.
examples.zh: 這場重要的會議今天持續了兩個多小時。

examples.en: Good true friends can last for a lifetime through hard times.
examples.zh: 經歷艱難時刻，真正的好朋友關係可以維持一輩子。

examples.en: These new batteries last much longer than the old ones did.
examples.zh: 這些新電池比舊電池耐用得多。

examples.en: He was late for the important morning business meeting.
examples.zh: 他今天早上的重要商務會議遲到了。

examples.en: We took a late flight and arrived past midnight.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘深夜航班，在午夜過後抵達。

examples.en: The late train caused many passengers to miss connections.
examples.zh: 誤點的火車導致許多乘客錯過了轉乘。

examples.en: She stayed up late last night to complete her work.
examples.zh: 她昨晚熬夜很晚才完成工作。

examples.en: The package arrived late due to bad weather conditions.
examples.zh: 包裹因惡劣的天氣狀況而送達得較晚。

examples.en: Don't eat dinner too late if you want good sleep.
examples.zh: 如果你想要良好的睡眠，晚餐不要太晚吃。

examples.en: I will call you back later when I finish working.
examples.zh: 我工作結束後稍後會再打給你。

examples.en: Two hours later, the rain finally stopped.
examples.zh: 兩小時後，雨終於停了。

examples.en: See you later at the entrance of the theater.
examples.zh: 待會劇院入口見。

examples.en: Have you heard the latest news about the typhoon?
examples.zh: 你聽到關於颱風的最新消息了嗎？

examples.en: She bought the latest model of smartphone at a store yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天在商店買了最新型號的智慧型手機。

examples.en: This fashion magazine shows the latest trends in clothing.
examples.zh: 這本時尚雜誌介紹了服裝的最新潮流。

examples.en: The latter half of the movie was much more exciting.
examples.zh: 這部電影的後半段精彩多了。

examples.en: In the latter part of his career, he wrote books.
examples.zh: 在他的生涯後半期，他撰寫書籍。

examples.en: She preferred the latter option presented during the team discussion.
examples.zh: 她偏好團隊討論時提出的後者選項。

examples.en: If I must choose between tea and coffee, I usually prefer the latter.
examples.zh: 如果要在茶和咖啡之間選擇，我通常偏好後者。

examples.en: Between apples and oranges, he chose the latter as a snack.
examples.zh: 在蘋果和橘子之間，他選擇了後者當點心。

examples.en: Both plans sound good, but the latter is more affordable.
examples.zh: 兩個計劃聽起來都不錯，但後者比較划算。

examples.en: The audience laughed out loud at the comedian's funny joke.
examples.zh: 觀眾對喜劇演員的幽默笑話大笑起來。

examples.en: It is good to laugh and enjoy life with good friends.
examples.zh: 與好朋友一起大笑並享受生活是很棒的事。

examples.en: Never laugh at someone who is trying their best.
examples.zh: 絕不要嘲笑正在盡力而為的人。

examples.en: Her bright laugh echoed through the empty hallway.
examples.zh: 她爽朗的笑聲在空曠的走廊裡迴盪。

examples.en: We had a good laugh over our silly old photos.
examples.zh: 我們看著自己愚蠢的舊照片大笑了一場。

examples.en: His joke got a big laugh from the whole class.
examples.zh: 他的笑話引得全班哄堂大笑。

examples.en: Every driver must obey the traffic laws to keep roads safe.
examples.zh: 每位駕駛都必須遵守交通法規以保持道路安全。

examples.en: The government passed a new environmental law to reduce plastic pollution.
examples.zh: 政府通過了一項新的環境法律以減少塑膠污染。

examples.en: My elder sister wants to study law at the university next year.
examples.zh: 我姊姊明年想在大學攻讀法律。

examples.en: My uncle is an experienced lawyer who specializes in corporate law.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是一位擅長公司法的資深律師。

examples.en: You should consult a qualified lawyer before signing any legal document.
examples.zh: 在簽署任何法律文件之前，你應該諮詢合格律師。

examples.en: The defense lawyer spoke persuasively to convince the judge.
examples.zh: 辯護律師言辭有力地說服法官。

examples.en: Please lay the clean tablecloth gently on the dinner table.
examples.zh: 請把乾淨的桌布輕輕鋪在餐桌上。

examples.en: The mother bird lays her eggs in a safe nest.
examples.zh: 母鳥在安全的鳥巢裡產卵。
