examples.en: Our neighbor kindly waters our plants when we leave.
examples.zh: 當我們出門時，我們的鄰居會好心地幫我們澆花。

examples.en: She had a friendly chat with her next-door neighbor.
examples.zh: 她與隔壁鄰居進行了一次友好的交談。

examples.en: The new neighbors moved into the house yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 新鄰居昨天下午搬進了那棟房子。

examples.en: Neither jacket fits me well so I bought a shirt instead.
examples.zh: 兩件外套都不太適合我，所以我改買了一件襯衫。

examples.en: Neither answer was completely correct on the math test paper.
examples.zh: 數學考卷上的兩個答案都不完全正確。

examples.en: Neither candidate gained enough support from voters in the election.
examples.zh: 兩位候選人在選舉中都未獲得選民足夠的支持。

examples.en: Two options were presented, but neither of them solved the problem.
examples.zh: 提出了兩個選項，但兩個都無法解決問題。

examples.en: Neither of my sisters likes spicy food from Indian restaurants.
examples.zh: 我的兩個姐妹都不喜歡印度餐廳的辣味食物。

examples.en: I tried both keys on the door, but neither worked.
examples.zh: 我試了門上的兩把鑰匙，但兩把都打不開。

examples.en: He neither drinks coffee nor eats sweet chocolate in the evening.
examples.zh: 他在晚上既不喝咖啡，也不吃甜巧克力。

examples.en: The weather was neither too hot nor too cold for hiking.
examples.zh: 這天氣既不太熱也不太冷，很適合健行。

examples.en: She can neither confirm nor deny the reports about the project.
examples.zh: 她既無法證實也無法否認有關該專案的報導。

examples.en: My nephew was born yesterday and looks extremely cute.
examples.zh: 我的姪子昨天出生，看起來非常可愛。

examples.en: I took my young nephew to the amusement park last weekend.
examples.zh: 我上週末帶我的小外甥去了遊樂園。

examples.en: His nephew is studying computer science at a local university.
examples.zh: 他的姪子正在當地一所大學攻讀資訊工程。

examples.en: The spinal cord connects the brain to sensory nerves.
examples.zh: 脊髓將大腦與感覺神經連接起來。

examples.en: It takes a lot of nerve to speak in public.
examples.zh: 在大眾面前說話需要很大的勇氣。

examples.en: He lost his nerve right before jumping off the platform.
examples.zh: 他在跳下平台前一刻失去了膽量。

examples.en: He always feels nervous before speaking in front of people.
examples.zh: 他在眾人面前發言前總是感到緊張。

examples.en: The nervous candidate waited patiently for her job interview.
examples.zh: 緊張的應徵者耐心等待她的求職面試。

examples.en: The doctor checked the function of his nervous system carefully.
examples.zh: 醫生仔細檢查了他的神經系統功能。

examples.en: The fisherman threw a large net into the ocean water.
examples.zh: 漁夫向海洋投下了一張大網。

examples.en: A volleyball net was set up on the sandy beach.
examples.zh: 沙灘上架起了一座排球網。

examples.en: The boy caught a butterfly with a small net.
examples.zh: 男孩用小網子抓到了一隻蝴蝶。

examples.en: The net profit of our small company increased this year.
examples.zh: 我們小公司今年的淨利潤有所增加。

examples.en: What is the net weight of this packaged food item?
examples.zh: 這個包裝食品項目的淨重是多少？

examples.en: He earned a net income after all mandatory tax deductions.
examples.zh: 在所有強制性扣稅後，他獲得了淨收入。

examples.en: The office computer network was down for two hours.
examples.zh: 辦公室的電腦網路停擺了兩個小時。

examples.en: Taipei has an efficient public transit network.
examples.zh: 台北擁有高效率的大眾運輸路網。

examples.en: He built a strong professional network during his career.
examples.zh: 他在職涯中建立了強大的專業人脈網。

examples.en: The conference gives attendees a chance to network with peers.
examples.zh: 研討會讓參與者有機會與同業建立人脈。

examples.en: She enjoys networking with other developers at tech events.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在科技活動中和其他開發人員建立人脈。

examples.en: All devices in the house are networked together wirelessly.
examples.zh: 家裡所有設備都透過無線方式連線在一起。

examples.en: I have never seen such a magnificent waterfall in my life.
examples.zh: 我這輩子從未看過如此壯觀的瀑布。

examples.en: He promised that he would never be late again.
examples.zh: 他保證再也不會遲到了。

examples.en: She never gives up when she faces difficulties.
examples.zh: 她面對困難時從不放棄。

examples.en: She bought a new laptop for her college classes.
examples.zh: 她為大學課程買了一台新筆記型電腦。

examples.en: Welcome to our team; let me introduce the new members.
examples.zh: 歡迎加入我們的團隊，讓我介紹新成員。

examples.en: We tried a new recipe for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 我們今天晚餐嘗試了新食譜。

examples.en: My parents watch the evening news on television every night.
examples.zh: 我父母每天晚上都在電視上收看晚間新聞。

examples.en: I have some good news to share with you about my promotion.
examples.zh: 關於我升職的事情，我有個好消息要跟你分享。

examples.en: Bad news travels fast through social media networks nowadays.
examples.zh: 現今壞消息在社群媒體網路上散播得很快。

examples.en: My grandfather reads the morning newspaper while drinking hot tea.
examples.zh: 我祖父邊喝熱茶邊看晨報。

examples.en: The story appeared on the front page of the newspaper.
examples.zh: 這則新聞登上了報紙頭版。

examples.en: He wrapped the fragile glass bowl in old newspaper carefully.
examples.zh: 他小心地用舊報紙包裹易碎的玻璃碗。

examples.en: The next train to Taipei will arrive in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 開往台北的下一班列車將在十分鐘後到達。

examples.en: We are currently planning our next family trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 我們目前正在規劃下一次去日本的家族旅行。

examples.en: She lives in the next house down this quiet street.
examples.zh: 她住在這條安靜街道上的隔壁房子。

examples.en: What should we do next after finishing this difficult homework assignment?
examples.zh: 完成這份艱巨的作業後，我們接下來該做什麼？

examples.en: Add some water next, and then mix everything together slowly.
examples.zh: 接著加入一些水，然後慢慢把所有東西混合在一起。

examples.en: First we will visit the museum, and next we will go shopping.
examples.zh: 我們會先參觀博物館，接下來去購物。

examples.en: We had a nice time at the beach last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末在海灘度過了一段美好的時光。

examples.en: It was very nice of you to help me carry my bags.
examples.zh: 你幫我提東西真是太親切了。

examples.en: The weather today is exceptionally nice and clear.
examples.zh: 今天的天氣特別好且晴朗。

senses.zh: 美好的；親切的；令人愉快的

examples.en: My uncle bought a cute doll for his little niece.
examples.zh: 我叔叔為他的小姪女買了一隻可愛的洋娃娃。

examples.en: Her niece is studying medicine at a famous university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她的外甥女正在台北的一所著名大學攻讀醫學。

examples.en: We invited my niece to join our weekend family picnic.
examples.zh: 我們邀請我的姪女加入我們週末的家庭野餐。

examples.en: Stars were shining brightly in the clear night sky.
examples.zh: 繁星在晴朗的夜空中燦爛閃耀。

examples.en: We stayed up late talking until midnight last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚熬夜聊天直到午夜。

examples.en: The street lamps automatically turned on at night.
examples.zh: 路燈在夜晚自動點亮。

examples.en: There are nine brightly colored pencils inside this small plastic box.
examples.zh: 這個小塑膠盒裡面有九枝色彩鮮豔的鉛筆。

examples.en: Our team scored nine points during the first half of the game.
examples.zh: 我們隊在比賽上半場拿下了九分。

examples.en: She bought nine fresh apples at the local morning fruit market.
examples.zh: 她在當地的早市買了九顆新鮮蘋果。

examples.en: Nine of the missing students have safely returned to the school.
examples.zh: 九名失蹤的學生已經安全返回學校。

examples.en: Out of ten questions, I answered nine correctly on the exam.
examples.zh: 十道題目中，我在考試中答對了九題。

examples.en: Nine of the applicants were selected to join the final round of the competition.
examples.zh: 申請者中有九人獲選進入比賽的最終決賽。

examples.en: There are no available seats left on this bus.
examples.zh: 這輛公車上已經沒有空座位了。

examples.en: He had no money left after buying the expensive laptop.
examples.zh: 他在買了昂貴的筆記型電腦後就沒有錢了。

examples.en: There is no reason to be afraid of the dark.
examples.zh: 沒有理由去害怕黑暗。

examples.en: No, I have not seen your lost keys anywhere.
examples.zh: 不，我沒有在任何地方看到你遺失的鑰匙。

examples.en: The rain is no longer falling as heavily as before.
examples.zh: 雨下得不再像之前那麼大了。

examples.en: She said no when he offered her another piece of cake.
examples.zh: 當他遞給她另一塊蛋糕時，她說不。

examples.en: Nobody answered the phone when I called the office.
examples.zh: 當我打電話給辦公室時，沒有人接聽。

examples.en: There was nobody in the classroom during the lunch break.
examples.zh: 午休時間教室裡沒有人。

examples.en: Nobody knows the secret password except the owner.
examples.zh: 除了擁有者之外，沒有人知道秘密密碼。

examples.en: She nodded her head in agreement with my proposal.
examples.zh: 她點頭表示同意我的提議。

examples.en: The tired student began to nod off during the long speech.
examples.zh: 這名疲憊的學生在長篇演講中開始打瞌睡。

examples.en: He nodded politely to greet his new neighbor this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早上禮貌地向新鄰居點頭致意。

examples.en: With a quick nod of his head, he left the office.
examples.zh: 他快速地點了點頭後便離開了辦公室。

examples.en: The manager gave us a nod of approval for the project.
examples.zh: 經理對我們的專案表示點頭認可。

examples.en: A silent nod was enough to convey her complete understanding.
examples.zh: 默默的點頭就足以傳達她完全理解了。

examples.en: Loud noise from traffic makes it difficult to sleep peacefully.
examples.zh: 交通帶來的巨大噪音讓人難以平靜入睡。

examples.en: I heard a strange noise coming from the storage basement.
examples.zh: 我聽到儲藏室地下室傳來奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: Please keep your noise level down in the quiet library.
examples.zh: 在安靜的圖書館內請降低你的聲音音量。

examples.en: The noisy construction outside my window woke me up early today.
examples.zh: 今天窗外吵鬧的施工聲把我提早吵醒了。

examples.en: It is difficult to study in such a noisy coffee shop.
examples.zh: 要在這麼嘈雜的咖啡館裡讀書是很困難的。

examples.en: The children were very noisy during the playground recess period.
examples.zh: 孩子們在操場下課休息期間非常吵鬧。

examples.en: None of the students missed the important morning lecture.
examples.zh: 沒有一個學生錯過這堂重要的早晨講座。

examples.en: We searched for the keys, but found none in the room.
examples.zh: 我們尋找鑰匙，但在房間裡毫無所獲。

examples.en: I wanted some cake, but there was none left.
examples.zh: 我想吃點蛋糕，但一塊也不剩了。

examples.en: Beef noodle soup is one of the most famous dishes in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 牛肉麵是台灣最有名的料理之一。

examples.en: She ordered a bowl of fried noodles for her lunch today.
examples.zh: 她今天午餐點了一碗炒麵條。

examples.en: Handmade noodles usually have a much firmer texture than instant ones.
examples.zh: 手工麵條通常比泡麵有更緊實的口感。

examples.en: We agreed to meet outside the mall at noon.
examples.zh: 我們同意中午在購物中心外面集合。

examples.en: The sun is directly overhead at noon every day.
examples.zh: 每天正午時分太陽都在頭頂正上方。

examples.en: They took a short lunch break around noon today.
examples.zh: 他們今天中午左右休息了一下吃午餐。

examples.en: He does not like coffee, nor does he drink tea.
examples.zh: 他不喜歡咖啡，也不喝茶。

examples.en: She neither called me nor sent an email yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她昨天下午既沒有打電話給我，也沒有發電子郵件。

examples.en: The weather was neither too hot nor too cold today.
examples.zh: 今天的天氣既不太熱也不太冷。

examples.en: Birds usually fly south for the winter and return north in spring.
examples.zh: 鳥類通常飛往南方過冬，並在春天返回北方。

examples.en: Taipei is located in the north of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台北位於台灣的北部。

examples.en: The compass needle always points toward the north.
examples.zh: 指南針的指針總是指向北方。

examples.en: Cold winds blew in from the north coast yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天冷風從北海岸吹了過來。

examples.en: The north wall of the house gets very little sun.
examples.zh: 房子的北牆幾乎照不到陽光。

examples.en: The north entrance of the museum is currently closed.
examples.zh: 博物館的北側入口目前關閉中。

examples.en: We drove north along the highway for two hours.
examples.zh: 我們沿著高速公路往北開了兩個小時。

examples.en: The storm is moving north toward the coastal cities.
examples.zh: 風暴正向北朝沿海城市移動。

examples.en: Walk north for three blocks and you will see the station.
examples.zh: 往北走三個街區，你就會看到車站。

examples.en: Taipei is located in the northern part of Taiwan island.
examples.zh: 台北位於台灣島的北部地區。

examples.en: The cold northern wind blew harshly across the empty fields.
examples.zh: 刺骨的北風吹過空曠的田野。

examples.en: They traveled to northern Europe to see the northern lights.
examples.zh: 他們前往北歐觀賞極光。

examples.en: He wiped his nose with a tissue during dinner.
examples.zh: 他在晚餐時間用面紙擦了擦鼻子。

examples.en: The dog has a keen nose for tracking scents.
examples.zh: 那隻狗擁有用來追蹤氣味的敏銳鼻子。

examples.en: She pinched her nose to avoid the bad smell.
examples.zh: 她捏住鼻子以避開難聞的氣味。

examples.en: I am not hungry because I had a large lunch earlier.
examples.zh: 我不餓，因為我提早吃了一頓豐盛的午餐。

examples.en: She will not be able to attend the meeting this afternoon.
examples.zh: 她今天下午將無法參加會議。

examples.en: It is not easy to learn a new language fluently overnight.
examples.zh: 要在一夜之間流利地學會一門新語言並不容易。

examples.en: She wrote a short note to remind herself about homework.
examples.zh: 她寫了一張簡短的便條來提醒自己做作業。

examples.en: Please take good notes during the history lecture today.
examples.zh: 今天歷史課請好好做筆記。

examples.en: The musician played a wrong note during the piano performance.
examples.zh: 那位音樂家在鋼琴演奏中彈錯了一個音符。

examples.en: Please note that the library will close early this Friday.
examples.zh: 請注意，圖書館本週五將提前關閉。

examples.en: The officer noted down all the details of the traffic accident.
examples.zh: 警官記錄下了這起交通事故的所有細節。

examples.en: As the doctor noted, getting enough sleep improves your health.
examples.zh: 正如醫生所指出的，獲得充足的睡眠能改善健康。

examples.en: She wrote down important ideas in her spiral notebook.
examples.zh: 她把重要的想法寫在她的線圈筆記本裡。

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your math notebook to class.
examples.zh: 上課時別忘了帶你的數學筆記本。

examples.en: He opened his new notebook to take meeting notes.
examples.zh: 他打開他的新筆記本記錄開會筆記。

examples.en: There was nothing inside the heavy wooden box on the desk.
examples.zh: 書桌上的重木盒裡什麼也沒有。

examples.en: He said nothing and just smiled quietly at his friends.
examples.zh: 他什麼也沒說，只是對著朋友們靜靜地微笑。

examples.en: I have nothing to do this afternoon, so let's watch a movie.
examples.zh: 我今天下午沒事做，所以我們來看一部電影吧。

examples.en: I did not notice the sign at the entrance.
examples.zh: 我沒有注意到入口處的標誌。

examples.en: Did you notice her new haircut this morning?
examples.zh: 你今天早上有注意到她的新髮型嗎？

examples.en: He noticed that someone was following him.
examples.zh: 他察覺到有人在跟蹤他。

examples.en: The manager posted an important notice on the wall.
examples.zh: 經理在牆上張貼了一則重要通知。

examples.en: They gave us short notice about the meeting.
examples.zh: 他們在開會前很短的時間才通知我們。

examples.en: Please read the notice carefully before filling out the form.
examples.zh: 填寫表格前請仔細閱讀告示。

examples.en: She spent the rainy weekend reading a thick detective novel.
examples.zh: 她花了這個下雨的週末閱讀一本厚厚的偵探小說。

examples.en: The famous author spent two years writing her new novel.
examples.zh: 這位著名的作者花了兩年時間寫她的新小說。

examples.en: This popular historical novel was adapted into an award-winning movie.
examples.zh: 這部熱門歷史小說被改編成了一部獲獎電影。

examples.en: The scientist proposed a novel approach to solving the energy problem.
examples.zh: 這位科學家提出了一種解決能源問題的新穎方法。

examples.en: Using solar panels to charge smartphones is a novel idea.
examples.zh: 使用太陽能板給智慧型手機充電是一個新穎的想法。

examples.en: The company introduced a novel marketing strategy to boost sales.
examples.zh: 該公司推出了一項新穎的行銷策略來提昇銷售額。

examples.en: The novelty of living in a big city wore off quickly.
examples.zh: 住在大城市的新鮮感很快就消退了。

examples.en: Electronic toys were still a complete novelty fifty years ago.
examples.zh: 五十年前電子玩具仍然是非常新奇的事物。

examples.en: The shop sells various colorful souvenirs and novelty items.
examples.zh: 這間商店販售各種色彩繽紛的紀念品與新奇小物。

examples.en: You should start working on your homework assignment right now.
examples.zh: 你現在就應該開始做你的功課作業。

examples.en: Where are you living now after moving away from Taipei city?
examples.zh: 從台北市搬走後，你現在住在哪裡？

examples.en: Now that the rain has stopped, we can finally go outdoors.
examples.zh: 既然現在雨已經停了，我們終於可以去戶外了。

examples.en: Please write down your contact phone number on this card.
examples.zh: 請在這張卡片上寫下您的聯絡電話號碼。

examples.en: A large number of tourists visited the museum yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天有大量遊客參觀了這座博物館。

examples.en: I cannot remember the exact room number of my office.
examples.zh: 我記不清我辦公室的確切房號。

examples.en: The pages of the document are numbered from one to ten.
examples.zh: 這份文件的頁面編號從一到十。

examples.en: The crowd was estimated to number in the thousands.
examples.zh: 據估計，人群數量達到了數千人。

examples.en: Each item in the store was numbered for quick tracking.
examples.zh: 店裡的每件商品都編了號以便快速追蹤。

examples.en: The kind nurse took care of patients at the hospital.
examples.zh: 那位親切的護理師在醫院照顧病人。

examples.en: She works as a head nurse in the local clinic.
examples.zh: 她在當地診所擔任護理長。

examples.en: The school nurse checked his fever and gave him medicine.
examples.zh: 學校護理師檢查了他發燒的狀況並給他藥。

examples.en: She stayed home to nurse her sick child back to health.
examples.zh: 她留在家裡照料生病的孩子恢復健康。

examples.en: The mother cat nursed her newborn kittens in a basket.
examples.zh: 母貓在籃子裡哺育她剛出生的幼貓。

examples.en: He nursed his injured leg carefully after the football match.
examples.zh: 足球比賽後，他小心地護理受傷的腿。

examples.en: Squirrels like to gather and store nuts for the winter.
examples.zh: 松鼠喜歡為冬天收集並儲藏堅果。

examples.en: Use a wrench to tighten the loose steel nut firmly.
examples.zh: 使用扳手把鬆動的鋼製螺帽鎖緊。

examples.en: She added mixed nuts to her healthy morning yogurt bowl.
examples.zh: 她在健康早餐優格碗裡加入綜合堅果。

examples.en: All vehicle drivers must obey traffic safety laws to ensure road security.
examples.zh: 所有車輛駕駛人都必須遵守交通安全法規以確保道路安全。

examples.en: Well-trained dogs learn to obey their owner's clear commands very quickly.
examples.zh: 訓練有素的狗能非常迅速地學會服從主人的明確指令。

examples.en: Students are expected to obey school discipline and rules during class hours.
examples.zh: 學生被期望在上課時間遵守學校的紀律和規定。

examples.en: A mysterious shiny object was spotted flying across the clear blue sky.
examples.zh: 一個神秘的發光物體被發現飛過晴朗的藍天。

examples.en: The primary object of this educational game is to improve your vocabulary skills.
examples.zh: 這款教育遊戲的主要目標是提升你的字彙能力。

examples.en: Museum visitors are strictly warned not to touch any precious display object.
examples.zh: 博物館的參觀者被嚴格警告切勿觸摸任何珍貴的展示物品。

examples.en: Several local residents strongly object to the construction of a noisy highway nearby.
examples.zh: 幾位在地居民強烈反對在附近興建噪音很大的公路。

examples.en: No one objected when the teacher suggested moving the test to next Friday.
examples.zh: 當老師建議將測驗改到下週五時，沒有人提出異議。

examples.en: I must object to your unfair statement regarding our team's performance.
examples.zh: 我必須對你關於我們團隊表現的不公正陳述提出反對。

examples.en: Lack of money is the main obstacle to starting the business.
examples.zh: 資金不足是創業的主要障礙。

examples.en: The horse cleared every obstacle during the jumping competition.
examples.zh: 那匹馬在跳躍比賽中越過了每一個障礙物。

examples.en: Fear of failure can become a huge obstacle to success.
examples.zh: 對失敗的恐懼會成為成功巨大的阻礙。

examples.en: It was obvious that she was pleased with her exam results.
examples.zh: 很明顯她對自己的考試成績感到滿意。

examples.en: There is an obvious difference between these two colors.
examples.zh: 這兩種顏色之間有明顯的差異。

examples.en: He made an obvious mistake on the first page of the document.
examples.zh: 他在文件的第一頁犯了一個明顯的錯誤。

examples.en: Earthquakes often occur in this coastal region during springtime.
examples.zh: 這座沿海地區在春季經常發生地震。

examples.en: A brilliant idea occurred to him while taking a walk.
examples.zh: 散步時他突然想到了一個絕妙的主意。

examples.en: Accidents can occur when drivers fail to follow traffic rules.
examples.zh: 當駕駛未遵守交通規則時，事故就可能發生。

examples.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on the planet.
examples.zh: 太平洋是地球上最大的海洋。

examples.en: We listened to the soothing sound of ocean waves.
examples.zh: 我們聆聽著海浪舒緩的聲音。

examples.en: Plastic waste poses a serious danger to ocean life.
examples.zh: 塑膠廢棄物對海洋生物造成嚴重危險。

examples.en: The roof of the old house was damaged by wind.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子的屋頂被風吹損壞了。

examples.en: She drank a glass of cool water after running.
examples.zh: 她跑步後喝了一杯涼水。

examples.en: Many parts of Taiwan are famous for high mountains.
examples.zh: 台灣的許多地方都以高山聞名。

examples.en: Please turn off the lights when leaving the main room.
examples.zh: 離開主房間時請關閉燈光。

examples.en: He took off his wet jacket after coming inside.
examples.zh: 進屋後，他脫下了濕漉漉的夾克。

examples.en: The airplane took off smoothly into the clear blue sky.
examples.zh: 飛機順利起飛，升入晴朗的藍天。

examples.en: The cat jumped off the table onto the soft carpet.
examples.zh: 貓咪從桌上跳到了柔軟的地毯上。

examples.en: The village is located just off the main coastal highway.
examples.zh: 該村莊就位於主要沿海公路旁邊。

examples.en: Keep off the freshly cut lawn to protect young grass.
examples.zh: 遠離剛修剪的草坪以保護幼草。

examples.en: The company offered her a great job with a high salary.
examples.zh: 這家公司提供了她一份高薪的好工作。

examples.en: He kindly offered to carry the heavy bags for the elderly lady.
examples.zh: 他親切地主動提出替那位年長女士提重包包。

examples.en: They offered a fair price for the second-hand wooden table.
examples.zh: 他們為這張二手木桌出了一個合理的價格。

examples.en: Thank you for your generous offer to help with our event.
examples.zh: 感謝你慷慨提議協助我們的活動。

examples.en: She accepted the attractive job offer from the international tech firm.
examples.zh: 她接受了那家國際科技公司提供的誘人工作機會。

examples.en: The store has a special offer on fresh fruit this weekend.
examples.zh: 這間店家這個週末對新鮮水果有特別的折扣優惠。

examples.en: My mother works in a modern office near the station.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在車站附近的一間現代化辦公室上班。

examples.en: Please visit the school office to get your student ID card.
examples.zh: 請到學校辦公室領取你的學生證。

examples.en: He was late for work because his office computer crashed.
examples.zh: 他上班遲到了，因為他的辦公室電腦當機了。

examples.en: A police officer stopped the car for running a red light.
examples.zh: 一名警官攔下了那輛闖紅燈的轎車。

examples.en: She met with a government officer to apply for a business permit.
examples.zh: 她與一位政府官員會面申辦營業許可。

examples.en: The military officer gave clear instructions to his squad.
examples.zh: 那位軍官對他的分隊下達了明確的指令。

examples.en: This is the official statement released by the government.
examples.zh: 這是政府發布的官方聲明。

examples.en: English is an official language in many countries globally.
examples.zh: 英語在全球許多國家都是官方語言。

examples.en: He attended the official opening ceremony of the new museum.
examples.zh: 他出席了新博物館的正式開幕典禮。

examples.en: Government officials met to discuss the new urban policy.
examples.zh: 政府官員會面討論新的城市政策。

examples.en: A health official inspected the restaurant kitchen this morning.
examples.zh: 一名衛生官員今天早上檢查了餐廳的廚房。

examples.en: The election official counted the ballots carefully.
examples.zh: 選務人員仔細地計算選票。

examples.en: We often go for a long walk in the quiet park.
examples.zh: 我們經常在寧靜的公園裡散步。

examples.en: How often do you visit your grandparents in the countryside?
examples.zh: 你多久去鄉下看望一次祖父母？

examples.en: It often rains heavily in Taiwan during the summer season.
examples.zh: 台灣在夏季經常下大雨。

examples.en: Add a tablespoon of olive oil to the pan.
examples.zh: 在平底鍋裡加入一湯匙橄欖油。

examples.en: The mechanic changed the engine oil in my car.
examples.zh: 技師幫我的車子更換了引擎機油。

examples.en: The price of crude oil went up this week.
examples.zh: 本週原油價格上漲了。

examples.en: My grandfather tells great stories from the old days.
examples.zh: 我爺爺會講述舊時代的精彩故事。

examples.en: She replaced her old computer with a fast one.
examples.zh: 她用一台快速的新電腦換掉了她的舊電腦。

examples.en: The little girl is five years old today.
examples.zh: 那個小女孩今天滿五歲了。

examples.en: The hot coffee cup is sitting on the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 熱咖啡杯正放在廚房桌子上。

examples.en: Our annual family trip usually takes place on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們一年一度的家庭旅行通常在星期日舉行。

examples.en: There is a beautiful painting hanging on the wall.
examples.zh: 牆上掛著一幅美麗的畫作。

examples.en: Please leave the lights on while I am away.
examples.zh: 我不在的時候，請讓燈保持亮著。

examples.en: He put on his warm jacket before going outside.
examples.zh: 他在出門前穿上了保暖的外套。

examples.en: The noise went on for hours and kept us awake.
examples.zh: 噪音持續了好幾個小時，讓我們無法入睡。

examples.en: I have only visited Japan once in my life.
examples.zh: 我這輩子只去過日本一次。

examples.en: My grandfather once lived in this quiet small town.
examples.zh: 我爺爺曾經在這個安靜的小鎮居住過。

examples.en: Check your written work at least once before submitting.
examples.zh: 在繳交前請至少檢查一次你的書面作品。

examples.en: Once you finish reading, turn off the light please.
examples.zh: 你一旦讀完書，請把燈關掉。

examples.en: The order will arrive once your payment is confirmed.
examples.zh: 一旦你的付款得到確認，訂單就會寄達。

examples.en: Once she starts singing, everyone stops talking.
examples.zh: 她一開始唱歌，大家就會停止說話。

examples.en: Many people prefer online shopping because it is very convenient.
examples.zh: 許多人更喜歡線上購物，因為非常方便。

examples.en: The university offers several online courses for remote students.
examples.zh: 這所大學為遠距學生提供幾門線上課程。

examples.en: You can buy tickets through the online booking system.
examples.zh: 你可以透過線上訂票系統買票。

examples.en: I usually read the news online before going to work.
examples.zh: 我通常在上班前在網路上看新聞。

examples.en: They met online and eventually became good business partners.
examples.zh: 他們在網路上相識，最終成為了良好的事業夥伴。

examples.en: You can order food online and have it delivered home.
examples.zh: 你可以在線上點餐並將餐點外送到家。

examples.en: There are only three pieces of cake left on the plate.
examples.zh: 盤子裡只剩下三塊蛋糕。

examples.en: He works out at the gym only on weekends.
examples.zh: 他只有在週末才會去健身房健身。

examples.en: I only wanted to ask a simple question about the assignment.
examples.zh: 我只是想問一個關於作業的簡單問題。

examples.en: She was the only person who solved the difficult problem.
examples.zh: 她是唯一解出那道難題的人。

examples.en: This is our only chance to win the championship title.
examples.zh: 這是我們贏得冠軍頭銜的唯一機會。

examples.en: He is the only child in his family.
examples.zh: 他是家裡的獨生子。

examples.en: The shop stays open until ten o'clock every night.
examples.zh: 這家商店每天晚上營業到十點。

examples.en: Leave the window open to let some fresh air in.
examples.zh: 讓窗戶打開著以引進一些新鮮空氣。

examples.en: He was very open about his feelings during the talk.
examples.zh: 他在談話中對自己的感受非常坦率。

senses.zh: 打開的；營業中的；坦率的

examples.en: Please open your textbook to page forty-five now.
examples.zh: 現在請打開你的課本到第四十五頁。

examples.en: The new supermarket will open next Monday morning.
examples.zh: 這家新超市將於下週一早晨開幕營業。

examples.en: She opened the door to welcome the guests inside.
examples.zh: 她打開門歡迎客人進來。

examples.en: Learn how to operate the machine safely before starting.
examples.zh: 在啟動之前，先學習如何安全操作這台機器。

examples.en: The big company operates several chain stores across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這家大公司在全台灣營運著幾家連鎖店。

examples.en: Surgeons will operate on the sick patient tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 外科醫生將會在明天早上為那位生病的病人動手術。

examples.en: The machine operator checked the equipment before starting the factory line.
examples.zh: 機器操作員在啟動工廠生產線之前檢查了設備。

examples.en: You can dial zero to speak directly to a customer service operator.
examples.zh: 你可以撥打零直接與客服接線員通話。

examples.en: The tour operator arranged all the hotel bookings for our vacation.
examples.zh: 旅行社業者為我們的假期安排了所有的飯店預訂。

senses.zh: 操作員；接線員；經營業者

examples.en: In my opinion, this plan is the most effective solution.
examples.zh: 依我之見，這個計劃是最有效的解決方案。

examples.en: Everyone has the right to share their opinion in class.
examples.zh: 每個人都有權利在課堂上分享自己的意見。

examples.en: We decided to ask an expert for a professional opinion.
examples.zh: 我們決定尋求專家提供專業意見。

examples.en: Would you prefer black tea or hot coffee with your breakfast?
examples.zh: 你早餐想喝紅茶還是熱咖啡？

examples.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the last train home tonight.
examples.zh: 快一點，否則你今晚會錯過回家的末班列車。

examples.en: You can pay by cash or credit card at the checkout.
examples.zh: 結帳時你可以選擇用現金或信用卡付款。

examples.en: She peeled an orange and shared the slices with her friend.
examples.zh: 她剝開一顆柳橙，把果肉分給朋友吃。

examples.en: Fresh orange juice is my favorite morning drink.
examples.zh: 新鮮的柳橙汁是我最喜歡的早晨飲料。

examples.en: Bright orange is a popular color for autumn clothing.
examples.zh: 鮮豔的橙色是秋冬服飾熱門的顏色。

examples.en: The cat has beautiful orange fur and green eyes.
examples.zh: 那隻貓擁有美麗的橘色毛髮與綠色眼睛。

examples.en: He wore an orange sweater to the family gathering.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件橘色毛衣去參加家庭聚會。

examples.en: The sky turned orange as the sun went down.
examples.zh: 太陽西下時，天空變成了橙色。

examples.en: We are ready to order our dinner now.
examples.zh: 我們現在準備好點晚餐了。

examples.en: I ordered a pair of shoes from the website.
examples.zh: 我從該網站訂購了一雙鞋子。

examples.en: The officer ordered the soldiers to stop.
examples.zh: 軍官命令士兵們停下。

examples.en: The waiter took our order politely.
examples.zh: 服務生很有禮貌地幫我們點餐。

examples.en: Your online order will be delivered tomorrow.
examples.zh: 您的網路訂單將於明天送達。

examples.en: Please arrange these files in alphabetical order.
examples.zh: 請按照字母順序排列這些檔案。

examples.en: It was just an ordinary day until the surprise happened.
examples.zh: 在驚喜發生之前，這只是一個平凡的一天。

examples.en: She lived an ordinary life in a quiet small town.
examples.zh: 她在一個寧靜的小鎮過著平凡的生活。

examples.en: These ordinary shoes are comfortable enough for daily long walking.
examples.zh: 這些普通的鞋子對於日常長途行走來說足夠舒適。

examples.en: The heart is a vital organ that pumps blood throughout the body.
examples.zh: 心臟是將血液輸送至全身的重要器官。

examples.en: A musician played the church organ beautifully during the Sunday service.
examples.zh: 一位音樂家在週日禮拜期間精采地演奏了教堂風琴。

examples.en: The skin is the largest organ of the human body.
examples.zh: 皮膚是人體最大的器官。

examples.en: She works for a non-profit organization helping children.
examples.zh: 她在一家幫助兒童的非營利組織工作。

examples.en: The international organization holds a conference every year.
examples.zh: 該國際組織每年都會舉辦一場會議。

examples.en: Good organization skills help you finish work much faster.
examples.zh: 良好的條理與組織能力能幫你更快完成工作。

examples.en: Scientists are studying the origin of the universe.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究宇宙的起源。

examples.en: Despite her humble origins, she became a successful businesswoman.
examples.zh: 儘管出身平凡，她後來成為一位成功的女企業家。

examples.en: The origin of this custom can be traced back centuries.
examples.zh: 這個習俗的由來可以追溯到幾個世紀以前。

examples.en: Do you have any other questions regarding this project?
examples.zh: 關於這個專案，你還有其他問題嗎？

examples.en: She decided to buy the other coat in the store.
examples.zh: 她決定購買店裡的另外那件大衣。

examples.en: There are many other ways to solve this problem.
examples.zh: 有許多其他方法可以解決這個問題。

examples.en: Some students like music while others prefer playing sports.
examples.zh: 有些學生喜歡音樂，而其他人則偏好運動。

examples.en: One glove was on the table, but where is the other?
examples.zh: 一隻手套在桌上，但另外一隻在哪裡？

examples.en: Respecting each other is fundamental for a healthy friendship.
examples.zh: 互相尊重是健康友誼的根本。

examples.en: The happy children ran out to play in the garden.
examples.zh: 快樂的孩子們跑出去到花園裡玩耍。

examples.en: The campfire went out after heavy rain started falling.
examples.zh: 在開始下大雨後，營火熄滅了。

examples.en: She turned off lights and went out for dinner.
examples.zh: 她關上燈，出去吃晚餐了。

examples.en: He looked out the window to watch rain fall.
examples.zh: 他看向窗外看著雨落下。

examples.en: Water flowed out of the pipe into the garden.
examples.zh: 水從水管流進了花園。

examples.en: She stepped out the door into bright warm sunshine.
examples.zh: 她跨出門口進入明亮溫暖的陽光中。

examples.en: We met outside the movie theater before buying hot popcorn.
examples.zh: 買熱爆米花前，我們在電影院外面集合。

examples.en: The children played games outside the school building during recess.
examples.zh: 下課時間，孩子們在大樓外面玩遊戲。

examples.en: There is a small fountain park located just outside my apartment.
examples.zh: 我的公寓外面正好有一個噴泉公園。

examples.en: It is raining heavily so please stay inside, not outside.
examples.zh: 外面下著大雨，所以請留在室內，不要去外面。

examples.en: Let us go outside to enjoy the fresh warm air.
examples.zh: 我們去戶外享受新鮮溫暖的空氣吧。

examples.en: He looked outside to see who was knocking on the door.
examples.zh: 他往外面看，想看看是誰在敲門。

examples.en: A colorful rainbow appeared over the mountains after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，山頭上方出現了一道彩虹。

examples.en: There were over fifty people attending the workshop last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有超過五十個人參加這場研討會。

examples.en: The dog jumped over the fence and ran into the garden.
examples.zh: 那隻狗跳過籬笆，跑進了花園。

examples.en: The long basketball game is finally over and our team won.
examples.zh: 這場漫長的籃球賽終於結束了，我們隊贏了。

examples.en: Please come over to my house for dinner this Saturday evening.
examples.zh: 這星期六晚上請來我家一起吃晚餐。

examples.en: He accidentally knocked the glass over and spilled the water.
examples.zh: 他不小心把玻璃杯弄倒，把水灑了出來。

examples.en: She dreams of opening her own bakery someday.
examples.zh: 她夢想著有一天能開一家屬於自己的麵包店。

examples.en: Every student in this class has their own locker.
examples.zh: 這班上的每個學生都有屬於自己的置物櫃。

examples.en: He likes to fix his computer with his own hands.
examples.zh: 他喜歡用自己的雙手修理他的電腦。

examples.en: My grandparents own a fruit orchard in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母在山區擁有一個果園。

examples.en: Does anyone here own this silver umbrella?
examples.zh: 這裡有人擁有這把銀色的雨傘嗎？

examples.en: The company owns several restaurants across the country.
examples.zh: 這家公司在全國擁有好幾家餐廳。

examples.en: The restaurant owner greeted every customer with a friendly smile.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳的老闆親切地向每一位顧客微笑打招呼。

examples.en: The police are looking for the owner of the abandoned car.
examples.zh: 警方正在尋找這輛廢棄車輛的車主。

examples.en: Every dog owner should clean up after their pet in public.
examples.zh: 每位狗主人都應該在公共場所清理寵物的排泄物。

examples.en: Please pack your bags early for tomorrow morning's flight.
examples.zh: 請早點打包行李，準備搭明天早上的班機。

examples.en: She packed a healthy lunch box for her younger son.
examples.zh: 她為她的小兒子打包了一盒健康的午餐。

examples.en: Fans packed the stadium to watch the final football game.
examples.zh: 球迷們擠滿了體育館以觀看決賽足球賽。

examples.en: A pack of wild wolves hunted near the snowy mountains.
examples.zh: 一群野狼在雪山附近獵食。

examples.en: He carried a heavy pack during the long hiking trip.
examples.zh: 在漫長的徒步旅行中，他背著一個重背包。

examples.en: She bought a pack of batteries at the local store.
examples.zh: 她在當地商店買了一包電池。

examples.en: The delivery driver left a large package at our front door.
examples.zh: 外送員在我們前門留下了一個大包裹。

examples.en: You can track your package online using this tracking number.
examples.zh: 你可以使用這個追蹤號碼線上追蹤你的包裹。

examples.en: She carefully opened the cardboard package to inspect the gifts.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地打開紙箱包裹以檢查禮物。

examples.en: The bakery packages its fresh cookies in lovely blue boxes.
examples.zh: 那家麵包店把新鮮餅乾包裝在可愛的藍色盒子裡。

examples.en: Workers package the organic vegetables before sending them to stores.
examples.zh: 工人在把有機蔬菜送到店家之前會先包裝好。

examples.en: The product was packaged poorly and arrived broken at my house.
examples.zh: 這項產品包裝不良，送達我家時已經破損了。

examples.en: Please open your textbooks and turn to page twenty-five now.
examples.zh: 現在請打開你們的課本並翻到第二十五頁。

examples.en: She wrote three full pages of neat notes during the lecture.
examples.zh: 她在講座期間寫了整整三頁工整的筆記。

examples.en: You can find more detailed information on our official web page.
examples.zh: 你可以在我們的官方網頁上找到更多詳細資訊。

examples.en: He took some medicine to relieve the sharp pain in his head.
examples.zh: 他吃了藥來緩解頭部的劇烈疼痛。

examples.en: She felt a sudden pain in her back while lifting a box.
examples.zh: 她在搬箱子時，背部突然感到一陣疼痛。

examples.en: Time can gradually heal emotional pain caused by personal loss.
examples.zh: 時間可以逐漸治癒個人損失帶來的心理痛苦。

examples.en: He had a painful knee after playing basketball all day.
examples.zh: 打了一整天的籃球後，他的膝蓋感到疼痛。

examples.en: It was a painful decision for her to leave home.
examples.zh: 對她來說，離開家是一個痛苦的決定。

examples.en: Removing the old bandage was slightly painful for him.
examples.zh: 撕掉舊繃帶對他來說有一點痛。

examples.en: We decided to paint our living room walls bright yellow.
examples.zh: 我們決定把客廳的牆壁粉刷成明亮黃色。

examples.en: She likes to paint peaceful landscapes with watercolors.
examples.zh: 她喜歡用水彩畫平靜的風景畫。

examples.en: The artist spent three months painting this large portrait.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家花了三個月繪製這幅大型肖像。

examples.en: The fresh paint on the bench is still wet.
examples.zh: 長椅上的新油漆還沒乾。

examples.en: You can mix red and blue paint to make purple.
examples.zh: 你可以混合紅色和藍色顏料來調配出紫色。

examples.en: He bought three cans of white paint at the store.
examples.zh: 他在店家買了三罐白色的油漆。

examples.en: An oil painting hung above the fireplace in the room.
examples.zh: 房間裡的壁爐上方掛著一幅油畫。

examples.en: She studied traditional Chinese painting during her summer vacation.
examples.zh: 她在暑假期間學習了傳統中國繪畫。

examples.en: The art gallery opened a new exhibition of modern paintings.
examples.zh: 這間美術館舉辦了一場現代畫作的新展覽。

examples.en: I need to buy a new pair of running shoes for the marathon.
examples.zh: 我需要買一雙新的跑步鞋來參加馬拉松。

examples.en: She wears a stylish pair of glasses when working on the computer.
examples.zh: 她在用電腦工作時會戴著一副時尚的眼鏡。

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to work in pairs on the assignment.
examples.zh: 老師要求學生們兩人一組完成這項作業。

examples.en: The app helps pair your phone with Bluetooth devices automatically.
examples.zh: 這款應用程式能幫你的手機自動與藍牙裝置配對。

examples.en: The teacher paired native speakers with foreign exchange students.
examples.zh: 老師將母語人士與外國交換學生進行配對。

examples.en: Red wine is often paired with red meat for better flavor.
examples.zh: 紅酒常常與紅肉搭配以獲得更好的風味。

examples.en: He changed into comfortable cotton pajamas before going to bed.
examples.zh: 他在上床睡覺前換上了舒服的棉質睡衣。

examples.en: The child wore warm pajamas on cold winter nights.
examples.zh: 這個孩子在寒冷的冬夜穿著保暖的睡衣。

examples.en: She bought a cute pair of pajamas for her daughter.
examples.zh: 她為女兒買了一套可愛的睡衣。

examples.en: Her face looked pale after hearing the bad news.
examples.zh: 聽到壞消息後，她的臉色看起來很蒼白。

examples.en: She wore a pale yellow dress to a summer party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件淺黃色的洋裝去參加夏天派對。

examples.en: The morning sun gave off a pale light in winter.
examples.zh: 冬日的朝陽發出淺淡的光芒。

examples.en: She melted some fresh butter in a hot frying pan.
examples.zh: 她在熱平底鍋裡融化了一些新鮮奶油。

examples.en: He washed the dirty pan after cooking eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 他在煮完早餐雞蛋後洗乾淨了髒鍋子。

examples.en: Pour the cake batter into a round baking pan.
examples.zh: 將蛋糕麵糊倒入圓形烤盤中。

examples.en: The panda munched on fresh bamboo leaves calmly.
examples.zh: 貓熊平靜地嚼著新鮮的竹葉。

examples.en: We saw a cute baby panda at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到了一隻可愛的幼年貓熊。

examples.en: The giant panda is protected in wildlife reserves.
examples.zh: 大貓熊在野生動物保護區內受到保護。

examples.en: He bought a pair of dark blue pants for the formal interview.
examples.zh: 他買了一條深藍色長褲用於正式面試。

examples.en: These pants are too loose around my waist and need a belt.
examples.zh: 這條長褲腰圍太鬆，需要一條腰帶。

examples.en: She spilled coffee on her white pants during breakfast.
examples.zh: 她在吃早餐時把咖啡灑在白褲子上。

examples.en: Fresh papaya milk is a famous iced drink here.
examples.zh: 新鮮木瓜牛奶是這裡著名的冰飲。

examples.en: Cut the ripe papaya in half and remove seeds.
examples.zh: 把成熟的木瓜切成兩半並去除籽。

examples.en: Papaya contains natural enzymes that help digest meals easily.
examples.zh: 木瓜含有天然酵素，有助於輕鬆消化餐點。

examples.en: Please hand me a piece of paper so I can take notes.
examples.zh: 請拿一張紙給我，這樣我才能做筆記。

examples.en: My grandfather reads the morning paper with his coffee every day.
examples.zh: 我爺爺每天喝咖啡時都會閱讀晨報。

examples.en: Students must hand in their history papers before next Friday.
examples.zh: 學生們必須在下週五之前交出歷史論文。

examples.en: Pardon me for interrupting your conversation just now.
examples.zh: 原諒我剛才打斷了你們的對話。

examples.en: The judge decided to pardon the young offender.
examples.zh: 法官決定赦免這名年輕的罪犯。

examples.en: Please pardon my late reply to your email message.
examples.zh: 請原諒我晚回覆你的電子郵件。

examples.en: The president granted a full pardon to the prisoner.
examples.zh: 總統給予該名囚犯全赦。

examples.en: He begged for pardon after making a mistake.
examples.zh: 他在犯錯後請求原諒。

examples.en: She granted him her pardon with a warm smile.
examples.zh: 她面帶溫暖的微笑原諒了他。

examples.en: Pardon? I didn't hear what you just said.
examples.zh: 請再說一遍好嗎？我剛才沒聽到你說的話。

examples.en: Pardon, could you repeat that number for me?
examples.zh: 對不起，你能為我重複一次那個數字嗎？

examples.en: Pardon, is this seat taken by anyone else?
examples.zh: 不好意思，這個座位有人坐嗎？

examples.en: Every parent wants to provide a safe environment for their children.
examples.zh: 每位父母親都想為他們的孩子提供一個安全的環境。

examples.en: Her parent came to school to talk with the guidance counselor.
examples.zh: 她的家長來到學校與輔導老師交談。

examples.en: Being a loving parent requires patience, responsibility, and constant effort.
examples.zh: 成為一位充滿愛的父母親需要耐心、責任感與持續的努力。

examples.en: Children like to play on the swings in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在公園的鞦韆上玩耍。

examples.en: We went for a relaxing walk in the central park.
examples.zh: 我們去中央公園散步放鬆。

examples.en: The national park attracts thousands of tourists every summer.
examples.zh: 該國家公園每年夏季吸引數千名遊客。

examples.en: You cannot park your car in front of the driveway.
examples.zh: 你不能把車停在車道前面。

examples.en: He parked his bicycle near the entrance of the library.
examples.zh: 他把自行車停在圖書館入口附近。

examples.en: It took me twenty minutes to find a place to park on this street.
examples.zh: 我花了二十分鐘才在這條街上找到停車位。

examples.en: Reading is an important part of learning a new language.
examples.zh: 閱讀是學習新語言的重要部分。

examples.en: The mechanic ordered a new part for my car.
examples.zh: 技師為我的汽車訂購了一個新零件。

examples.en: She played the leading part in the school play.
examples.zh: 她在學校的話劇中飾演主角。

examples.en: The dark clouds parted and the warm sun came out.
examples.zh: 烏雲散開，溫暖的太陽露了出來。

examples.en: They promised to stay friends even after they parted ways.
examples.zh: 他們承諾即使分道揚鑣後仍會維持朋友關係。

examples.en: It was difficult for him to part with his old bicycle.
examples.zh: 對他來說，捨棄那台舊單車是很困難的。

examples.en: Many international runners participate in the annual Taipei marathon.
examples.zh: 許多國際跑者參加一年一度的台北馬拉松。

examples.en: Students are encouraged to participate in active classroom discussions.
examples.zh: 鼓勵學生參與積極的課堂討論。

examples.en: She will participate in the international science fair next month.
examples.zh: 她下個月將參加國際科學展覽會。

examples.en: Is there any particular song you would like to hear?
examples.zh: 有哪首特定的歌曲你想聽嗎？

examples.en: She is very particular about the cleanliness of her bedroom.
examples.zh: 她對自己臥室的整潔非常挑剔。

examples.en: We paid attention to this particular detail during our research.
examples.zh: 我們在研究過程中注意到了這個特定的細節。

examples.en: Choose a partner to complete the English speaking exercise together.
examples.zh: 選擇一位搭檔一起完成英語口說練習。

examples.en: He met his business partner during his time at university.
examples.zh: 他在大學時期結識了他的商業夥伴。

examples.en: She danced gracefully across the hall with her dance partner.
examples.zh: 她與她的舞蹈搭檔優雅地翩翩起舞穿過大廳。

examples.en: We held a surprise birthday party for our friend yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天為朋友舉辦了一個驚喜生日派對。

examples.en: Are you planning to go to the Christmas party tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚打算去參加聖誕聚會嗎？

examples.en: Members of the political party met to discuss the strategy.
examples.zh: 該政黨的成員開會討論策略。

examples.en: She studied hard and managed to pass the final exam.
examples.zh: 她努力學習，成功通過了期末考試。

examples.en: Could you please pass me the salt from the table?
examples.zh: 你可以順手把桌上的鹽遞給我嗎？

examples.en: Time passes so quickly when you are having fun.
examples.zh: 當你玩得開心時，時間過得真快。

examples.en: You need to show your official pass at the entrance.
examples.zh: 你需要在大門入口處出示你的官方通行證。

examples.en: He bought a weekly bus pass to save money.
examples.zh: 他買了一張公車週票以節省開銷。

examples.en: The players made a quick pass across the basketball court.
examples.zh: 球員們在籃球場上進行了一次快速傳球。

examples.en: We cannot change the past, so we should focus on the future.
examples.zh: 我們無法改變過去，所以應該專注於未來。

examples.en: She talked about her happy memories from the distant past.
examples.zh: 她談到了遙遠過去的快樂回憶。

examples.en: In the past, people communicated mainly through handwritten letters.
examples.zh: 在過去，人們主要透過手寫信件交流。

examples.en: Over the past few days, the weather has been unusually warm.
examples.zh: 在過去的幾天裡，天氣異常溫暖。

examples.en: He has gained a lot of experience during his past jobs.
examples.zh: 他在過去的工作中累積了許多經驗。

examples.en: The past events helped shape her into a strong person.
examples.zh: 過去發生的事件塑造了她堅強的性格。

examples.en: Walk past the bakery and the bank will be on your left.
examples.zh: 走過麵包店，銀行就會在你的左手邊。

examples.en: It is already past ten o'clock, so the kids should go to sleep.
examples.zh: 現在已經過十點了，小孩應該去睡覺了。

examples.en: The train sped past small towns without stopping at all.
examples.zh: 火車疾馳駛過小鎮，完全沒有停下來。

examples.en: Spread garlic paste evenly on a slice of French bread.
examples.zh: 把蒜蓉醬均勻塗抹在法國麵包片上。

examples.en: Rub a small amount of cleaning paste onto the stain.
examples.zh: 把少量清潔膏塗抹在污漬上。

examples.en: The children used paste to complete their art project.
examples.zh: 孩子們用漿糊完成他們的美勞作品。

examples.en: Copy the text from a website and paste it into a document.
examples.zh: 從網站複製文字並將其貼上到文件中。

examples.en: She pasted several old family photos onto the memory board.
examples.zh: 她把幾張家族舊照片黏貼在回憶板上。

examples.en: Please paste the mailing label neatly on the package front.
examples.zh: 請將郵寄標籤整齊地貼在包裹正面。

examples.en: We followed the narrow path through the quiet green forest.
examples.zh: 我們沿著穿過寂靜綠色森林的狹窄小徑前進。

examples.en: The stone path leads directly to the front door of the house.
examples.zh: 這條石板路直接通往房子的前門。

examples.en: She chose a career path that allowed her to travel often.
examples.zh: 她選擇了一條能讓她經常旅行的職涯道路。

examples.en: The doctor spent thirty minutes examining the patient at the clinic.
examples.zh: 醫生花了三十分鐘在診所檢查這位病人。

examples.en: Nurses gave medication to every patient in the hospital ward.
examples.zh: 護理師給醫院病房裡的每位患者發了藥物。

examples.en: The dental patient sat nervously in the chair awaiting her checkup.
examples.zh: 看牙醫的病患緊張地坐在椅子上等待檢查。

examples.en: You need to be patient when teaching young children new skills.
examples.zh: 在教幼童新技能時，你需要很有耐心。

examples.en: The customer remained patient despite waiting in line for half an hour.
examples.zh: 儘管排隊等了半小時，顧客依然保持耐心。

examples.en: My math teacher is always patient with students who have difficulty learning.
examples.zh: 我的數學老師對學習有困難的學生總是很有耐心。

examples.en: She bought a colorful curtain with a beautiful floral pattern.
examples.zh: 她買了一副有漂亮花朵圖案的彩色窗簾。

examples.en: Scientists noticed a regular weather pattern during the autumn season.
examples.zh: 科學家注意到秋季期間有規律的天氣模式。

examples.en: He cut the fabric according to the sewing pattern carefully.
examples.zh: 他仔細地按照紙樣裁剪布料。

examples.en: She tried to pattern her teaching methods after her favorite mentor.
examples.zh: 她試圖模仿自己最崇拜的導師的教學方法。

examples.en: The new curriculum was patterned on European education standards.
examples.zh: 這套新課程是以歐洲教育標準為模式設計的。

examples.en: The young artist patterned his sculpture style after famous classical masters.
examples.zh: 這名年輕藝術家以著名古典大師為榜樣塑造雕塑風格。

examples.en: I will pay for the dinner with my credit card tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚會用信用卡支付晚餐費用。

examples.en: Remember to pay your monthly electricity bill on time every month.
examples.zh: 記得每個月準時繳納你的電費。

examples.en: Hard work will always pay off in the long run.
examples.zh: 長遠來看，努力工作一定會有回報。

examples.en: Factory workers are asking for higher pay and better working conditions.
examples.zh: 工廠工人正在要求更高的薪水與更好的工作條件。

examples.en: She received her weekly pay at the end of every Friday.
examples.zh: 她每週五結束時領取她的週薪。

examples.en: The job offers good pay but requires working very long hours.
examples.zh: 這份工作提供良好的薪水，但需要工作很長時間。

examples.en: The two countries signed an agreement to restore peace and stability.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署了一份協議以恢復和平與穩定。

examples.en: She enjoys reading a good book in peace on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在星期天早上平靜地讀一本好書。

examples.en: Meditation helped him find inner peace amidst his busy daily life.
examples.zh: 冥想幫助他在忙碌的日常生活中找到內心安寧。

examples.en: They enjoyed a peaceful walk around the quiet countryside lake park.
examples.zh: 他們沿著寧靜的鄉間湖畔公園，悠閒地散了一趟步。

examples.en: The room was dark and peaceful, perfect for a good sleep.
examples.zh: 房間暗淡而平靜，非常適合好好睡一覺。

examples.en: The two countries worked hard to find a peaceful solution to the conflict.
examples.zh: 兩國努力尋找和平解決衝突的方法。

examples.en: She bought a basket of fresh sweet peaches at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市場買了一籃新鮮甜美的桃子。

examples.en: This peach juice tastes delicious and refreshing on a hot summer day.
examples.zh: 這款水蜜桃汁在大熱天喝起來既美味又解渴。

examples.en: The tree in our backyard is full of ripe pink peaches.
examples.zh: 我們後院的樹上結滿了成熟的粉紅色桃子。

examples.en: The mountain peak was completely covered with thick white snow.
examples.zh: 山頂完全被厚厚的白雪覆蓋。

examples.en: Traffic reaches its peak every morning during rush hour.
examples.zh: 每天早上的上班尖峰時間，交通流量達到最高峰。

examples.en: The climbers finally reached the highest peak of the mountain.
examples.zh: 登山者們終於到達了這座山的最高峰。

examples.en: Hotel room rates are usually much higher during peak season.
examples.zh: 在旺季期間，飯店房價通常高出許多。

examples.en: The athlete was in peak physical condition for the competition.
examples.zh: 這位運動員處於比賽的最佳體能狀態。

examples.en: They work extra hours to handle the peak demand.
examples.zh: 他們加班以應付尖峰時期的需求。

examples.en: Tourist numbers usually peak during the summer holiday months.
examples.zh: 觀光客人數通常在暑假月份達到高峰。

examples.en: Her career peaked after she won the national competition.
examples.zh: 在贏得全國比賽後，她的事業達到了巔峰。

examples.en: Temperatures will peak at thirty degrees Celsius this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午氣溫將達到攝氏三十度的高溫。

examples.en: She washed a crisp sweet pear to eat for snack.
examples.zh: 她洗了一顆爽脆甜美的梨子當點心吃。

examples.en: The pear tree in our backyard produces juicy fruit every year.
examples.zh: 我們後院的梨樹每年都結出多汁的果實。

examples.en: He sliced the fresh pear into thin pieces for salad.
examples.zh: 他把新鮮梨子切成薄片做沙拉。

examples.en: Please sign your name with a blue pen on this form.
examples.zh: 請用藍色原子筆在這張表格上簽名。

examples.en: He always keeps a black pen in his front pocket.
examples.zh: 他總是把一支黑筆放在前面的口袋裡。

examples.en: Can I borrow a pen to write down the phone number?
examples.zh: 我可以借一支筆記下電話號碼嗎？

examples.en: The reporter penned a great article about the local festival.
examples.zh: 那位記者寫了一篇關於在地節慶的好文章。

examples.en: She penned a warm thank-you letter to her old teacher.
examples.zh: 她給以前的老師寫了一封溫馨的感謝信。

examples.en: He spent hours penning a poem for his mother's birthday.
examples.zh: 他花了幾個小時為母親的生日寫詩。

examples.en: Use a pencil so you can erase any mistakes easily.
examples.zh: 使用鉛筆，這樣你才能輕鬆擦掉任何錯誤。

examples.en: He sharpened his pencil before starting the math exam.
examples.zh: 他在開始數學考試前削好了鉛筆。

examples.en: She drew a beautiful portrait of her cat using a pencil.
examples.zh: 她用鉛筆畫了一幅她家貓咪的美麗肖像。

examples.en: Many people attended the outdoor concert in the public park.
examples.zh: 許多人參加了公共公園裡的戶外演唱會。

examples.en: Taiwanese people are famous for their kindness and genuine hospitality.
examples.zh: 台灣人民以友善與真誠的款待而聞名。

examples.en: Young people today face various economic and career planning choices.
examples.zh: 當今的年輕人面臨著各種經濟與職涯規劃的選擇。

examples.en: The car was traveling at sixty kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 這輛車以每小時六十公里的速度行駛。

examples.en: Tickets cost fifty US dollars per person for the event.
examples.zh: 該活動的入場券每人費用為五十美元。

examples.en: You should drink at least two liters of water per day.
examples.zh: 你每天應該喝至少兩公升的水。

examples.en: The sunny mild weather was perfect for our weekend beach picnic.
examples.zh: 晴朗溫和的天氣對於我們週末的海灘野餐來說是完美的。

examples.en: She earned a perfect score on the difficult national math contest.
examples.zh: 她在這場難度高的全國數學競賽中獲得了滿分。

examples.en: This quiet cafe provides a perfect environment for reading books.
examples.zh: 這間安靜的咖啡館為閱讀書籍提供了極好的環境。

examples.en: He practiced daily to perfect his pronunciation for his English presentation.
examples.zh: 他每天練習，好讓自己的英文簡報發音更完美。

examples.en: The baker spent years perfecting her signature chocolate cake recipe.
examples.zh: 這位烘焙師花了多年時間使她招牌巧克力蛋糕食譜趨於完美。

examples.en: Engineers are working hard to perfect the software user interface.
examples.zh: 工程師們正努力完善該軟體的使用者介面。

examples.en: Perhaps we should stay inside until the rain stops.
examples.zh: 也許我們應該待在室內直到雨停止。

examples.en: She is late; perhaps she missed her morning train.
examples.zh: 她遲到了；也許她錯過了早班火車。

examples.en: This is perhaps the best meal I have ever eaten.
examples.zh: 這也許是我吃過最美味的一餐。

examples.en: The museum displays artwork from the early Qing period.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了清朝早期的藝術作品。

examples.en: Our English class takes place during the second period every Monday.
examples.zh: 我們的英文課在每週一的第二節課進行。

examples.en: Remember to place a period at the end of every sentence.
examples.zh: 記得在每個句子末尾放上一個句點。

examples.en: Only one person is allowed to enter the room at a time.
examples.zh: 一次只允許一個人進入房間。

examples.en: She is the most generous person I have ever met in life.
examples.zh: 她是我一生中遇過最慷慨的人。

examples.en: Please contact the person in charge if you have any further questions.
examples.zh: 如果您有任何其他問題，請聯絡負責人。

examples.en: Please keep your personal belongings in a safe place at all times.
examples.zh: 請始終將您的個人物品放在安全的地方。

examples.en: He refused to answer any questions regarding his personal life.
examples.zh: 他拒絕回答任何關於他私人生活的提問。

examples.en: The famous singer made a personal appearance at the charity concert.
examples.zh: 這位知名歌手親自出席了這場慈善音樂會。

examples.en: She has an outgoing personality and makes friends very easily.
examples.zh: 她性格外向，非常容易交朋友。

examples.en: Each of the twins has a completely different personality.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎中的每一個都有著截然不同的個性。

examples.en: Several famous television personalities attended the red carpet event.
examples.zh: 幾位著名的電視名人出席了這場紅毯盛會。

examples.en: Taking care of a pet requires patience and love.
examples.zh: 照顧寵物需要耐心與愛心。

examples.en: Many families adopt pets from the local animal shelter.
examples.zh: 許多家庭從當地的動物收容所領養寵物。

examples.en: My brother wants to get a fish as his first pet.
examples.zh: 我弟弟想買一條魚作為他的第一隻寵物。

examples.en: The child reached out to pet the friendly cat.
examples.zh: 小孩伸出手去撫摸那隻友善的貓。

examples.en: Always wash your hands after you pet stray animals.
examples.zh: 撫摸流浪動物後一定要洗手。

examples.en: She likes to pet her rabbit while watching television.
examples.zh: 她喜歡看電視時撫摸她的兔子。

examples.en: She took a beautiful photograph of the colorful sunset over the ocean.
examples.zh: 她拍攝了一張海洋上色彩繽紛的日落美麗照片。

examples.en: My grandfather keeps an old family photograph in his wallet at all times.
examples.zh: 我祖父皮夾裡時刻保留著一張舊的家族相片。

examples.en: This framed photograph reminds me of our unforgettable high school trip.
examples.zh: 這張框好的照片讓我想起我們難忘的高中旅行。

examples.en: Professional photographers were invited to photograph the historic wedding event.
examples.zh: 專業攝影師獲邀為這場歷史性的婚禮活動拍照。

examples.en: Visitors are not allowed to photograph the paintings in this museum.
examples.zh: 參觀者不得拍攝這間博物館裡的畫作。

examples.en: She loves to photograph wild flowers during her mountain hiking trips.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在登山健行期間拍攝野花。

examples.en: Learn one useful English phrase every day to improve your speaking.
examples.zh: 每天學一個實用的英文片語來提升口說能力。

examples.en: The prepositional phrase acts as an adjective in this sentence.
examples.zh: 介系詞片語在這句話中充當形容詞。

examples.en: He used a catchy phrase in his popular television commercial.
examples.zh: 他在熱門的電視廣告中使用了一句朗朗上口的標語。

examples.en: You should phrase your complaint politely to avoid unnecessary conflict.
examples.zh: 你應該禮貌地措辭你的抱怨以避免不必要的衝突。

examples.en: The writer phrased his opinions carefully in the news article.
examples.zh: 作者在新聞文章中仔細地表達了他的觀點。

examples.en: How would you phrase this concept in simple words?
examples.zh: 你會如何用簡單的字眼表達這個概念？

examples.en: She practices playing the piano for two hours every evening.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上練習彈鋼琴兩個小時。

examples.en: My father bought a beautiful grand piano for our living room.
examples.zh: 我父親為我們的客廳買了一架美麗的平台鋼琴。

examples.en: He sat at the piano and played a gentle song.
examples.zh: 他坐在鋼琴前，彈奏了一首溫柔的歌曲。

examples.en: She needs to pick a new gift for her friend.
examples.zh: 她需要為她的朋友挑選一份新禮物。

examples.en: The kids love to pick sweet strawberries on the farm.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在農場採摘甜美的草莓。

examples.en: Please pick up the trash on the classroom floor.
examples.zh: 請撿起教室地面上的垃圾。

examples.en: You can take your pick from these colorful apples.
examples.zh: 你可以從這些色彩鮮豔的蘋果中任選。

examples.en: This restaurant is my first pick for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳是我今晚晚餐的首選。

examples.en: The coach made his pick for the team captain.
examples.zh: 教練挑選出了隊長的人選。

examples.en: We had a wonderful picnic by the lake last Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們上星期天在湖邊進行了一次美好的野餐。

examples.en: Pack some sandwiches and fruit for our family picnic.
examples.zh: 為我們的家庭野餐準備一些三明治和水果吧。

examples.en: The rain ruined our plans for an afternoon picnic.
examples.zh: 這場雨破壞了我們下午野餐的計畫。

examples.en: Many families picnic in this park during the spring.
examples.zh: 春天時許多家庭會在這座公園野餐。

examples.en: We decided to picnic near the river this coming weekend.
examples.zh: 我們決定這個週末去河邊野餐。

examples.en: They love to picnic whenever the weather is warm and sunny.
examples.zh: 每當天氣溫暖晴朗時，他們就喜歡去野餐。

examples.en: Can you take a picture of us in front of the waterfall?
examples.zh: 你能幫我們在瀑布前拍張照片嗎？

examples.en: There is a beautiful picture hanging on the living room wall.
examples.zh: 客廳牆上掛著一張美麗的畫作。

examples.en: The article includes a clear picture of the new product.
examples.zh: 這篇文章包含了該新產品的清晰圖片。

examples.en: It is hard to picture what the town looked like fifty years ago.
examples.zh: 很難想像這座城鎮五十年前是什麼樣子。

examples.en: The novel vividly pictures life in the mountain village.
examples.zh: 這本小說生動地描繪了山村的生活。

examples.en: I can easily picture her becoming a successful doctor.
examples.zh: 我很輕易能想像她成為一名成功的醫生。

examples.en: My grandmother baked a fresh apple pie for dessert.
examples.zh: 我的祖母烤了一個新鮮的蘋果派當甜點。

examples.en: Would you like another slice of pumpkin pie?
examples.zh: 你想再來一片南瓜派嗎？

examples.en: The warm chicken pot pie smells delicious in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房裡溫熱的雞肉派聞起來很香。

examples.en: Would you like a piece of chocolate cake with your coffee?
examples.zh: 你想要一塊巧克力蛋糕配咖啡嗎？

examples.en: He wrote his phone number on a piece of paper for me.
examples.zh: 他在一張紙上寫下他的電話號碼給我。

examples.en: This valuable piece of art was created in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 這件珍貴的藝術品創作於十九世紀。

examples.en: The little pig rolled around in the mud.
examples.zh: 那隻小豬在泥巴裡滾來滾去。

examples.en: The farmer feeds his pigs every morning.
examples.zh: 農夫每天早晨餵他的豬。

examples.en: We saw three pigs at the farm.
examples.zh: 我們在農場看到了三隻豬。

examples.en: She rested her head on a soft feather pillow and fell asleep.
examples.zh: 她把頭靠在柔軟的羽絨枕頭上睡著了。

examples.en: I need an extra pillow to feel comfortable in this hotel bed.
examples.zh: 我需要多一個枕頭，睡在這張飯店的床上才會舒服。

examples.en: The children had a noisy pillow fight in the bedroom.
examples.zh: 孩子們在臥室裡玩了一場吵鬧的枕頭大戰。

examples.en: She used a sharp pin to attach the paper note.
examples.zh: 她用了一根尖銳的大頭針把紙條固定住。

examples.en: My mother gave me a beautiful silver pin as a present.
examples.zh: 我媽媽給了我一枚漂亮的銀色胸針作為禮物。

examples.en: She used a small pin to hold the hem of her skirt.
examples.zh: 她用一根小別針固定住裙子的下襬。

examples.en: He pinned the colorful map on the bedroom wall yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天把這張色彩鮮豔的地圖釘在臥室牆上。

examples.en: The wrestler pinned his opponent down to win the match.
examples.zh: 摔角手壓制住對手以贏得比賽。

examples.en: She pinned her long hair up before starting to cook.
examples.zh: 開始做飯前，她把長髮固定起來。

examples.en: She bought a cute pink jacket to wear to the birthday party.
examples.zh: 她買了一件可愛的粉紅色外套穿去參加生日派對。

examples.en: The cherry blossom trees were covered with delicate pink flowers in spring.
examples.zh: 春天時，櫻花樹上盛開著纖細的粉紅色花朵。

examples.en: He gave his girlfriend a big bouquet of pink roses on Valentine's Day.
examples.zh: 他在西洋情人節送給女朋友一大束粉紅色玫瑰花。

examples.en: Pink is my younger sister's favorite color for her bedroom decor.
examples.zh: 粉紅色是我妹妹最喜歡的臥室裝潢顏色。

examples.en: She painted her fingernails in a light shade of pink.
examples.zh: 她把指甲塗成了淺粉紅色。

examples.en: The sky turned a beautiful mix of orange and pink during sunset.
examples.zh: 日落時，天空轉變成一片橘粉交織的美麗景致。

examples.en: Water leaked from the broken pipe under the kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 水從廚房水槽下方破損的水管漏了出來。

examples.en: The old man sat in his rocking chair and smoked a wooden pipe.
examples.zh: 那位老爺爺坐在搖椅上抽著木製菸斗。

examples.en: Workers installed metal pipes underground to carry natural gas.
examples.zh: 工人在地下安裝金屬管道以輸送天然氣。

examples.en: We ordered a large pepperoni pizza for our family movie night on Friday.
examples.zh: 我們在週五的家庭電影之夜點了一份大號的義式香腸披薩。

examples.en: The crispy crust is what makes this Italian pizza so remarkably delicious.
examples.zh: 酥脆的餅皮正是讓這款義大利披薩如此美味的原因。

examples.en: How many slices of hot pizza can you eat for lunch today?
examples.zh: 你今天午餐能吃幾片熱騰騰的披薩？

examples.en: This park is a wonderful place for an afternoon walk.
examples.zh: 這座公園是下午散步的好地方。

examples.en: Please put the books back in their proper place.
examples.zh: 請把書放回適當的位置。

examples.en: He won first place in the national speech contest.
examples.zh: 他在全國演講比賽中獲得了第一名。

examples.en: She placed the vase of flowers in the center of the table.
examples.zh: 她把花瓶擺放在桌子的中央。

examples.en: He placed his order with the waiter at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 他在餐廳向服務生點餐。

examples.en: Please place all garbage into the proper recycling bins.
examples.zh: 請將所有垃圾放入適當的回收桶內。

examples.en: She prefers wearing a plain white T-shirt on weekends.
examples.zh: 她週末喜歡穿一件樸素的白色 T 恤。

examples.en: He explained the complex idea in plain English.
examples.zh: 他用簡單明白的英文解釋了這個複雜的想法。

examples.en: We ordered plain white rice to go with the spicy dishes.
examples.zh: 我們點了白飯配辣味菜餚。

examples.en: Cattle were grazing peacefully on the vast green plain.
examples.zh: 牛隻悠閒地在廣闊的綠色平原上吃草。

examples.en: The train traveled fast across the flat open plain.
examples.zh: 火車快速穿過平坦開闊的平原。

examples.en: Floods often affect the villages scattered around this low plain.
examples.zh: 洪水經常影響散布在這個低窪平原上的村莊。

examples.en: We need to make a detailed plan for our upcoming summer vacation.
examples.zh: 我們需要為即將到來的暑假制定一個詳細的計畫。

examples.en: The architect showed us the floor plan for the new house.
examples.zh: 建築師向我們展示了新房屋的平面圖。

examples.en: If Plan A does not work, we can always switch to Plan B.
examples.zh: 如果 A 計畫不行，我們隨時可以切換到 B 計畫。

examples.en: Our family plans to visit our grandparents in Kaohsiung next weekend.
examples.zh: 我們全家打算下週末去高雄看望祖父母。

examples.en: She is planning a surprise birthday party for her best friend.
examples.zh: 她正在為她最好的朋友籌劃一個驚喜生日派對。

examples.en: They planned their budget carefully before buying a new car.
examples.zh: 他們在買新車前仔細地規劃了預算。

examples.en: Earth is the third planet from the sun in the solar system.
examples.zh: 地球是太陽系中距離太陽第三近的行星。

examples.en: Scientists are exploring whether other planets can support life.
examples.zh: 科學家正探索其他行星是否能夠維持生命的存在。

examples.en: We must protect our planet by reducing plastic waste every day.
examples.zh: 我們必須透過每天減少塑膠廢棄物來保護我們的地球。

examples.en: Water this green plant twice a week to keep it healthy.
examples.zh: 每週給這株綠色植物澆水兩次以保持健康。

examples.en: They built a large power plant near the coastal area.
examples.zh: 他們在沿海地區附近建造了一座大型發電廠。

examples.en: She placed a small indoor plant on her office desk.
examples.zh: 她在辦公桌上放了一株小型的室內植物。

examples.en: We plan to plant some colorful flowers in the garden.
examples.zh: 我們計劃在花園裡種植一些五彩繽紛的花朵。

examples.en: Farmers plant rice seeds in the muddy fields every spring.
examples.zh: 農夫們每年春天在泥濘的田裡播種水稻。

examples.en: Students planted trees around the school campus on Earth Day.
examples.zh: 學生們在地球日那天在學校校園周圍種樹。

examples.en: Please put the fresh fruit on the ceramic plate.
examples.zh: 請把新鮮水果放在陶瓷盤子上。

examples.en: He accidentally dropped a plate and it broke into pieces.
examples.zh: 他不小心摔落一個盤子，破成了碎片。

examples.en: She piled her plate high with delicious fried noodles.
examples.zh: 她在盤子裡堆滿了美味的炒麵。

examples.en: Passengers waited on the crowded train platform for their train.
examples.zh: 乘客們在擁擠的火車月台上等待列車。

examples.en: The online educational platform offers free video lectures to students.
examples.zh: 這個線上教育平台為學生提供免費的影片講座。

examples.en: The speaker stepped onto the wooden platform to address the crowd.
examples.zh: 演講者登上木製講台向人群發表演說。

examples.en: The children love to play in the park every afternoon.
examples.zh: 孩子們每天下午都喜歡在公園玩耍。

examples.en: My brother is learning how to play the guitar on weekends.
examples.zh: 我哥哥週末正在學習如何彈吉他。

examples.en: Our team will play against the national champions tomorrow afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們隊伍明天下午將與全國冠軍隊對決。

senses.zh: 玩耍；打（球）；彈奏（樂器）；播放

examples.en: Our drama club will perform a Shakespeare play on stage tonight.
examples.zh: 我們的戲劇社今晚將在舞台上演出莎士比亞的劇作。

examples.en: We bought balcony tickets to see a popular musical play downtown.
examples.zh: 我們買了樓座票，要去市中心看一部熱門的音樂劇。

examples.en: She wrote a short play for the annual school cultural festival.
examples.zh: 她為一年一度的校園文化節寫了一部短劇。

examples.en: He is a professional basketball player in the national league.
examples.zh: 他是國家聯賽的專業籃球運動員。

examples.en: Each player receives seven cards at the start of the game.
examples.zh: 遊戲開始時，每位玩家會收到七張牌。

examples.en: We bought a new music player to listen to CDs.
examples.zh: 我們買了一台新的音樂播放器來聽 CD。

examples.en: Children were happily playing on swings at the neighborhood playground.
examples.zh: 孩子們正在社區遊樂場高興地玩鞦韆。

examples.en: The primary school built a safe new playground for students.
examples.zh: 這所小學為學生建造了一個安全的新遊樂場。

examples.en: Parents sat on park benches watching kids in the playground.
examples.zh: 父母坐在公園長椅上看著遊樂場裡的孩子們。

examples.en: We had a pleasant afternoon in the quiet park.
examples.zh: 我們在安靜的公園度過了一個愉快的下午。

examples.en: Her pleasant voice made everyone feel very relaxed.
examples.zh: 她宜人的聲音讓每個人感到非常放鬆。

examples.en: The spring weather is mild and very pleasant.
examples.zh: 春天的天氣溫和且非常宜人。

examples.en: Please close the door when you leave.
examples.zh: 離開時請關門。

examples.en: Could you please pass me the salt?
examples.zh: 請你把鹽遞給我好嗎？

examples.en: Please speak a bit slower for me.
examples.zh: 請說得稍微慢一點好嗎？

examples.en: It is hard to please everyone all the time.
examples.zh: 要一直讓每個人滿意是很困難的。

examples.en: The student worked hard to please her parents.
examples.zh: 那名學生努力學習以讓父母高興。

examples.en: The good news pleased the entire team.
examples.zh: 這個好消息讓整個團隊都很高興。

examples.en: Reading books brings immense pleasure to her quiet weekend afternoons.
examples.zh: 閱讀書籍給她平靜的週末下午帶來極大的樂趣。

examples.en: It is a great pleasure to work with your professional team.
examples.zh: 與您的專業團隊合作是一件非常榮幸的事。

examples.en: He takes much pleasure in cooking delicious food for friends.
examples.zh: 他非常享受為朋友烹煮美味食物的樂趣。

examples.en: In our math class, we learned that two plus three equals five.
examples.zh: 在我們的數學課上，我們學到二加三等於五。

examples.en: The total cost is fifty dollars plus a five-dollar shipping fee.
examples.zh: 總費用是五十美元加上五美元的運費。

examples.en: She brings intelligence plus years of practical experience to the team.
examples.zh: 她為團隊帶來了智慧加上多年的實務經驗。

examples.en: Good communication skills are a definite plus factor for this job.
examples.zh: 良好的溝通技巧對於這份工作而言絕對是一個加分因素。

examples.en: The temperature dropped to plus two degrees Celsius last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚氣溫降到零上兩度。

examples.en: Speaking Japanese is a plus point when you apply for this job.
examples.zh: 會說日語對應徵這份工作而言是個加分點。

examples.en: The teacher drew a clear plus sign on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一個清晰的加號。

examples.en: Living near an MRT station is a major plus for city residents.
examples.zh: 住在捷運站附近對城市居民而言是一個主要的好處。

examples.en: Each additional language skill is a big plus on your resume.
examples.zh: 每多一項語言能力，都是你履歷上的一大加分。

examples.en: The train is scheduled to arrive at four pm.
examples.zh: 火車預計在下午四點抵達。

examples.en: Our store closes at nine pm every evening.
examples.zh: 我們的店家每天晚上九點打烊。

examples.en: The meeting will start promptly at two pm tomorrow.
examples.zh: 會議將於明天下午兩點準時開始。

examples.en: He put his hands into his coat pocket to keep warm.
examples.zh: 他把手伸進外套口袋裡取暖。

examples.en: I found some loose coins in my jacket pocket this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上在我的夾克口袋裡發現了一些硬幣。

examples.en: She pulled out her smartphone from her back jeans pocket quickly.
examples.zh: 她快速地從牛仔褲後口袋掏出了智慧型手機。

examples.en: The student wrote a beautiful poem about nature for English class.
examples.zh: 這位學生為英文課寫了一首關於大自然的美麗詩歌。

examples.en: She recited a famous love poem during the school literature festival.
examples.zh: 她在學校文學節期間朗誦了一首著名的情詩。

examples.en: Reading a short calm poem before bed helps him relax deeply.
examples.zh: 睡前讀一首短小平靜的詩有助於他深度放鬆。

examples.en: The famous poet wrote beautiful verses inspired by quiet nature scenes.
examples.zh: 這位著名的詩人受到寧靜自然美景的啟發，寫下了美麗的詩句。

examples.en: Students analyzed a poem written by a famous nineteenth-century poet.
examples.zh: 學生們分析了一位十九世紀知名詩人所寫的詩。

examples.en: She dreams of becoming a professional poet after graduating from university.
examples.zh: 她夢想在大學畢業後成為一名專業詩人。

examples.en: She enjoys reading modern English poetry during her free time.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在空閒時間閱讀現代英文詩歌。

examples.en: The student wrote a beautiful piece of poetry about nature.
examples.zh: 這名學生寫了一首關於大自然的美麗詩歌。

examples.en: Poetry allows writers to express deep human emotions creatively.
examples.zh: 詩歌讓創作者能以創意表達人類深層的情感。

examples.en: She made a very good point during the group discussion.
examples.zh: 她在小組討論中提出了一個非常好的觀點。

examples.en: Our basketball team won the game by only one point.
examples.zh: 我們的籃球隊僅以一分之差贏得了比賽。

examples.en: The sharp point of the pencil broke off while writing.
examples.zh: 鉛筆尖銳的筆尖在書寫時斷掉了。

examples.en: The guide pointed at the mountain top in the distance.
examples.zh: 導遊指向遠處的山頂。

examples.en: Please do not point your finger directly at other people.
examples.zh: 請不要用手指直接比著別人。

examples.en: The sign points toward the entrance of the museum building.
examples.zh: 這個標誌指向博物館建築的入口。

examples.en: The bottle contains chemical poison and should be handled carefully.
examples.zh: 這個瓶子裝有化學毒藥，應該小心處理。

examples.en: Scientists identified the poison used in the lab accident.
examples.zh: 科學家確認了實驗室意外中使用的毒物。

examples.en: Farmers use poison to keep pests away from crops.
examples.zh: 農夫使用毒藥來防範害蟲靠近農作物。

examples.en: Toxic factory waste will poison the local river water.
examples.zh: 有毒的工廠廢棄物會污染當地的河水。

examples.en: Negative thoughts can poison your mind and make you unhappy.
examples.zh: 負面想法會毒害你的心靈，讓你感到不快樂。

examples.en: Careless disposal of trash can poison the natural soil.
examples.zh: 隨意丟棄垃圾可能會毒害天然土壤。

examples.en: Call the police immediately if you notice any suspicious activity outside.
examples.zh: 如果你注意到外面有任何可疑活動，請立即報警。

examples.en: The police are investigating the cause of the traffic accident.
examples.zh: 警方正在調查這起交通事故的原因。

examples.en: Two police officers walked around the neighborhood to maintain safety.
examples.zh: 兩名警察在社區附近巡邏以維持安全。

examples.en: The friendly policeman helped the lost child find her parents.
examples.zh: 這位親切的警察幫助失蹤的小孩找到了父母。

examples.en: A policeman directed traffic at a busy street intersection safely.
examples.zh: 一名警察在繁忙的街口安全地指揮交通。

examples.en: The alert policeman blew his whistle to stop the speeding motorcycle.
examples.zh: 機警的警察吹哨攔下了那輛超速的機車。

examples.en: The company updated its return policy for all online orders.
examples.zh: 這家公司更新了所有線上訂單的退貨政策。

examples.en: The government introduced a new policy to reduce plastic pollution.
examples.zh: 政府推出了一項新政策以減少塑膠污染。

examples.en: She bought a travel insurance policy before heading overseas.
examples.zh: 她在前往海外之前購買了一份旅遊保險單。

examples.en: It is polite to say thank you when receiving help.
examples.zh: 收到幫助時說謝謝是有禮貌的。

examples.en: The polite young man offered his seat to the elderly lady.
examples.zh: 那位有禮貌的年輕人將座位讓給了老婦人。

examples.en: She gave a polite smile to the visitor.
examples.zh: 她對訪客露出禮貌的微笑。

examples.en: There are several colorful fish swimming in the pond.
examples.zh: 池塘裡有好幾條色彩斑斕的魚在游動。

examples.en: The children built a toy boat and floated it on the pond.
examples.zh: 孩子們做了一艘玩具船並讓它浮在池塘上。

examples.en: Frogs start croaking loudly near the pond at night.
examples.zh: 夜晚時，青蛙開始在池塘附近大聲鳴叫。

examples.en: The children love swimming in the outdoor pool during summer.
examples.zh: 孩子們夏天喜歡在戶外游泳池游泳。

examples.en: Rain created a large pool of water on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 降雨在人行道上形成了大型水坑。

examples.en: We played a game of pool after dinner at the club.
examples.zh: 晚餐後我們在俱樂部打了一局撞球。

examples.en: The charity collects money to help poor families in the area.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構籌集資金來幫助當地的貧困家庭。

examples.en: The poor cat was lost in the storm all night.
examples.zh: 那隻可憐的貓整晚都在暴風雨中迷路。

examples.en: His exam results were poor due to a lack of preparation.
examples.zh: 由於缺乏準備，他的考試成績很差。

examples.en: The red balloon popped with a loud sound at the party.
examples.zh: 紅氣球在派對上發出砰的一聲破裂了。

examples.en: An interesting idea suddenly popped into my head yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我腦海中突然浮現出一個有趣的點子。

examples.en: I need to pop into the grocery store for fresh milk.
examples.zh: 我需要快速順道去雜貨店買新鮮牛奶。

examples.en: She loves listening to Taiwanese pop music during her free time.
examples.zh: 她空閒時間喜歡聽台灣流行音樂。

examples.en: Pop culture influences young people's fashion and speech trends.
examples.zh: 流行文化影響著年輕人的時尚與用語潮流。

examples.en: He bought tickets for the pop star's world concert tour.
examples.zh: 他買了這位流行巨星世界巡迴音樂會的門票。

examples.en: Classical music and pop are two very different musical genres.
examples.zh: 古典音樂和流行音樂是兩種非常不同的音樂流派。

examples.en: We heard a loud pop coming from the kitchen microwave.
examples.zh: 我們聽到廚房微波爐發出一聲巨響。

examples.en: He opened a cold can of pop on a hot summer afternoon.
examples.zh: 他在炎熱的夏日午後打開了一罐冰涼的汽水。

examples.en: We bought a large bucket of popcorn at the cinema.
examples.zh: 我們在電影院買了一大桶爆米花。

examples.en: The smell of fresh popcorn filled the living room.
examples.zh: 新鮮爆米花的香味彌漫了客廳。

examples.en: I like salty popcorn more than sweet popcorn.
examples.zh: 我喜歡鹹爆米花勝過甜爆米花。

examples.en: This local bakery is very popular for its fresh strawberry cakes.
examples.zh: 這家在地烘焙坊因其新鮮草莓蛋糕而非常受歡迎。

examples.en: K-pop music has become extremely popular among teenagers worldwide.
examples.zh: 韓國流行音樂在全世界青少年之間變得極受歡迎。

examples.en: Basketball is one of the most popular sports in Taiwan today.
examples.zh: 籃球是現今台灣最受歡迎的運動之一。

examples.en: The total population of this city is growing rapidly.
examples.zh: 這個城市的總人口正在快速增長。

examples.en: Nearly half the population lives near the coastal area.
examples.zh: 近一半的人口住在海岸附近地區。

examples.en: Scientists studied the wild animal population in the forest.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了森林裡野生動物的數量。

examples.en: My grandmother cooked delicious pork soup for our family dinner.
examples.zh: 我祖母為我們的家庭晚餐煮了美味的豬肉湯。

examples.en: Fresh pork and fresh vegetables are common ingredients in local dishes.
examples.zh: 新鮮豬肉和新鮮蔬菜是在地料理的常見食材。

examples.en: He ordered grilled pork chops with roasted potatoes at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 他在餐廳點了烤豬排佐烤馬鈴薯。

examples.en: The cargo ship entered the busy port early this morning.
examples.zh: 這艘貨輪今天一大早就進入了繁忙的港口。

examples.en: Kaohsiung is a major international port city in Southern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 高雄是台灣南部主要的國際港口城市。

examples.en: Plug the USB cable into the port on the side of the laptop.
examples.zh: 把 USB 傳輸線插進筆電側邊的連接埠。

examples.en: The models stood together to pose for the fashion magazine photographer.
examples.zh: 模特兒們站在一起，為時尚雜誌攝影師擺姿勢。

examples.en: Heavy pollution can pose a serious threat to public health.
examples.zh: 嚴重的污染可能對公眾健康造成嚴重威脅。

examples.en: The student raised his hand to pose a difficult question to the teacher.
examples.zh: 學生舉手向老師提出了一個困難的問題。

senses.zh: 擺姿勢；提出（問題）；造成（威脅）

examples.en: Hold that standing pose for three seconds while I take a picture.
examples.zh: 在我拍照時，保持那個站立姿勢三秒鐘。

examples.en: Yoga practice involves holding various physical poses to build flexibility.
examples.zh: 瑜伽練習包含保持各種身體姿態來建立靈活性。

examples.en: She adopted a confident pose in front of the camera lens.
examples.zh: 她在鏡頭面前展現出自信的姿態。

examples.en: She checked her current position on the map app.
examples.zh: 她在地圖應用程式上確認了自己目前的位置。

examples.en: He applied for a sales manager position at the company.
examples.zh: 他應徵了該公司的銷售經理職位。

examples.en: Sitting in a bad position for hours causes back pain.
examples.zh: 以不良姿勢坐著數小時會引起背痛。

examples.en: The workers positioned the heavy machinery carefully near the entrance.
examples.zh: 工人仔細地將重型機械放置在入口附近。

examples.en: She positioned the desk next to the window for better natural light.
examples.zh: 她把書桌安置在窗戶旁邊以獲得更好的自然光。

examples.en: The company positioned itself as a leader in eco-friendly technology.
examples.zh: 該公司將自身定位為環保科技領域的領導者。

examples.en: Maintaining a positive attitude helps overcome many difficult problems.
examples.zh: 保持積極的態度有助於克服許多困難的問題。

examples.en: We received positive feedback from our customers.
examples.zh: 我們收到了顧客正面的回饋。

examples.en: Are you positive that you locked the main door?
examples.zh: 你確信你已經鎖上大門了嗎？

examples.en: There is a high possibility of rain this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚有很大的下雨可能性。

examples.en: We are exploring every possibility to improve our product.
examples.zh: 我們正在探索改善我們產品的每一種可能性。

examples.en: Scientists are studying the possibility of life on other planets.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究其他星球存在生命的可能性。

examples.en: Is it possible to finish this project by Friday?
examples.zh: 在星期五之前完成這個專案有可能嗎？

examples.en: We explored every possible option before making a decision.
examples.zh: 我們在做決定前探索了每一個可能的選項。

examples.en: Please respond to my email as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 請儘快回覆我的電子郵件。

examples.en: Her latest online post about healthy eating received many likes.
examples.zh: 她最新的健康飲食線上貼文獲得了許多讚。

examples.en: The wooden post in the garden supports the heavy climbing plants.
examples.zh: 花園裡的木柱支撐著沈重的爬藤植物。

examples.en: He applied for a senior teaching post at the local university.
examples.zh: 他應徵了當地大學的一個資深教職。

examples.en: The school will post exam results on the main notice board.
examples.zh: 學校將把考試成績張貼在主公告欄上。

examples.en: She posted a short travel video on her personal blog.
examples.zh: 她在個人部落格上發布了一段旅遊短片。

examples.en: I need to post these documents to the head office today.
examples.zh: 我今天需要把這些文件郵寄給總公司。

examples.en: My friend sent me a colorful postcard from Paris.
examples.zh: 我的朋友從巴黎寄給我一張色彩繽紛的明信片。

examples.en: She collected many beautiful postcards during her trip.
examples.zh: 她在旅行期間收集了許多美麗的明信片。

examples.en: Don't forget to write your address on the postcard.
examples.zh: 別忘了在明信片上寫下你的地址。

examples.en: My mother put a large pot of water on the stove.
examples.zh: 我母親在爐火上放了一大鍋水。

examples.en: She planted a tiny red rose in a clay pot.
examples.zh: 她在泥土花盆裡種了一株小紅玫瑰。

examples.en: The soup was kept warm in a ceramic pot.
examples.zh: 湯在一隻陶瓷鍋子裡保持著溫熱。

examples.en: She washed and peeled the fresh potato to make vegetable soup.
examples.zh: 她洗淨並削去新鮮馬鈴薯的皮來煮蔬菜湯。

examples.en: French fries are made from sliced potato fried in hot oil.
examples.zh: 薯條是由切片馬鈴薯在熱油中炸製而成的。

examples.en: Mashed potato is a popular side dish served with roast chicken.
examples.zh: 馬鈴薯泥是搭配烤雞時很受歡迎的配菜。

examples.en: She bought two pounds of fresh apples from the local market.
examples.zh: 她從當地市場買了兩磅新鮮蘋果。

examples.en: The jacket cost fifty pounds when I bought it in London.
examples.zh: 這件外套我在倫敦購買時花了五十英鎊。

examples.en: He lost five pounds after running every morning for a month.
examples.zh: 每天早上跑步持續一個月後，他瘦了五磅。

examples.en: Waves continued to pound against the rocky cliffs during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，浪花持續拍打著岩石峭壁。

examples.en: His heart began to pound rapidly as he walked onto the stage.
examples.zh: 當他走上舞台時，他的心臟開始急速跳動。

examples.en: He used a hammer to pound the stake into the soft ground.
examples.zh: 他用鐵鎚把木樁打進鬆軟的地面。

examples.en: The sudden storm caused a complete power outage tonight.
examples.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨造成今晚完全停電。

examples.en: The engine generates enough power to drive the truck.
examples.zh: 這台引擎產生足夠的動力來驅動這輛卡車。

examples.en: The president has the power to sign new laws.
examples.zh: 總統擁有簽署新法律的權力。

examples.en: Solar panels power the green lighting system in the park.
examples.zh: 太陽能板為公園裡的綠能照明系統提供動力。

examples.en: Rechargeable batteries power this small portable music speaker.
examples.zh: 充電電池為這台小型便攜式音樂喇叭提供動力。

examples.en: Electricity powers most of our household devices.
examples.zh: 電力為我們大多數的家用設備提供動力。

examples.en: The sports car has a very powerful engine.
examples.zh: 這款跑車配備了一台非常強大的引擎。

examples.en: Her speech left a powerful impression on the audience.
examples.zh: 她的演講給聽眾留下了深刻強烈的印象。

examples.en: He is one of the most powerful leaders in business.
examples.zh: 他是商業領域中最有影響力的領袖之一。

senses.zh: 強大的；強烈的；有影響力的

examples.en: She practices playing the piano for two hours daily.
examples.zh: 她每天練習彈鋼琴兩個小時。

examples.en: You need to practice speaking English with native speakers.
examples.zh: 你需要多跟母語人士練習說英語。

examples.en: The doctor has practiced medicine in Taipei for ten years.
examples.zh: 這位醫師在台北行醫已有十年。

examples.en: Regular practice is essential for mastering any new skill.
examples.zh: 定期練習對於掌握任何新技能都至關重要。

examples.en: It is common practice to shake hands when meeting.
examples.zh: 見面時握手是一種常見的習慣做法。

examples.en: The dentist opened his own private practice last summer.
examples.zh: 那位牙醫師去年夏天開了自己的私人診所。

examples.en: The teacher praised the hardworking student for her excellent test results.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚那位勤奮的學生考出優異的成績。

examples.en: Many people praise the delicious food served at this restaurant.
examples.zh: 許多人讚揚這家餐廳提供的美味食物。

examples.en: The manager praised the team after completing the major project smoothly.
examples.zh: 經理在順利完成重大專案後讚揚了團隊。
