examples.en: Two kids were playing happily on the seesaw.
examples.zh: 兩個小孩在蹺蹺板上開心玩耍。

examples.en: The park added a new colorful seesaw recently.
examples.zh: 公園最近新增了一個色彩繽紛的新蹺蹺板。

examples.en: She sat on one end of the wooden seesaw.
examples.zh: 她坐在木製蹺蹺板的一端。

examples.en: Stock prices continued to seesaw throughout the week.
examples.zh: 股票價格整週持續上下搖擺。

examples.en: The game seesawed back and forth until the end.
examples.zh: 比賽交替變化、拉鋸直到結束。

examples.en: Temperatures tend to seesaw during late autumn months.
examples.zh: 氣溫在深秋月份傾向於交替變化。

examples.en: My grandfather seldom goes out during cold and windy winter days.
examples.zh: 我祖父在寒冷且颳風的冬日裡很少出門。

examples.en: She seldom eats fast food because she prefers healthy home cooking.
examples.zh: 她很少吃速食，因為她更喜歡健康的家常菜。

examples.en: We seldom watch television since we started using smartphones for news.
examples.zh: 自從我們開始使用智慧型手機看新聞後，我們就很少看電視了。

examples.en: Please select your preferred language from the screen list.
examples.zh: 請從螢幕清單中選擇你偏好的語言。

examples.en: Judges will select three winners from all the participants.
examples.zh: 評審將會從所有參賽者中挑選出三位獲勝者。

examples.en: She selected a dark blue dress for a formal dinner.
examples.zh: 她挑選了一件深藍色的洋裝參加正式晚餐。

examples.en: Only a select group of students joined the program.
examples.zh: 只有少數精選的學生參與了這個計畫。

examples.en: The luxury hotel offers select wines from local farms.
examples.zh: 這間奢華飯店供應來自在地農場的精選葡萄酒。

examples.en: He sells select handmade leather goods in his store.
examples.zh: 他在店裡販售精選的手工皮革製品。

examples.en: The bakery offers a wide selection of fresh delicious pastries.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店提供豐富選擇的新鮮美味糕點。

examples.en: The selection process for the scholarship was very competitive this year.
examples.zh: 今年獎學金的篩選過程競爭非常激烈。

examples.en: He read a selection of poems by his favorite author.
examples.zh: 他閱讀了他最喜歡作者的詩歌精選。

examples.en: She showed her true self after getting comfortable.
examples.zh: 在她感覺自在之後展現出了她真實的自我。

examples.en: Meditation can help you discover your inner self.
examples.zh: 冥想能幫助你發現內在的自己。

examples.en: He was back to his normal energetic self today.
examples.zh: 他今天回到了平時精力充沛的自己。

examples.en: It was selfish of him to take all the food.
examples.zh: 他拿走所有的食物真是太自私了。

examples.en: Don't be so selfish and share your toys with others.
examples.zh: 別這麼自私，跟其他人分享你的玩具。

examples.en: A selfish person rarely thinks about the feelings of others.
examples.zh: 自私的人很少考慮別人的感受。

examples.en: The local farmer decided to sell fresh organic vegetables at the market.
examples.zh: 當地農夫決定在市場上出售新鮮的有機蔬菜。

examples.en: This popular bookstore sells electronic devices as well as paper books.
examples.zh: 這家受歡迎的書店除了紙本書外，也販賣電子設備。

examples.en: They plan to sell their old family car before buying a new electric vehicle.
examples.zh: 他們計劃在買新電動車之前賣掉舊的家用車。

examples.en: I will send you an email with attached document later.
examples.zh: 我稍後會發送一封附有文件的電子郵件給你。

examples.en: She forgot to send a postcard to her parents yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天忘記寄明信片給她的父母了。

examples.en: The company decided to send three engineers to the site.
examples.zh: 公司決定派遣三位工程師到現場。

examples.en: Dogs have a very strong sense of smell.
examples.zh: 狗有非常強烈的嗅覺。

examples.en: I felt a sudden sense of relief after the exam.
examples.zh: 考試結束後我感到一股突然的放鬆感。

examples.en: Common sense is needed when solving daily problems.
examples.zh: 解決日常問題時需要常識。

examples.en: I can sense the danger in this dark street.
examples.zh: 我能感覺到這條黑暗街道上的危險。

examples.en: She sensed that something was wrong with her friend.
examples.zh: 她意識到她的朋友有些不對勁。

examples.en: Animals can often sense changes in the weather.
examples.zh: 動物常常能察覺天氣的變化。

examples.en: Her teeth are very sensitive to cold ice cream and drinks.
examples.zh: 她的牙齒對冰涼的冰淇淋和飲料非常敏感。

examples.en: He is a sensitive writer who understands human emotions deeply.
examples.zh: 他是一位感受敏銳、深刻理解人類情感的作家。

examples.en: This topic is politically sensitive, so we should avoid it.
examples.zh: 這個話題政治上很敏感，所以我們應該避免。

senses.zh: 敏感的；感受敏銳的；易受影響的

examples.en: Please write a complete sentence using the new vocabulary word.
examples.zh: 請用這個新單字寫出一個完整的句子。

examples.en: The teacher corrected the grammar errors in my English sentence.
examples.zh: 老師糾正了我英文句子中的語法錯誤。

examples.en: The judge announced a light sentence for the first crime.
examples.zh: 法官對這項初犯宣判了輕判。

examples.en: The court will sentence the criminal next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 法院將於下週二宣判這名罪犯。

examples.en: The judge decided to sentence him to community service.
examples.zh: 法官決定判他做社區服務。

examples.en: Courts sentence people who break the law.
examples.zh: 法院會對違法的人宣判刑罰。

examples.en: The two sisters sleep in separate bedrooms in their house.
examples.zh: 這對姊妹在家裡睡在不同的臥室。

examples.en: They decided to handle the tasks as two separate projects.
examples.zh: 他們決定把這些任務當作兩個獨立的專案來處理。

examples.en: Please keep raw meat separate from fresh vegetables when cooking.
examples.zh: 烹飪時請將生肉與新鮮蔬菜分開。

examples.en: A narrow river separates the peaceful village from the city.
examples.zh: 一條狹窄的河流將這個寧靜的村莊與城市分隔開來。

examples.en: Teachers had to separate the noisy boys in the classroom.
examples.zh: 老師不得不將教室裡吵鬧的男孩們分開。

examples.en: Oil and water will eventually separate into two distinct layers.
examples.zh: 油和水最終會分離成兩個不同的層次。

examples.en: The doctor had a serious expression while talking to the patient.
examples.zh: 醫生在與病人交談時表情嚴肅。

examples.en: Traffic accidents can cause serious damage to vehicles and people.
examples.zh: 交通事故會對車輛和人員造成嚴重損害。

examples.en: Are you really serious about starting your own new business?
examples.zh: 你對於開創自己的新事業真的是認真的嗎？

examples.en: The loyal servant served the royal family faithfully for over thirty years.
examples.zh: 這位忠誠的僕人忠實地服務王室超過三十年。

examples.en: In ancient times wealthy families hired many domestic servants for daily chores.
examples.zh: 在古代，富有家庭僱用許多家務用人處理日常雜務。

examples.en: The master gave his old servant a generous reward for long service.
examples.zh: 主人給了他的老僕人一筆豐厚的酬勞以感謝長年服務。

examples.en: The waiter served us hot tea as soon as we sat down.
examples.zh: 我們一坐下，服務生就給我們端上熱茶。

examples.en: This local restaurant serves delicious seafood dishes every evening.
examples.zh: 這間在地餐廳每天晚上提供美味的海鮮料理。

examples.en: He served in the army for two years after graduating from college.
examples.zh: 大學畢業後他在陸軍服役了兩年。

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for excellent customer service.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳以優秀的顧客服務而聞名。

examples.en: My car requires regular service every five thousand kilometers.
examples.zh: 我的車子每五千公里需要定期保養一次。

examples.en: Public bus service operates early in the morning here.
examples.zh: 這裡的公車服務在清晨就開始營運了。

examples.en: Mechanics service the air conditioning unit once a year.
examples.zh: 技師每年檢修一次空調設備。

examples.en: The technician arrived to service the broken elevator today.
examples.zh: 技術員今天抵達來維修故障的電梯。

examples.en: They service all company delivery trucks every six months.
examples.zh: 他們每六個月維護一次公司所有的送貨卡車。

examples.en: Please set the hot teacup carefully on the wooden table.
examples.zh: 請把熱茶杯小心放在木桌上。

examples.en: The sun sets in the west every evening.
examples.zh: 太陽每天傍晚在西方落下。

examples.en: Our teacher set clear rules for the classroom project.
examples.zh: 我們老師為課堂專題制定了明確的規則。

senses.zh: 放置；設定；制定；太陽落下

examples.en: My mother bought a new set of ceramic kitchenware yesterday.
examples.zh: 我媽媽昨天買了一套新的陶瓷廚具。

examples.en: He owns a complete set of encyclopedias in his study.
examples.zh: 他的書房裡有一整套百科全書。

examples.en: They bought a large television set for their living room.
examples.zh: 他們為客廳買了一台大電視機。

examples.en: The two neighbors managed to settle their garden boundary dispute peacefully.
examples.zh: 這兩位鄰居成功地和平解決了他們的花園邊界紛爭。

examples.en: After years of traveling, they decided to settle in a quiet town.
examples.zh: 多年的旅行之後，他們決定在一個寧靜的小鎮定居。

examples.en: Please settle your hotel bill at the front desk before departing.
examples.zh: 離開前請在櫃檯結清你的飯店帳單。

examples.en: I have visited that historical museum several times this year.
examples.zh: 我今年已經造訪過那間歷史博物館好幾次了。

examples.en: Several students volunteered to clean the classroom.
examples.zh: 有幾位學生自願打掃教室。

examples.en: There are several options available on the restaurant dinner menu.
examples.zh: 餐廳晚餐菜單上有好幾種選擇。

examples.en: Many people applied for the job, and several were invited to an interview.
examples.zh: 許多人應徵這份工作，其中有幾位受邀面試。

examples.en: Some apples were spoiled, but several were still fresh and crisp.
examples.zh: 有些蘋果壞了，但有幾個仍然新鮮爽脆。

examples.en: He bought many books, and several were about world history.
examples.zh: 他買了許多書，其中有幾本是關於世界歷史。

examples.en: Please indicate your legal sex on the application form.
examples.zh: 請在申請表上註明你的法定性別。

examples.en: The study examines differences between the sexes in education.
examples.zh: 這項研究檢視了教育中男女兩性之間的差異。

examples.en: Sex education is an important subject for teenagers.
examples.zh: 性教育對青少年來說是重要的課題。

examples.en: You should shake the juice bottle before opening it.
examples.zh: 開瓶前你應該先搖勻這瓶果汁。

examples.en: They shook hands after signing the new contract.
examples.zh: 簽署新合約後，他們握手致意。

examples.en: The scared dog was shaking in the cold rain.
examples.zh: 這隻受驚的狗在寒雨中發抖。

examples.en: Shall we go for a walk in the park?
examples.zh: 我們要在公園裡散散步嗎？

examples.en: I shall return all the borrowed books tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我明天早上會歸還所有借來的書。

examples.en: What shall we prepare for our dinner party tonight?
examples.zh: 我們今晚的晚餐派對應該準備些什麼？

examples.en: It is a great shame that you missed the party.
examples.zh: 你錯過了派對真是太遺憾了。

examples.en: He felt a deep sense of shame after lying to his parents.
examples.zh: 他在對父母撒謊後感到深深的羞恥。

examples.en: What a shame that the weather ruined our outdoor picnic.
examples.zh: 天氣毀了我們的戶外野餐，真是太可惜了。

examples.en: The birthday cake was baked in the shape of a star.
examples.zh: 生日蛋糕被烘焙成星形。

examples.en: He exercises every morning to stay in good physical shape.
examples.zh: 他每天早晨運動以保持良好的身體狀況。

examples.en: The old wooden dining table was still in great shape.
examples.zh: 這張舊木製餐桌狀況仍然維持得很好。

examples.en: The artist used soft clay to shape a small bird.
examples.zh: 藝術家使用軟黏土塑造成一隻小鳥。

examples.en: A good school environment helps shape a student's character.
examples.zh: 良好的學校環境有助於塑造學生的性格。

examples.en: Strong winds helped shape these amazing natural rock formations.
examples.zh: 強風有助於形成這些令人驚嘆的天然岩石構造。

examples.en: Children should learn to share their toys with friends.
examples.zh: 小孩應該學會與朋友分享玩具。

examples.en: Roommates usually share the monthly utility bills together.
examples.zh: 室友通常會一起分擔每月的電費雜費。

examples.en: The two companies agreed to share key research results.
examples.zh: 兩家公司同意共享關鍵研究成果。

examples.en: He bought one hundred shares of the technology company stock.
examples.zh: 他買了一百股該科技公司的股票。

examples.en: Everyone did their fair share of the group project work.
examples.zh: 每個人都完成了自己在小組專案中該負擔的一份工作。

examples.en: She inherited a substantial share of the family business.
examples.zh: 她繼承了家族企業相當大一部分的股份。

examples.en: A large shark was spotted swimming near the sunny beach.
examples.zh: 有人看見一隻大鯊魚在陽光明媚的海灘附近游動。

examples.en: The aquarium has a huge glass tunnel with swimming sharks.
examples.zh: 水族館有一個巨大且有鯊魚游動的玻璃隧道。

examples.en: Sharks have multiple rows of sharp teeth for hunting fish.
examples.zh: 鯊魚有許多排用來捕魚的鋒利牙齒。

examples.en: Be careful when using this sharp kitchen knife to cut fresh meat.
examples.zh: 使用這把鋒利的廚房刀切新鮮肉類時要小心。

examples.en: The experienced detective has a sharp mind for finding hidden clues.
examples.zh: 富經驗的偵探對於尋找隱藏線索有敏銳的頭腦。

examples.en: The sports car made a sharp turn on the dangerous mountain road.
examples.zh: 那輛跑車在危險的山路上做了急轉彎。

examples.en: The morning train leaves the central station at eight o'clock sharp.
examples.zh: 早班火車在八點整準時離開中央車站。

examples.en: Please ensure you arrive at the school auditorium at nine sharp today.
examples.zh: 請確保你今天九點準時到達學校大禮堂。

examples.en: The online registration system will open at midnight sharp tonight.
examples.zh: 線上報名系統今晚午夜整準時開放。

examples.en: She is a hardworking doctor who cares deeply about all her patients.
examples.zh: 她是一位工作努力且非常關心所有病人的醫生。

examples.en: After finishing her homework, she decided to walk her dog in the park.
examples.zh: 寫完作業後，她決定去公園遛狗。

examples.en: She enjoys reading historical novels in her spare time during the weekend.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在週末的空閒時間閱讀歷史小說。

examples.en: A flock of sheep was grazing quietly on the green hill.
examples.zh: 一群綿羊正在綠色丘陵上靜靜地吃草。

examples.en: Farmers shear the sheep every spring to collect wool.
examples.zh: 農夫每年春天給綿羊剪毛以收集羊毛。

examples.en: The little girl enjoyed feeding the gentle sheep on the farm.
examples.zh: 小女孩喜歡在農場裡餵食溫順的綿羊。

examples.en: She changed the sheet on the bed this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上換了床上的床單。

examples.en: Please write your name on a clean sheet of paper.
examples.zh: 請在一張乾淨的紙上寫下你的名字。

examples.en: The roof is made of thin metal sheets.
examples.zh: 屋頂是用薄金屬板製成的。

examples.en: Put the heavy books on the bottom shelf please.
examples.zh: 請把重書放在最底層的架子上。

examples.en: She organized all the spice bottles on the kitchen shelf.
examples.zh: 她把所有的香料瓶整齊排列在廚房架子上。

examples.en: The dust was wiped clean off the wooden shelf.
examples.zh: 木架子上的灰塵被擦拭乾淨了。

examples.en: Children collected colorful shells along the sandy beach.
examples.zh: 孩子們沿著沙灘收集五彩繽紛的貝殼。

examples.en: Turtles retreat inside their hard shell when feeling threatened.
examples.zh: 烏龜感到威脅時會縮進堅硬的殼裡。

examples.en: You need to crack the outer shell of the nut.
examples.zh: 你需要敲開堅果的外殼。

examples.en: The warm summer sun continues to shine brightly in the blue sky.
examples.zh: 溫暖的夏日陽光繼續在藍天中耀眼地照耀著。

examples.en: He uses a soft cloth to shine his formal leather shoes daily.
examples.zh: 他每天用軟布擦亮他的正裝皮鞋。

examples.en: Her talents truly shine when she plays classical music on the piano.
examples.zh: 當她在鋼琴上演奏古典音樂時，她的天賦真正展露無遺。

examples.en: The polished wooden floor had a beautiful natural shine in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 磨光的木地板在陽光下泛著美麗的自然光澤。

examples.en: This new conditioner adds a healthy shine to your dry hair after washing.
examples.zh: 這款新的潤髮乳能在洗髮後為乾燥的頭髮增添健康光澤。

examples.en: The natural shine of the silk fabric caught everyone's immediate attention.
examples.zh: 絲綢面料的自然光澤立刻吸引了所有人的注意。

examples.en: The large cargo ship arrived at the harbor early today.
examples.zh: 那艘大型貨船今天一大早抵達了港口。

examples.en: The captain guided the ship safely through the storm.
examples.zh: 船長引導輪船安全穿越暴風雨。

examples.en: We watched the ship sail slowly across the ocean horizon.
examples.zh: 我們看著輪船緩慢地航行過海洋地平線。

examples.en: The online store will ship your package tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 那家網路商店明天早上會寄送你的包裹。

examples.en: They ship fresh fruit to other countries by air freight.
examples.zh: 他們透過空運將新鮮水果運送到其他國家。

examples.en: It costs extra money to ship heavy goods overseas.
examples.zh: 將重型貨物寄送到海外需要額外花費。

examples.en: He ironed his white formal shirt before the job interview.
examples.zh: 他在工作面試前燙平了他的白色正式襯衫。

examples.en: She wore a comfortable casual shirt with blue jeans today.
examples.zh: 她今天穿著一件舒適的休閒上衣搭配藍色牛仔褲。

examples.en: Spilling coffee on a clean shirt ruined his whole morning.
examples.zh: 將咖啡灑在乾淨的襯衫上毀了整個早晨。

examples.en: The sudden news came as a great shock to everyone.
examples.zh: 這突然的消息對每個人來說都是極大的震驚。

examples.en: The injured hiker was treated for shock at the hospital.
examples.zh: 受傷的登山客在醫院接受了休克的治療。

examples.en: Be careful with that wire or you will get an electric shock.
examples.zh: 小心那根電線，否則你會遭到電擊。

examples.en: Her unexpected resignation shocked the entire office team.
examples.zh: 她意外的辭職讓整個辦公室團隊感到震驚。

examples.en: The high prices in the store shocked the shoppers.
examples.zh: 商店裡昂貴的價格讓購物者感到驚愕。

examples.en: The sad news shocked the whole class.
examples.zh: 這則令人難過的消息讓全班同學震驚。

examples.en: He bent down to tie the laces on his shoe.
examples.zh: 他彎下腰綁好鞋子上的鞋帶。

examples.en: She bought a pair of running shoes yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天買了一雙跑鞋。

examples.en: This left shoe feels a bit tight on my foot.
examples.zh: 這隻左鞋讓我的腳感覺有點緊。

examples.en: He practiced how to shoot free throws every afternoon.
examples.zh: 他每天下午練習如何投罰球。

examples.en: The director plans to shoot the new film in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 導演計劃在台灣拍攝這部新電影。

examples.en: Students at the archery club learn how to shoot arrows at targets.
examples.zh: 射箭社的學生學習如何朝靶子射箭。

examples.en: Green shoots started emerging from the soil in early spring.
examples.zh: 早春時節，綠色的嫩芽開始從土壤中冒出。

examples.en: The fashion magazine scheduled a photo shoot at the beach.
examples.zh: 時尚雜誌安排了一場在海灘的相片拍攝活動。

examples.en: Bamboo shoots are a popular ingredient in traditional Asian cooking.
examples.zh: 竹筍是傳統亞洲料理中受歡迎的食材。

examples.en: She opened a small flower shop near the train station.
examples.zh: 她在火車站附近開了一家小花店。

examples.en: The repair shop fixed my bicycle in an hour.
examples.zh: 修理店在一小時內修好了我的腳踏車。

examples.en: I bought this bread at a small shop near my school.
examples.zh: 我在學校附近的一家小店買了這個麵包。

examples.en: Many people prefer to shop online for convenience.
examples.zh: 很多人為了方便偏好在網路購物。

examples.en: We went to the mall to shop for winter clothes.
examples.zh: 我們去購物中心買冬衣。

examples.en: She likes to shop for fresh vegetables at the market.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在市場採買新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: The friendly shopkeeper greeted every customer with a smile.
examples.zh: 那位友善的店主微笑著跟每一位顧客打招呼。

examples.en: The local shopkeeper has owned this grocery store for years.
examples.zh: 當地的店主擁有這間雜貨店已經很多年了。

examples.en: An honest shopkeeper returned the forgotten wallet to its owner.
examples.zh: 一位誠實的店主把被遺忘的錢包歸還給了主人。

examples.en: Children were building sandcastles along the shore.
examples.zh: 孩子們正在海岸邊建造沙堡。

examples.en: A small wooden boat was tied up near the shore.
examples.zh: 一艘小木船被繫在岸邊附近。

examples.en: Waves crashed gently against the rocky shore.
examples.zh: 海浪輕柔地拍打著岩石海岸。

examples.en: The short boy reached up to touch the green leaves.
examples.zh: 那個矮個子的男孩伸出手去摸綠葉。

examples.en: We took a short break after two hours of study.
examples.zh: 研讀兩個小時後，我們短暫休息了一下。

examples.en: Our bakery is currently running short on fresh organic milk.
examples.zh: 我們的麵包店目前新鮮有機牛奶短缺。

examples.en: The bus stopped short to avoid hitting a stray cat.
examples.zh: 公車突然急煞車以避免撞到流浪貓。

examples.en: He cut his speech short because time was running out.
examples.zh: 由於時間即將用盡，他提早結束了演講。

examples.en: He stopped short when he saw the sign.
examples.zh: 他一看到標誌就突然停了下來。

examples.en: He likes to wear denim shorts when going to the beach.
examples.zh: 他去海灘時喜歡穿牛仔短褲。

examples.en: Students put on sports shorts for their physical education class.
examples.zh: 學生們換上運動短褲上體育課。

examples.en: She bought a pair of comfortable blue shorts for the summer.
examples.zh: 她為夏天買了一條舒適的藍色短褲。

examples.en: The police officer heard a shot and ran toward the sound.
examples.zh: 警察聽到一聲槍響，朝著聲音的方向跑去。

examples.en: The nurse gave the child a flu shot in the arm.
examples.zh: 護理師在小孩手臂上打了一針流感疫苗。

examples.en: The soccer player took a powerful shot toward the goal.
examples.zh: 這名足球員朝球門用力射了一腳。

examples.en: He carried his heavy school backpack over his left shoulder.
examples.zh: 他把沉重的書包背在左肩上。

examples.en: The doctor gently tapped my shoulder to calm me down.
examples.zh: 醫生輕輕拍了拍我的肩膀，讓我冷靜下來。

examples.en: She felt a sharp pain in her right shoulder after playing tennis.
examples.zh: 打完網球後，她感到右肩膀有一陣劇痛。

examples.en: Don't shout at me when I am trying to explain the situation clearly.
examples.zh: 當我試著把情況解釋清楚時，不要對我大喊大叫。

examples.en: The excited fans began to shout loudly when the famous singer appeared.
examples.zh: 當那位知名歌手出現時，興奮的歌迷們開始大聲歡呼。

examples.en: He had to shout to be heard above the noisy crowd outside.
examples.zh: 為了在外面嘈雜的人群中被聽見，他不得不大聲喊叫。

examples.en: A sudden shout broke the silence of the night.
examples.zh: 一聲突如其來的叫喊打破了夜晚的寂靜。

examples.en: We heard joyful shouts coming from the playground behind the primary school.
examples.zh: 我們聽到從國小後方的操場傳來歡樂的喊聲。

examples.en: Give me a shout when you are ready to depart for the airport.
examples.zh: 當你準備好出發去機場時，大聲叫我一聲。

examples.en: Please show me your identification card before entering the security zone.
examples.zh: 進入安全區域前請向我出示您的身分證。

examples.en: Recent scientific research shows a clear link between exercise and mental health.
examples.zh: 最新的科學研究顯示了運動與心理健康之間的明確聯繫。

examples.en: The tour guide will show us around the historic city center tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 導遊明天上午會帶我們參觀歷史悠久的市中心。

examples.en: We bought tickets to watch a popular magic show this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們買了票準備這個週末去觀看一場熱門的魔術表演。

examples.en: Her favorite television show airs every Thursday night at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 她最喜歡的電視節目在每週四晚上八點播出。

examples.en: The annual international auto show attracted thousands of passionate car enthusiasts.
examples.zh: 一年一度的國際車展吸引了數千名熱情的車迷。

examples.en: I always take a warm shower before going to bed.
examples.zh: 我總是在上床睡覺前洗個熱水澡。

examples.en: A sudden rain shower delayed our outdoor tennis match.
examples.zh: 一場突如其來的陣雨耽誤了我們的戶外網球比賽。

examples.en: The bathroom features a spacious modern shower area.
examples.zh: 這間浴室配有寬敞的現代化淋浴區。

examples.en: He usually showers quickly after his intense workout session.
examples.zh: 他通常在高強度的健身運動後快速淋浴。

examples.en: Fans showered the singer with red roses and gifts.
examples.zh: 歌迷們送給歌手大量的紅玫瑰和禮物。

examples.en: She showers every morning to feel refreshed for work.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨洗澡以感到神清氣爽地去上班。

examples.en: Please shut the heavy front door quietly when you leave.
examples.zh: 離開時請安靜地關上沉重的前門。

examples.en: She shut her textbook after finishing her homework assignment tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚完成作業後，她合上了課本。

examples.en: The store will shut early because of the typhoon warning.
examples.zh: 由於颱風警報，店家將提早關門。

examples.en: Keep the bedroom window shut to keep the cold wind out.
examples.zh: 把臥室窗戶關好，別讓冷風吹進來。

examples.en: The library doors stayed shut during the national holiday.
examples.zh: 圖書館大門在國定假日期間保持關閉。

examples.en: He kept his eyes shut tight while making a birthday wish.
examples.zh: 許生日願望時，他緊緊閉上雙眼。

examples.en: The shy little girl hid behind her mother when strangers arrived.
examples.zh: 當陌生人來到時，這個害羞的小女孩躲在媽媽背後。

examples.en: He feels too shy to speak in front of large audiences.
examples.zh: 他覺得太害羞，不敢在大批觀眾面前演講。

examples.en: She gave a shy smile and answered the question quietly.
examples.zh: 她害羞地笑了笑，並安靜地回答了問題。

examples.en: She stayed in bed because she was feeling sick.
examples.zh: 她躺在床上，因為她感到身體不適。

examples.en: Caring for a sick family member requires great patience.
examples.zh: 照料生病的家人需要極大的耐心。

examples.en: The strong smell of smoke made him feel sick.
examples.zh: 濃烈的煙味讓他感到噁心想要嘔吐。

examples.en: Please sign your full name on this side of the paper.
examples.zh: 請在紙的這一面簽上你的全名。

examples.en: He walked on the left side of the street.
examples.zh: 他走在街道的左側。

examples.en: Both sides agreed to sign the peace treaty.
examples.zh: 雙方都同意簽署和平條約。

examples.en: Pedestrians should always walk on the sidewalk for safety.
examples.zh: 為了安全起見，行人應該總是走在人行道上。

examples.en: There are many trees planted along the wide sidewalk.
examples.zh: 寬敞的人行道旁種植了許多樹木。

examples.en: He parked his bicycle near the bench on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 他把腳踏車停在人行道的長椅附近。

examples.en: Her sight is still very good for her age.
examples.zh: 以她的年紀來說，她的視力仍然很好。

examples.en: The sunset over the ocean was a beautiful sight.
examples.zh: 海上的夕陽是一幅美麗的景象。

examples.en: Tourists came from afar to visit the famous historical sights of Kyoto.
examples.zh: 遊客從遠方前來參觀京都著名的歷史名勝。

examples.en: Follow the road sign to find the nearest hospital quickly.
examples.zh: 跟隨路標以快速找到最近的醫院。

examples.en: The dark clouds are a clear sign of coming rain.
examples.zh: 烏雲是即將下雨的明顯徵兆。

examples.en: There is a no parking sign outside the building.
examples.zh: 大樓外面有一個禁止停車的標誌。

examples.en: Please sign your name on the bottom of the document.
examples.zh: 請在文件的底部簽上你的姓名。

examples.en: The famous athlete signed a contract with a new team.
examples.zh: 這位知名運動員與新球隊簽署了合約。

examples.en: He signed the delivery receipt when the package arrived today.
examples.zh: 今天包裹送達時，他在簽收單上簽名。

examples.en: A deep silence fell over the classroom during the test.
examples.zh: 考試期間教室裡陷入一片死寂。

examples.en: Her long silence made her parents feel very worried.
examples.zh: 她長時間的沉默讓父母感到非常擔心。

examples.en: The audience kept absolute silence while the pianist played.
examples.zh: 鋼琴家演奏時，觀眾保持絕對的靜默。

examples.en: The teacher clapped her hands to silence the loud students.
examples.zh: 老師拍手讓嘈雜的學生安靜下來。

examples.en: He turned off his phone to silence all incoming notifications.
examples.zh: 他把手機關機，讓所有收到的通知都不再作響。

examples.en: Clear facts quickly silenced the doubts raised by the team.
examples.zh: 明確的事實迅速消除了團隊提出的疑問。

examples.en: The library was completely silent as students prepared for exams.
examples.zh: 學生們準備考試時，圖書館裡一片寂靜。

examples.en: He remained silent during the meeting because he was thinking deeply.
examples.zh: 會議期間他保持沉默，因為他正在深思。

examples.en: They watched the old silent movie with live piano music.
examples.zh: 他們觀看配有現場鋼琴伴奏的古老默片。

examples.en: He put on a silly hat to make the children laugh.
examples.zh: 他戴上一頂滑稽的帽子來逗孩子們笑。

examples.en: It was silly of me to leave my keys inside.
examples.zh: 我把鑰匙留在裡面真是太糊塗了。

examples.en: Stop arguing over such silly little things with your brother.
examples.zh: 停止為了這種無聊的小事跟你兄弟爭吵。

examples.en: The ring is made of pure silver and looks shiny.
examples.zh: 這枚戒指是由純銀製成，看起來很閃亮。

examples.en: She polished the family silver before the grand dinner party.
examples.zh: 她在盛大晚宴前將家族傳承的銀器擦亮。

examples.en: He won a silver medal in the swimming competition yesterday.
examples.zh: 他在昨天的游泳比賽中榮獲銀牌。

examples.en: The full moon gave off a bright silver light tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚的滿月發出明亮的銀色光芒。

examples.en: She bought a sleek silver car at the auto show.
examples.zh: 她在車展上買了一輛時尚的銀色轎車。

examples.en: He wore a stylish silver watch on his left wrist.
examples.zh: 他左手腕上戴著一只時尚的銀色手錶。

examples.en: The twin sisters have similar taste in clothes.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎姊妹對衣服的品味很相似。

examples.en: My new smartphone has features that are similar to your current model.
examples.zh: 我的新智慧型手機的功能與你目前的機型相似。

examples.en: We arrived at a similar conclusion after analyzing the scientific research data.
examples.zh: 在分析科學研究數據後，我們得出了一個類似的結論。

examples.en: This dish is very simple and easy to prepare.
examples.zh: 這道菜非常簡單且容易準備。

examples.en: He lives a simple life in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他在鄉間過著樸素的生活。

examples.en: Follow these simple instructions to finish the test.
examples.zh: 依照這些簡單的說明完成測驗。

examples.en: She explained the math rule simply so every student could understand.
examples.zh: 她簡單地解釋了數學規則，好讓每個學生都能聽懂。

examples.en: I am simply suggesting that we take a brief break now.
examples.zh: 我只不過是建議我們現在稍微休息一下。

examples.en: The view from the top of the mountain was simply breathtaking.
examples.zh: 從山頂看到的景色簡直令人屏息。

examples.en: I have lived in Taipei since my parents moved here ten years ago.
examples.zh: 自從我父母十年前搬來這裡後，我就一直住在台北。

examples.en: Since it is raining heavily outside, we should stay inside today.
examples.zh: 因為外面正下著大雨，我們今天應該留在室內。

examples.en: She has been working as a teacher since she graduated from college.
examples.zh: 自從大學畢業後，她就一直擔任教師。

examples.en: He has been studying hard since early morning in the quiet library.
examples.zh: 他從一大早就一直在安靜的圖書館裡用功讀書。

examples.en: Our company has grown rapidly since its opening two years ago.
examples.zh: 自從兩年前開業以來，我們公司成長迅速。

examples.en: I have not seen my elementary classmate since last year's summer camp.
examples.zh: 自從去年的夏令營以來，我就沒見過我的國小同學了。

examples.en: The young girl loves to sing happy songs in the shower.
examples.zh: 這個小女孩喜歡在淋浴時唱快樂的歌曲。

examples.en: Birds sing sweetly in the trees outside every early morning.
examples.zh: 鳥兒每天清晨在窗外的樹上甜美地歌唱。

examples.en: The choir will sing traditional carols at church tonight.
examples.zh: 合唱團今晚將在教堂演唱傳統聖誕頌歌。

examples.en: The popular singer will perform a concert in Taipei tonight.
examples.zh: 這位知名歌手今晚將在台北舉辦演唱會。

examples.en: She has been a professional singer for over ten years.
examples.zh: 她擔任專業歌手已經超過十年了。

examples.en: The lead singer of the rock band signed autographs for fans.
examples.zh: 搖滾樂團的主唱為粉絲簽名。

examples.en: He answered every single question correctly on the written test.
examples.zh: 他在筆試中正確回答了每一道問題。

examples.en: She is currently single and focusing on her career.
examples.zh: 她目前單身，專注於自己的事業。

examples.en: I booked a single room at the hotel for business trip.
examples.zh: 我為商務旅行預訂了飯店的一間單人房。

examples.en: Good morning, sir. How may I help you today?
examples.zh: 早安先生，我今天能為您提供什麼幫助？

examples.en: Here is your steak, sir. Enjoy your meal.
examples.zh: 先生，這是您的牛排，請慢用。

examples.en: Excuse me sir, you dropped your wallet on the floor.
examples.zh: 先生打擾一下，您的皮夾掉在地板上了。

examples.en: My older sister helps me with my math homework.
examples.zh: 我的姊姊幫我做我的數學作業。

examples.en: She shared her favorite sweet snacks with her sister.
examples.zh: 她和她的妹妹分享了她最喜歡的甜點零食。

examples.en: The two sisters look very similar to each other.
examples.zh: 這對姊妹看起來彼此非常相似。

examples.en: Please sit down on the comfortable armchair and relax for a moment.
examples.zh: 請在舒適的單人沙發上坐下，放鬆片刻。

examples.en: The peaceful ancient castle sits gracefully on top of the green hill.
examples.zh: 這座寧靜的古堡優雅地坐落在綠色山丘頂上。

examples.en: The students were instructed to sit quietly during the national exam.
examples.zh: 學生們被指示在國家考試期間安靜地坐著。

examples.en: The clerk asked me what size shoes I usually wear.
examples.zh: 店員問我平時穿什麼尺寸的鞋子。

examples.en: They selected a table of suitable size for the family dinner.
examples.zh: 他們選了一張大小適合家庭晚餐的桌子。

examples.en: This new sweater comes in three different sizes for customers.
examples.zh: 這款新毛衣有三種不同尺寸供顧客選擇。

examples.en: Cooking is a valuable life skill that everyone should learn.
examples.zh: 烹飪是每個人都應該學會的寶貴生活技能。

examples.en: Developing good communication skills is important for your future career growth.
examples.zh: 培養良好的溝通技巧對你未來的職涯發展很重要。

examples.en: The master artist demonstrated high technical skill during the public workshop.
examples.zh: 這位大師級藝術家在公開工作坊中展現了高超的技術技巧。

examples.en: He is a skilled carpenter who builds high quality furniture.
examples.zh: 他是一位製作高品質家具的熟練木工。

examples.en: The factory needs more skilled workers to operate complex machinery.
examples.zh: 工廠需要更多熟練的工人來操作複雜的機械。

examples.en: She is a skilled pianist who has won many competitions.
examples.zh: 她是一位技巧熟練的鋼琴家，贏過許多比賽。

examples.en: Apply sunscreen to protect your sensitive skin from sunburn.
examples.zh: 塗抹防曬乳以保護你敏感的皮膚免於曬傷。

examples.en: Peel the yellow skin off the banana before eating.
examples.zh: 食用前請剝掉香蕉的黃色外皮。

examples.en: Her skin felt smooth and clean after the facial wash.
examples.zh: 洗臉後她的皮膚感覺光滑乾淨。

examples.en: She wore a comfortable denim skirt to class today.
examples.zh: 她今天穿了一件舒適的牛仔裙去上課。

examples.en: My mother bought a beautiful pleated skirt for the family dinner.
examples.zh: 我媽媽為家庭晚餐買了一件美麗的百褶裙。

examples.en: Our school uniform skirt is dark blue and looks elegant.
examples.zh: 我們學校的制服裙是深藍色的，看起來很優雅。

examples.en: The helmet protects your skull from injury during accidents.
examples.zh: 安全帽能在事故中保護你的頭骨免受傷害。

examples.en: Archeologists discovered a human skull inside the ancient cave.
examples.zh: 考古學家在古老洞穴內發現了一具人類頭骨。

examples.en: The warning sign featured a skull and crossbones symbol.
examples.zh: 警告標誌上繪有頭骨與交叉骨頭的符號。

examples.en: The sky was filled with bright stars on that clear night.
examples.zh: 在那個晴朗的夜晚，天空佈滿了明亮的星星。

examples.en: Dark clouds gathered in the sky before the storm started.
examples.zh: 在暴風雨開始之前，烏雲聚集在天空。

examples.en: An airplane flew high across the blue sky this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有一架飛機在高高的藍天中飛過。

examples.en: I usually sleep for eight hours every night to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 我通常每天晚上睡覺八小時以保持健康。

examples.en: The baby slept peacefully in her crib all afternoon.
examples.zh: 嬰兒整個下午都在嬰兒床裡平靜地睡覺。

examples.en: You should not sleep with the lights on in your bedroom.
examples.zh: 你不應該開著臥室的燈睡覺。

examples.en: Getting a good night's sleep is essential for your health.
examples.zh: 擁有良好的夜間睡眠對健康至關重要。

examples.en: He was so tired that he fell into a deep sleep.
examples.zh: 他太累了，以至於陷入了沉睡。

examples.en: Lack of sleep can affect your concentration at school.
examples.zh: 缺乏睡眠會影響你在學校的專注力。

examples.en: The sleepy child rubbed his eyes and yawned loudly.
examples.zh: 睏倦的小孩揉揉眼睛，大聲打了個哈欠。

examples.en: I feel very sleepy after drinking warm milk before bed.
examples.zh: 睡前喝了熱牛奶後，我覺得非常睏倦。

examples.en: A hot afternoon lesson made everyone in class sleepy.
examples.zh: 午後炎熱的課堂讓班上的每個人都想睡覺。

examples.en: Children love to slide down the snowy hill on sleds.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡坐雪橇從積雪的山丘上滑下來。

examples.en: The glass plate slid off the wet counter top.
examples.zh: 玻璃盤子從濕滑的檯面上滑落。

examples.en: Prices slid by twenty percent during the seasonal sale.
examples.zh: 在季節促銷期間，價格下滑了百分之二十。

examples.en: Kids queued up eagerly for the playground slide.
examples.zh: 孩子們熱切地排隊玩遊樂場滑梯。

examples.en: The speaker showed a helpful slide to illustrate data.
examples.zh: 講者展示了一張有用的幻燈片來說明數據。

examples.en: The water park has a long slide that ends in a big pool.
examples.zh: 水上樂園有一座通往大泳池的長滑梯。

examples.en: She exercises regularly to keep a slim figure.
examples.zh: 她定期運動以保持苗條的身材。

examples.en: There is only a slim chance of winning the lottery.
examples.zh: 中彩券的機會非常微小。

examples.en: He bought a slim laptop that fits easily into his backpack.
examples.zh: 他買了一台很容易放進背包的輕薄筆記型電腦。

examples.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.
examples.zh: 小心不要在潮濕的地板上滑倒了。

examples.en: Time slips away quickly when you are having fun.
examples.zh: 當你玩得開心時，時間總是溜得很快。

examples.en: The paper slipped out of his hand onto the ground.
examples.zh: 那張紙從他手中滑落到了地上。

examples.en: Write down your phone number on a small slip.
examples.zh: 在一張小紙條上記下你的電話號碼。

examples.en: He had a minor slip while walking down the stairs.
examples.zh: 他走下樓梯時稍微滑了一下。

examples.en: Keep the deposit slip as official proof of payment.
examples.zh: 請保留這張存款單作為付款的官方證明。

examples.en: He put on a pair of soft indoor slippers at home.
examples.zh: 他在家裡穿上一雙柔軟的室內拖鞋。

examples.en: She left her warm cozy slipper next to the bed.
examples.zh: 她把她溫暖舒適的拖鞋留在了床邊。

examples.en: The puppy chewed on his slipper under the table.
examples.zh: 小狗在桌子底下咬著他的拖鞋。

examples.en: Turtles are known for their very slow movement on land.
examples.zh: 烏龜以在陸地上非常緩慢的移動著稱。

examples.en: Traffic was very slow during the rainy morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 下雨天早晨的尖峰時段，交通非常緩慢。

examples.en: The internet is slow because of the weak signal.
examples.zh: 因為訊號弱，網路很慢。

examples.en: You must slow down when driving through a school zone.
examples.zh: 開車經過學校區域時，你必須放慢速度。

examples.en: The heavy fog forced the driver to slow the vehicle down.
examples.zh: 濃霧迫使駕駛放慢車速。

examples.en: Taking deep breaths can help slow your rapid heart rate down.
examples.zh: 深呼吸有助於放慢你快速的心跳。

examples.en: They live in a small cozy apartment near campus.
examples.zh: 他們住在校園附近的一間小巧溫馨的公寓裡。

examples.en: He made a small mistake on his math test.
examples.zh: 他在數學測驗上犯了一個小錯誤。

examples.en: A small amount of rain fell earlier this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上早些時候下了少量的雨。

examples.en: The smart student answered all the difficult math questions quickly.
examples.zh: 這位聰明的學生快速回答了所有困難的數學題目。

examples.en: He wore a smart suit to his job interview today.
examples.zh: 他今天穿著一套時髦的西裝去參加求職面試。

examples.en: Smart home devices allow people to control appliances from anywhere.
examples.zh: 智慧家居裝置讓人們能從任何地方控制家電。

examples.en: The fresh bread from the bakery smells wonderful.
examples.zh: 麵包店剛出爐的麵包聞起來香極了。

examples.en: Can you smell the sweet scent of blooming jasmine flowers outside?
examples.zh: 你能聞到外面盛開茉莉花的甜美香味嗎？

examples.en: The room smells like fresh coffee after my sister brewed a cup.
examples.zh: 我姊姊泡了一杯咖啡後，房間裡聞起來盡是新鮮咖啡味。

examples.en: The bad smell from the trash can filled the small kitchen.
examples.zh: 垃圾桶傳出的難聞氣味充滿了這個小廚房。

examples.en: Dogs have a strong sense of smell that helps them track things.
examples.zh: 狗擁有敏銳的嗅覺，能幫助牠們追蹤事物。

examples.en: I love the pleasant smell of rain falling on dry soil.
examples.zh: 我喜歡雨水降落在乾燥土地上的宜人氣味。

examples.en: She couldn't help but smile when she saw the puppy.
examples.zh: 當她看到那隻小狗時，她忍不住笑了起來。

examples.en: The friendly waiter smiled warmly as he greeted us today.
examples.zh: 親切的服務生今天招呼我們時溫和地微笑。

examples.en: Everyone smiled for the group photo at the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 大家在畢業典禮的合照中都露出了笑容。

examples.en: He had a broad smile on his face after winning.
examples.zh: 獲勝後，他的臉上帶著燦爛的笑容。

examples.en: Her warm smile made everyone feel welcome at the event.
examples.zh: 她溫暖的笑容讓活動中的每個人都感到受到歡迎。

examples.en: A polite smile can easily brighten up someone else day.
examples.zh: 禮貌的微笑可以輕易照亮別人的日子。

examples.en: Thick black smoke rose from the factory chimney.
examples.zh: 濃濃的黑煙從工廠煙囪升起。

examples.en: The room was filled with smoke from burning dry wood.
examples.zh: 房間裡充滿了乾柴燃燒產生的煙霧。

examples.en: A smoke alarm alerted everyone to leave the office building.
examples.zh: 煙霧警報器提醒所有人離開辦公大樓。

examples.en: It is strictly forbidden to smoke inside the public hospital.
examples.zh: 公立醫院內嚴禁吸菸。

examples.en: The wet wood began to smoke as soon as lit.
examples.zh: 濕木頭一被點燃就開始冒煙。

examples.en: He decided to smoke less for the sake of his health.
examples.zh: 為了健康著想，他決定少抽一點菸。

examples.en: The wooden desk has a smooth surface after being carefully polished.
examples.zh: 這張木桌在經過仔細打磨後表面非常平滑。

examples.en: We had a smooth journey with no traffic delays on the highway.
examples.zh: 我們有一段順利的旅程，高速公路上沒有交通延誤。

examples.en: Her skin felt soft and smooth after applying moisturizing lotion.
examples.zh: 塗抹保濕乳液後，她的肌膚感覺柔軟光滑。

examples.en: She used her hand to smooth out the wrinkles on her dress.
examples.zh: 她用手撫平洋裝上的皺褶。

examples.en: The worker used a tool to smooth the wet concrete surface.
examples.zh: 工人使用工具將濕水泥表面弄平。

examples.en: He tried to smooth over the disagreement between his two classmates.
examples.zh: 他試圖撫平兩位同學之間的意見不合。

examples.en: They tried to smuggle rare animals across the border.
examples.zh: 他們企圖偷運稀有動物過境。

examples.en: The man was arrested for smuggling illegal drugs into the country.
examples.zh: 那名男子因走私非法毒品入境而被逮捕。

examples.en: Customs officers caught two people smuggling foreign currency last night.
examples.zh: 海關官員昨晚逮捕了兩名走私外幣的人。

examples.en: I always eat a light healthy snack after my workout.
examples.zh: 我總是在健身運動後吃一份輕便健康的點心。

examples.en: Children grabbed a quick snack before heading back to study.
examples.zh: 孩子們在回去讀書前快速抓了一份零食。

examples.en: Fresh fruit is a much healthier snack than potato chips.
examples.zh: 新鮮水果是比洋芋片健康得多的零食。

examples.en: Try not to snack continuously while watching late night movies.
examples.zh: 看深夜電影時，盡量不要一直吃零食。

examples.en: She likes to snack on nuts between breakfast and lunch.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在早餐和午餐之間吃堅果當零食。

examples.en: Students often snack during study breaks to stay fully energized.
examples.zh: 學生們常在唸書休息時吃點心，以保持精力充沛。

examples.en: A small snail moved slowly across the wet garden wall.
examples.zh: 一隻小蝸牛緩慢地爬過潮濕的花園牆壁。

examples.en: We saw many snails after the heavy rain stopped.
examples.zh: 大雨停止後，我們看到了許多蝸牛。

examples.en: The children observed the snail eating a green leaf.
examples.zh: 孩子們觀察蝸牛吃綠葉。

examples.en: We spotted a green snake moving quietly through the grass.
examples.zh: 我們注意到一隻綠色的蛇在草叢中靜靜地爬行。

examples.en: Some people are terrified of any kind of dangerous snake.
examples.zh: 有些人害怕任何種類的危險蛇類。

examples.en: The zookeeper fed the large snake a small meal.
examples.zh: 動物園管理員餵了這條大蛇一小份食物。

examples.en: The narrow river tends to snake through the peaceful valley.
examples.zh: 這條狹窄的河流曲折延伸穿過寧靜的山谷。

examples.en: A long queue of people began to snake around block.
examples.zh: 長長的人龍開始沿著街區曲折排隊。

examples.en: The mountain road snakes upward toward the high peak.
examples.zh: 這條山路蜿蜒向上延伸通往高聳的山頂。

examples.en: The heavy snow made it difficult to drive on the highway.
examples.zh: 大雪使得在高速公路上開車變得困難。

examples.en: Children love to build a snowman in the soft snow.
examples.zh: 小朋友喜歡在柔軟的積雪中堆雪人。

examples.en: Snow fell continuously throughout the night and covered the garden.
examples.zh: 整夜下雪，覆蓋了整個花園。

examples.en: It usually starts to snow here in early December.
examples.zh: 這邊通常在十二月初開始下雪。

examples.en: It snowed so heavily yesterday that school was canceled.
examples.zh: 昨天雪下得很大，所以學校停課了。

examples.en: If it snows tomorrow, we can go skiing on the mountain.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雪，我們就可以去山上滑雪。

examples.en: Children love playing outdoors during a cold snowy winter day.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在寒冷下雪的冬天戶外玩耍。

examples.en: We drove through the snowy mountains in Japan.
examples.zh: 我們開車穿越日本的雪山。

examples.en: Drive carefully on the snowy road surface to avoid sliding.
examples.zh: 在下雪的路面上謹慎駕駛以避免滑行。

examples.en: The coffee is so hot that I cannot drink it.
examples.zh: 這咖啡太熱了，我喝不下去。

examples.en: She sings so beautifully that everyone listens attentively.
examples.zh: 她唱得如此美妙，大家都專心聆聽。

examples.en: Why are you so late for the morning meeting?
examples.zh: 你早會為什麼遲到這麼久？

examples.en: It started to rain, so we stayed inside the house.
examples.zh: 開始下雨了，所以我們待在房子裡。

examples.en: He studied very hard, so he passed the test easily.
examples.zh: 他非常努力學習，所以輕鬆通過了考試。

examples.en: The bus was full, so I had to wait for another.
examples.zh: 公車擠滿了，所以我必須等下一班。

examples.en: Wash your hands with soap before having lunch.
examples.zh: 吃午餐前請用肥皂洗手。

examples.en: She bought a bar of lavender soap yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天買了一塊薰衣草肥皂。

examples.en: Natural soap is usually gentle on sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 天然肥皂通常對敏感肌膚很溫和。

examples.en: Many students like to play soccer after school on Fridays.
examples.zh: 許多學生喜歡在星期五放學後踢足球。

examples.en: Our school soccer team won the championship match last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們學校的足球隊上週末贏得了冠軍賽。

examples.en: He bought a pair of new shoes for soccer practice.
examples.zh: 他買了一雙新鞋用於足球練習。

examples.en: Participating in club activities is a good way to build social skills.
examples.zh: 參加社團活動是建立社交技巧的好方法。

examples.en: Many young people rely on social media to keep in touch with friends.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人依賴社群媒體與朋友保持聯絡。

examples.en: The government works hard to solve complex social issues in urban areas.
examples.zh: 政府努力解決城市地區複雜的社會問題。

examples.en: Technology plays an increasingly important role in modern society.
examples.zh: 科技在現代社會中扮演著越來越重要的角色。

examples.en: Every citizen has a responsibility to contribute positively to society.
examples.zh: 每位公民都有責任對社會做出積極貢獻。

examples.en: She joined the university film society to meet other movie lovers.
examples.zh: 她加入了大學電影社團，以結識其他電影愛好者。

examples.en: He put on warm wool socks before going outside.
examples.zh: 他出門前穿上了溫暖的羊毛襪。

examples.en: There was a small hole in the heel of his sock.
examples.zh: 他的襪子腳後跟有一個小洞。

examples.en: She lost a single white sock in the washing machine.
examples.zh: 她在洗衣機裡洗丟了一隻白色襪子。

examples.en: He ordered a glass of cold soda with his pizza for lunch.
examples.zh: 他點了一杯冷汽水配他的午餐披薩。

examples.en: Drinking too much sweet soda can damage your teeth.
examples.zh: 喝太多含糖汽水會傷害你的牙齒。

examples.en: She bought a can of fruit soda from the vending machine nearby.
examples.zh: 她從附近的自動販賣機買了一罐水果汽水。

examples.en: We bought a comfortable leather sofa for our newly decorated living room.
examples.zh: 我們為新裝修的客廳買了一張舒適的皮沙發。

examples.en: The tired father fell fast asleep on the soft sofa after work.
examples.zh: 疲憊的父親下班後在柔軟的沙發上熟睡了。

examples.en: Please sit on the sofa while I prepare a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 在我準備一杯茶的時候，請坐在沙發上。

examples.en: The baby slept peacefully on the soft white blanket.
examples.zh: 小寶寶在柔軟的白毯子上安詳地睡著。

examples.en: She listened to soft music while reading a book.
examples.zh: 她邊讀書邊聽著柔和的音樂。

examples.en: The teacher spoke in a soft voice to the children.
examples.zh: 老師用輕柔的聲音對孩子們說話。

examples.en: Plants need rich soil and sunshine to grow well.
examples.zh: 植物需要肥沃的土壤和陽光才能長得好。

examples.en: The farmer added rich organic compost to the garden soil.
examples.zh: 農夫在花園泥土中加入了豐富的有機堆肥。

examples.en: Heavy rain washed away the soil on the hillside.
examples.zh: 大雨沖走了山坡上的泥土。

examples.en: The brave soldier served his country honorably for ten years.
examples.zh: 這位勇敢的士兵榮譽地服役了十年。

examples.en: Thousands of soldiers marched across the field during training exercises.
examples.zh: 數千名士兵在訓練演習期間行進穿越田野。

examples.en: He wrote frequent letters home while serving as a soldier.
examples.zh: 當士兵期間，他經常寫信回家。

examples.en: We need to find a practical solution to this problem.
examples.zh: 我們需要為這個問題找到實用的解決方案。

examples.en: The math teacher clearly explained the step-by-step solution.
examples.zh: 數學老師清楚講解了這題的逐步解法。

examples.en: Mix the salt into warm water to create a saline solution.
examples.zh: 把鹽混入溫水以調配出鹽水溶液。

examples.en: The math teacher showed us how to solve the difficult problem.
examples.zh: 數學老師向我們示範如何解答這道難題。

examples.en: We need to work together to solve this technical issue.
examples.zh: 我們需要合作來解決這個技術問題。

examples.en: Detectives worked hard to solve the mysterious disappearance case.
examples.zh: 偵探們努力工作以破獲這起神秘失蹤案。

examples.en: Would you like some fresh orange juice with breakfast?
examples.zh: 你早餐想喝點新鮮柳橙汁嗎？

examples.en: Some students prefer studying in the quiet school library.
examples.zh: 有些學生比較喜歡在安靜的學校圖書館讀書。

examples.en: I need to buy some paper towels from the store.
examples.zh: 我需要從商店買一些紙巾。

examples.en: Some of the apples in the basket are very sweet.
examples.zh: 籃子裡的一些蘋果非常甜。

examples.en: Some agreed with the plan while others strongly disagreed.
examples.zh: 有些人同意這個計劃，而其他人則強烈反對。

examples.en: If you need extra pens, I have some to share.
examples.zh: 如果你需要額外的原子筆，我有幾支可以分享。

examples.en: Someone left an umbrella under the chair in the hallway.
examples.zh: 有人把傘留在走廊的椅子下面了。

examples.en: I heard someone knocking gently on the front door just now.
examples.zh: 我剛才聽到有人輕輕敲大門。

examples.en: Can someone please help me move this heavy table?
examples.zh: 有人可以幫我搬這張重桌子嗎？

examples.en: There is something hidden inside this small wooden box.
examples.zh: 這個小木盒裡面藏著某個東西。

examples.en: She wanted to tell him something very important yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天想告訴他一件非常重要的事。

examples.en: Would you like to get something to eat after class?
examples.zh: 下課後你想去吃點東西嗎？

examples.en: Sometimes I walk to school instead of taking the bus.
examples.zh: 有時我會走路去上學，而不是搭公車。

examples.en: She sometimes reads books late into the night.
examples.zh: 她有時會讀書讀到深夜。

examples.en: Weather in the mountains can change quickly sometimes.
examples.zh: 山區的天氣有時變化得很快。

examples.en: The price of the smartphone was somewhat higher than I expected.
examples.zh: 這款智慧型手機的價格比我預期的稍微高了一些。

examples.en: She felt somewhat nervous before the speech contest.
examples.zh: 她在演講比賽前感到有點緊張。

examples.en: The weather turned somewhat cooler as evening approached.
examples.zh: 隨著傍晚臨近，天氣變得稍微涼爽了些。

examples.en: I left my house keys somewhere in the office.
examples.zh: 我把家門鑰匙留在辦公室的某個地方了。

examples.en: Let's go somewhere quiet to talk about our plans.
examples.zh: 我們找個安靜的地方談談我們的計畫吧。

examples.en: He recently moved somewhere in southern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 他最近搬到了台灣南部的某個地方。

examples.en: Their oldest son is studying medicine at a Taipei university.
examples.zh: 他們的大兒子正在台北的一所大學攻讀醫學。

examples.en: He took his young son to the park to fly a kite.
examples.zh: 他帶他年輕的兒子去公園放風箏。

examples.en: She is proud of her son's achievements in high school.
examples.zh: 她為兒子在高中取得的成就感到自豪。

examples.en: She sang a beautiful song at the school festival.
examples.zh: 她在學校節慶上唱了一首美麗的歌曲。

examples.en: This pop song became very popular among many teenagers.
examples.zh: 這首流行歌曲在許多青少年中變得非常受歡迎。

examples.en: He wrote an original song for his sister's birthday.
examples.zh: 他為妹妹的生日寫了一首原創歌曲。

examples.en: The scheduled bus should be arriving here very soon, so please wait.
examples.zh: 班車應該很快就會到達這裡，所以請稍候。

examples.en: Get well soon, and we hope to see you back at school.
examples.zh: 祝你早日康復，我們希望很快能看到你回到學校。

examples.en: The winter holiday season will start soon, and everyone is getting excited.
examples.zh: 寒假季節很快就要開始了，大家都很興奮。

examples.en: My muscles felt very sore after a hard workout yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天劇烈健身後，我的肌肉感到非常痠痛。

examples.en: She drank warm honey tea to soothe her sore throat.
examples.zh: 她喝溫蜂蜜茶來舒緩疼痛的喉嚨。

examples.en: His feet were extremely sore after walking all day in the city.
examples.zh: 在城市裡走了一整天的路後，他的雙腳非常痠痛。

examples.en: I am truly sorry for being late for our important meeting.
examples.zh: 很抱歉我在這麼重要的會議上遲到了。

examples.en: She felt sorry for the stray cat shivering in the cold rain.
examples.zh: 她對在寒雨中發抖的流浪貓感到難過。

examples.en: He said he was sorry for making a noise during the lecture.
examples.zh: 他說對於在講座期間發出噪音感到抱歉。

examples.en: What sort of music do you like listening to most?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡聽哪種類型的音樂？

examples.en: There were all sorts of fresh fruits at the local market.
examples.zh: 當地市場有各種各樣的新鮮水果。

examples.en: He is the sort of person who always helps others.
examples.zh: 他是那種總是幫助他人的人。

examples.en: Please sort the letters by zip code before mailing them.
examples.zh: 請在郵寄信件前按照郵遞區號進行分類。

examples.en: She spent the afternoon sorting through her old clothes.
examples.zh: 她花了一個下午整理她的舊衣服。

examples.en: We need to sort out this problem before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我們需要在截止日期前解決這個問題。

examples.en: Beautiful classical music can bring comfort to a tired soul.
examples.zh: 優美的古典樂能帶給疲憊的心靈慰藉。

examples.en: He put his heart and soul into creating this painting.
examples.zh: 他傾注心血與全心全意創作這幅畫作。

examples.en: Not a single soul was seen on the quiet village street.
examples.zh: 在安靜的村莊街道上連一個人影都沒有看見。

senses.zh: 靈魂；心靈；人（多用於否定句）

examples.en: The sound of the ocean helps me fall asleep.
examples.zh: 大海的聲音幫助我入睡。

examples.en: We heard a strange sound from the dark garden.
examples.zh: 我們聽到來自黑暗花園的奇怪聲音。

examples.en: Turn down the sound on your audio player.
examples.zh: 請調低你音響設備的音量。

examples.en: Your plan to travel around Europe sounds great.
examples.zh: 你環遊歐洲的計劃聽起來棒極了。

examples.en: Her story sounded believable to everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她的故事對房間裡的每個人來說聽起來都很可信。

examples.en: That guitar sounds a bit out of tune.
examples.zh: 那把吉他聽起來有點走音。

examples.en: He gave us some sound advice on studying.
examples.zh: 他給了我們一些很好的讀書建議。

examples.en: The old wooden bridge is still structurally sound.
examples.zh: 這座舊木橋結構依然完好。

examples.en: She fell into a sound sleep after working hard.
examples.zh: 努力工作後她睡得很沉很安穩。

senses.zh: 可靠的；完好的；（睡眠）酣熟的

examples.en: A warm bowl of chicken soup is perfect for a cold winter day.
examples.zh: 一碗熱騰騰的雞湯非常適合寒冷的冬天。

examples.en: The chef added fresh herbs to the vegetable soup.
examples.zh: 廚師在蔬菜湯裡加了新鮮的香草。

examples.en: She drank a cup of hot tomato soup before eating her steak.
examples.zh: 她在吃牛排前喝了一杯熱番茄湯。

examples.en: The fresh lemon juice tasted extremely sour without sugar.
examples.zh: 鮮榨檸檬汁沒有加糖吃起來非常酸。

examples.en: The milk went sour because it was left out overnight.
examples.zh: 牛奶因為在室溫放了一整夜而變酸變質了。

examples.en: He had a sour expression on his face all afternoon.
examples.zh: 他整個下午臉上都帶著不悅的表情。

examples.en: Their friendship began to sour after the major argument.
examples.zh: 他們的友誼在大吵一架後開始惡化。

examples.en: Bad weather soured our plans for an outdoor picnic weekend.
examples.zh: 惡劣的天氣破壞了我們週末戶外野餐的計畫。

examples.en: The milk soured rapidly in the hot summer weather.
examples.zh: 牛奶在炎熱的天氣裡迅速變酸。

examples.en: Oranges are a great source of vitamin C.
examples.zh: 柳橙是維生素 C 的優良來源。

examples.en: You must cite the source of your information clearly.
examples.zh: 你必須清楚引用你的資訊出處。

examples.en: The source of the river is high up in the mountains.
examples.zh: 這條河的源頭位於高山之上。

examples.en: Birds fly to the south during the cold winter.
examples.zh: 鳥類在寒冷的冬天飛往南方。

examples.en: Tainan is located in the south of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台南位於台灣南部。

examples.en: The wind was coming directly from the warm south.
examples.zh: 風直接從溫暖的南方吹來。

examples.en: They visited the south coast during their summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他們在暑假期間造訪了南海岸。

examples.en: The south entrance to the shopping mall is closed.
examples.zh: 購物中心的南門關閉了。

examples.en: Drive along the south bank of the wide river.
examples.zh: 沿著寬闊河流的南岸開車。

examples.en: The flock of birds is flying south for winter.
examples.zh: 這群鳥正向南飛去過冬。

examples.en: Head south on this main road for three kilometers.
examples.zh: 在這條主要道路上向南前行三公里。

examples.en: The strong current pushed our small boat south.
examples.zh: 強勁的水流把我們的小船推向南方。

examples.en: They traveled to the southern part of Taiwan during winter vacation.
examples.zh: 他們在寒假期間去了台灣南部地區旅行。

examples.en: Warm ocean currents affect the climate along the southern coastline.
examples.zh: 溫暖的洋流影響著南部海岸線沿線的氣候。

examples.en: The southern region of the country is famous for tropical fruits.
examples.zh: 該國的南部地區以熱帶水果聞名。

examples.en: Soybean milk is a popular drink for breakfast in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 豆漿是台灣很受歡迎的早餐飲料。

examples.en: Farmers in this region grow soybean crops every year.
examples.zh: 這個地區的農夫每年都種植大豆作物。

examples.en: Tofu is made from soybeans and is very nutritious.
examples.zh: 豆腐由黃豆製成，營養豐富。

examples.en: There is not enough space in my bedroom for a desk.
examples.zh: 我的臥室裡沒有足夠的空間放一張書桌。

examples.en: Astronauts travel into outer space to conduct scientific experiments.
examples.zh: 太空人前往外太空進行科學實驗。

examples.en: Please leave a blank space between these two sentences.
examples.zh: 請在這兩個句子之間空一格。

examples.en: Please speak more slowly so everyone can understand you.
examples.zh: 請說得慢一點，好讓大家都能聽懂你的話。

examples.en: She can speak both English and Japanese fluently.
examples.zh: 她能流利地說英語和日語。

examples.en: The guest speaker will speak about environmental conservation today.
examples.zh: 客座講者今天將就環境保護發表演講。

examples.en: The keynote speaker shared his inspiring story with the audience.
examples.zh: 主講嘉賓與聽眾分享了他鼓舞人心的故事。

examples.en: I bought a portable Bluetooth speaker for our outdoor picnic.
examples.zh: 我為我們的戶外野餐買了一個攜帶式藍芽喇叭。

examples.en: The sound quality of this new speaker is surprisingly good.
examples.zh: 這款新喇叭的音質好得令人驚訝。

examples.en: My grandmother cooked a special dinner for my birthday.
examples.zh: 我祖母為我的生日做了一頓特別的晚餐。

examples.en: This event requires special permission from the school principal.
examples.zh: 這項活動需要學校校長的特別許可。

examples.en: She has a special talent for playing the piano.
examples.zh: 她在彈鋼琴方面有著特別的天賦。

examples.en: The principal delivered an inspiring speech at the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 校長在畢業典禮上發表了一場鼓舞人心的演講。

examples.en: Her clear speech made it easy for everyone to understand.
examples.zh: 她清晰的言語讓每個人都很容易理解。

examples.en: He gave a humorous speech that made the audience laugh loudly.
examples.zh: 他發表了一場幽默的演說，讓觀眾大聲發笑。

examples.en: The driver reduced his speed as he approached the school zone.
examples.zh: 駕駛在靠近學校區域時降低了他的速度。

examples.en: A fast internet speed lets us watch videos smoothly.
examples.zh: 網路速度夠快，我們才能順暢地觀看影片。

examples.en: The wind speed reached dangerous levels during the sudden summer storm.
examples.zh: 風速在突如其來的夏季暴風雨期間達到了危險程度。

examples.en: Do not speed when driving through narrow residential streets at night.
examples.zh: 夜間開車穿過狹窄的住宅街區時不要超速。

examples.en: The ambulance began to speed through city traffic to the emergency room.
examples.zh: 救護車開始快速穿過城市交通趕往急診室。

examples.en: Time seems to speed by when you are having fun with friends.
examples.zh: 當你和朋友開心聚會時，時間似乎過得很快。

examples.en: How do you spell your last name correctly, please?
examples.zh: 請問你的姓氏正確要怎麼拼寫呢？

examples.en: Children learn to spell simple words in primary school.
examples.zh: 孩子們在小學學習拼寫簡單的單字。

examples.en: The teacher asked him to spell the difficult term.
examples.zh: 老師請他拼出那個困難的詞。

examples.en: The old witch cast a magic spell on the prince.
examples.zh: 老巫婆對王子施展了魔法咒語。

examples.en: We experienced a short spell of dry weather recently.
examples.zh: 我們最近經歷了一小段乾旱的天氣。

examples.en: She lived in Japan for a short spell after college.
examples.zh: 她大學畢業後在日本住了一小段時間。

examples.en: She checked her English essay for any spelling mistakes.
examples.zh: 她檢查了她的英文作文是否有任何拼字錯誤。

examples.en: His name has an unusual spelling that confuses many people.
examples.zh: 他的名字有一種特殊的拼法，讓許多人感到困惑。

examples.en: Good spelling is important when writing official business emails.
examples.zh: 撰寫正式的商務電子郵件時，正確的拼字非常重要。

examples.en: I usually spend two hours doing my homework after school every day.
examples.zh: 我每天放學後通常花兩個小時做作業。

examples.en: They decided to spend their summer holiday visiting traditional cultural sites.
examples.zh: 他們決定利用暑假去參觀傳統文化遺址。

examples.en: Do not spend too much money buying unnecessary electronic products online.
examples.zh: 不要花太多錢在網路上購買不必要的電子產品。

examples.en: A huge spider built a complex web in the garden corner.
examples.zh: 一隻大蜘蛛在花園角落織了一張複雜的網。

examples.en: My little brother is very afraid of spiders and insects.
examples.zh: 我的弟弟非常害怕蜘蛛和昆蟲。

examples.en: The spider crawled slowly across the bathroom wall this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上這隻蜘蛛慢慢地爬過浴室牆面。

examples.en: The team showed great fighting spirit throughout the tough match.
examples.zh: 該隊在整場艱苦的比賽中展現了高昂的鬥志。

examples.en: Although his body was weak, his spirit remained exceptionally strong.
examples.zh: 雖然他的身體虛弱，但他的心靈依然極為堅強。

examples.en: The festival filled the entire town with a joyful holiday spirit.
examples.zh: 慶典活動讓整個小鎮充滿了歡樂的節慶氣氛。

examples.en: She used a wooden spoon to stir the hot soup.
examples.zh: 她用木匙攪拌熱湯。

examples.en: Please pass me a clean spoon for the ice cream.
examples.zh: 請遞給我一支吃冰淇淋的乾淨湯匙。

examples.en: Use a small spoon to add sugar to the black tea.
examples.zh: 用一支小湯匙把糖加進紅茶裡。

examples.en: Basketball is a very popular sport among high schoolers.
examples.zh: 籃球是一項在高中生之間非常受歡迎的運動。

examples.en: Playing a sport regularly keeps your body strong.
examples.zh: 規律地從事一項運動，能讓你的身體保持強壯。

examples.en: Which sport do you like to play after school?
examples.zh: 你放學後喜歡玩哪一項運動？

examples.en: This scenic lake is a popular tourist spot in summer.
examples.zh: 這座風景優美的湖泊是夏季熱門的觀光地點。

examples.en: The leopard has dark spots all over its body.
examples.zh: 花豹全身長滿了黑色的斑點。

examples.en: She noticed a small spot on her white shirt.
examples.zh: 她注意到自己的白襯衫上有一個小污點。

examples.en: I managed to spot my friend in the crowded market.
examples.zh: 我成功在擁擠的市場裡看到了我的朋友。

examples.en: The hawk spotted a mouse moving in the grass.
examples.zh: 老鷹注意到在草叢中移動的老鼠。

examples.en: Can you spot the difference between these two pictures?
examples.zh: 你能發現這兩張圖片之間的差異嗎？

examples.en: The bird spread its wings and flew into the sky.
examples.zh: 這隻鳥張開翅膀飛向天空。

examples.en: She likes to spread butter on her warm toast.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在溫熱的吐司上抹奶油。

examples.en: News about the grand sale spread quickly across town.
examples.zh: 關於大特賣的消息迅速在鎮上傳開。

examples.en: She bought a jar of chocolate spread for her toast.
examples.zh: 她買了一罐巧克力抹醬來塗吐司。

examples.en: Health workers tried to stop the spread of disease.
examples.zh: 衛生工作者試圖阻止疾病的擴散。

examples.en: The magazine ran a two-page spread on summer fashion.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌刊登了夏季時尚的跨頁報導。

examples.en: Flowers bloom and trees turn green in early spring.
examples.zh: 早春時節百花盛開，樹木變綠。

examples.en: The mattress lost its bounce because a spring broke.
examples.zh: 由於彈簧斷裂，床墊失去了彈性。

examples.en: Animals come to drink clear water from the mountain spring.
examples.zh: 動物們前來飲用來自山泉的清澈泉水。

examples.en: The cat sprang onto the high kitchen counter suddenly.
examples.zh: 貓咪突然跳上了高高的廚房檯面。

examples.en: Water sprang up from the pipe when it broke.
examples.zh: 水管破裂時水噴湧而出。

examples.en: A brilliant idea suddenly sprang to mind.
examples.zh: 一個絕妙的點子突然浮現在腦海中。

examples.en: A square has four equal sides and four right angles.
examples.zh: 正方形有四條等長的邊和四個直角。

examples.en: People gathered in the public square to listen to music.
examples.zh: 人們聚集在公共廣場聆聽音樂。

examples.en: Draw a neat square on your grid paper with a ruler.
examples.zh: 用尺在網格紙上畫出一個整齊的正方形。

examples.en: The room has a square shape and high ceiling lighting.
examples.zh: 這間房間呈正方形形狀，並有高挑的頂燈。

examples.en: The apartment measures fifty square meters in total living space.
examples.zh: 這間公寓的總生活空間為五十平方公尺。

examples.en: He put his belongings in a square cardboard delivery box.
examples.zh: 他把物品放在一個正方形的紙箱裡。

examples.en: The actor stood in the middle of the stage and bowed.
examples.zh: 演員站在舞台中央並鞠躬。

examples.en: This product is still in the early stage of development.
examples.zh: 這項產品仍處於開發的早期階段。

examples.en: The band performed on the main stage at the festival.
examples.zh: 樂團在音樂節的主舞台上演出。

examples.en: The drama club decided to stage a new play this semester.
examples.zh: 話劇社決定這學期上演一部新劇。

examples.en: Local residents staged a peaceful protest against the project.
examples.zh: 當地居民發起了一場針對該計畫的和平抗議。

examples.en: The company staged a major launch event for its new phone.
examples.zh: 公司為其新手機籌劃了一場大型發布會。

examples.en: He slowly climbed the steep flight of stairs to the third floor.
examples.zh: 他慢慢爬上陡峭的樓梯到三樓。

examples.en: Please hold onto the handrail while walking down these slippery stairs.
examples.zh: 走下這些濕滑的樓梯時，請緊握扶手。

examples.en: A small toy was left sitting on the top stair near the door.
examples.zh: 門附近最上面的一階樓梯上擺放著一個小玩具。

examples.en: Don't forget to put a stamp on the envelope.
examples.zh: 別忘了在信封上貼郵票。

examples.en: The officer put an official stamp on my passport application.
examples.zh: 官員在我的護照申請表上蓋了官方印章。

examples.en: He has a large collection of rare postage stamps.
examples.zh: 他收集了大量珍貴的郵票。

examples.en: The officer stamped my passport when I arrived at the airport.
examples.zh: 我抵達機場時，官員在我的護照上蓋了章。

examples.en: The angry child stamped her foot on the floor.
examples.zh: 生氣的小孩在地板上跺腳。

examples.en: She stamped the letters before mailing them at the post office.
examples.zh: 她在去郵局寄信前，先把信貼好了郵票。

examples.en: Students stood up when the teacher entered the classroom.
examples.zh: 當老師進入教室時，學生們站了起來。

examples.en: The old wooden tower stands near the city park.
examples.zh: 這座老舊木塔位於城市公園附近。

examples.en: I cannot stand the noise from the construction site.
examples.zh: 我無法忍受來自施工現場的噪音。

examples.en: We bought fresh fruit from a street food stand.
examples.zh: 我們從街頭食品攤位買了新鮮水果。

examples.en: She put her coat on the tall wooden coat stand.
examples.zh: 她把大衣掛在高大的木質衣帽架上。

examples.en: The government took a firm stand against illegal hunting.
examples.zh: 政府對非法打獵採取了堅定的立場。

examples.en: The hotel maintains a high standard of customer service.
examples.zh: 這家飯店保持著高水準的顧客服務。

examples.en: We must follow the safety standard in this factory.
examples.zh: 我們在這間工廠必須遵守安全標準。

examples.en: Her work sets a new standard for quality design.
examples.zh: 她的作品為高品質設計樹立了新標準。

examples.en: This model is the standard version of the car.
examples.zh: 這個型號是該款汽車的標準版本。

examples.en: The test questions follow the standard high school curriculum.
examples.zh: 測驗題目符合一般的高中課程標準。

examples.en: Shipping takes three to five business days for standard delivery.
examples.zh: 標準運送需要三到五個工作天。

examples.en: The bright star shone in the clear night sky.
examples.zh: 明亮的星星在清澈的夜空中閃耀。

examples.en: She became a famous movie star at twenty.
examples.zh: 她在二十歲時成為著名的電影明星。

examples.en: Draw a star on the paper with a red pen.
examples.zh: 用紅筆在紙上畫一顆星星。

examples.en: She will star in a new comedy next year.
examples.zh: 她明年將主演一部新喜劇。

examples.en: The popular actor stars as a brave police officer.
examples.zh: 這位熱門演員飾演一名勇敢的警察。

examples.en: He starred in three major films last summer.
examples.zh: 他去年夏天主演了三部大片。

examples.en: The meeting will start at nine sharp tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 會議將在明天早上九點準時開始。

examples.en: He pressed the red button to start the engine.
examples.zh: 他按下紅鈕啟動引擎。

examples.en: We should start our journey early to avoid traffic.
examples.zh: 我們應該早點出發，以避開塞車。

examples.en: The team got off to a good start this season.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍在本賽季有了良好的開端。

examples.en: Rain delayed the start of the final baseball match.
examples.zh: 下雨使棒球決賽延後開始。

examples.en: Learning basic vocabulary is a great start for beginners.
examples.zh: 學習基礎單字對初學者來說是一個很好的開始。

examples.en: The old bridge is currently in a very dangerous state.
examples.zh: 這座老橋目前處於非常危險的狀態。

examples.en: California is the most populous state in the United States.
examples.zh: 加州是美國人口最多的州。

examples.en: The head of state visited several countries to improve relations.
examples.zh: 元首訪問了幾個國家以改善關係。

examples.en: Please state your name and address clearly for official record.
examples.zh: 請清楚陳述您的姓名與地址以供官方記錄。

examples.en: The document clearly states all requirements for this application.
examples.zh: 該文件明確說明了這項申請的所有要求。

examples.en: The witness stated that he saw the car run a red light.
examples.zh: 證人表示他看到那輛車闖紅燈。

examples.en: We met outside the busy train station in the morning.
examples.zh: 我們早上在繁忙的火車站外見面。

examples.en: The police station is located near the central city square.
examples.zh: 警察局位於中央城市廣場附近。

examples.en: She listens to her favorite radio station every day.
examples.zh: 她每天收聽她最喜歡的廣播電台。

examples.en: Guards were stationed at the entrance of the government building.
examples.zh: 警衛駐守在政府大樓的入口處。

examples.en: The young soldier was stationed abroad for two long years.
examples.zh: 這名年輕士兵被駐紮在國外長達兩年。

examples.en: Volunteers were stationed along the marathon route to provide water.
examples.zh: 志工被部署在馬拉松路線沿途提供水分。

examples.en: We plan to stay at a cozy hotel during our vacation in Yilan.
examples.zh: 我們計劃在宜蘭度假期間住宿在一家舒適的飯店。

examples.en: You should stay calm when facing unexpected difficulties in daily life.
examples.zh: 在日常生活中面對意外困難時，你應該保持冷靜。

examples.en: Please stay in your seat until the airplane stops completely.
examples.zh: 在飛機完全停止之前，請留在座位上。

examples.en: We enjoyed our brief stay at the quiet mountain village last week.
examples.zh: 我們上週在安靜的山村裡短暫的停留過得很愉快。

examples.en: Her stay in Tokyo was extended due to the sudden bad weather.
examples.zh: 由於突然的惡劣天氣，她在東京的逗留時間延長了。

examples.en: Thank you for making our stay at your home so comfortable.
examples.zh: 謝謝你讓我們在你家住宿得這麼舒服。

examples.en: He ordered a grilled steak with vegetables for dinner.
examples.zh: 他點了一份烤牛排配蔬菜當晚餐。

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for serving tender beef steak.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳以提供嫩牛肉排而聞名。

examples.en: My father cooks delicious pork steak on the weekend.
examples.zh: 我父親在週末會烹煮美味的豬排。

examples.en: The bridge was constructed using heavy steel beams.
examples.zh: 這座橋樑是使用重型鋼鐵樑建造的。

examples.en: Stainless steel knives are widely used in kitchens.
examples.zh: 不鏽鋼刀具廣泛用於廚房。

examples.en: The local factory produces tons of industrial steel monthly.
examples.zh: 當地工廠每月生產數噸工業鋼鐵。

examples.en: He took a cautious step forward into the dark quiet room.
examples.zh: 他謹慎地往前走了一步，踏入黑暗安靜的房間。

examples.en: Planning your monthly budget is an important step toward financial independence.
examples.zh: 規劃每月預算是邁向財務獨立的重要步驟。

examples.en: She sat on the front step waiting for her friend.
examples.zh: 她坐在前門台階上等待她的朋友。

examples.en: Please watch out so you do not step on the wet paint.
examples.zh: 請小心，不要踩到未乾的油漆。

examples.en: She stepped onto the stage and delivered a confident graduation speech.
examples.zh: 她踏上舞台，發表了一篇自信的畢業演講。

examples.en: He stepped back to let the elderly woman pass through first.
examples.zh: 他往後退了一步，讓那位年長女士先通過。

examples.en: The dog ran after the wooden stick thrown by its owner.
examples.zh: 狗狗追著主人丟出去的木棍。

examples.en: Children collected dry sticks to build a campfire.
examples.zh: 孩子們收集乾樹枝來搭營火。

examples.en: He picked up a long stick to help him walk up the hill.
examples.zh: 他拾起一根長棍子來輔助他爬山。

examples.en: Please stick the poster on the wall with tape.
examples.zh: 請用膠帶把海報貼在牆上。

examples.en: The paper stuck to the bottom of his wet shoe.
examples.zh: 紙張黏在他濕答答的鞋底上。

examples.en: The drawer got stuck and I could not open it.
examples.zh: 抽屜卡住了，我打不開它。

examples.en: Although it was raining, they still decided to go hiking.
examples.zh: 儘管下著雨，他們依然決定去健行。

examples.en: My grandmother is eighty years old and still enjoys gardening.
examples.zh: 我的祖母八十歲了，仍然喜歡園藝。

examples.en: Do you still remember where we parked our car this morning?
examples.zh: 你還記得我們今天早上把車停在哪裡嗎？

examples.en: Stand still while I take a picture of you with my camera.
examples.zh: 當我用相機為你拍照時，請站著別動。

examples.en: The water in the lake was completely still this early morning.
examples.zh: 一大清早，湖水非常平靜。

examples.en: Keep still so the doctor can examine your injury carefully.
examples.zh: 保持靜止，這樣醫生才能仔細檢查你的傷勢。

examples.en: Your dirty socks stink so much that you should wash them.
examples.zh: 你的髒襪子臭死了，你應該洗洗它們。

examples.en: The trash bin began to stink after standing in hot sun.
examples.zh: 垃圾桶在大太陽下放了一陣子後開始發臭。

examples.en: The rotten fish in the refrigerator stinks up the whole kitchen.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡腐壞的魚把整個廚房弄得臭氣沖天。

examples.en: There was a terrible stink coming from the garbage room downstairs.
examples.zh: 樓下的垃圾房傳來一股可怕的惡臭。

examples.en: The chemical smell left a strong stink in the small bathroom.
examples.zh: 化學藥品的氣味在小浴室裡留下了濃烈的臭味。

examples.en: A strong stink filled the air near the polluted local river.
examples.zh: 受污染的當地河流附近的空氣中瀰漫著濃烈的臭味。

examples.en: He had a terrible stomachache after eating too much ice cream.
examples.zh: 他吃了太多冰淇淋後，胃痛得很厲害。

examples.en: The doctor gave her some medicine for her stomachache.
examples.zh: 醫生開了一些治胃痛的藥給她。

examples.en: Drinking warm water can sometimes help lessen a sudden stomachache.
examples.zh: 喝溫水有時有助於減輕突然發作的胃痛。

examples.en: Children threw small stones into the calm river water.
examples.zh: 孩子們把小石頭扔進平靜的河水裡。

examples.en: The ancient castle was built with heavy gray stone blocks.
examples.zh: 這座古老的城堡是用沉重的灰色石塊建造的。

examples.en: Remove the hard stone before eating the juicy peach.
examples.zh: 吃多汁的蜜桃前請先把硬果核去除。

examples.en: The red traffic light indicates that drivers must stop their vehicles completely.
examples.zh: 紅色的交通信號燈表示駕駛人必須完全停下車輛。

examples.en: Rain finally stopped falling after three continuous days of heavy downpours.
examples.zh: 連續下了三天的大雨後，雨終於停了。

examples.en: Nothing could stop the enthusiastic crowd from cheering for their athletic team.
examples.zh: 沒有什麼能阻止熱情的群眾為他們的運動隊伍加油。

examples.en: Get off the bus at the next stop near the city library.
examples.zh: 請在市立圖書館附近的下一個公車站下車。

examples.en: The sudden stop of the elevator caused a brief moment of panic.
examples.zh: 電梯突然停住，造成了短暫的恐慌。

examples.en: Our train will make a brief five-minute stop at the central station.
examples.zh: 我們的列車將在中央車站作短暫的五分鐘停靠。

examples.en: She bought some fresh fruit from the grocery store near home.
examples.zh: 她從家附近的雜貨店買了一些新鮮水果。

examples.en: The clothing store offers a wide range of stylish summer dresses.
examples.zh: 這家服飾店提供各式各樣時尚的夏日洋裝。

examples.en: This convenience store is open twenty-four hours a day.
examples.zh: 這間便利商店二十四小時營業。

examples.en: You should store extra food in a clean and dry place.
examples.zh: 你應該把多餘的食物儲存在乾淨乾燥的地方。

examples.en: Computers store vast amounts of digital information in servers.
examples.zh: 電腦將大量的數位資訊儲存在伺服器中。

examples.en: Squirrels gather and store nuts in tree trunks before winter arrives.
examples.zh: 松鼠在冬天來臨前收集並將堅果儲存在樹幹裡。

examples.en: The heavy storm knocked down several big trees last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚強烈的暴風雨刮倒了幾棵大樹。

examples.en: Ship captains were warned of an approaching storm at sea.
examples.zh: 船長們接獲了海上風暴即將來襲的警告。

examples.en: We stayed safely indoors during the sudden storm.
examples.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨期間，我們安全地待在室內。

examples.en: He stormed out of the office after an argument.
examples.zh: 爭吵過後，他氣衝衝地衝出了辦公室。

examples.en: Hundreds of fans stormed the stage to meet their favorite singer.
examples.zh: 數百名粉絲衝上舞台，想見他們最喜歡的歌手。

examples.en: She stormed into the room demanding a quick response.
examples.zh: 她氣衝衝地闖進房間要求快速回應。

examples.en: My grandmother tells us an interesting bedtime story every night.
examples.zh: 我的祖母每天晚上都會講一個有趣的故事給我們聽。

examples.en: The journalist wrote an inspiring story about local volunteer work.
examples.zh: 該記者寫了一篇關於在地志工工作的感人報導。

examples.en: They live in a tall apartment building with twenty stories.
examples.zh: 他們住在一棟二十個樓層的高樓公寓裡。

examples.en: Draw a straight line between these two points.
examples.zh: 在這兩點之間畫出一條直線。

examples.en: He has naturally straight black hair.
examples.zh: 他擁有天生的烏黑直髮。

examples.en: Give me a straight answer without hiding the truth.
examples.zh: 給我一個直截了當的答案，不要隱瞞真相。

examples.en: Go straight down this street and turn left.
examples.zh: 沿著這條街筆直往前走然後左轉。

examples.en: She walked straight into the office without knocking.
examples.zh: 她沒有敲門就直接走進了辦公室。

examples.en: He went straight to sleep after returning home.
examples.zh: 他回家後就直接去睡覺了。

examples.en: I heard a strange noise coming from the basement.
examples.zh: 我聽到地下室傳來一陣奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: Walking in a strange city at night feels scary.
examples.zh: 夜晚走在陌生的城市裡感覺很可怕。

examples.en: It feels strange to wear heavy coats in spring.
examples.zh: 春天穿著厚重的大衣感覺很奇怪。

examples.en: Parents always advise young kids not to talk to strangers.
examples.zh: 父母總是建議幼童不要跟陌生人說話。

examples.en: A polite stranger gave me directions to the nearest subway station.
examples.zh: 一位有禮貌的陌生人指引我去最近的捷運站。

examples.en: When I first moved here, I felt like a stranger.
examples.zh: 當我剛搬到這裡時，我覺得自己像個陌生人。

examples.en: She ordered a slice of fresh strawberry cake at the cafe.
examples.zh: 她在咖啡廳點了一塊新鮮的草莓蛋糕。

examples.en: Children enjoyed picking fresh red strawberries at the farm on weekends.
examples.zh: 孩子們週末在農場開心採摘新鮮的紅草莓。

examples.en: Strawberry ice cream is her absolute favorite flavor in the summer.
examples.zh: 草莓冰淇淋是她夏天絕對的最愛口味。

examples.en: They sat by the stream and enjoyed the fresh air.
examples.zh: 他們坐在小溪邊，享受著新鮮的空氣。

examples.en: Clear water flows quickly down the rocky mountain stream.
examples.zh: 清澈的水迅速地流過多石的山間溪流。

examples.en: Children love to play in the shallow stream during summer.
examples.zh: 夏天時，孩子們喜歡在淺淺的溪流裡玩耍。

examples.en: Tears began to stream down her face upon hearing the news.
examples.zh: 一聽到這個消息，眼淚就開始從她臉上流下來。

examples.en: Millions of users stream music on their smartphones every day.
examples.zh: 每天有數百萬使用者在智慧型手機上串流音樂。

examples.en: Sunlight continued to stream through the large living room window.
examples.zh: 陽光持續透過客廳的大窗戶照射進來。

examples.en: The busy street was lined with small local shops.
examples.zh: 繁忙的街道兩旁林立著當地的店家。

examples.en: Look both ways before crossing the busy main street.
examples.zh: 穿過繁忙的主幹道路之前要先看兩邊。

examples.en: Children were happily playing in the quiet residential street.
examples.zh: 孩子們在安靜的住宅區街道上歡快地玩耍。

examples.en: Regular exercise is a great way to relieve stress.
examples.zh: 定期運動是減輕壓力的好方法。

examples.en: Financial stress can cause severe sleep problems for adults.
examples.zh: 財務壓力會給成年人造成嚴重的睡眠問題。

examples.en: The teacher laid stress on the key exam points.
examples.zh: 老師強調了考試的重點事項。

examples.en: The speaker stressed the importance of daily practice.
examples.zh: 講者強調了每日練習的重要性。

examples.en: Don't stress yourself over small mistakes.
examples.zh: 不要為了小錯誤而給自己壓力。

examples.en: He stressed that all safety rules must be followed.
examples.zh: 他強調所有安全規則都必須被遵守。

examples.en: It is important to stretch your muscles before exercising.
examples.zh: 運動前伸展肌肉非常重要。

examples.en: The broad highway stretches for miles across the flat desert.
examples.zh: 這條寬廣的高速公路跨越平坦的沙漠延伸數英里。

examples.en: She stretched out her arms and yawned lazily this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上伸展雙臂，懶洋洋地打哈欠。

examples.en: A simple morning stretch helps relax tight neck muscles.
examples.zh: 簡單的晨間伸展有助於放鬆緊繃的頸部肌肉。

examples.en: Drivers should rest after a long stretch of highway driving.
examples.zh: 駕駛在高速公路上長途開車後應該休息。

examples.en: We walked along a peaceful stretch of sandy beach yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天沿著一段寧靜的沙灘散步。

examples.en: Our school library has strict rules about keeping noise levels down.
examples.zh: 我們學校的圖書館對於保持安靜有嚴格的規定。

examples.en: His parents are very strict about finishing homework before playing games.
examples.zh: 他的父母對於打電玩前要先完成功課非常嚴格。

examples.en: The coach enforced a strict training schedule for all basketball team members.
examples.zh: 教練對所有籃球隊員執行了嚴格的訓練日程表。

examples.en: A strong earthquake struck the island early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天清晨強震襲擊了這個島嶼。

examples.en: The grandfather clock strikes twelve times every midnight.
examples.zh: 這座老爺鐘每天午夜會敲響十二下。

examples.en: Factory workers decided to strike for higher wages.
examples.zh: 工廠工人決定罷工以爭取更高薪資。

examples.en: The train strike caused severe traffic problems today.
examples.zh: 火車罷工今天造成了嚴重的交通問題。

examples.en: The workers organized a peaceful strike to demand better conditions.
examples.zh: 工人組織了一場和平罷工，以要求更好的條件。

examples.en: The bowling player got a strike on his first turn.
examples.zh: 這位保齡球選手在第一局就打出了全倒。

examples.en: She tied the package tightly with a piece of strong string.
examples.zh: 她用一段堅固的細繩把包裹緊緊繫住。

examples.en: The kite lost control when its long string snapped in the wind.
examples.zh: 當長線在風中斷裂時，風箏失去了控制。

examples.en: He carefully replaced the broken string on his acoustic guitar.
examples.zh: 他仔細更換了原聲吉他上斷掉的琴弦。

examples.en: He exercises every day to build a strong and healthy body.
examples.zh: 他每天運動以建立強壯健康的身體。

examples.en: A strong wind blew away several hats on the beach.
examples.zh: 一陣強風吹走了海灘上的幾頂帽子。

examples.en: The building was constructed with strong materials to resist earthquakes.
examples.zh: 這棟建築是用堅固的材料建造的，以抵禦地震。

examples.en: The business struggled to survive during the economic downturn.
examples.zh: 這家企業在經濟不景氣期間努力掙扎求生。

examples.en: Many students struggle with difficult calculus math problems.
examples.zh: 許多學生在面對艱難的微積分數學題目時感到掙扎。

examples.en: He struggled to open the tight lid of the jar.
examples.zh: 他費了好大的勁才打開罐子緊閉的蓋子。

examples.en: For him, achieving success was a long and difficult struggle.
examples.zh: 對他而言，取得成功是一場漫長而艱辛的奮鬥。

examples.en: Freedom of speech was gained through a historical struggle.
examples.zh: 言論自由是透過歷史性的奮鬥爭取來的。

examples.en: The fish put up a strong struggle before being caught.
examples.zh: 這條魚在被捕獲前進行了強烈的掙扎。

examples.en: Every student in our class was eager to learn English.
examples.zh: 我們班上的每一位學生都渴望學習英文。

examples.en: She is a hardworking medical student at National Taiwan University.
examples.zh: 她是國立台灣大學一名努力的醫學生。

examples.en: The school library was filled with quiet students preparing for exams.
examples.zh: 學校圖書館裡擠滿了安靜準備考試的學生。

examples.en: Students need to study hard to pass the final exam successfully.
examples.zh: 學生需要努力研讀才能成功通過期末考。

examples.en: Scientists study the effects of climate change on coral reefs.
examples.zh: 科學家研究氣候變遷對珊瑚礁的影響。

examples.en: She plans to study abroad at a famous foreign university next year.
examples.zh: 她計劃明年到國外一所知名大學留學。

examples.en: The recent medical study highlights the benefits of drinking sufficient water.
examples.zh: 最近的醫學研究強調了喝足夠水的好處。

examples.en: My father likes to read in his quiet study after dinner.
examples.zh: 我父親喜歡晚餐後在安靜的書房裡看書。

examples.en: The professor published a comprehensive study on local wildlife preservation methods.
examples.zh: 教授發表了一篇關於在地野生動物保護方法的全面研究。

examples.en: Making such a careless mistake was really a stupid idea.
examples.zh: 犯下這樣粗心的錯誤真的是個愚蠢的主意。

examples.en: Don't feel stupid just because you missed one single question.
examples.zh: 不要只因為答錯了一道題就覺得自己很傻。

examples.en: He regretted saying those stupid words during the argument yesterday.
examples.zh: 他後悔昨天在爭吵中說了那些愚蠢的話。

examples.en: She loves modern clothing design and has good personal style.
examples.zh: 她熱愛現代服裝設計，並擁有良好的個人風格。

examples.en: The ancient building was constructed in a traditional Asian style.
examples.zh: 這座古老的建築是以傳統亞洲風格建造的。

examples.en: Loose jeans are coming back into style among young students.
examples.zh: 寬鬆牛仔褲在年輕學生之間再次流行起來。

examples.en: The hairdresser styled her hair for the upcoming wedding.
examples.zh: 美髮師為她整理髮型，準備即將舉行的婚禮。

examples.en: She styled the photo shoot with colorful vintage clothing items.
examples.zh: 她用色彩繽紛的復古服飾單品為這場拍攝做造型。

examples.en: He styled his hair with gel before going to the party.
examples.zh: 他在去派對前用髮膠整理了造型。

examples.en: Math is my favorite subject at secondary school.
examples.zh: 數學是我中學最喜歡的科目。

examples.en: They discussed the main subject of the new movie.
examples.zh: 他們討論了這部新電影的主要主題。

examples.en: Find the subject of the sentence in this grammar test.
examples.zh: 在這個文法測驗中找出句子的主詞。

examples.en: If you practice diligently, you will succeed in time.
examples.zh: 如果你勤奮地練習，你終究會成功的。

examples.en: Her hard work helped her succeed in the business world.
examples.zh: 她的努力工作幫助她在商業世界中取得成功。

examples.en: The young prince will succeed his father as king.
examples.zh: 那位年輕的王子將會繼承他的父親成為國王。
