examples.en: Hard work and perseverance are key elements for achieving success.
examples.zh: 努力與堅持是取得成功的關鍵要素。

examples.en: The school charity concert was a huge success last weekend.
examples.zh: 這場學校慈善音樂會上週末獲得了巨大的成功。

examples.en: Her new business venture proved to be a remarkable success.
examples.zh: 她的新創事業被證明是一次卓越的成功。

examples.en: After years of hard work, she became a successful businesswoman.
examples.zh: 經過多年的努力，她成為一位成功的企業家。

examples.en: The school held a very successful science fair last week.
examples.zh: 上週學校舉辦了一場非常成功的科學展覽。

examples.en: With proper planning, your project will surely be successful.
examples.zh: 有了適當的規劃，你的計畫一定會成功。

examples.en: It was such a beautiful day that we decided to picnic.
examples.zh: 天氣太好了，以致於我們決定去野餐。

examples.en: I have never seen such large trees in my whole life.
examples.zh: 我這輩子從來沒有見過這麼巨大的樹木。

examples.en: Why are you in such a hurry to leave the party?
examples.zh: 你為什麼這麼急著要離開派對？

examples.en: A sudden noise from the street startled everyone inside.
examples.zh: 街上突然發出的聲音嚇到了裡面的每個人。

examples.en: The sudden change in weather caught the hikers without umbrellas.
examples.zh: 天氣的突然變化讓沒帶傘的登山者猝不及防。

examples.en: His sudden decision to resign surprised all his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他突然決定辭職震驚了所有同事。

examples.en: Please add a spoonful of sugar to my black coffee.
examples.zh: 請在我的黑咖啡裡加一匙糖。

examples.en: Eating too much sugar can lead to dental and health problems.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖會導致牙齒和健康問題。

examples.en: This sweet fruit juice contains no added sugar at all.
examples.zh: 這款甜水果汁完全不含添加糖。

examples.en: I suggest taking the subway to avoid heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 我建議搭乘捷運以避免繁忙的交通。

examples.en: Doctors suggest drinking plenty of water during hot summer.
examples.zh: 醫生建議在炎熱的夏天多喝水。

examples.en: The dark clouds suggest that a storm is coming.
examples.zh: 烏雲暗示著暴風雨即將來臨。

examples.en: He wore a formal black suit to the job interview.
examples.zh: 他穿著一套正式的黑色西裝去參加求職面試。

examples.en: She bought a stylish business suit for her new office job.
examples.zh: 她為新的辦公室工作買了一套時尚的商務套裝。

examples.en: The court dismissed the civil suit due to a lack of evidence.
examples.zh: 法院因缺乏證據駁回了這起民事訴訟。

examples.en: Does this meeting time suit everyone on our team?
examples.zh: 這個開會時間適合我們團隊的每一個人嗎？

examples.en: Bright blue suits her skin tone very well.
examples.zh: 鮮藍色非常適合她的膚色。

examples.en: This flexible work schedule suits parents with young children well.
examples.zh: 這種彈性工作時間非常適合育有幼童的家長。

examples.en: This movie is not suitable for young children due to scary scenes.
examples.zh: 由於恐怖場面，這部電影不適合幼童觀看。

examples.en: She found a suitable venue for her sister's birthday party.
examples.zh: 她為妹妹的生日派對找到了一個合適的場地。

examples.en: Wear comfortable shoes that are suitable for walking on rocky trails.
examples.zh: 請穿著適合在多石小徑上行走的舒適鞋子。

examples.en: The sun shines brightly in the clear blue sky.
examples.zh: 太陽在晴朗的藍天中明亮地照耀著。

examples.en: We sat on the balcony to enjoy the afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 我們坐在陽台上享受下午的陽光。

examples.en: The sun sets early in the evening during the winter season.
examples.zh: 冬天時太陽在傍晚很早就會落下。

examples.en: It is a beautiful sunny morning, perfect for an outdoor picnic.
examples.zh: 這是一個美麗晴朗的早晨，非常適合戶外野餐。

examples.en: We sat in the sunny garden to enjoy our hot morning tea.
examples.zh: 我們坐在陽光充足的庭園裡享用熱晨茶。

examples.en: The weather forecast says it will be sunny all weekend.
examples.zh: 天氣預報說整個週末都會是晴天。

examples.en: We had a super time at the amusement park last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末在遊樂園過得極為愉快。

examples.en: She did a super job on her final presentation yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她昨天下午的期末簡報做得極好。

examples.en: The new supermarket offers super discounts on fresh organic vegetables.
examples.zh: 這家新超市提供新鮮有機蔬菜的超級優惠。

examples.en: I am super excited about our upcoming trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 我對我們即將到來的日本之行感到非常興奮。

examples.en: The restaurant was super busy during the Sunday dinner hours.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳在週日晚餐時段非常繁忙。

examples.en: This math problem is super easy to solve once you understand.
examples.zh: 一旦你理解了，這道數學題就非常容易解答。

examples.en: My mother goes to the local supermarket to buy fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 我母親去當地的超級市場購買新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: The supermarket offers discounts on fresh milk every Tuesday.
examples.zh: 這家超級市場每週二提供鮮奶折扣。

examples.en: We bought snacks and drinks at the supermarket before the trip.
examples.zh: 我們在旅行前於超級市場買了零食和飲料。

examples.en: The whole family sat together and enjoyed a light supper.
examples.zh: 全家人坐在一起享用簡單的晚餐。

examples.en: What would you like to eat for supper this evening?
examples.zh: 你今晚晚餐想吃什麼？

examples.en: She cooked hot noodle soup for a late-night supper after work.
examples.zh: 她在下班後煮了熱麵湯當宵夜。

examples.en: The freshwater supply in the region was limited during the hot summer.
examples.zh: 該地區的淡水供應在炎熱的夏季十分有限。

examples.en: Volunteers delivered emergency food supplies to the mountain disaster area.
examples.zh: 志工將緊急食品物資運送到山區災區。

examples.en: There is a large supply of paper in the office storage room.
examples.zh: 辦公室儲藏室裡有大量的紙張存貨。

examples.en: The local farm supplies fresh organic milk to nearby supermarkets daily.
examples.zh: 當地農場每天向附近的超市供應新鮮有機牛奶。

examples.en: Solar panels supply clean electricity to the whole school building.
examples.zh: 太陽能板為整棟校舍提供潔淨的電力。

examples.en: The government supplied water filters to families affected by pollution.
examples.zh: 政府向受污染影響的家庭提供了水過濾器。

examples.en: Family members always support each other during difficult times in life.
examples.zh: 家庭成員在生活的困難時期總是互相支持。

examples.en: Strong wooden pillars support the heavy roof of the historic building.
examples.zh: 堅固的木柱支撐著這座歷史建築沉重的屋頂。

examples.en: Local businesses support community sports events for kids.
examples.zh: 在地企業支持兒童的社區體育活動。

examples.en: The proposal received strong support from all members of the council.
examples.zh: 該提案獲得了委員會所有成員的強烈支持。

examples.en: Thank you for your kind support during my stay in the hospital.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在我住院期間的支持。

examples.en: Steel beams provide strong support for the new bridge.
examples.zh: 鋼樑為這座新橋提供堅固的支撐。

examples.en: I suppose we should leave early to avoid traffic jams.
examples.zh: 我猜想我們應該提早出發以避免塞車。

examples.en: What do you suppose happened to the missing library book?
examples.zh: 你認為那本遺失的圖書館書籍發生了什麼事？

examples.en: Let us suppose for a moment that his theory is correct.
examples.zh: 讓我們暫且假定他的理論是正確的。

examples.en: Are you sure that you turned off the oven?
examples.zh: 你確信你已經關掉烤箱了嗎？

examples.en: He is sure to pass because he works hard.
examples.zh: 他一定會通過的，因為他非常努力。

examples.en: Make sure to check your answers before submitting the test.
examples.zh: 在交卷前，請務必確認你的答案。

examples.en: I sure hope that the weather stays nice tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我確實希望明天天氣能保持良好。

examples.en: Can you help me? Sure, no problem at all!
examples.zh: 你能幫我嗎？當然，一點問題都沒有！

examples.en: That sure was an exciting football game we watched.
examples.zh: 我們看的這場足球賽確實非常刺激。

examples.en: Many young people love to surf at the beach on weekends.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人喜歡在週末去海灘衝浪。

examples.en: He usually surfs the internet for news while eating his breakfast.
examples.zh: 他通常一邊吃早餐，一邊上網瀏覽新聞。

examples.en: She learned how to surf big ocean waves during summer vacation.
examples.zh: 她在暑假期間學會了如何在海洋大浪中衝浪。

examples.en: The sound of the ocean surf was relaxing as night fell.
examples.zh: 隨著夜幕降臨，海洋浪花的聲音令人放鬆。

examples.en: Children played safely near the edge of the surf.
examples.zh: 孩子們在浪花邊緣安全地玩耍。

examples.en: The heavy surf crashed against the high rocks along the coastline.
examples.zh: 洶湧的海浪猛烈撞擊著海岸線旁的高石。

examples.en: The surface of the quiet lake was as smooth as glass.
examples.zh: 平靜的湖面像玻璃一樣光滑。

examples.en: Please wipe the dusty table surface clean with a wet cloth.
examples.zh: 請用濕布把滿是灰塵的桌子表面擦乾淨。

examples.en: Rough surfaces increase friction when objects move across them.
examples.zh: 粗糙的表面會在物體移動時增加摩擦力。

examples.en: The submarine slowly surfaced after completing its underwater training.
examples.zh: 這艘潛水艇在完成水下訓練後慢慢浮出水面。

examples.en: New evidence surfaced during the second investigation of the case.
examples.zh: 在該案的第二次調查中顯露出了新的證據。

examples.en: The swimmer surfaced to take a deep breath of air.
examples.zh: 游泳者浮出水面吸了一大口空氣。

examples.en: Her friends planned a wonderful surprise party for her birthday.
examples.zh: 她的朋友為她的生日策劃了一場美好的驚喜派對。

examples.en: To my great surprise, he remembered my name after many years.
examples.zh: 令我非常驚奇的是，多年後他還記得我的名字。

examples.en: The unexpected news was a big surprise to everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 這項出乎意料的消息對房間裡的每個人來說都是個大驚喜。

examples.en: The news surprised everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 這個消息讓辦公室裡的每個人都很驚訝。

examples.en: He wanted to surprise his mother with a bouquet of flowers.
examples.zh: 他想用一束鮮花給母親一個驚喜。

examples.en: Her high test score surprised both her parents and teachers.
examples.zh: 她高分的考試成績讓父母和老師都感到驚訝。

examples.en: I was very surprised by the unexpected birthday party my friends threw.
examples.zh: 我對朋友舉辦的意想之外的生日派對感到非常驚訝。

examples.en: The teacher was surprised to see all students finish the test early.
examples.zh: 老師很吃驚看到所有學生都提早完成了測驗。

examples.en: She looked surprised when she heard the news about winning the contest.
examples.zh: 當她聽到關於贏得比賽的消息時，看起來很吃驚。

examples.en: Clean drinking water is essential for human survival.
examples.zh: 乾淨的飲用水對人類的生存至關重要。

examples.en: Warm clothes are vital for survival in cold weather.
examples.zh: 保暖的衣服是在寒冷天氣中生存的關鍵。

examples.en: They took a basic outdoor survival course last month.
examples.zh: 他們上個月參加了一堂基礎戶外生存課程。

examples.en: Few plants can survive in such a dry desert.
examples.zh: 很少有植物能在如此乾燥的沙漠中存活。

examples.en: The passenger survived the serious car accident without injuries.
examples.zh: 乘客在嚴重的車禍中倖存且沒有受傷。

examples.en: Small businesses struggled to survive during the economic crisis.
examples.zh: 小企業在經濟危機期間掙扎求生。

examples.en: Take a sip of water to help swallow the pill.
examples.zh: 喝一口水來幫助吞下藥丸。

examples.en: The snake can swallow animals much larger than its head.
examples.zh: 這條蛇能吞下比牠頭部大許多的動物。

examples.en: He was so thirsty that he swallowed the water quickly.
examples.zh: 他太渴了，以至於快速吞下了水。

examples.en: A swallow built its nest under the roof of our porch.
examples.zh: 一隻燕子在我們門廊的屋簷下築巢。

examples.en: We saw a flock of swallows flying across the evening sky.
examples.zh: 我們看到一群燕子飛過傍晚的天空。

examples.en: The swallow is a migratory bird that returns in spring.
examples.zh: 燕子是一種在春天返回的候鳥。

examples.en: She wore a warm wool sweater to keep out the cold winter wind.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件溫暖的羊毛衣以禦寒冷的冬風。

examples.en: My grandmother knitted a soft blue sweater for my little cousin.
examples.zh: 我祖母為我的小表弟編織了一件柔軟的藍色毛衣。

examples.en: You should bring a heavy sweater when traveling to the mountains.
examples.zh: 當去山區旅行時，你應該帶一件厚毛衣。

examples.en: Please sweep the floor before the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 請在客人到達前掃地。

examples.en: She swept the fallen leaves off the porch.
examples.zh: 她把門廊上的落葉掃乾淨。

examples.en: He used a broom to sweep the sidewalk daily.
examples.zh: 他每天用掃帚清掃人行道。

examples.en: Give the dusty living room a quick sweep today.
examples.zh: 今天給充滿灰塵的客廳快速打掃一下。

examples.en: She finished the morning sweep before opening the shop.
examples.zh: 她在開店前完成了早晨的掃除。

examples.en: After a quick sweep, the classroom looked clean again.
examples.zh: 快速打掃一下之後，教室又變乾淨了。

examples.en: The ripe red strawberries tasted fresh and sweet after the rain.
examples.zh: 成熟的紅草莓在雨後吃起來新鮮又甜。

examples.en: She left a sweet note on the fridge for her husband.
examples.zh: 她在冰箱上留了一張貼心的字條給她的丈夫。

examples.en: The garden was filled with the sweet smell of blooming white flowers.
examples.zh: 花園裡充滿了盛開白花的芳香氣味。

examples.en: Children love buying colorful sweets from the local candy shop nearby.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡從附近在地糖果店購買色彩繽紛的糖果。

examples.en: Eating too many sweets after dinner is not healthy for kids.
examples.zh: 晚餐後吃太多甜食對小孩健康不好。

examples.en: She offered a small sweet to every guest at her party.
examples.zh: 她在她舉辦的派對上給每位客人提供了一顆小糖果。

examples.en: We like to swim in the outdoor pool on hot summer days.
examples.zh: 我們喜歡在炎熱的夏天到戶外泳池游泳。

examples.en: He learned how to swim when he was seven years old.
examples.zh: 他七歲時學會了游泳。

examples.en: The wild ducks swim peacefully across the calm blue lake.
examples.zh: 野鴨悠閒地游過寧靜的藍色湖面。

examples.en: Let's go for a refreshing swim after our exam.
examples.zh: 讓我們在結束考試後去暢快地游個泳吧。

examples.en: A morning swim always leaves me feeling energetic for the day.
examples.zh: 早晨的游泳總能讓我一整天都感到精力充沛。

examples.en: They took a short swim in the clear ocean water yesterday.
examples.zh: 他們昨天在清澈的海水裡短暫地游了泳。

examples.en: Do not forget to pack your swimsuit for the beach vacation.
examples.zh: 去海邊度假時別忘了打包你的泳衣。

examples.en: She bought a new red swimsuit for the summer pool party.
examples.zh: 她為夏日泳池派對買了一件新的紅色泳衣。

examples.en: He put on his swimsuit and jumped into the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 他穿上泳衣，跳進了游泳池。

examples.en: The monkey began to swing from branch to branch smoothly.
examples.zh: 猴子開始流暢地在樹枝間擺動。

examples.en: He swung his baseball bat as hard as he could.
examples.zh: 他盡全力揮動他的棒球棒。

examples.en: The pendulum of the clock continues to swing back and forth.
examples.zh: 鐘擺持續前後搖擺。

examples.en: The kids love to play on the swing at the park.
examples.zh: 小孩喜歡在公園玩鞦韆。

examples.en: With one powerful swing, he hit the golf ball far.
examples.zh: 憑藉一次強有力的揮桿，他把高爾夫球打得很遠。

examples.en: There has been a huge swing in public opinion recently.
examples.zh: 最近公眾輿論發生了巨大的轉變。

examples.en: The dove is widely recognized as a symbol of peace.
examples.zh: 鴿子被廣泛視為和平的象徵。

examples.en: Chemical symbols are used to represent elements on the periodic table.
examples.zh: 化學符號用於代表元素週期表上的元素。

examples.en: The red heart is a common symbol for expressing love.
examples.zh: 紅心是表達愛的常見標誌。

examples.en: The school updated its computer system to improve network security.
examples.zh: 學校更新了其電腦系統以提升網路安全。

examples.en: Taiwan has an efficient public transportation system across major cities.
examples.zh: 台灣在主要城市擁有高效的大眾運輸系統。

examples.en: The human immune system protects the body against dangerous infections.
examples.zh: 人體免疫系統保護身體免受危險感染。

examples.en: He wore a casual white t-shirt and blue jeans.
examples.zh: 他穿著一件休閒的白色T恤和藍色牛仔褲。

examples.en: I bought a comfortable cotton t-shirt at the mall.
examples.zh: 我在購物中心買了一件舒適的棉質T恤。

examples.en: She likes to wear a simple t-shirt in the summer.
examples.zh: 她夏天喜歡穿簡單的T恤。

examples.en: Please clear your books off the dining table before we serve dinner.
examples.zh: 在我們端上晚餐前，請清理掉餐桌上的書本。

examples.en: The statistical data is neatly summarized in the table on page ten.
examples.zh: 統計數據簡潔地總結在第十頁的表格中。

examples.en: We reserved a window table at the restaurant for our anniversary dinner.
examples.zh: 我們在餐廳預訂了靠窗的桌子來吃我們的週年晚餐。

examples.en: The happy dog wagged its tail when its owner returned home tonight.
examples.zh: 這隻快樂的狗在主人今晚回家時搖了搖尾巴。

examples.en: Cats often use their long tails to maintain balance while walking on walls.
examples.zh: 貓咪在牆上行走時，經常使用長尾巴來保持平衡。

examples.en: The monkey wrapped its flexible tail around the thick branch securely.
examples.zh: 這隻猴子用靈活的尾巴緊緊纏住粗壯的樹枝。

examples.en: Please take an umbrella with you because it might rain.
examples.zh: 請帶把傘出門，因為可能會下雨。

examples.en: It will take thirty minutes to walk to the station.
examples.zh: 步行到車站將花費三十分鐘。

examples.en: She decided to take a short nap after finishing work.
examples.zh: 她決定完成工作後稍微睡個午覺。

examples.en: What is your personal take on the current economic situation?
examples.zh: 你對目前的經濟狀況有何個人看法？

examples.en: The movie director was finally satisfied with the third take.
examples.zh: 電影導演終於對第三個拍攝鏡頭感到滿意。

examples.en: The article gives an interesting take on modern art trends.
examples.zh: 這篇文章對現代藝術趨勢提出了有趣的看法。

examples.en: The old man told us a fascinating tale about the ocean.
examples.zh: 那位老人給我們講了一個關於海洋的迷人故事。

examples.en: This classic fairy tale has been loved for generations.
examples.zh: 這則經典童話故事深受好幾代人的喜愛。

examples.en: She wrote a tale based on her childhood memories.
examples.zh: 她寫了一個基於自己童年回憶的故事。

examples.en: They sat on the bench and talked for hours about life.
examples.zh: 他們坐在長椅上談話聊了幾個小時的人生。

examples.en: Please stop talking and listen to what the teacher is explaining.
examples.zh: 請停止說話，聽老師正在解釋的內容。

examples.en: I need to talk to you about our project plans tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天需要和你談談我們的專案計畫。

examples.en: We had an interesting talk about modern high technology trends today.
examples.zh: 我們今天就現代高科技趨勢進行了有趣的交談。

examples.en: The famous scientist will give a public talk on space exploration.
examples.zh: 這位知名科學家將發表一場關於太空探索的公開演講。

examples.en: The two companies ended their talks after hours of discussion.
examples.zh: 經過數小時的討論，兩家公司結束了會談。

examples.en: A tall tree grows in front of the house.
examples.zh: 一棵高大的樹生長在房子前面。

examples.en: He is the tallest student in his class.
examples.zh: 他是班上最高的學生。

examples.en: The company built a tall office tower downtown.
examples.zh: 公司在市中心建造了一棟高大的辦公大樓。

examples.en: Use sticky tape to seal the box before sending the package.
examples.zh: 寄出包裹前，請用膠帶封好箱子。

examples.en: My father played an old music tape on his cassette player.
examples.zh: 我父親用卡式錄音機播放了一張舊音樂帶。

examples.en: She wrapped the birthday gift carefully with colorful decorative tape.
examples.zh: 她用彩色裝飾膠帶小心地包裹生日禮物。

examples.en: Please tape the poster securely onto the classroom wall.
examples.zh: 請用膠帶把海報牢固地貼在教室牆上。

examples.en: The reporter taped the entire interview with the famous writer.
examples.zh: 記者錄下了與這位知名作家面談的全過程。

examples.en: They taped the box shut so nothing would fall out.
examples.zh: 他們用膠帶把箱子封好，這樣就不會掉出任何東西。

examples.en: Our sales team reached its quarterly target ahead of time.
examples.zh: 我們的銷售團隊提早達到了季度目標。

examples.en: The archer hit the center of the target with precision.
examples.zh: 射箭手精準地擊中了靶心。

examples.en: Teenagers are the primary target audience for this video game.
examples.zh: 青少年是這款電玩遊戲的主要目標受眾。

examples.en: The advertisement targets young students who want an affordable phone.
examples.zh: 這則廣告鎖定想買平價手機的年輕學生。

examples.en: The new policy targets energy waste in local factories.
examples.zh: 這項新政策針對本地工廠的能源浪費問題。

examples.en: The program targets people who need job training assistance.
examples.zh: 該計畫針對需要職業訓練協助的民眾。

examples.en: Cleaning the whole garage was a challenging physical task for us.
examples.zh: 打掃整個車庫對我們來說是一項具挑戰性的體力工作。

examples.en: Our primary task today is to complete the weekly financial report.
examples.zh: 我們今天的首要任務是完成每週財務報告。

examples.en: The manager assigned a new design task to the creative team.
examples.zh: 經理把一項新的設計任務指派給創意團隊。

examples.en: The sweet taste of fresh strawberries always reminds me of summer.
examples.zh: 新鮮草莓甜美的味道總讓我想起夏天。

examples.en: She has excellent taste in modern art and home design.
examples.zh: 她對現代藝術與居家設計有著絕佳的品味。

examples.en: This traditional soup has a rich and delicious herbal taste.
examples.zh: 這道傳統湯品有著濃郁美味的草藥滋味。

examples.en: You should taste this delicious chocolate cake made by my mother.
examples.zh: 你應該品嚐一下這款由我媽媽製作的美味巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: This hot soup tastes a little too salty for me.
examples.zh: 這碗熱湯對我來說有點太鹹了。

examples.en: I could taste the lemon in this refreshing cold drink.
examples.zh: 我能在這款清涼的冷飲中嚐出檸檬的味道。

examples.en: The government decided to raise the tax on luxury goods.
examples.zh: 政府決定提高奢侈品的稅金。

examples.en: You need to file your income tax before the end of May.
examples.zh: 你需要在五月底前申報綜合所得稅。

examples.en: The price of the shirt already includes sales tax.
examples.zh: 這件襯衫的價格已經包含營業稅。

examples.en: The country taxes imported sugary drinks at a higher rate.
examples.zh: 該國對進口含糖飲料徵收較高的稅率。

examples.en: The local council taxes properties based on their market value.
examples.zh: 當地議會根據房產的市場價值課稅。

examples.en: Heavy responsibilities will tax his patience and mental energy.
examples.zh: 重大的責任會考驗他的耐心與精力。

senses.zh: 向……徵稅；考驗；使負擔沉重

examples.en: We hailed a yellow taxicab outside the busy airport.
examples.zh: 我們在繁忙的機場外攔了一輛黃色計程車。

examples.en: The taxicab driver knew the fastest route through traffic.
examples.zh: 這位計程車司機知道穿過車流的最快路線。

examples.en: It is convenient to take a taxicab late at night.
examples.zh: 深夜搭乘計程車非常方便。

examples.en: She poured a hot cup of green tea for the visitor.
examples.zh: 她為訪客倒了一杯熱綠茶。

examples.en: Taiwan is famous worldwide for producing high quality tea.
examples.zh: 台灣以生產高品質茶葉而聞名世界。

examples.en: They enjoy sitting in the garden and drinking afternoon tea.
examples.zh: 他們喜歡坐在花園裡享用下午茶。

examples.en: My mother taught me how to cook delicious traditional dishes.
examples.zh: 我母親教我如何烹飪美味的傳統菜餚。

examples.en: She teaches English literature at a local high school daily.
examples.zh: 她每天在當地高中教授英語文學。

examples.en: Experience can teach us valuable lessons about life and work.
examples.zh: 經驗可以教給我們關於生活與工作的寶貴教訓。

examples.en: Our English teacher always explains difficult grammar rules clearly.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師總是清楚地解釋困難的文法規則。

examples.en: The teacher encouraged the students to ask more questions.
examples.zh: 老師鼓勵學生多提問。

examples.en: She has been an elementary school teacher for ten years.
examples.zh: 她擔任國小教師已經十年了。

examples.en: Our school football team won the regional championship yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們的學校足球隊昨天贏得了區域冠軍。

examples.en: A team of expert doctors performed the difficult surgical operation.
examples.zh: 一隊專家醫生執行了這項困難的外科手術。

examples.en: Good communication is essential for effective team collaboration in business.
examples.zh: 良好的溝通對於商業中有效的團隊合作至關重要。

examples.en: She poured hot Oolong tea from a traditional ceramic teapot.
examples.zh: 她從傳統的陶瓷茶壺倒出熱烏龍茶。

examples.en: Be careful when you lift the teapot because it is very hot.
examples.zh: 拿起茶壺時請小心，因為它很燙。

examples.en: My grandmother owns a valuable antique purple clay teapot.
examples.zh: 我祖母擁有一只珍貴的古董紫砂茶壺。

examples.en: Tears rolled down her cheeks when she heard good news.
examples.zh: 當她聽到好消息時，眼淚順著臉頰流了下來。

examples.en: He wiped away a tear with the back of his hand.
examples.zh: 他用手背擦去了一滴淚水。

examples.en: The emotional movie brought tears to many people in the audience.
examples.zh: 這部感人的電影讓許多觀眾落淚。

examples.en: Be careful not to tear the fragile paper while unwrapping.
examples.zh: 拆包裝時要小心，不要撕破脆弱的紙。

examples.en: He accidentally tore his pants while climbing over the fence.
examples.zh: 他在翻越籬笆時不小心扯破了褲子。

examples.en: She tore the letter into small pieces and threw them away.
examples.zh: 她把信撕成碎片並丟掉了。

examples.en: Every teenager should learn how to manage time.
examples.zh: 每個青少年都應該學習如何管理時間。

examples.en: The teenager enjoyed playing basketball with his classmates.
examples.zh: 這位青少年喜歡和同學一起打籃球。

examples.en: Many teenagers like to listen to pop music.
examples.zh: 許多青少年喜歡聽流行音樂。

examples.en: She learned to play the guitar during her early teens.
examples.zh: 她在十三、四歲時學會了彈吉他。

examples.en: Most teens spend hours using social media every day.
examples.zh: 大多數青少年每天花數小時使用社群媒體。

examples.en: The book is targeted at teens who love fantasy adventure.
examples.zh: 這本書的目標對象是喜歡奇幻冒險的青少年。

examples.en: The office telephone rang while I was out for lunch.
examples.zh: 我出去吃午餐時，辦公室電話響了。

examples.en: Alexander Graham Bell is widely credited with inventing the telephone.
examples.zh: 亞歷山大·格拉漢姆·貝爾被公認為發明了電話。

examples.en: She picked up the telephone to call her close friend.
examples.zh: 她拿起電話打給她的好友。

examples.en: Please telephone the hotel front desk to reserve a room.
examples.zh: 請打電話給飯店櫃檯預訂房間。

examples.en: He telephoned his parents to share the good news immediately.
examples.zh: 他立即打電話給父母分享這個好消息。

examples.en: I will telephone you as soon as I land safely.
examples.zh: 我一安全降落就會打電話給你。

examples.en: Our family watches the news on television every evening together.
examples.zh: 我們全家每天晚上一起看電視新聞。

examples.en: Turn off the television and go to study your lessons.
examples.zh: 關掉電視，去複習你的課業。

examples.en: They bought a flat screen television for their new apartment.
examples.zh: 他們為新公寓買了一台平面電視。

examples.en: Please tell me the truth about what happened this morning.
examples.zh: 請告訴我今天早上發生的事情真相。

examples.en: Grandmother likes to tell funny bedtime stories to the children.
examples.zh: 祖母喜歡給孩子們講有趣的睡前故事。

examples.en: It is difficult to tell the twins apart without close observation.
examples.zh: 如果沒有仔細觀察，很難分辨這對雙胞胎。

examples.en: The room temperature dropped suddenly after the window was opened.
examples.zh: 窗戶打開後，房間溫度突然下降。

examples.en: The nurse measured the patient's temperature with a thermometer.
examples.zh: 護士用體溫計量測了病人的體溫。

examples.en: Water reaches its boiling point at a temperature of one hundred degrees.
examples.zh: 水在一百度的溫度下達到沸點。

examples.en: Many tourists visited the ancient Buddhist temple in Tainan.
examples.zh: 許多遊客造訪了台南這座古老的佛寺。

examples.en: The historic temple was built over three hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的寺廟建於三百多年前。

examples.en: He gently rubbed his temples to relieve his headache.
examples.zh: 他輕輕揉著太陽穴以緩解頭痛。

examples.en: They play tennis at the local club every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 他們每週六早上在當地的俱樂部打網球。

examples.en: She bought a new tennis racket for the upcoming tournament.
examples.zh: 她為即將到來的錦標賽買了一支新網球拍。

examples.en: Watching a live tennis match at the stadium is exciting.
examples.zh: 在體育館觀看現場網球比賽令人興奮。

examples.en: Students have to take final exams at the end of every school term.
examples.zh: 學生必須在每個學期末參加期末考。

examples.en: Please read the contract terms carefully before signing your name.
examples.zh: 在簽名之前，請仔細閱讀合約條款。

examples.en: The teacher explained a new medical term to the class today.
examples.zh: 老師今天向全班解釋了一個新的醫學專有名詞。

examples.en: Scientists term this unusual natural phenomenon a solar eclipse.
examples.zh: 科學家把這種罕見的自然現象稱為日食。

examples.en: The newspaper termed the plan a success.
examples.zh: 報紙稱這項計畫是成功的。

examples.en: Experts term the new invention a breakthrough in modern technology.
examples.zh: 專家將這項新發明稱為現代科技的一大突破。

examples.en: We experienced terrible weather during our entire vacation trip.
examples.zh: 我們在整個度假行程中遇到了糟糕的天氣。

examples.en: I had a terrible headache and stayed in bed.
examples.zh: 我頭痛得厲害，所以躺在床上。

examples.en: The restaurant received a terrible review for poor service.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳因服務差而得到很糟的評價。

examples.en: Students are studying hard for the upcoming math test tomorrow.
examples.zh: 學生們正在為明天即將到來的數學測驗努力複習。

examples.en: The doctor ordered a blood test to check her health.
examples.zh: 醫生指示進行血液檢查以確認她的健康狀況。

examples.en: Engineers performed a safety test on the new brake system.
examples.zh: 工程師對新的煞車系統進行了安全測試。

examples.en: Scientists test the new medicine to see if it is safe.
examples.zh: 科學家測試新藥物以確認其是否安全。

examples.en: The long marathon race tested the runners' endurance to the maximum.
examples.zh: 這場漫長的馬拉松比賽最大限度地考驗了跑者的耐力。

examples.en: Teachers test students' listening skills using audio recordings.
examples.zh: 老師使用錄音來測試學生的聽力技能。

examples.en: Please open your history textbook to page forty-five now.
examples.zh: 現在請打開你們的歷史課本到第四十五頁。

examples.en: Students purchased their required biology textbooks at the campus store.
examples.zh: 學生們在校園書店購買了規定使用的生物教科書。

examples.en: The library keeps several digital copies of the reference textbook.
examples.zh: 圖書館保存了這本參考教科書的數個數位副本。

examples.en: My older brother is taller than me by five centimeters.
examples.zh: 我哥哥比我高五公分。

examples.en: My dad always says that actions speak louder than words.
examples.zh: 我爸總是說，行動勝於空談。

examples.en: This new phone model is more expensive than the old one.
examples.zh: 這款新手機型號比舊款更貴。

examples.en: It took longer to finish the work than we had expected.
examples.zh: 完成這項工作所花的時間比我們預期的要長。

examples.en: She would rather stay at home than go out tonight.
examples.zh: 她今晚寧願待在家裡也不願出去。

examples.en: More people attended the concert than the organizers originally planned.
examples.zh: 參加演唱會的人數比主辦單位原本預計的要多。

examples.en: I want to thank you for your kind assistance today.
examples.zh: 我想感謝你今天親切的協助。

examples.en: She wrote a letter to thank her mentor for her guidance.
examples.zh: 她寫了一封信感謝導師的指導。

examples.en: We should thank the host before leaving the dinner party.
examples.zh: 我們在離開晚宴前應該向主人道謝。

examples.en: That red coat on the rack looks very warm.
examples.zh: 架子上的那件紅大衣看起來很溫暖。

examples.en: Who lives in that big house on the corner?
examples.zh: 誰住在街角的那棟大房子裡？

examples.en: I cannot forget that wonderful holiday in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我忘不了山裡的那次美好假期。

examples.en: That is the best answer to our complex question.
examples.zh: 那是對於我們複雜問題的最佳答案。

examples.en: Did you see that on the news last night?
examples.zh: 你昨晚在新聞上看到那件事了嗎？

examples.en: That belongs to the student sitting in front.
examples.zh: 那是屬於坐在前面的學生的。

examples.en: She said that she would arrive before six o'clock.
examples.zh: 她說她會在六點前到達。

examples.en: I hope that everyone enjoys the annual company party.
examples.zh: 我希望大家都能享受這一年一度的公司派對。

examples.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep immediately.
examples.zh: 他累到立刻就睡著了。

senses.zh: 引導名詞子句或結果子句

examples.en: Please turn off the light before leaving the room.
examples.zh: 離開房間前請關燈。

examples.en: The sun rises in the east every morning.
examples.zh: 太陽每天早上從東方升起。

examples.en: She is the best tennis player in our school.
examples.zh: 她是我們學校最好的網球選手。

examples.en: We bought movie tickets online before heading to the downtown theater.
examples.zh: 我們在前往市中心電影院前先在線上買了電影票。

examples.en: The famous drama troupe will perform live at the national theater tonight.
examples.zh: 知名劇團今晚將在國家劇院現場演出。

examples.en: The small theater was filled with students watching the school play.
examples.zh: 這個小劇院擠滿了觀看校園戲劇演出的學生。

examples.en: We had dinner and then went to the movies together.
examples.zh: 我們吃了晚餐，然後一起去看了電影。

examples.en: Let's meet at three o'clock. See you then!
examples.zh: 我們三點見面，到時候見！

examples.en: If you are ready, then we can start the meeting.
examples.zh: 如果你準備好了，那麼我們就可以開始開會了。

examples.en: The teacher is sitting over there, talking with a parent.
examples.zh: 老師坐在那裡和一位家長說話。

examples.en: We walked there together because the restaurant was close to school.
examples.zh: 我們一起走路去那裡，因為那家餐廳離學校很近。

examples.en: Put the heavy wooden box over there by the front door.
examples.zh: 把那個沉重的木箱放在前門那裡。

examples.en: There is a small coffee shop near the public bus station.
examples.zh: 公車總站附近有一家小咖啡店。

examples.en: There are many interesting books in the school library to read.
examples.zh: 學校圖書館裡有許多有趣的書籍可供閱讀。

examples.en: There was a sudden loud noise outside our classroom this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早晨我們教室外面傳來突如其來的巨響。

examples.en: He studied hard and therefore passed the tough exam.
examples.zh: 他努力讀書，因此通過了這場艱難的考試。

examples.en: The roads were icy and therefore dangerous to drive.
examples.zh: 路面結冰了，因此開車非常危險。

examples.en: She was ill and therefore could not attend class.
examples.zh: 她生病了，因此無法來上課。

examples.en: These books on the table belong to the school library.
examples.zh: 桌上的這些書屬於學校圖書館。

examples.en: I bought these fresh apples from the local farmers' market.
examples.zh: 我從當地的農夫市場買了這些新鮮蘋果。

examples.en: These simple rules must be followed by every new student.
examples.zh: 每位新學生都必須遵守這些簡單的規則。

examples.en: Out of all the pictures, these are my favorite ones.
examples.zh: 在所有的照片中，這些是我最喜歡的。

examples.en: These are the shoes I wore to the party yesterday.
examples.zh: 這些是我昨天穿去派對的鞋子。

examples.en: If you need color pencils, you can use these.
examples.zh: 如果你需要色鉛筆，你可以用這些。

examples.en: They went to the movie theater together last Saturday.
examples.zh: 他們上週六一起去看了電影。

examples.en: Where are the keys? They were on the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 鑰匙在哪裡？它們剛才還在廚房櫃檯上。

examples.en: They are working hard to complete the project ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 他們正在努力工作，以便提前完成專案。

examples.en: She bought a thick wool coat for cold winter months.
examples.zh: 她買了一件厚羊毛大衣來度過寒冬月份。

examples.en: A thick layer of dust covered the old wooden table.
examples.zh: 一層厚厚的灰塵覆蓋在舊木桌上。

examples.en: The chef prepared a thick mushroom soup as a starter.
examples.zh: 主廚準備了一道濃郁的蘑菇濃湯當前菜。

examples.en: Snow fell fast and thick over the entire town overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之間，整個城鎮下起了又大又厚的雪。

examples.en: The grass grew thick and tall along the quiet riverbank.
examples.zh: 草群沿著寧靜的河岸密集而高聳地生長。

examples.en: Dust lay thick on every shelf in the neglected attic.
examples.zh: 這間被忽視的閣樓裡，每個架子上都積著厚厚的灰塵。

examples.en: The thief stole a computer from the office.
examples.zh: 小偷從辦公室偷走了一台電腦。

examples.en: Police caught the thief near the train station.
examples.zh: 警方在火車站附近抓到了竊賊。

examples.en: A clever thief took her wallet on the bus.
examples.zh: 一個聰明的竊賊在公車上拿走了她的皮夾。

examples.en: Slice the fresh red apples into very thin pieces for the pie.
examples.zh: 把新鮮的紅蘋果切成很薄的薄片來做派。

examples.en: The runner looked remarkably thin and fit before the marathon race started.
examples.zh: 在馬拉松比賽開始前，這位跑者看起來非常纖瘦且健壯。

examples.en: The cold air becomes noticeably thin as you climb higher up the mountain.
examples.zh: 當你爬得越高，山上的冷空氣會明顯變得越稀薄。

examples.en: Pack your things because we are leaving early tomorrow.
examples.zh: 收拾你的東西，因為我們明天很早要出發。

examples.en: There is one important thing I forgot to tell you.
examples.zh: 有一件重要的事情我忘了跟你說。

examples.en: She bought several useful things for her new apartment.
examples.zh: 她為她的新公寓買了幾樣實用的東西。

examples.en: I need some time to think about this decision.
examples.zh: 我需要一些時間來思考這個決定。

examples.en: Do you think it will rain this afternoon?
examples.zh: 你覺得今天下午會下雨嗎？

examples.en: She thinks that learning English is very useful.
examples.zh: 她認為學習英文非常有用。

examples.en: This is her third time visiting this beautiful coastal city.
examples.zh: 這是她第三次造訪這座美麗的沿海城市。

examples.en: Our classroom is located on the third floor of the school.
examples.zh: 我們的教室位於學校的三樓。

examples.en: He finished in third place in the national running race.
examples.zh: 他在全國跑步比賽中獲得第三名。

examples.en: About one third of the students joined the music club.
examples.zh: 大約三分之一的學生加入了音樂社團。

examples.en: She ate a third of the pie.
examples.zh: 她吃了這個派的三分之一。

examples.en: He was the third to arrive at the party venue.
examples.zh: 他是第三個到達派對場地的人。

examples.en: He crossed the finish line third and won the bronze medal.
examples.zh: 他第三個衝過終點線，贏得銅牌。

examples.en: Third, we need to check the answers again before handing in the test.
examples.zh: 第三，交卷前我們需要再檢查一次答案。

examples.en: She came third in the science fair this year.
examples.zh: 她今年在科展中獲得第三名。

examples.en: I am very thirsty after running five miles.
examples.zh: 跑完五英里後，我覺得非常口渴。

examples.en: The thirsty travelers drank cold water at the well.
examples.zh: 口渴的旅人在水井旁喝了冷水。

examples.en: Give the thirsty dog some fresh water in a bowl.
examples.zh: 在碗裡倒些新鮮的水給那隻口渴的狗。

examples.en: This red bicycle belongs to my younger sister.
examples.zh: 這輛紅色腳踏車是我妹妹的。

examples.en: I cannot finish all this work before the end of the day.
examples.zh: 我無法在今天結束前完成這所有的工作。

examples.en: This coffee tastes much better than the one we had.
examples.zh: 這杯咖啡喝起來比我們剛才喝的好多了。

examples.en: This is the best birthday present I have ever received.
examples.zh: 這是我收到過最好的生日禮物。

examples.en: How much does this cost in Taiwan dollars?
examples.zh: 這個用新台幣要多少錢？

examples.en: This is why we need to plan everything carefully beforehand.
examples.zh: 這就是為什麼我們需要事先仔細計劃一切的原因。

examples.en: Those are the books I borrowed from the public library.
examples.zh: 那些是我從公共圖書館借來的書。

examples.en: These cookies are mine, and those are yours.
examples.zh: 這些餅乾是我的，那些是你的。

examples.en: Those who arrive early will get a free gift.
examples.zh: 早到的人可以獲得免費贈品。

examples.en: Those shoes are too small for my feet.
examples.zh: 那些鞋子對我的腳來說太小了。

examples.en: Do you remember those wonderful days in summer camp?
examples.zh: 你還記得夏令營裡那些美好的日子嗎？

examples.en: Those houses on the hill have a great view.
examples.zh: 山上的那些房子景色很好。

examples.en: Though it was raining, they went out for dinner.
examples.zh: 雖然下著雨，他們還是出去吃晚餐。

examples.en: He passed the exam, though he was very tired.
examples.zh: 雖然他非常累，他還是通過了考試。

examples.en: She enjoyed the film, though it was quite long.
examples.zh: 儘管這部電影相當長，她還是很喜歡。

examples.en: The food was cheap; the service was slow, though.
examples.zh: 食物很便宜；不過服務有點慢。

examples.en: I cannot join you today; thanks for asking, though.
examples.zh: 我今天無法加入你們；不過還是謝謝你邀請。

examples.en: He promised to come; he might be late, though.
examples.zh: 他承諾會來；不過他可能會遲到。

examples.en: She shared her deep thoughts on environmental protection during the seminar.
examples.zh: 她在研討會期間分享了她對環境保護的深刻想法。

examples.en: After much thought, he decided to accept the new job offer.
examples.zh: 經過多番思考後，他決定接受這份新工作。

examples.en: The sudden thought of travel brought a huge smile to her face.
examples.zh: 突然想到旅行讓她的臉上露出了燦爛的微笑。

examples.en: Thousands of tourists visit the night market every weekend.
examples.zh: 每個週末都有數千名觀光客造訪這個夜市。

examples.en: This new phone costs about thirty thousand.
examples.zh: 這支新手機大約要三萬元。

examples.en: He counted from one to a thousand before he fell asleep.
examples.zh: 他從一數到一千才睡著。

examples.en: Two thousand students attended the annual university graduation ceremony yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 昨天下午有兩千名學生參加了大學的年度畢業典禮。

examples.en: The library has three thousand books available for students to borrow.
examples.zh: 圖書館有三千本書可供學生借閱。

examples.en: The smartphone costs around fifteen thousand New Taiwan dollars online.
examples.zh: 這款智慧型手機在網路上售價約一萬五千新台幣。

examples.en: Drinking warm honey water can help soothe a sore and dry throat.
examples.zh: 喝溫蜂蜜水有助於舒緩疼痛且乾燥的喉嚨。

examples.en: He cleared his throat loudly before starting his presentation to the team.
examples.zh: 他在向團隊開始簡報前，大聲地清了清嗓子。

examples.en: The doctor used a small flashlight to inspect the patient's red throat.
examples.zh: 醫生用一支小手電筒檢查病人發紅的喉嚨。

examples.en: We walked quietly through the dense forest during our morning hike.
examples.zh: 我們在早晨健行時安靜地穿過濃密的森林。

examples.en: Bright sunlight streamed through the window into the clean bedroom.
examples.zh: 明亮的陽光透過窗戶照進乾淨的臥室。

examples.en: The train moved smoothly through the long dark mountain tunnel.
examples.zh: 火車平穩地穿過漫長黑暗的山岳隧道。

examples.en: This train goes straight through to Kaohsiung without stopping.
examples.zh: 這班火車直達高雄，中途不停。

examples.en: The gate was left open, so the dog ran right through.
examples.zh: 大門開著，所以狗直接跑了過去。

examples.en: Read the whole document through before you sign it.
examples.zh: 簽名之前，請把整份文件從頭到尾讀一遍。

examples.en: It rained continuously throughout the entire day.
examples.zh: 一整天下來雨下個不停。

examples.en: The news spread rapidly throughout the small town.
examples.zh: 這則新聞迅速傳遍了這座小鎮。

examples.en: She stayed calm and focused throughout the difficult match.
examples.zh: 在整場艱難的比賽中，她都保持冷靜與專注。

examples.en: The house was freshly painted and newly decorated throughout.
examples.zh: 這棟房子裡裡外外都重新粉刷並重新裝修過。

examples.en: The museum looks modern and clean throughout.
examples.zh: 這間博物館到處看起來都很現代且乾淨。

examples.en: He remained active and helpful throughout.
examples.zh: 他自始至終都保持積極且樂於助人。

examples.en: Please throw the basketball to your teammate across the court.
examples.zh: 請把籃球傳給球場另一端的隊友。

examples.en: Don't throw trash on the floor in the classroom area.
examples.zh: 不要在教室區域的地板上亂扔垃圾。

examples.en: He can throw a baseball at a very high speed.
examples.zh: 他能以非常快的速度投擲棒球。

examples.en: That was an amazing throw by the young football quarterback.
examples.zh: 那位年輕的美式足球四分衛做出了一次驚人的傳球。

examples.en: The winning team secured victory with one final great throw.
examples.zh: 獲勝隊伍憑藉最後一次精彩的投擲取得了勝利。

examples.en: He practiced his free throw technique every single afternoon.
examples.zh: 他每天下午都在練習罰球技巧。

examples.en: A sudden loud crash of thunder scared the sleeping cat under the sofa.
examples.zh: 一陣突如其來的響亮雷聲嚇到了沙發下正在睡覺的貓。

examples.en: We heard thunder in the distance before the heavy rainfall started.
examples.zh: 在大雨開始前，我們聽到遠處傳來雷聲。

examples.en: The sound of thunder echoed across the dark night sky.
examples.zh: 雷聲在黑暗的夜空中迴盪。

examples.en: It began to thunder as we walked home from school.
examples.zh: 我們從學校走路回家時，開始打雷了。

examples.en: Heavy trucks thunder past our house on the main road.
examples.zh: 重型卡車在主幹道上轟隆隆地駛過我們家。

examples.en: The storm continued to thunder throughout the entire evening.
examples.zh: 這場暴風雨在整個晚上持續轟隆打雷。

examples.en: He worked hard all year and thus earned a promotion.
examples.zh: 他一整年都很努力工作，因此獲得了升遷。

examples.en: The road was flooded, and thus we had to turn back.
examples.zh: 道路淹水了，因此我們只好折返。

examples.en: She studied late every night, thus passing the exam easily.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上都讀書到很晚，因此輕鬆通過了考試。

examples.en: I bought a train ticket to Taipei online yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在網路上買了一張去台北的火車票。

examples.en: You need to show your admission ticket at the door.
examples.zh: 你需要在門口出示你的入場票。

examples.en: The police officer gave him a traffic ticket for speeding.
examples.zh: 警察因為他超速而開給他一張交通罰單。

examples.en: Please keep your personal desk tidy and clean throughout the school day.
examples.zh: 請在整個上學期間保持你個人課桌的整潔與乾淨。

examples.en: His bedroom is always remarkably neat and tidy without any clutter.
examples.zh: 他的臥室總是異常整潔乾淨，沒有任何雜物。

examples.en: She organized all the historical documents into tidy folders on the shelf.
examples.zh: 她把所有歷史文件整理成書架上整齊的資料夾。

examples.en: I need to tidy up my bedroom before my relatives visit this afternoon.
examples.zh: 在親戚今天下午來訪之前，我需要收拾一下我的臥室。

examples.en: The teacher asked the young children to tidy their toys after playtime ended.
examples.zh: 遊戲時間結束後，老師請小朋友們把玩具收拾好。

examples.en: She spent the whole morning tidying her garden and watering the flowers.
examples.zh: 她花了整個早上整理花園並給花澆水。

examples.en: He wore a silk tie to the job interview.
examples.zh: 他戴著一條絲綢領帶去參加求職面試。

examples.en: The football match ended in a tie yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天的足球比賽以平手收場。

examples.en: His red tie matches his dark black suit.
examples.zh: 他的紅領帶很配他的深黑色西裝。

examples.en: Please tie your shoelaces before you start running.
examples.zh: 跑步前請先綁好鞋帶。

examples.en: She tied the package with a long green ribbon.
examples.zh: 她用一條長長的綠色絲帶繫住包裹。

examples.en: He tied the boat to the dock safely.
examples.zh: 他把船安全地繫在碼頭上。

examples.en: A fierce tiger roared loudly inside the large zoo cage.
examples.zh: 一隻兇猛的老虎在大動物園的籠子裡大聲吼叫。

examples.en: Tigers are famous for their orange fur and black stripes.
examples.zh: 老虎以其橙色毛皮和黑色條紋聞名。

examples.en: Wild tigers usually hunt for food during the night.
examples.zh: 野生老虎通常在夜間捕食。

examples.en: The library remains open till nine o'clock every night.
examples.zh: 圖書館每天晚上開到九點。

examples.en: We waited at the bus stop till noon, but the bus never came.
examples.zh: 我們在公車站一直等到中午，但公車始終沒來。

examples.en: She worked on her report till late last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚寫報告一直工作到很晚。

examples.en: Stay inside the office till I return from lunch.
examples.zh: 在我吃完午飯回來之前，請留在辦公室裡。

examples.en: They didn't start the party till everyone arrived.
examples.zh: 直到所有人都到齊，他們才開始派對。

examples.en: Keep driving straight till you see the gas station.
examples.zh: 一直往前開，直到你看到加油站為止。

examples.en: Do you have enough time to finish the project today?
examples.zh: 你今天有足夠的時間完成這個專案嗎？

examples.en: She called her mother three times yesterday to check in.
examples.zh: 她昨天給媽媽打了三次電話問候。

examples.en: In ancient times, people built houses using mud and straw.
examples.zh: 在古代，人們用泥土和稻草建造房屋。

examples.en: The judge timed each runner with a professional digital stopwatch.
examples.zh: 裁判用專業的數位碼表為每位跑者計時。

examples.en: You need to time your jump perfectly to win.
examples.zh: 你必須精準掌握起跳的時機才能獲勝。

examples.en: The company timed the product launch for the holiday season.
examples.zh: 公司將產品上市時間安排在假期期間。

examples.en: A tiny kitten slept peacefully in the warm basket.
examples.zh: 一隻極小的幼貓在溫暖的籃子裡安詳地睡覺。

examples.en: She noticed a tiny scratch on her new phone screen.
examples.zh: 她注意到新手機螢幕上有個微小的刮痕。

examples.en: Ants carry tiny bits of bread back to their nest.
examples.zh: 螞蟻搬運著微小的麵包屑回到巢穴。

examples.en: The article provides useful tips for learning English faster.
examples.zh: 這篇文章提供了快速學習英文的實用秘訣。

examples.en: He left a generous tip for the friendly server.
examples.zh: 他給那位友善的服務生留下了大方的小費。

examples.en: The pencil tip broke off while I was writing.
examples.zh: 在我寫字的時候，鉛筆筆尖斷掉了。

examples.en: People usually tip the waiter after enjoying a good meal.
examples.zh: 人們在享用美味餐點後通常會給服務生小費。

examples.en: Be careful not to tip the glass over accidentally.
examples.zh: 小心不要不小心把玻璃杯弄翻了。

examples.en: He tipped his hat slightly to greet the lady.
examples.zh: 他微微輕觸帽沿向那位女士打招呼。

examples.en: I feel very tired after working for ten hours.
examples.zh: 工作了十個小時後，我感到非常疲倦。

examples.en: The tired child fell asleep in his mother's arms.
examples.zh: 疲倦的孩子在媽媽的懷抱裡睡著了。

examples.en: She was tired of arguing over small matters.
examples.zh: 她厭倦了為了小事爭吵。

examples.en: Please write down the title of your report clearly.
examples.zh: 請清楚寫下你報告的標題。

examples.en: His job title is senior sales representative at the firm.
examples.zh: 他在公司的職稱是資深業務代表。

examples.en: The tennis player won her first championship title yesterday.
examples.zh: 這位網球選手昨天贏得了她的第一個冠軍頭銜。

examples.en: She titled her new painting Sunset over the Sea.
examples.zh: 她將自己的新畫作命名為《海上日落》。

examples.en: The author titled the book after his childhood hometown.
examples.zh: 作者以他童年的故鄉為這本書命名。

examples.en: The article was titled How to Save Energy Effectively.
examples.zh: 這篇文章名為《如何有效節約能源》。

examples.en: We are going to the local library to borrow some books.
examples.zh: 我們正要前往當地圖書館借一些書。

examples.en: Please send this important package to the main office address.
examples.zh: 請把這個重要包裹寄到總公司地址。

examples.en: She handed the house keys to her sister before leaving.
examples.zh: 她在離開前把房屋鑰匙交給了她妹妹。

examples.en: I usually eat buttered toast and coffee for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐通常吃奶油吐司配咖啡。

examples.en: He put two slices of bread in the toaster to make some toast.
examples.zh: 他把兩片麵包放進烤麵包機做吐司。

examples.en: The manager raised his glass to propose a toast.
examples.zh: 經理舉杯提議祝酒乾杯。

examples.en: She toasted two slices of bread for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她為早餐烤了兩片麵包。

examples.en: We raised our glasses to toast the happy couple.
examples.zh: 我們舉杯向這對幸福的新人敬酒。

examples.en: He likes to toast his bagel until it is crispy.
examples.zh: 他喜歡把貝果烤到酥脆為止。

examples.en: We are planning to visit the natural history museum together today.
examples.zh: 我們計劃今天一起參觀自然歷史博物館。

examples.en: Many people order products online instead of visiting physical stores today.
examples.zh: 現今許多人在網路上訂購產品，而不是光顧實體店家。

examples.en: What would you like to eat for lunch today?
examples.zh: 你今天午餐想吃什麼？

examples.en: Today is going to be a very productive day for everyone.
examples.zh: 今天對每個人來說都將是很有成效的一天。

examples.en: Today's newspaper has a story about our school.
examples.zh: 今天的報紙有一篇關於我們學校的報導。

examples.en: In today's world, digital skills are important for every job.
examples.zh: 在當今世界，數位技能對每一種工作都很重要。

examples.en: He accidentally stubbed his big toe against the chair leg.
examples.zh: 他不小心把大腳趾撞到了椅腳上。

examples.en: She stood on her toes to reach the high shelf.
examples.zh: 她踮起腳趾以夠到高層的架子。

examples.en: My toes felt freezing cold after walking in the snow.
examples.zh: 在雪地裡行走後，我的腳趾感到冰冷。

examples.en: Stinky tofu is a famous traditional night market snack in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 臭豆腐是台灣知名的傳統夜市小吃。

examples.en: She added fresh tofu and green onions to the miso soup.
examples.zh: 她在味噌湯裡加入了鮮豆腐和蔥花。

examples.en: Tofu is a rich source of plant protein for vegetarians.
examples.zh: 豆腐是素食者優質的植物蛋白質來源。

examples.en: My family usually enjoys having dinner together at weekends.
examples.zh: 我們家通常在週末一起享用晚餐。

examples.en: The group of students worked together to complete the project.
examples.zh: 這群學生共同合作完成了這項專案。

examples.en: Let's sing this happy song together at the party.
examples.zh: 讓我們在派對上一起唱這首快樂的歌吧。

examples.en: Excuse me, where is the nearest public toilet?
examples.zh: 請問最近的公廁在哪裡？

examples.en: He flushed the toilet after using the restroom.
examples.zh: 他上完廁所後沖了馬桶。

examples.en: The hotel bathroom was equipped with a clean modern toilet.
examples.zh: 飯店的浴室配備了乾淨的現代化馬桶。

examples.en: She added slices of fresh red tomato to her breakfast sandwich.
examples.zh: 她在早餐三明治裡加了新鮮紅番茄片。

examples.en: Growing your own tomato plants in the garden can be rewarding.
examples.zh: 在花園裡自己種番茄植物會很有成就感。

examples.en: Italian pasta sauce is usually made with ripe tomatoes.
examples.zh: 義大利麵醬通常是用成熟的番茄做的。

examples.en: Tomorrow will be a busy day full of important meetings.
examples.zh: 明天將是充滿重要會議的繁忙一天。

examples.en: Let's put off the discussion until tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們把討論延到明天吧。

examples.en: The weather report says tomorrow will bring clear sunshine.
examples.zh: 天氣預報說明天會帶來晴朗陽光。

examples.en: We are going to travel to Tainan together tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天要一起去台南旅行。

examples.en: She promises to finish the whole written report tomorrow.
examples.zh: 她承諾明天會完成整份書面報告。

examples.en: Call me tomorrow if you need any further assistance.
examples.zh: 如果你需要任何進一步協助，明天打電話給我。

examples.en: The doctor asked the sick patient to stick out his tongue.
examples.zh: 醫生要生病的病人伸出舌頭。

examples.en: She accidentally burned her tongue on the extremely hot chicken soup.
examples.zh: 她不小心被極燙的雞湯燙到了舌頭。

examples.en: English is not my mother tongue, but I speak it fluently.
examples.zh: 英文不是我的母語，但我說得很流利。

examples.en: We are going to watch a movie at home tonight.
examples.zh: 我們今晚要在家看電影。

examples.en: Please remember to complete your homework before sleeping tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚睡覺前請記得完成你的作業。

examples.en: The moon is shining brightly in the clear sky tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚月亮在晴朗的天空中璀璨明亮。

examples.en: Tonight will be a very special evening for our team.
examples.zh: 今晚對我們團隊來說將會是一個非常特別的夜晚。

examples.en: Tonight's concert will be very exciting.
examples.zh: 今晚的音樂會一定會很精彩。

examples.en: Let's enjoy tonight together with good food and music.
examples.zh: 讓我們一起用美食和音樂享受今晚。

examples.en: My sister likes drinking green tea and I like it too.
examples.zh: 我妹妹喜歡喝綠茶，我也喜歡。

examples.en: This leather jacket is too expensive for me to buy.
examples.zh: 這件皮衣太貴了，我買不起。

examples.en: He was driving too fast on the slippery road yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天在濕滑的道路上開得太快了。

examples.en: A hammer is an essential tool for basic home repairs.
examples.zh: 鐵鎚是日常居家維修的基本工具。

examples.en: Computers have become a powerful tool for modern learning.
examples.zh: 電腦已成為現代學習的強大工具。

examples.en: The mechanic picked up a tool to fix the engine.
examples.zh: 技師拿起了工具來修理引擎。

examples.en: He broke a tooth while eating hard candy yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 他昨天下午吃硬糖時弄斷了一顆牙齒。

examples.en: You should brush every tooth carefully twice a day.
examples.zh: 你應該每天小心刷每一顆牙齒兩次。

examples.en: The dentist examined my painful tooth during the appointment.
examples.zh: 牙醫在看診時檢查了我疼痛的牙齒。

examples.en: He could not sleep last night because of a bad toothache.
examples.zh: 他昨晚因為嚴重牙痛而無法入睡。

examples.en: I made an urgent appointment with the dentist for my toothache.
examples.zh: 我為了牙痛緊急預約了牙醫。

examples.en: Eating too many sugary sweets can lead to terrible toothache.
examples.zh: 吃太多含糖甜食會導致可怕的牙痛。

examples.en: You should replace your toothbrush every three months.
examples.zh: 你應該每三個月更換一次牙刷。

examples.en: She put some toothpaste on her new toothbrush.
examples.zh: 她在新的牙刷上擠了一些牙膏。

examples.en: Don't forget to pack your toothbrush for the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行時別忘了帶上你的牙刷。

examples.en: There is a small bird sitting on top of the roof.
examples.zh: 有隻小鳥坐在屋頂的頂端。

examples.en: We finally reached the top of the high mountain.
examples.zh: 我們終於到達了高山的頂峰。

examples.en: Put the title at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 請把標題寫在頁面最上方。

examples.en: She is one of the top students in our class.
examples.zh: 她是我們班上最好的學生之一。

examples.en: Providing quality service is our company's top priority.
examples.zh: 提供優質服務是我們公司的首要任務。

examples.en: He achieved top marks in the final English examination.
examples.zh: 他在英文期末考試中獲得了最高分。

examples.en: We discussed several important topics during the meeting today.
examples.zh: 我們在今天的會議中討論了幾個重要主題。

examples.en: Environmental protection is a hot topic among young people.
examples.zh: 環境保護是年輕人之間的熱門話題。

examples.en: She chose an interesting topic for her final presentation.
examples.zh: 她為期末簡報選擇了一個有趣的題目。

examples.en: The total cost of the trip was high.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行的總費用很高。

examples.en: We were in total agreement about the plan.
examples.zh: 我們對這個計劃意見完全一致。

examples.en: The store suffered a total loss of power.
examples.zh: 這間商店經歷了電力完全中斷。

examples.en: The total reached fifty dollars after adding tax.
examples.zh: 加稅後總數達到了五十美元。

examples.en: She added up all numbers to find the total.
examples.zh: 她把所有數字加起來以求出總數。

examples.en: Pay the total before the end of this month.
examples.zh: 請在本月底前付清總額。

examples.en: The repair bills total more than two thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 維修帳單總計超過兩千美元。

examples.en: The tickets for our whole family total three thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 我們全家的票總計三千元。

examples.en: Our sales totaled fifty thousand dollars last week.
examples.zh: 我們上週的銷售額總計五萬元。

examples.en: Please do not touch the paintings in the museum.
examples.zh: 請勿觸摸博物館裡的畫作。

examples.en: Her warm and sincere speech touched the hearts of everyone.
examples.zh: 她溫暖而真誠的演講感動了每個人的心。

examples.en: The branches of the tall tree touch our bedroom window.
examples.zh: 高大樹木的樹枝觸碰到了我們臥室的窗戶。

examples.en: The velvet fabric is soft and pleasant to the touch.
examples.zh: 這天鵝絨布料摸起來柔軟舒適。

examples.en: Keep in touch with your friends after moving to college.
examples.zh: 搬去上大學後，要與你的朋友保持聯繫。

examples.en: He added a personal touch to the home party decoration.
examples.zh: 他為家庭派對的裝飾增添了個人風格。

examples.en: We joined a guided walking tour of the historic museum district.
examples.zh: 我們參加了歷史博物館區的導覽步行之旅。

examples.en: The famous rock band announced a worldwide concert tour next summer.
examples.zh: 這支著名的搖滾樂團宣布明年夏天進行全球巡迴演唱會。

examples.en: Their school organized an educational day tour to a national park.
examples.zh: 他們的學校組織了一次前往國家公園的教育一日遊。

examples.en: Thousands of foreign tourists tour Taiwan's night markets every year.
examples.zh: 每年有數千外國觀光客遊覽台灣的夜市。

examples.en: The theater group will tour several European cities this coming autumn.
examples.zh: 這支劇團將在即將到來的秋天巡迴歐洲數個城市。

examples.en: They spent three weeks touring around the beautiful coastal island.
examples.zh: 他們花了三週時間在這個美麗的海岸島嶼各處觀光。

examples.en: The child ran toward his mother with open arms.
examples.zh: 小孩張開雙臂朝母親跑去。

examples.en: He showed a friendly attitude toward the new neighbors.
examples.zh: 他對新鄰居展現出友好的態度。

examples.en: All savings will go toward buying a new family home.
examples.zh: 所有存款都將用於購買新的家庭住宅。

examples.en: Please dry your wet hands with a clean towel.
examples.zh: 請用乾淨的毛巾擦乾你的濕手。

examples.en: She wrapped a big beach towel around her shoulders.
examples.zh: 她用一張大沙灘巾裹住肩膀。

examples.en: I need to put fresh towels in the guest bathroom.
examples.zh: 我需要在客用浴室放新的毛巾。

examples.en: My grandparents live in a small quiet town near the mountains.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母住在靠近山區的一個安靜小鎮。

examples.en: The main street of the town was decorated with colorful lights.
examples.zh: 城鎮的主要街道裝飾著五彩繽紛的燈飾。

examples.en: She drove into town to buy some groceries for dinner.
examples.zh: 她開車進入城鎮購買晚餐所需的食材。

examples.en: The little child left his colorful toys all over the living room.
examples.zh: 小孩把他的彩色玩具散落客廳各處。

examples.en: This educational toy helps children develop their problem solving skills.
examples.zh: 這款益智玩具幫助兒童發展解決問題的能力。

examples.en: He donated his old plastic toys to the local community hospital.
examples.zh: 他把自己舊的塑膠玩具捐給了在地社區醫院。

examples.en: We walked along a muddy dirt track through the woods.
examples.zh: 我們沿著穿過樹林的小泥路行走。

examples.en: Runners are warming up on the athletic running track.
examples.zh: 跑步選手們正在田徑跑道上熱身。

examples.en: The train arrived safely on track number three.
examples.zh: 火車安全抵達第三號軌道。

examples.en: You can track your package online using the shipping number.
examples.zh: 你可以使用運送單號線上追蹤你的包裹。

examples.en: Scientists track the movement of wild animals using satellites.
examples.zh: 科學家利用衛星追蹤野生動物的活動。

examples.en: The hunter tracked the bear through the deep snow.
examples.zh: 獵人穿過深雪跟蹤那隻熊。

examples.en: International trade plays a vital role in our economy.
examples.zh: 國際貿易在我們的經濟中扮演關鍵角色。

examples.en: He made a trade with his friend for a comic book.
examples.zh: 他和朋友做了一筆漫畫書的交易。

examples.en: My uncle learned the trade of carpentry when he was young.
examples.zh: 我叔叔年輕時學習了木工手藝。

examples.en: The two countries trade goods across the ocean.
examples.zh: 這兩個國家跨海進行商品貿易。

examples.en: I traded my apple for her banana at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 我在午餐時間用我的蘋果換了她的香蕉。

examples.en: Investors trade stocks on the financial market daily.
examples.zh: 投資人每天在金融市場上交易股票。

examples.en: Eating mooncakes during Mid Autumn Festival is an ancient tradition.
examples.zh: 中秋節吃月餅是一項古老的傳統。

examples.en: Our family has a tradition of gathering for Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 我們家有週日晚餐聚在一起的傳統。

examples.en: They work hard to keep the local tradition alive.
examples.zh: 他們努力讓在地傳統延續下去。

examples.en: Mooncakes are a traditional food enjoyed during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
examples.zh: 月餅是中秋節期間享用的傳統美食。

examples.en: They wore traditional clothes to attend a friend's wedding.
examples.zh: 他們穿著傳統服飾參加朋友的婚禮。

examples.en: Craftsmen use traditional techniques to make these teapots.
examples.zh: 工匠使用傳統技藝來製作這些茶壺。

examples.en: The morning traffic was very heavy on the highway.
examples.zh: 高速公路上的早晨交通非常繁忙。

examples.en: Traffic rules must be obeyed by all vehicle drivers.
examples.zh: 所有車輛駕駛都必須遵守交通規則。

examples.en: We were stuck in traffic for nearly an hour.
examples.zh: 我們卡在車流中快一個小時。

examples.en: The high speed train arrived at the station on time.
examples.zh: 高鐵列車準時到達車站。

examples.en: We took an early morning train to visit Taroko Gorge.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘清晨的火車去遊覽太魯閣峽谷。

examples.en: The freight train carried goods across the entire broad continent.
examples.zh: 這列貨運火車載著貨物穿過整片廣袤的大陸。

examples.en: Athletes train hard every day for the international Olympic games.
examples.zh: 運動員每天都為國際奧林匹克運動會努力訓練。

examples.en: The senior manager will train new employees starting next Monday.
examples.zh: 資深經理將從下週一開始培訓新員工。

examples.en: She trained her pet dog to sit and stay calm.
examples.zh: 她訓練她的寵物狗坐下並保持冷靜。

examples.en: The clever mouse avoided the wooden trap set in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 聰明的老鼠躲開了設置在廚房裡的木製陷阱。

examples.en: Do not fall into the consumer trap of buying unnecessary items.
examples.zh: 不要掉入購買不必要物品的消費圈套。

examples.en: The hunter set a trap near the river to catch wild rabbits.
examples.zh: 獵人在河邊設下陷阱來捕捉野兔。

examples.en: Several people were trapped in the elevator during the power outage.
examples.zh: 停電期間有幾個人被困在電梯裡。

examples.en: Thick snow trapped the mountain climbers inside their tent overnight.
examples.zh: 厚雪將登山者們整夜困在他們的帳篷裡。

examples.en: The rescue team worked quickly to free animals trapped underwater.
examples.zh: 救援隊快速工作以解救被困在水下的動物。

examples.en: Please throw your plastic wrappers into the trash can.
examples.zh: 請把你的塑膠包裝紙扔進垃圾桶裡。

examples.en: The street was full of trash after the parade ended.
examples.zh: 遊行結束後，街道上堆滿了垃圾。

examples.en: Please remember to take out the household trash tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚請記得把家裡的垃圾拿出去。

examples.en: Vandals trashed the public park late last night.
examples.zh: 破壞者昨天深夜破壞了公共公園。

examples.en: Don't trash good items that can still be reused.
examples.zh: 不要丟棄還能重複使用的好東西。

examples.en: They completely trashed the room after the wild party.
examples.zh: 狂歡派對結束後，他們把房間徹底搞得一團亂。

examples.en: They love to travel to foreign countries during their annual winter holiday.
examples.zh: 他們喜歡在每年寒假出國旅行。

examples.en: Light travels much faster than sound through the open atmosphere of Earth.
examples.zh: 光在大氣中傳播的速度比聲音快得多。

examples.en: Many young people prefer to travel abroad with a lightweight backpack.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人喜歡背著輕便的背包去國外旅行。

examples.en: International air travel has become much more affordable for ordinary tourists.
examples.zh: 對一般觀光客而言，國際航空旅行已變得平價許多。

examples.en: Her extensive travel experiences inspired her to write a fascinating new book.
examples.zh: 她豐富的旅行經歷啟發她寫出了一本吸引人的新書。

examples.en: The travel agency offers complete vacation packages to various popular destinations.
examples.zh: 該旅行社提供前往各個熱門目的地的完整假期套裝行程。

examples.en: The pirates hid their golden treasure on a secret island.
examples.zh: 海盜把他們的黃金寶藏藏在一座祕密島嶼上。

examples.en: She found a box of ancient treasure in the deep cave.
examples.zh: 她在深邃的洞穴裡找到了一盒古代寶藏。

examples.en: The museum exhibits many valuable national treasures from the past.
examples.zh: 博物館展出了許多來自過去的珍貴國寶。

examples.en: I will always treasure the memories of our high school graduation trip.
examples.zh: 我會永遠珍惜我們高中畢業旅行的回憶。

examples.en: My grandfather deeply treasures the old pocket watch from his father.
examples.zh: 我的祖父非常珍視他父親留給他的舊懷錶。

examples.en: She treasures every opportunity to perform on the stage.
examples.zh: 她珍惜每一個在舞台上表演的機會。

examples.en: Our boss always treats every employee with fairness.
examples.zh: 我們的老闆總是公平地對待每一位員工。

examples.en: I will treat you to dinner after work.
examples.zh: 下班後我請你吃晚餐。

examples.en: The doctor knows how to treat this rare illness.
examples.zh: 醫生知道如何治療這種罕見疾病。

examples.en: Eating ice cream on a hot day is a real treat.
examples.zh: 在大熱天吃冰淇淋是一大樂事。

examples.en: My grandmother brought us homemade treats for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我祖母帶了自製的點心給我們過週末。

examples.en: Put your wallet away; dinner tonight is my treat.
examples.zh: 把錢包收起來，今晚的晚餐我請客。

examples.en: A tall tree grows right in front of my house.
examples.zh: 一棵高大的樹生長在我家正前方。

examples.en: Birds are singing happily on the branches of the tree.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在樹枝上快樂地唱歌。

examples.en: We sat under a big tree to escape the hot sun.
examples.zh: 我們坐在一棵大樹下躲避烈日。

examples.en: The court trial lasted for almost two full weeks.
examples.zh: 這場法院審判持續了將近兩個星期。

examples.en: They are offering a free thirty-day trial for the app.
examples.zh: 他們為這款應用程式提供三十天的免費試用。

examples.en: The new drug was proved effective in clinical trials.
examples.zh: 這種新藥在臨床試驗中被證實有效。

examples.en: A triangle has three sides and three interior angles.
examples.zh: 三角形有三條邊和三個內角。

examples.en: The music student played the triangle in the school orchestra.
examples.zh: 這名音樂系學生在學校管弦樂團裡打三角鐵。

examples.en: She cut the toasted sandwich into two neat triangles.
examples.zh: 她把烤三明治切成兩個整齊的三角形。

examples.en: The magician performed a clever card trick that amazed the audience.
examples.zh: 魔術師表演了一個精彩的撲克牌魔術，讓觀眾驚嘆不已。

examples.en: Children love playing tricks on their friends on April Fools' Day.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在愚人節對朋友惡作劇。

examples.en: Learning a useful keyboard trick can speed up your computer typing.
examples.zh: 學習實用的鍵盤技巧可以加快你的電腦打字速度。

examples.en: The dishonest salesman tried to trick customers into buying cheap goods.
examples.zh: 不誠實的銷售員企圖騙顧客購買廉價商品。

examples.en: Don't let advertisements trick you into spending more money than intended.
examples.zh: 不要讓廣告騙你花比預期更多的錢。

examples.en: He managed to trick his opponents with a brilliant tactical move.
examples.zh: 他成功用精彩的戰術動作騙過了對手。

examples.en: We are planning a business trip to Japan next month.
examples.zh: 我們正在計劃下個月去日本出差。

examples.en: How was your field trip to the science museum yesterday?
examples.zh: 你昨天去科學博物館的戶外教學怎麼樣？

examples.en: They enjoyed their brief trip to the beautiful mountain town.
examples.zh: 他們很享受前往那座美麗山城短暫的旅程。

examples.en: Be careful not to trip over those scattered toys on floor.
examples.zh: 小心不要被地板上散落的玩具絆倒。

examples.en: He managed not to trip while running down the stairs.
examples.zh: 他在跑下樓梯時成功沒有絆倒。

examples.en: The player tripped on the grass and hurt his ankle.
examples.zh: 該名球員在草地上絆倒並弄傷了腳踝。

examples.en: He got into trouble for coming to school late again.
examples.zh: 他因為再次上學遲到而陷入麻煩。

examples.en: We had a lot of trouble finding the correct address.
examples.zh: 我們在尋找正確地址時遇到很多困難。

examples.en: The car engine broke down and caused us much trouble.
examples.zh: 汽車引擎故障給我們帶來了很大的麻煩。

examples.en: I am sorry to trouble you with so many questions.
examples.zh: 很抱歉用這麼多問題打擾你。

examples.en: Please do not trouble yourself with making coffee for me.
examples.zh: 請不用麻煩自己為我泡咖啡。

examples.en: Her health problems have troubled her for several months.
examples.zh: 她的健康問題已經困擾了她幾個月。

examples.en: The large red truck was carrying heavy wooden furniture yesterday.
examples.zh: 那輛紅色的大卡車昨天載著重型木製家具。

examples.en: He drives a delivery truck for a local logistics company.
examples.zh: 他為一家當地的物流公司駕駛送貨卡車。

examples.en: A garbage truck collects household trash twice a week here.
examples.zh: 垃圾車在這裡每週清運兩次家庭垃圾。

examples.en: Is it true that you are moving to a new city next month?
examples.zh: 你下個月要搬到新的城市，是真的嗎？

examples.en: The film is based on a remarkable true story of human courage.
examples.zh: 這部影片改編自一個展現人類勇氣的真實故事。

examples.en: A true friend will always support you through difficult and challenging times.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友總會在艱難與挑戰的時刻支持你。

examples.en: I fully trust my doctor to recommend the best treatment options.
examples.zh: 我完全信任我的醫生會推薦最好的治療方案。

examples.en: She learned to trust her own instincts when making tough decisions.
examples.zh: 在做艱難決定時，她學會了相信自己的直覺。

examples.en: Customers trust this brand because of its high safety standards.
examples.zh: 顧客信賴這個品牌，因為它的安全標準很高。

examples.en: Building deep trust between teammates takes a long time.
examples.zh: 在隊友之間建立深厚的信任需要很長的時間。

examples.en: He betrayed her trust by leaking private information.
examples.zh: 他洩露了私人資訊，辜負了她的信任。

examples.en: The rich businessman set up a trust fund for poor children.
examples.zh: 那位富商為貧困兒童設立了信託基金。

examples.en: It is always best to tell the truth to your parents.
examples.zh: 對父母說實話總是最好的選擇。

examples.en: The reporter worked hard to discover the truth behind the scandal.
examples.zh: 記者努力工作以發掘醜聞背後的真相。

examples.en: There is a grain of truth in what he said.
examples.zh: 他說的話裡有一絲事實。

examples.en: You should try your best to complete the assignment on time.
examples.zh: 你應該盡力按時完成這份作業。

examples.en: She decided to try a new recipe for dinner this evening.
examples.zh: 她決定今天晚餐嘗試一份新食譜。

examples.en: I will try calling him again after the meeting finishes.
examples.zh: 會議結束後我會試著再打給他。

examples.en: Even if you fail, at least you gave it a good try.
examples.zh: 就算你失敗了，至少你已經努力試過了。

examples.en: Let me have a try at solving this difficult puzzle.
examples.zh: 讓我嘗試看看解開這個困難的謎題。

examples.en: It took several tries before he managed to fix the bicycle.
examples.zh: 在他成功修好腳踏車之前，經歷了幾次嘗試。

examples.en: She squeezed a small amount of toothpaste from the tube.
examples.zh: 她從軟管擠出了少量的牙膏。

examples.en: Water flows through a long plastic tube into the garden.
examples.zh: 水流經一條長塑膠管進入花園。

examples.en: We decided to take the Tube to get across London quickly.
examples.zh: 我們決定搭乘地鐵快速穿過倫敦。

examples.en: Please turn right at the next traffic light.
examples.zh: 請在下一個紅綠燈路口右轉。

examples.en: The tree leaves turn yellow during the cool autumn season.
examples.zh: 樹葉在涼爽的秋季會轉變成黃色。

examples.en: She turned the key gently to unlock the front door.
examples.zh: 她輕輕轉動鑰匙，打開了前門的鎖。

examples.en: Take a sharp left turn at the end of the street.
examples.zh: 在街道盡頭處來個急左轉。

examples.en: It is your turn to wash the dishes tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚輪到你洗碗了。

examples.en: The story took an unexpected turn in the last chapter.
examples.zh: 故事在最後一章出現了意想不到的轉折。

examples.en: A sea turtle swam gracefully through the clear blue ocean.
examples.zh: 一隻海龜在澈藍的大海中優雅地游泳。

examples.en: The slow turtle walked across the dusty farm path.
examples.zh: 緩慢的烏龜爬過了滿是灰塵的農場小路。

examples.en: Children watched the giant green turtle feeding on fresh lettuce.
examples.zh: 孩子們看著巨大的綠蠵龜吃著新鮮萵苣。

examples.en: I brush my teeth at least twice a day.
examples.zh: 我每天至少刷牙兩次。

examples.en: She checked the contract twice to avoid any hidden mistakes.
examples.zh: 她把合約檢查了兩次以避免任何隱藏的錯誤。

examples.en: This new model is twice as fast as the old one.
examples.zh: 這款新機型的速度是舊款的兩倍。

examples.en: What type of music do you like to listen to?
examples.zh: 你喜歡聽哪種類型的音樂？

examples.en: This type of computer is popular among university students.
examples.zh: 這種類型的電腦在大學生中很受歡迎。

examples.en: There are many different types of tea in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣有許多不同類型的茶。

examples.en: She can type very fast without looking at the keys.
examples.zh: 她可以打字很快且不用看按鍵。

examples.en: Please type your full name on the online form.
examples.zh: 請在線上表格上打出你的全名。

examples.en: He typed an urgent message to his business partner.
examples.zh: 他給他的商業夥伴打了一封緊急訊息。

examples.en: The strong typhoon brought heavy rainfall to the island.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風給這座島嶼帶來了豪雨。

examples.en: Schools will be closed tomorrow because of the approaching typhoon.
examples.zh: 由於颱風逼近，學校明天停課。

examples.en: Residents prepared food and flashlight batteries before the typhoon.
examples.zh: 居民在颱風來臨前準備了食物和手電筒電池。

examples.en: The old wooden house was painted in an ugly color.
examples.zh: 這棟老舊木屋被漆成了難看的顏色。

examples.en: He wore an ugly holiday sweater to the family party.
examples.zh: 他穿著一件醜陋的節日毛衣去參加家庭派對。

examples.en: The stormy weather turned the beautiful beach into an ugly sight.
examples.zh: 暴風雨天氣把美麗的海灘變成了難看的景象。

examples.en: Don't forget to take an umbrella on rainy days.
examples.zh: 下雨天別忘了帶一把雨傘。

examples.en: He opened his large umbrella as soon as it started to rain.
examples.zh: 天一開始下雨，他就打開了他的大雨傘。

examples.en: I left my wet umbrella near the front door.
examples.zh: 我把濕透的雨傘放在前門附近。

examples.en: He was unable to attend the meeting due to heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 由於交通擁塞，他無法出席會議。

examples.en: The doctor was unable to find any serious medical problem.
examples.zh: 醫生無法發現任何嚴重的健康問題。

examples.en: She felt unable to express her feelings clearly in public.
examples.zh: 她覺得自己無法在公開場合清楚表達自己的感受。

senses.zh: 無法的；不能的；無能力的

examples.en: My uncle bought me a new bike for my birthday.
examples.zh: 我叔叔買了一輛新自行車送我當生日禮物。

examples.en: His uncle lives in a peaceful house in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他的舅舅住在鄉下一棟寧靜的房子裡。

examples.en: We visited our uncle during the winter holidays.
examples.zh: 寒假期間我們去拜訪了伯父。

examples.en: The cat is sleeping under the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 那隻貓正睡在廚房桌子底下。

examples.en: Children under twelve years old can enter the park for free.
examples.zh: 十二歲以下的兒童可以免費進入公園。

examples.en: The new bridge is currently under construction until next month.
examples.zh: 新橋目前正在施工中，直到下個月。

examples.en: The boat flipped over and went completely under.
examples.zh: 船隻翻覆並完全沉入水下。

examples.en: The swimmer took a deep breath and went under.
examples.zh: 那位游泳者深吸一口氣潛入水下。

examples.en: The ship was hit by a wave and went under quickly.
examples.zh: 船隻被巨浪擊中並迅速沉入水下。

examples.en: I do not fully understand the teacher's grammar explanation today.
examples.zh: 我今天不完全理解老師的文法解釋。

examples.en: She helps me understand complex scientific principles clearly.
examples.zh: 她幫助我清楚地理解複雜的科學原理。

examples.en: Do you understand how to operate this new digital camera?
examples.zh: 你明白如何操作這台新型數位相機嗎？

examples.en: All students are required to wear a clean uniform to school.
examples.zh: 所有學生都必須穿著整潔的制服上學。

examples.en: The police officer was wearing a dark blue uniform on duty.
examples.zh: 那位警官執勤時穿著深藍色制服。

examples.en: She hung her nurse uniform neatly inside the wooden closet.
examples.zh: 她把護士制服整齊地掛在木製衣櫥裡。

examples.en: The tiles on the wall must be of uniform size.
examples.zh: 牆上的磁磚必須大小一致。

examples.en: The bakery maintains a uniform quality across all its branches.
examples.zh: 這家烘焙坊在所有分店都維持一致的品質。

examples.en: The temperature remained uniform throughout the experiment.
examples.zh: 在整個實驗過程中，溫度保持一致。

examples.en: We will study the third unit of our English textbook tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天將學習英文課本的第三單元。

examples.en: The meter is a standard unit used for measuring physical distance.
examples.zh: 公尺是用於測量物理距離的標準單位。

examples.en: Each air-conditioning unit passed a safety test before shipment.
examples.zh: 每台冷氣機組在出貨前都通過了安全測試。

examples.en: Astronomers discover new stars in the universe every year.
examples.zh: 天文學家每年都會在宇宙中發現新的恆星。

examples.en: Scientists study the origin of the universe using powerful telescopes.
examples.zh: 科學家使用強大的望遠鏡研究宇宙的起源。

examples.en: Earth is just a tiny planet in the vast universe.
examples.zh: 地球只是浩瀚宇宙中的一顆微小行星。

examples.en: She will study computer science at the university next semester.
examples.zh: 她下學期要在大學攻讀資訊工程。

examples.en: The campus of this university is large and very beautiful.
examples.zh: 這所大學的校園廣闊且非常美麗。

examples.en: Many international students apply to this university each year.
examples.zh: 每年都有許多國際學生申請這所大學。

examples.en: The main library will stay open until nine PM.
examples.zh: 總圖書館將會開放直到晚上九點為止。

examples.en: We waited until sunset before leaving the scenic park.
examples.zh: 我們等到日落後才離開風景優美的公園。

examples.en: The store will be closed until next Monday.
examples.zh: 這家店會休息到下週一。

examples.en: Stay here until I return from the local store.
examples.zh: 待在這裡，直到我從當地的商店回來。

examples.en: They didn't start eating until everyone had arrived.
examples.zh: 直到所有人都到達後，他們才開始用餐。

examples.en: Keep stirring the soup until it boils completely.
examples.zh: 繼續攪拌湯，直到它完全煮滾為止。

examples.en: He stood up to answer the teacher's question.
examples.zh: 他站起來回答老師的問題。

examples.en: Prices have gone up significantly over the past year.
examples.zh: 過去一年價格大幅上升。

examples.en: Please speak up; I can't hear you.
examples.zh: 請大聲一點，我聽不到你說話。

examples.en: We slowly walked up the steep mountain path.
examples.zh: 我們慢慢沿著陡峭的山路向上走。

examples.en: The cat climbed up the tall tree in our garden.
examples.zh: 貓爬上了我們花園裡的高樹。

examples.en: The store is located just up the street from here.
examples.zh: 那家店就在這條街往前一點的地方。

examples.en: It took five minutes to upload the video clip.
examples.zh: 上傳這段影片花了五分鐘。

examples.en: Students must upload their homework to the school website.
examples.zh: 學生必須將作業上傳到學校網站。

examples.en: She uploaded several travel photos to her social media account.
examples.zh: 她將幾張旅遊照片上傳到她的社群媒體帳號。

examples.en: Once upon a time there lived a wise old king.
examples.zh: 很久很久以前，住著一位明智的老國王。

examples.en: Upon arriving at the airport, she called her waiting husband.
examples.zh: 一到達機場，她就打電話給等待中的丈夫。

examples.en: The decision depends entirely upon your personal willingness and effort.
examples.zh: 這個決定完全取決於你個人的意願與努力。

examples.en: The bedrooms are located on the upper floor of the house.
examples.zh: 臥室都在這棟房子的上層。

examples.en: He felt a sharp muscle pain in his upper back yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天感覺背部上方有劇烈的肌肉疼痛。

examples.en: The upper branches of the tree were covered in green leaves.
examples.zh: 樹木較高處的枝條覆蓋著綠色的樹葉。

senses.zh: 上面的；較高處的；上層的

examples.en: She ran upstairs to grab her winter coat.
examples.zh: 她跑上樓拿她的冬季大衣。

examples.en: The children are playing quietly upstairs right now.
examples.zh: 孩子們現在正安靜地在樓上玩耍。

examples.en: Please go upstairs and wait in the hallway.
examples.zh: 請上樓並在走廊等待。

examples.en: The upstairs bedroom receives plenty of warm sunlight.
examples.zh: 樓上的臥室接收到充足的溫暖陽光。

examples.en: They repainted the entire upstairs bathroom last weekend.
examples.zh: 他們上週末重新塗刷了整個樓上的浴室。

examples.en: The upstairs window looks out over the park.
examples.zh: 樓上的窗戶俯瞰著公園。

examples.en: The upstairs of the old house was quiet.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子的樓上很安靜。

examples.en: We cleaned the upstairs first and then the downstairs.
examples.zh: 我們先打掃樓上，再打掃樓下。

examples.en: Noise from the upstairs disturbed her study session.
examples.zh: 來自樓上的噪音打擾了她的自習時間。

examples.en: The friendly teacher invited us to join the science club today.
examples.zh: 親切的老師今天邀請我們加入科學社團。

examples.en: Please give us a call when you arrive safely at home.
examples.zh: 當你安全抵達家裡時，請給我們打個電話。

examples.en: My mother baked a big delicious chocolate cake for us yesterday.
examples.zh: 媽媽昨天為我們烤了一個大又美味的巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: Can I use your pen to fill out this form?
examples.zh: 我可以用你的筆來填寫這張表格嗎？

examples.en: She uses a laptop to take notes in class.
examples.zh: 她在課堂上使用筆記型電腦做筆記。

examples.en: You should use water wisely to prevent waste.
examples.zh: 你應該善用水資源，避免浪費。

examples.en: This new tool has many practical uses in life.
examples.zh: 這項新工具有許多生活上的實用用途。

examples.en: Cellphone use is not allowed during the test.
examples.zh: 考試期間禁止使用手機。

examples.en: This old building is no longer in active use.
examples.zh: 這棟老舊建築物已經不再被實際使用了。

examples.en: I am slowly getting used to my new morning routine.
examples.zh: 我正在慢慢習慣我新的早晨例行公事。

examples.en: He bought a reliable used car to save some money.
examples.zh: 他買了一輛可靠的二手車以省些錢。

examples.en: She is not used to staying up late at night.
examples.zh: 她不習慣晚上熬夜。

examples.en: This dictionary is very useful for learning new English words.
examples.zh: 這本字典對學習新的英文單字非常有幫助。

examples.en: She gave me some useful advice about writing a college entrance essay.
examples.zh: 她給了我一些關於撰寫大學入學論文的實用建議。

examples.en: Smartphone apps can be useful tools for managing daily tasks.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機應用程式可以是管理日常任務的實用工具。

examples.en: Older users find the new app easy to use.
examples.zh: 年長的使用者覺得這款新應用程式很容易上手。

examples.en: Over one million users registered for the online service this month.
examples.zh: 這個月有超過一百萬名用戶註冊了該線上服務。

examples.en: Each system user must choose a unique password for security.
examples.zh: 為了安全，每位系統使用者必須選擇一個獨特的密碼。

examples.en: He took his usual seat near the window in the coffee shop.
examples.zh: 他在咖啡店坐在他平常坐的靠窗位置。

examples.en: She arrived at the office at her usual time today.
examples.zh: 她今天在她平常的時間到達辦公室。

examples.en: It is usual for children to feel nervous on the first day of school.
examples.zh: 孩子們在開學第一天感到緊張是很正常的。

examples.en: I usually eat breakfast at seven in the morning.
examples.zh: 我通常在早上七點吃早餐。

examples.en: She usually walks her dog in the park in the evening.
examples.zh: 她通常傍晚在公園遛狗。

examples.en: Bus service is usually reliable during peak traffic hours.
examples.zh: 公車服務在交通尖峰時段通常很可靠。

examples.en: We are planning a relaxing vacation in Hawaii this summer.
examples.zh: 我們正在計劃今年夏天去夏威夷度過一個放鬆的假期。

examples.en: My family took a short vacation to the mountains last week.
examples.zh: 上週我們全家去山裡度了個短假。

examples.en: She looks happy after returning from her beach vacation.
examples.zh: 她海灘度假回來後看起來很高興。

examples.en: Your passport must be valid for at least six months.
examples.zh: 你的護照必須至少有六個月的有效期。

examples.en: The customer presented a valid coupon to get a discount.
examples.zh: 顧客出示了一張有效的優惠券以獲得折扣。

examples.en: He raised several valid points during the team discussion.
examples.zh: 他在團隊討論中提出了一些合理的觀點。

senses.zh: 有效的；合理的；有根據的

examples.en: A quiet river flows gently through the deep green valley.
examples.zh: 一條平靜的河流緩緩流過深綠色的山谷。

examples.en: We enjoyed a breathtaking view of the valley from the mountain top.
examples.zh: 我們在山頂欣賞了山谷令人屏息的美景。

examples.en: The small village is nestled safely in a beautiful valley.
examples.zh: 這個小村莊安全地坐落於美麗的山谷之中。

examples.en: Thank you for sharing your valuable experience with our class.
examples.zh: 感謝您與我們班分享您寶貴的經驗。

examples.en: She keeps all her valuable jewelry in a safe.
examples.zh: 她把所有貴重的首飾保存在保險箱裡。

examples.en: This old painting is extremely valuable to art collectors worldwide.
examples.zh: 這幅古老的畫作對全世界的藝術收藏家來說極具價值。

senses.zh: 寶貴的；有價值的；貴重的

examples.en: The antique vase has a high historical value to collectors.
examples.zh: 這件古董花瓶對收藏家來說具有很高的歷史價值。

examples.en: The property value in this district has increased significantly recently.
examples.zh: 該地區的房產價值最近大幅增加。

examples.en: This textbook offers great value for students learning English language.
examples.zh: 這本教科書對學習英語的學生來說非常有價值。

examples.en: I value your honest friendship and wise advice very much.
examples.zh: 我非常重視你真誠的友誼與明智的建議。

examples.en: The expert valued the old oil painting at millions of dollars.
examples.zh: 專家將這幅舊油畫估價為數百萬美元。

examples.en: Our company values team cooperation and innovative creative ideas.
examples.zh: 我們公司重視團隊合作與創新創意。

examples.en: Eating fresh vegetables every day is good for your health.
examples.zh: 每天吃新鮮蔬菜對你的健康有益。

examples.en: My mother bought a lot of green vegetables from the market.
examples.zh: 我媽媽從市場買了許多綠色蔬菜。

examples.en: Carrots and broccoli are my favorite kinds of vegetables.
examples.zh: 胡蘿蔔和花椰菜是我最喜歡的蔬菜種類。

examples.en: Draw a vertical line on the piece of paper.
examples.zh: 在這張紙上畫一條垂直線。

examples.en: The steep cliff has an almost vertical drop to the ocean.
examples.zh: 這座陡峭的懸崖幾乎垂直降到海洋。

examples.en: They installed a vertical garden on the outer wall of the building.
examples.zh: 他們在大樓的外牆上安裝了垂直花園。

examples.en: Thank you very much for your kind help today.
examples.zh: 非常感謝您今天的親切協助。
