examples.en: The chicken soup is very hot so please be careful.
examples.zh: 雞湯非常燙，所以請小心。

examples.en: She arrived very early at the busy train station.
examples.zh: 她很早就到達了繁忙的火車站。

examples.en: This is the very book that I was searching for.
examples.zh: 這正好就是我一直在尋找的那本書。

examples.en: At that very moment, the phone rang.
examples.zh: 就在那一刻，電話響了。

examples.en: He was standing at the very center of the court.
examples.zh: 他就站在球場的最中央。

examples.en: The team celebrated their basketball championship victory with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 球隊熱情地慶祝他們的籃球錦標賽勝利。

examples.en: Hard work and practice brought them a glorious victory yesterday.
examples.zh: 努力與練習在昨天為他們帶來了輝煌的勝利。

examples.en: The candidate announced her election victory to her supporters tonight.
examples.zh: 候選人今晚向她的支持者宣布了選舉勝利。

examples.en: She uploaded an instructional video to her online channel.
examples.zh: 她上傳了一支教學影片到她的線上頻道。

examples.en: We watched a funny cat video on the internet together.
examples.zh: 我們一起在網路上看了一支搞笑的貓咪影片。

examples.en: The teacher showed an educational video during the science class.
examples.zh: 老師在自然課上播放了一支教育影片。

examples.en: He decided to video the wedding ceremony for his sister.
examples.zh: 他決定幫妹妹把婚禮儀式錄影下來。

examples.en: Please do not video the performance inside the concert hall.
examples.zh: 請勿在音樂廳內對演出進行錄影。

examples.en: She used her smartphone to video the adorable puppies.
examples.zh: 她用智慧型手機拍攝了那些可愛小狗的影片。

examples.en: The hotel room offers a beautiful view of the ocean.
examples.zh: 這間飯店房間提供美麗的海景。

examples.en: In my view, we should start the plan early.
examples.zh: 依我看，我們應該早點開始這個計畫。

examples.en: The tall tree blocked our view of the stage.
examples.zh: 那棵高樹擋住了我們看舞台的視線。

examples.en: Millions of people viewed the live video on the internet.
examples.zh: 數百萬人在網路上觀看了這支直播影片。

examples.en: We can view the city from the top of the tower.
examples.zh: 我們可以從塔頂俯瞰這座城市。

examples.en: He views this mistake as a chance to learn something new.
examples.zh: 他將這個錯誤視為學習新事物的機會。

examples.en: They live in a quiet fishing village near the sea.
examples.zh: 他們住在靠近大海的一個安靜的漁村。

examples.en: The small mountain village is surrounded by green hills.
examples.zh: 這座小山村被翠綠的山丘環繞。

examples.en: Tourists visit the historic village to see old houses.
examples.zh: 遊客造訪這座歷史悠久的村莊去看老房子。

examples.en: She has been practicing the violin for over five years.
examples.zh: 她練習小提琴已經超過五年了。

examples.en: The classical musician played a beautiful melody on his violin.
examples.zh: 這位古典音樂家用他的小提琴演奏了一首優美的旋律。

examples.en: My younger brother takes violin lessons every Saturday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我弟弟每週六下午上小提琴課。

examples.en: My grandmother loves it when we visit her on the weekend.
examples.zh: 我的祖母很喜歡我們在週末去拜訪她。

examples.en: We plan to visit the famous museum during our trip to Taipei.
examples.zh: 我們計劃在台北旅行期間參觀那座著名的博物館。

examples.en: Many tourists visit this historical town every summer to enjoy the view.
examples.zh: 每年夏天都有許多觀光客造訪這個歷史悠久的小鎮欣賞風景。

examples.en: Thank you for your warm welcome during my brief visit to your home.
examples.zh: 感謝在我短暫造訪你家期間所給予的熱情招待。

examples.en: The doctor suggested a follow-up visit next Tuesday to check my recovery.
examples.zh: 醫生建議我下週二回診複查，以確認我的康復狀況。

examples.en: Our annual visit to the farm is always full of fun and laughter.
examples.zh: 我們每年對農場的參觀總是充滿樂趣與歡笑。

examples.en: Every visitor must sign in at the main front desk.
examples.zh: 每位訪客都必須在大廳櫃檯簽到登記。

examples.en: The museum welcomed its one millionth visitor this afternoon.
examples.zh: 這座博物館今天下午迎來了第一百萬位參觀者。

examples.en: Our home had a foreign visitor from Canada last week.
examples.zh: 我們家上週有一位來自加拿大的外國訪客。

examples.en: Her gentle voice made the frightened child feel safe and calm immediately.
examples.zh: 她溫柔的聲音讓受驚嚇的孩子立刻感到安全與平靜。

examples.en: The famous singer lost her voice before the big concert yesterday.
examples.zh: 這位知名歌手在昨天的大型演唱會前失聲了。

examples.en: Please keep your voice down while reading in the public library.
examples.zh: 在公共圖書館閱讀時請放低聲音。

examples.en: The students voiced their opinions about the new campus rules clearly.
examples.zh: 學生們明確地表達了他們對新校規的意見。

examples.en: Many citizens came together to voice their concerns regarding environmental pollution.
examples.zh: 許多市民聚集起來表達他們對環境污染的擔憂。

examples.en: He took the chance to voice his thanks to his team.
examples.zh: 他藉這個機會向團隊表達謝意。

examples.en: Citizens will vote for their preferred candidate in the upcoming election.
examples.zh: 公民將在即將到來的選舉中投給他們心儀的候選人。

examples.en: The committee voted to approve the new building budget yesterday.
examples.zh: 委員會昨天投票通過了新建築預算案。

examples.en: We voted on where to go for our class graduation trip.
examples.zh: 我們就班級畢業旅行要去哪裡進行了表決。

examples.en: Each club member has one vote in the annual election.
examples.zh: 每位社團成員在年度選舉中都有一票。

examples.en: The motion passed by a unanimous vote during the meeting.
examples.zh: 該動議在會議期間獲得全體一致通過。

examples.en: The final vote count showed a clear victory for the leader.
examples.zh: 最終得票數顯示這位領導者明顯獲勝。

examples.en: He tied his jacket around his waist after his morning run.
examples.zh: 晨跑後，他把外套綁在腰上。

examples.en: These blue jeans are a bit too loose around my waist.
examples.zh: 這條藍色牛仔褲的腰圍對我來說有點太鬆。

examples.en: The tailor measured my waist before making my new pants.
examples.zh: 裁縫師在做我的新褲子前先量了我的腰圍。

examples.en: We had to wait in line for an hour to buy tickets.
examples.zh: 我們不得不排隊等候一個小時來買票。

examples.en: Please wait for me near the entrance of the station.
examples.zh: 請在車站入口附近等我。

examples.en: Dinner is almost ready, so please wait a few minutes.
examples.zh: 晚餐快好了，所以請稍等幾分鐘。

examples.en: After a long wait, the bus finally arrived at the stop.
examples.zh: 經過漫長的等待，公車終於到達了公車站。

examples.en: There was a two-hour wait at the clinic this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午診所需要等兩個小時。

examples.en: There was a short wait before we got our table.
examples.zh: 在我們拿到座位之前，稍微等待了一下。

examples.en: The waiter brought us water and handed us the menu.
examples.zh: 男服務生給我們送來水並遞給我們菜單。

examples.en: We asked the polite waiter for the check after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後我們向那位有禮貌的男服務生索取帳單。

examples.en: The waiter recommended the fresh seafood soup to the customer.
examples.zh: 男服務生向顧客推薦新鮮的海鮮湯。

examples.en: I usually wake up at seven every morning.
examples.zh: 我通常每天早上七點醒來。

examples.en: Please wake me up if I fall asleep.
examples.zh: 如果我睡著了，請把我叫醒。

examples.en: The loud noise outside woke everybody in the house.
examples.zh: 外面巨大的噪音吵醒了房子裡的每個人。

examples.en: I prefer to walk to the local market daily.
examples.zh: 我偏好每天步行去在地市場。

examples.en: She walked along the beach while enjoying the sunset.
examples.zh: 她一邊欣賞日落，一邊沿著海灘散步。

examples.en: They walk their friendly dog around the neighborhood every evening.
examples.zh: 他們每天傍晚都在社區附近溜他們友善的狗。

examples.en: Let us go for a long walk in the morning.
examples.zh: 讓我們在早晨長途散步吧。

examples.en: The park is only a five-minute walk from here.
examples.zh: 公園從這裡走過去只要五分鐘步程。

examples.en: Taking a daily walk is good for your health.
examples.zh: 每天散步對你的健康有好處。

examples.en: They hung a beautiful painting on the white wall.
examples.zh: 他們把一張漂亮的畫掛在白牆上。

examples.en: The ancient city was protected by a thick stone wall.
examples.zh: 這座古城受到了厚實石牆的保護。

examples.en: He leaned his bicycle against the outer brick wall.
examples.zh: 他把自行車靠在外面的磚牆上。

examples.en: He accidentally left his black leather wallet on the restaurant counter today.
examples.zh: 他今天不小心把黑色皮夾忘在餐廳櫃檯上了。

examples.en: My wallet contains my driver's license, credit cards, and a little cash.
examples.zh: 我的錢包裡有我的駕照、信用卡和少量現金。

examples.en: She searched her handbag carefully but could not locate her blue wallet.
examples.zh: 她仔細搜尋了自己的手提包，但找不到她的藍色錢包。

examples.en: I want to buy a new computer for my college studies.
examples.zh: 我想買一台新電腦用於大學課業。

examples.en: She wants to join the art club with her best friends.
examples.zh: 她想和最好的朋友一起加入美術社團。

examples.en: The teacher wants all students to hand in their homework today.
examples.zh: 老師希望所有學生今天繳交作業。

examples.en: The historical textbook covers the causes of the devastating regional war.
examples.zh: 這本歷史教科書涵蓋了那場具破壞性的區域戰爭的原因。

examples.en: Peace negotiations were held to finally end the prolonged painful war.
examples.zh: 舉行和平談判以最終結束這場長期的痛苦戰爭。

examples.en: Museums display old photos and maps from the war.
examples.zh: 博物館展出了戰爭期間的老照片與地圖。

examples.en: Put on a warm coat before going out into the cold.
examples.zh: 在走進寒冷戶外前穿上一件溫暖的大衣。

examples.en: The friendly host gave us a warm welcome at the door.
examples.zh: 友善的主人在門口熱情地歡迎我們。

examples.en: I love drinking a cup of warm milk before going to bed.
examples.zh: 我喜歡睡前喝一杯溫牛奶。

examples.en: Sit by the cozy fireplace to warm your frozen hands.
examples.zh: 坐在舒適的壁爐旁暖暖你凍僵的雙手。

examples.en: She warmed up the cold leftover soup in the microwave.
examples.zh: 她在微波爐裡加熱冷掉的剩湯。

examples.en: The bright sunshine slowly warmed the chilly room this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上明亮的陽光慢慢照暖了寒冷的房間。

examples.en: Please wash your hands carefully with soap before meals.
examples.zh: 用餐前請務必用肥皂仔細洗手。

examples.en: He washed his dirty bicycle in the garden yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天在花園裡清洗了他的髒腳踏車。

examples.en: She washes her clothes at the laundry every weekend.
examples.zh: 她每個週末都會在洗衣店洗衣服。

examples.en: Give the fresh vegetables a thorough wash before cooking.
examples.zh: 烹飪前將新鮮蔬菜徹底清洗一次。

examples.en: The car needs a good wash after the long road trip.
examples.zh: 經過長途公路旅行後，這輛車需要好好洗一洗。

examples.en: She put the dirty sheets in the wash after breakfast.
examples.zh: 她吃完早餐後，把髒床單放進待洗衣物裡。

examples.en: Do not waste water while brushing your teeth every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上刷牙時不要浪費水。

examples.en: It is a pity to waste such a good opportunity.
examples.zh: 浪費這麼好的機會真可惜。

examples.en: We should not waste time watching boring television programs.
examples.zh: 我們不應該把時間浪費在看無聊的電視節目上。

examples.en: Leaving the lights on all day is a terrible waste.
examples.zh: 整天開著燈是一種可怕的浪費。

examples.en: Factory waste must be treated properly before entering the river.
examples.zh: 工廠廢棄物在排入河流前必須經過妥善處理。

examples.en: Recycling helps reduce the amount of household waste generated daily.
examples.zh: 資源回收有助於減少每天產生的家庭垃圾量。

examples.en: They converted the waste land into a beautiful community garden.
examples.zh: 他們把荒廢的土地改造成美麗的社區花園。

examples.en: The city built a system to deal with waste water safely.
examples.zh: 這座城市建立了一個安全處理廢水的系統。

examples.en: Old newspapers and waste paper should be recycled regularly.
examples.zh: 舊報紙和廢紙應該定期回收。

examples.en: We sat together on the sofa to watch an exciting film.
examples.zh: 我們一起坐在沙發上看一部刺激的影片。

examples.en: Please watch your step when walking down the wet stairs.
examples.zh: 走下潮濕的樓梯時請注意腳步。

examples.en: Could you watch my bags for a few minutes?
examples.zh: 你能幫我看守幾分鐘包包嗎？

examples.en: He checked his watch to see if he was late.
examples.zh: 他看了一下手錶確認自己是否遲到。

examples.en: My grandmother gave me a beautiful classic wrist watch.
examples.zh: 我祖母給了我一隻美麗的經典手錶。

examples.en: The security guard kept a night watch over the building.
examples.zh: 保全對這棟建築物進行夜間看守。

examples.en: Drinking plenty of fresh clean water is key to health.
examples.zh: 飲用大量新鮮乾淨的水是健康的關鍵。

examples.en: The crystal clear water in the mountain stream was cold.
examples.zh: 山間小溪裡清澈見底的水非常冰涼。

examples.en: Please hand me a glass of tap water with lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐時請遞給我一杯自來水。

examples.en: She waters her potted indoor plants twice a week.
examples.zh: 她每週給室內盆栽植物澆水兩次。

examples.en: Farmers water their crops early in the morning during summer.
examples.zh: 農夫們在夏天大清早給莊稼澆水。

examples.en: The gardener watered the dry lawn to keep it green.
examples.zh: 園丁給乾燥的草坪澆水以保持其綠意。

examples.en: Eating sweet watermelon is the best way to cool down in summer.
examples.zh: 在夏天吃甜西瓜是消暑的最佳方法。

examples.en: My father bought a huge watermelon from the local traditional market.
examples.zh: 我父親從當地的傳統市場買了一顆巨大的西瓜。

examples.en: We sliced the red watermelon and shared it with our neighbors.
examples.zh: 我們切開紅西瓜並與鄰居分享。

examples.en: She stood at the station platform to wave goodbye to friends.
examples.zh: 她站在車站月台上向朋友揮手告別。

examples.en: The friendly police officer began to wave to the excited children.
examples.zh: 親切的警官開始向興奮的孩子們揮手。

examples.en: Fans continue to wave colorful banners to support their sports team.
examples.zh: 球迷們繼續揮舞著色彩繽紛的橫幅來支持他們的運動隊伍。

examples.en: A large ocean wave washed over the quiet sandy beach coast.
examples.zh: 一陣巨大的海浪沖過了平靜的沙灘海岸。

examples.en: Surfers waited patiently for the next big wave.
examples.zh: 衝浪者耐心地等待下一個大浪。

examples.en: A heat wave hit the city, and temperatures rose above thirty-eight degrees.
examples.zh: 熱浪襲擊這座城市，氣溫升到攝氏三十八度以上。

examples.en: Could you please show me the way to the station?
examples.zh: 能否請你告訴我前往火車站的路？

examples.en: There are many different ways to solve this difficult problem.
examples.zh: 有許多不同的方法可以解決這個困難的問題。

examples.en: They walked a long way back home in the snow.
examples.zh: 他們在雪中走了很長一段路回家。

examples.en: The cost of the car was way beyond our budget.
examples.zh: 這輛汽車的費用遠遠超出我們的預算。

examples.en: She arrived way before the concert performance actually started tonight.
examples.zh: 她今晚在演唱會演出實際開始前很久就到了。

examples.en: The new house is way larger than their previous apartment.
examples.zh: 這棟新房子比他們之前的公寓大得多。

examples.en: The patient felt too weak to get out of bed.
examples.zh: 病人感到太虛弱而無法下床。

examples.en: The old bridge is too weak to hold heavy trucks.
examples.zh: 這座老橋不夠堅固，承受不了重型卡車。

examples.en: He gave a weak excuse for being late today.
examples.zh: 他為今天遲到找了一個站不住腳的藉口。

examples.en: Students must wear a uniform when attending school every day.
examples.zh: 學生每天上學時必須穿著校服。

examples.en: She likes to wear glasses when reading thick story books.
examples.zh: 她讀厚故事書時喜歡戴眼鏡。

examples.en: He was wearing a dark jacket when I saw him.
examples.zh: 我看到他時，他穿著一件深色夾克。

examples.en: We stayed indoors all afternoon due to the bad weather.
examples.zh: 由於惡劣的天氣，我們整個下午都待在室內。

examples.en: The warm weather brought many visitors to the beach today.
examples.zh: 溫暖的天氣今天吸引了許多遊客來到海灘。

examples.en: You should check the weather forecast before going on a trip.
examples.zh: 去旅行前你應該先看天氣預報。

examples.en: They invited over one hundred guests to their wedding.
examples.zh: 他們邀請了一百多位賓客參加他們的婚禮。

examples.en: The bride wore a beautiful white dress at the wedding.
examples.zh: 新娘在婚禮上穿了一件美麗的白色婚紗。

examples.en: My sister is busy planning her outdoor wedding next month.
examples.zh: 我姊姊正忙著籌備下個月的戶外婚禮。

examples.en: I have a busy schedule planned for the upcoming week at work.
examples.zh: 我為即將到來的一週制定了忙碌的工作計劃。

examples.en: There are seven days in a week, from Monday to Sunday.
examples.zh: 一週有七天，從星期一到星期日。

examples.en: We stayed at a cozy seaside hotel for one relaxing week during summer.
examples.zh: 夏天時，我們在舒適的海濱飯店度過了一週放鬆的時光。

examples.en: The museum is open on every weekday except Mondays.
examples.zh: 除了星期一之外，這間博物館平日都有開放。

examples.en: Traffic is usually very heavy on weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 平日早上的交通通常非常繁忙。

examples.en: I try to go to bed early on a normal weekday night.
examples.zh: 在一般的平日晚上，我都盡量早點上床睡覺。

examples.en: We are going to visit our grandparents this coming weekend.
examples.zh: 我們這個週末打算去拜訪祖父母。

examples.en: What do you usually like to do on the weekend?
examples.zh: 你週末通常喜歡做些什麼？

examples.en: They spent a relaxing weekend at a quiet mountain resort.
examples.zh: 他們在一家幽靜的山區渡假村度過了一個放鬆的週末。

examples.en: She has put on some weight since she started working from home.
examples.zh: 自從開始在家工作後，她的體重增加了一些。

examples.en: The weight of the boxes made them difficult to move.
examples.zh: 這些箱子的重量讓它們很難搬動。

examples.en: His encouraging words lifted a huge weight off my shoulders.
examples.zh: 他鼓勵的話語減輕了我肩上的巨大負擔。

examples.en: The fishing line was weighted with a piece of lead.
examples.zh: 釣魚線被一塊鉛給加重了。

examples.en: Teachers weight final exam scores heavily in overall semester grades.
examples.zh: 老師們在學期總成績中大幅加重期末考的比重。

examples.en: The curtains are weighted at the bottom so they hang straight.
examples.zh: 窗簾底部加了重物，所以能垂得很直。

examples.en: All new students are welcome to join our school music band.
examples.zh: 歡迎所有新同學加入我們學校的樂團。

examples.en: New ideas are always welcome in our team.
examples.zh: 我們團隊總是歡迎新的想法。

examples.en: Visitors are welcome to take photos inside the public art museum.
examples.zh: 歡迎訪客在公共美術館內拍照。

examples.en: The principal stepped forward to welcome the foreign exchange students yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 校長昨天早上上前歡迎外國交換學生。

examples.en: We always welcome guests with warm smiles and delicious hot tea.
examples.zh: 我們總是用溫暖的微笑和美味的熱茶歡迎客人。

examples.en: The host warmly welcomed the international visitors to the annual technology conference.
examples.zh: 主持人熱烈歡迎國際訪客參加一年一度的科技會議。

examples.en: The local people gave the famous singer a warm and loud welcome.
examples.zh: 當地民眾給予這位知名歌手熱情響亮的歡迎。

examples.en: We received a cheerful welcome upon arriving at the mountain resort hotel.
examples.zh: 我們一到達山區渡假飯店就受到了歡快的接待。

examples.en: The traditional welcome party was organized by the senior university students.
examples.zh: 傳統的歡迎派對是由大學高年級學生組織的。

examples.en: She speaks English very well after living abroad.
examples.zh: 在國外生活後，她的英文說得很好。

examples.en: He did well on his final math exam yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天的數學期末考考得很好。

examples.en: The newly prepared dish was cooked very well.
examples.zh: 這道新準備的菜餚烹調得非常好。

examples.en: I do not feel well today, so I stayed home.
examples.zh: 我今天感覺身體不太舒服，所以待在家。

examples.en: She was completely well after a good rest.
examples.zh: 休息過後她完全恢復了健康。

examples.en: Are you well enough to go back to work?
examples.zh: 你健康狀況好到可以回去工作了嗎？

examples.en: Villagers drew fresh water from the deep well.
examples.zh: 村民們從深井裡打新鮮的水。

examples.en: They dug a new well near the farm field.
examples.zh: 他們在農田附近挖了一口新水井。

examples.en: The dry well could no longer provide clean water.
examples.zh: 乾涸的水井不再能提供乾淨的水。

examples.en: The sun sets in the west every evening without fail.
examples.zh: 太陽每天晚上必定從西方落下。

examples.en: They spent a month traveling across the American West.
examples.zh: 他們花了一個月橫越美國西部。

examples.en: Cultural differences exist between the East and the West.
examples.zh: 東方和西方之間存在著文化差異。

examples.en: They live on the west coast of the island near the sea.
examples.zh: 他們住在這座島嶼靠海的西海岸。

examples.en: A strong west wind blew across the island.
examples.zh: 強勁的西風吹過這座島嶼。

examples.en: We entered the building through the west gate.
examples.zh: 我們從西門進入了大樓。

examples.en: Drive west for two kilometers until you see the station.
examples.zh: 向西開車兩公里，直到你看見車站。

examples.en: The birds flew west as winter approached rapidly.
examples.zh: 隨著冬天迅速臨近，鳥兒向西飛去。

examples.en: Head west on Main Street to reach the museum.
examples.zh: 在主街上向西走即可抵達博物館。

examples.en: They enjoy eating Western food such as pasta and pizza.
examples.zh: 他們喜歡吃義大利麵與披薩等西方美食。

examples.en: The western region of the island is famous for beaches.
examples.zh: 該島嶼的西部地區以海灘聞名。

examples.en: He studies Western art history at university this semester.
examples.zh: 這學期他在大學修習西方藝術史。

examples.en: Don't walk on the floor, it is still wet.
examples.zh: 不要走在地板上，它還是濕的。

examples.en: My clothes got completely wet in the sudden rainstorm.
examples.zh: 我的衣服在突如其來的暴風雨中全濕透了。

examples.en: She wiped the kitchen table with a wet towel.
examples.zh: 她用濕毛巾擦拭廚房桌子。

examples.en: Remember to wet the sponge before cleaning the sink.
examples.zh: 清潔水槽前記得先弄濕海綿。

examples.en: The rain wet my shoes as I walked home.
examples.zh: 我走路回家時雨水弄濕了我的鞋子。

examples.en: He wet his lips before he began his speech.
examples.zh: 他在演講前濕潤了一下嘴唇。

examples.en: A giant blue whale swam gracefully in the deep ocean.
examples.zh: 一隻巨型藍鯨在深海中優雅地游泳。

examples.en: Tourists went on a boat trip to watch whales yesterday.
examples.zh: 遊客們昨天搭船去觀賞鯨魚。

examples.en: The whale came up to the surface to breathe air.
examples.zh: 這隻鯨魚浮出水面呼吸空氣。

examples.en: What did you buy at the supermarket earlier this morning?
examples.zh: 你今天早上稍早時在超級市場買了什麼？

examples.en: I do not understand what you are trying to say now.
examples.zh: 我不明白你現在想表達什麼。

examples.en: Do you know what time the next train will arrive here?
examples.zh: 你知道下一班火車什麼時候會抵達這裡嗎？

examples.en: What color do you like best for your bedroom walls?
examples.zh: 你最喜歡臥室牆壁漆成什麼顏色？

examples.en: What kind of music do you usually listen to on weekends?
examples.zh: 你週末通常聽什麼類型的音樂？

examples.en: What size shoes does your little brother wear now?
examples.zh: 你弟弟現在穿幾號的鞋子？

examples.en: You can order whatever you want from the lunch menu today.
examples.zh: 今天你可以從午餐菜單中點任何你想要的餐點。

examples.en: Do whatever is necessary to complete the group assignment on time.
examples.zh: 做任何必要的事，按時完成小組作業。

examples.en: Whatever happens during the competition, we will still be proud.
examples.zh: 無論比賽期間發生什麼事，我們仍然會感到自豪。

examples.en: Take whatever time you need to make the right career decision.
examples.zh: 花費任何你需要的時間來做正確的職業決定。

examples.en: She promised to offer whatever help she could to her friend.
examples.zh: 她承諾會向她的朋友提供任何她能提供的幫助。

examples.en: You may choose whatever book interests you from the bookshelf.
examples.zh: 你可以從書架上選擇任何你感興趣的書。

examples.en: One of the bicycle wheels needs to be filled with air.
examples.zh: 其中一個腳踏車輪子需要打氣。

examples.en: Keep both hands on the steering wheel while you are driving.
examples.zh: 開車時請把雙手放在方向盤上。

examples.en: The wooden wheel on the ancient cart broke during the trip.
examples.zh: 古老手推車上的木頭輪子在旅途中壞掉了。

examples.en: When will the next train to Taipei arrive at this platform?
examples.zh: 下一班開往台北的列車什麼時候會到達這個月台？

examples.en: Do you know when the famous department store opens in the morning?
examples.zh: 你知道那家著名的百貨公司早上幾點開門嗎？

examples.en: When did you first learn how to ride a bicycle by yourself?
examples.zh: 你第一次學會自己騎腳踏車是什麼時候？

examples.en: Please turn off all the lights when you leave the office room.
examples.zh: 離開辦公室時，請關閉所有燈光。

examples.en: I was walking in the park when it suddenly started to rain heavily.
examples.zh: 我正在公園散步時，突然下起了大雨。

examples.en: Call me when you arrive safely at the hotel tonight.
examples.zh: 你今晚平安抵達飯店時，請給我打個電話。

examples.en: Where did you put the car keys after returning home this afternoon?
examples.zh: 今天下午回家後你把車鑰匙放在哪裡了？

examples.en: Do you know where the nearest convenience store is located around here?
examples.zh: 你知道這附近最近的便利商店在哪裡嗎？

examples.en: Where are you planning to go for your summer family vacation this year?
examples.zh: 你今年夏天的家庭度假計劃去哪裡？

examples.en: Sit where you can see the blackboard clearly.
examples.zh: 請坐在能清楚看到黑板的地方。

examples.en: This is the quiet park where I used to play during my childhood.
examples.zh: 這是我童年時期常常玩的寧靜公園。

examples.en: Please put the milk back where you found it.
examples.zh: 請把牛奶放回你拿的地方。

examples.en: I am not sure whether it will rain later this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我不確定今天下午晚些時候是否會下雨。

examples.en: Please let us know whether you can attend the party tonight.
examples.zh: 請讓我們知道你今晚是否能參加派對。

examples.en: We will hold the picnic whether the weather is sunny or cloudy.
examples.zh: 無論天氣晴朗還是多雲，我們都會舉辦野餐。

examples.en: Which of these two books would you prefer to read first?
examples.zh: 這兩本書中，你比較想先讀哪一本？

examples.en: Which is the fastest way to get to the train station?
examples.zh: 去火車站最快的方式是哪一個？

examples.en: She could not decide which of the dresses looked better on her.
examples.zh: 她無法決定哪一件洋裝穿在她身上好看。

examples.en: Which sweater do you want to buy for your sister's birthday?
examples.zh: 你想買哪一件毛衣作為你妹妹的生日禮物？

examples.en: Which bus should we take to go to the night market?
examples.zh: 我們應該搭乘哪一班公車去夜市？

examples.en: Do you know which movie is playing in the theater tonight?
examples.zh: 你知道今晚電影院正在上映哪一部電影嗎？

examples.en: I listened to music while I was cleaning my bedroom.
examples.zh: 我在打掃房間時聽音樂。

examples.en: He likes action movies while his sister prefers romantic comedies.
examples.zh: 他喜歡動作片，而他妹妹則偏好浪漫喜劇。

examples.en: While the test was difficult, all students passed it successfully.
examples.zh: 雖然考試很難，但所有學生都順利通過了。

examples.en: We rested for a while before continuing our mountain hike.
examples.zh: 在繼續我們的登山步道之前，我們休息了一會兒。

examples.en: It took a long while for the train to arrive.
examples.zh: 火車過了很久才到達。

examples.en: She has been living in Taipei for quite a while.
examples.zh: 她在台北已經住了好一段時間了。

examples.en: She wore a clean white shirt to her job interview.
examples.zh: 她穿著乾淨的白色襯衫去參加求職面試。

examples.en: The mountains were covered with white snow in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天時，山脈被白雪覆蓋。

examples.en: He prefers white bread over whole wheat bread for breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐時，比起全麥麵包，他更喜歡白麵包。

examples.en: White is often associated with peace and simplicity.
examples.zh: 白色常讓人聯想到和平與簡樸。

examples.en: Doctors and nurses usually wear white in the hospital.
examples.zh: 醫生和護士在醫院裡通常穿白衣。

examples.en: She painted the walls of her living room in white.
examples.zh: 她把客廳的牆壁漆成了白色。

examples.en: Who is coming to the dinner party tonight with you?
examples.zh: 今晚誰要跟你一起來參加晚宴？

examples.en: I know a friendly girl who speaks three different languages.
examples.zh: 我認識一個能說三種不同語言的友善女孩。

examples.en: Do you know who left this blue umbrella on the seat?
examples.zh: 你知道誰把這把藍色雨傘留在座位上嗎？

examples.en: The whole family went on a trip to Japan together.
examples.zh: 全家人一起去日本旅行。

examples.en: I spent the whole morning cleaning up my messy room.
examples.zh: 我花了整個上午清理我凌亂的房間。

examples.en: He ate the whole pizza by himself because he was hungry.
examples.zh: 因為他很餓，他自己一個人吃掉了整份披薩。

examples.en: The town was affected as a whole by the flood.
examples.zh: 整個城鎮做為一個整體都受到了洪水的影響。

examples.en: On the whole, the trip was a pleasant experience for everyone.
examples.zh: 整體而言，這趟旅行對每個人來說都是愉快的經驗。

examples.en: Each part of the engine is essential to the whole.
examples.zh: 引擎的每個零件對整體來說都是不可或缺的。

examples.en: To whom should I address this formal business letter?
examples.zh: 我這封正式商業信函應該寄給誰？

examples.en: The manager with whom I spoke was very helpful today.
examples.zh: 今天與我交談的那位經理非常熱心。

examples.en: Whom did you invite to your birthday party this weekend?
examples.zh: 你這個週末邀請了誰來參加你的生日派對？

examples.en: Whose is this water bottle on the desk?
examples.zh: 桌上這個水瓶是誰的？

examples.en: This umbrella isn't mine. Whose is it?
examples.zh: 這把傘不是我的，那是誰的？

examples.en: I found a wallet, but I don't know whose it is.
examples.zh: 我撿到一個皮夾，但不知道是誰的。

examples.en: He is the boy whose dog won the contest.
examples.zh: 他就是那個狗贏得比賽的男孩。

examples.en: We met a writer whose books sold millions of copies.
examples.zh: 我們遇到了一位書籍售出數百萬冊的作家。

examples.en: I have a friend whose father is a famous chef.
examples.zh: 我有一個朋友，他的父親是知名的主廚。

examples.en: Can you explain why you were absent from school yesterday morning?
examples.zh: 你能解釋一下你昨天早上為什麼沒來學校嗎？

examples.en: I do not know why the computer stopped working all of a sudden.
examples.zh: 我不知道為什麼電腦突然停止運作了。

examples.en: Why did she decide to leave the party without saying goodbye?
examples.zh: 為什麼她決定不道別就離開派對？

examples.en: That is why our team lost the final basketball game.
examples.zh: 那就是我們隊伍輸掉籃球決賽的原因。

examples.en: Understanding why people make mistakes helps us learn and grow better.
examples.zh: 理解人們為什麼會犯錯有助於我們更好地學習與成長。

examples.en: Please tell me the exact reason why you chose this difficult major.
examples.zh: 請告訴我你選擇這個困難科系的確切原因。

examples.en: The river is very wide and hard to cross safely.
examples.zh: 這條河流非常寬廣，很難安全渡過。

examples.en: She opened her eyes wide in complete surprise and amazement.
examples.zh: 她驚喜且驚訝地睜大眼睛。

examples.en: The online store offers a wide selection of clothing items.
examples.zh: 這家線上商店提供廣泛的服飾商品選擇。

examples.en: Measure the width of the wooden door frame before buying the curtain.
examples.zh: 購買窗簾前請先測量木門框的寬度。

examples.en: The road narrows to the width of a single small car.
examples.zh: 這條道路縮窄至僅有一輛小轎車的寬度。

examples.en: The swimming pool has a width of twenty meters and a depth of two meters.
examples.zh: 這座游泳池寬二十公尺、深二公尺。

examples.en: He bought a bouquet of red roses for his wife.
examples.zh: 他買了一束紅玫瑰給妻子。

examples.en: My wife and I love cycling along the riverside park.
examples.zh: 我和我妻子喜歡沿著河濱公園騎自行車。

examples.en: She is a devoted wife and a loving mother.
examples.zh: 她是一位全心全意的妻子，也是慈愛的母親。

examples.en: We saw many wild animals during our trip to the national park.
examples.zh: 我們在國家公園之旅中看到了許多野生動物。

examples.en: The crowd went wild when the team scored the winning goal.
examples.zh: 當球隊拿下致勝分時，群眾變得非常瘋狂。

examples.en: Strong winds caused wild waves along the rocky coast yesterday.
examples.zh: 強風昨天在多岩石的海岸邊引發了狂暴的浪潮。

examples.en: Our company will launch a new product next spring season.
examples.zh: 我們公司將在明年春季推出一款新產品。

examples.en: I will help you with your homework after dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚晚餐後我會協助你做功課。

examples.en: She will call you as soon as she arrives at the hotel.
examples.zh: 她一到達飯店就會打電話給你。

examples.en: He showed a strong will to recover from the serious illness.
examples.zh: 他展現出從重病中康復的強烈意志。

examples.en: The grandfather left his entire fortune to his family in his will.
examples.zh: 祖父在他的遺囑中把全部財產留給了他的家人。

examples.en: Where there is a will, there is a way.
examples.zh: 有志者事竟成。

examples.en: He is willing to help us move this weekend.
examples.zh: 他樂意在這個週末幫我們搬家。

examples.en: Are you willing to try new food during the trip?
examples.zh: 你願意在旅行期間嘗試新食物嗎？

examples.en: She is willing to work extra hours to finish the project.
examples.zh: 她願意加班來完成這個專案。

examples.en: Our team hopes to win the game tonight.
examples.zh: 我們隊伍希望今晚能贏得比賽。

examples.en: She worked hard to win the first prize.
examples.zh: 她努力工作以贏得頭獎。

examples.en: Our class won first place in the singing contest.
examples.zh: 我們班在歌唱比賽中得到第一名。

examples.en: It was an important win for the football team.
examples.zh: 這對足球隊來說是一場重要的勝利。

examples.en: The surprising win raised the morale of all players.
examples.zh: 這場令人驚喜的勝利提升了所有球員的士氣。

examples.en: Their recent win boosted their standing in the league.
examples.zh: 他們最近的勝利提高了他們在聯賽中的排名。

examples.en: A cool wind blew gently through the open window.
examples.zh: 一陣涼風輕輕地吹過打開的窗戶。

examples.en: Strong winds damaged several trees during the storm last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚暴風雨期間，強風損壞了幾棵樹。

examples.en: The wind is blowing hard from the north today.
examples.zh: 今天風從北方吹得很猛烈。

examples.en: The narrow road winds through the green mountains.
examples.zh: 這條狹窄的道路蜿蜒穿過青山。

examples.en: She carefully wound the long string into a tight ball.
examples.zh: 她小心地把長繩纏繞成一個緊實的球。

examples.en: Remember to wind your antique watch before going to bed.
examples.zh: 睡覺前記得給你的古董手錶上發條。

examples.en: She opened the window to let in fresh cool air.
examples.zh: 她打開窗戶讓涼爽的新鮮空氣進來。

examples.en: Please close the application window on your computer screen.
examples.zh: 請關閉電腦螢幕上的應用程式視窗。

examples.en: Raindrops were falling softly against the bedroom glass window.
examples.zh: 雨滴輕柔地落在臥室玻璃窗上。

examples.en: It was so windy today that my hat blew away.
examples.zh: 今天風太大了，以至於我的帽子被吹走了。

examples.en: They had a picnic on a windy hill near the sea.
examples.zh: 他們在海邊一座多風的山丘上野餐。

examples.en: Dress warmly because it is going to be cold and windy.
examples.zh: 穿暖一點，因為天氣將會又冷又風大。

examples.en: They shared a bottle of red wine at the dinner party.
examples.zh: 他們在晚餐派對上共享了一瓶紅葡萄酒。

examples.en: France is famous for producing high-quality wine.
examples.zh: 法國以生產高品質的葡萄酒而聞名。

examples.en: The waiter filled her glass with chilled white wine.
examples.zh: 服務生將她的玻璃杯倒滿了冰鎮白葡萄酒。

examples.en: The injured bird could not fly because of its broken wing.
examples.zh: 這隻受傷的鳥因為折斷的翅膀而無法飛行。

examples.en: I had a window seat right next to the airplane wing.
examples.zh: 我坐在緊鄰機翼的靠窗座位。

examples.en: Butterflies have colorful wings covered with tiny delicate powder scales.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶擁有覆蓋著細緻鱗粉的彩色翅膀。

examples.en: It is wise to save money for emergency situations.
examples.zh: 為緊急狀況存錢是明智的。

examples.en: The wise old judge listened carefully to both sides.
examples.zh: 那位聰慧的老法官仔細聆聽了雙方的說詞。

examples.en: She gave me some wise advice on career choices.
examples.zh: 她給了我一些關於職涯選擇的明智建議。

examples.en: I wish you good luck on your entrance examination tomorrow.
examples.zh: 祝你明天的入學考試好運。

examples.en: She wishes she could travel around the world someday.
examples.zh: 她希望有一天能環遊世界。

examples.en: If you wish to attend the concert, please buy tickets.
examples.zh: 如果你想參加音樂會，請購買門票。

examples.en: She blew out the birthday candles and made a secret wish.
examples.zh: 她吹熄生日蠟燭並許下了一個祕密願望。

examples.en: Send my best wishes to your family during the holidays.
examples.zh: 在假期期間代我向你的家人表達最良好的祝願。

examples.en: His greatest wish is to pass the English proficiency test.
examples.zh: 他最大的願望是通過英文檢定考試。

examples.en: I love going to the movie theater with my friends.
examples.zh: 我喜歡和朋友一起去電影院。

examples.en: She came to class with a large blue backpack.
examples.zh: 她帶著一個大的藍色背包來上課。

examples.en: You should cut the paper carefully with sharp scissors.
examples.zh: 你應該用鋒利的剪刀小心地剪紙。

examples.en: The library is located within walking distance of our school.
examples.zh: 圖書館位於我們學校步行距離之內。

examples.en: Please complete the registration form within five business days.
examples.zh: 請在五個工作天之內填妥報名表。

examples.en: Please keep this information within the team.
examples.zh: 請將這項資訊保留在團隊內部。

examples.en: He left the house without taking his umbrella.
examples.zh: 他沒拿雨傘就離開了家。

examples.en: It is difficult to survive without clean drinking water.
examples.zh: 沒有乾淨的飲用水很難生存。

examples.en: She solved the entire math puzzle without any help.
examples.zh: 她未經任何幫助就解開了整個數學謎題。

examples.en: A wild gray wolf was seen hunting in the snowy forest.
examples.zh: 有人看到一隻野生灰狼在白雪覆蓋的森林裡獵食。

examples.en: The hungry wolf howled loudly at the bright full moon tonight.
examples.zh: 飢餓的狼今晚對著明亮滿月大聲嚎叫。

examples.en: A pack of wild wolves works together to find food daily.
examples.zh: 一群野狼每天合作尋找食物。

examples.en: The kind woman helped the lost child find his parents.
examples.zh: 這位善良的女人幫助迷路的小孩找到了父母。

examples.en: She is an intelligent woman who manages a large corporate department.
examples.zh: 她是一位管理著大型企業部門的聰慧女性。

examples.en: A young woman sat next to me on the train today.
examples.zh: 今天一位年輕女性在火車上坐在我旁邊。

examples.en: I wonder why the train is running late today.
examples.zh: 我想知道為什麼今天火車晚點了。

examples.en: She wondered if her friends remembered her birthday party.
examples.zh: 她想知道朋友們是否還記得她的生日派對。

examples.en: We all wondered at the magical performance on stage.
examples.zh: 我們都對舞台上的魔術表演感到驚奇。

examples.en: The Grand Canyon is considered a natural wonder of the world.
examples.zh: 大峽谷被認為是世界的自然奇觀。

examples.en: The children looked at the starry sky with great wonder.
examples.zh: 孩子們懷著極大的驚奇看著繁星點點的天空。

examples.en: It is no wonder that he passed the test easily.
examples.zh: 難怪他能輕鬆通過測驗。

examples.en: We had a wonderful time during our summer vacation in Taitung.
examples.zh: 我們在台東的暑假過得非常愉快。

examples.en: The delicious dinner cooked by my mother tasted wonderful.
examples.zh: 媽媽做的美味晚餐嚐起來棒極了。

examples.en: The talented musician gave a wonderful performance on the piano.
examples.zh: 這位有才華的音樂家帶來了精彩的鋼琴演奏。

examples.en: The dining table is made from solid oak wood.
examples.zh: 這張餐桌是由實木橡木製成的。

examples.en: They collected dry wood in the forest to build a campfire.
examples.zh: 他們在森林裡收集乾木頭以建造營火。

examples.en: A narrow path leads through the woods to the lake.
examples.zh: 一條狹窄的小徑穿過樹林通往湖邊。

examples.en: They sit around a sturdy wooden dining table every night.
examples.zh: 他們每天晚上坐在堅固的木製餐桌旁。

examples.en: She bought a carved wooden toy horse at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市場上買了一隻雕刻的木馬玩具。

examples.en: The old cabin was built using heavy wooden logs long ago.
examples.zh: 這間老小屋很久以前是用沉重的木頭圓木建造的。

examples.en: This thick winter sweater is made of pure natural sheep wool.
examples.zh: 這件厚實的冬天毛衣是由純天然羊毛製成。

examples.en: My grandmother knitted a warm scarf using dark blue wool.
examples.zh: 我祖母用深藍色毛線編織了一條溫暖的圍巾。

examples.en: Farmers shear wool from sheep during the early spring season.
examples.zh: 農夫在早春季節從羊身上剪下羊毛。

examples.en: Please look up the definition of this unfamiliar word in your dictionary.
examples.zh: 請在你的字典裡查閱這個陌生單字的定義。

examples.en: Can I have a word with you after class?
examples.zh: 下課後我可以和你談一下嗎？

examples.en: I give you my solemn word that I will keep your secret.
examples.zh: 我向你鄭重保證，我會為你保守祕密。

examples.en: He leaves for work at eight o'clock every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上八點出發去工作。

examples.en: The museum displays famous works of modern art.
examples.zh: 這家博物館展出了著名的現代藝術作品。

examples.en: Finishing this project requires a lot of hard work.
examples.zh: 完成這個計畫需要付出許多努力。

examples.en: She works as a software engineer for a tech company.
examples.zh: 她在一家科技公司擔任軟體工程師。

examples.en: My computer is old and does not work properly.
examples.zh: 我的電腦很舊了，無法正常運作。

examples.en: The aspirin worked quickly to relieve her headache.
examples.zh: 阿斯匹靈迅速起作用減輕了她的頭痛。

examples.en: Please open your math workbook to page twenty.
examples.zh: 請打開你們的數學練習簿到第二十頁。

examples.en: Students must complete the grammar exercises in the workbook.
examples.zh: 學生們必須完成作業本裡的文法練習。

examples.en: He left his English workbook under the desk yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天把英文練習簿忘在課桌下面了。

examples.en: The hardworking worker finished building the wooden fence by noon.
examples.zh: 那位勤奮的工人中午前建好了木籬笆。

examples.en: Every factory worker is required to wear a safety helmet daily.
examples.zh: 每位工廠工人都被要求每天配戴安全帽。

examples.en: An office worker often spends hours working in front of computers.
examples.zh: 辦公室員工經常在電腦前工作數小時。

examples.en: She dreams of traveling all around the world after graduation.
examples.zh: 她夢想著畢業後環遊全世界。

examples.en: Technology has transformed how people connect across the world.
examples.zh: 科技改變了世界各地的人們彼此聯繫的方式。

examples.en: The Amazon rainforest is home to the world's most diverse wildlife.
examples.zh: 亞馬遜雨林是世界上最多樣野生動物的家園。

examples.en: As the saying goes, the early bird catches the worm.
examples.zh: 俗話說，早起的鳥兒有蟲吃。

examples.en: A worm crawled slowly across the wet garden soil.
examples.zh: 一條蟲慢慢爬過潮濕的花園泥土。

examples.en: We used worms as bait when we went fishing.
examples.zh: 我們去釣魚時用蟲當作魚餌。

examples.en: Parents often worry about the safety of their children.
examples.zh: 父母經常擔心孩子的安全。

examples.en: Don't worry about the exam, you prepared well.
examples.zh: 別擔心考試，你準備得很充分。

examples.en: She worries that she might miss the morning bus.
examples.zh: 她擔心自己可能會錯過早班公車。

examples.en: Financial problems are a major worry for many families.
examples.zh: 財務問題是許多家庭的主要煩惱。

examples.en: He expressed his worries about changing his career path.
examples.zh: 他表達了對改變職涯規劃的擔憂。

examples.en: Your kindness took away all my worries about moving.
examples.zh: 你的好意消除了我對搬家的所有擔憂。

examples.en: The weather became worse as the afternoon went on.
examples.zh: 隨著下午時間過去，天氣變得更糟糕。

examples.en: His exam score was worse than he had expected.
examples.zh: 他的考試分數比他預期的還要差。

examples.en: Nothing could be worse than losing your wallet on vacation.
examples.zh: 沒有什麼比在度假時弄丟皮夾更糟的了。

examples.en: The new phone works worse than my old one.
examples.zh: 這支新手機的表現比我的舊手機還差。

examples.en: The students did worse on this test than on the last one.
examples.zh: 學生們這次考試考得比上次還差。

examples.en: If you do not practice, you will play worse next time.
examples.zh: 如果你不練習，下次會發揮得更差。

examples.en: This was the worst thunderstorm the city had seen in years.
examples.zh: 這是這座城市多年來最嚴重的一場雷雨。

examples.en: Friday afternoon is always the worst time to drive downtown.
examples.zh: 星期五下午總是開車進市區最糟的時段。

examples.en: Poor communication was the worst mistake made during the project.
examples.zh: 溝通不良是這個專案期間犯下的最嚴重錯誤。

examples.en: Among all team members, he was the worst affected by illness.
examples.zh: 在所有團隊成員中，他受到疾病影響最為嚴重。

examples.en: She behaved worst when she was extremely tired or hungry.
examples.zh: 當她極度累或餓的時候表現得最差。

examples.en: The area that suffered worst from the storm was rebuilt quickly.
examples.zh: 遭受風暴打擊最嚴重的地區迅速重建了。

examples.en: We should hope for the best but prepare for the worst.
examples.zh: 我們應該抱最好的希望，但做最壞的打算。

examples.en: The worst of the rainstorm is finally over.
examples.zh: 這場暴雨最糟的情況終於結束了。

examples.en: She was ready to face the worst after hearing the news.
examples.zh: 聽到這個消息後，她準備好面對最壞的情況。

senses.zh: 最壞的情況；最差的事物

examples.en: The famous museum is definitely worth visiting while in Paris.
examples.zh: 這座知名博物館在巴黎時絕對值得一訪。

examples.en: This antique gold watch is worth thousands of dollars.
examples.zh: 這支古董金錶價值數千美元。

examples.en: It is worth taking the extra time to double-check.
examples.zh: 多花時間再三檢查是值得的。

examples.en: The storm caused millions of dollars' worth of property damage.
examples.zh: 這場暴風雨造成了價值數百萬美元的財產損失。

examples.en: True friendship is of far greater worth than pure wealth.
examples.zh: 真正的友誼比純粹的財富價值大得多。

examples.en: She bought ten dollars' worth of fresh fruit at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市場買了價值十美元的新鮮水果。

examples.en: The doctor cleaned the deep wound on his knee carefully.
examples.zh: 醫生仔細地清洗了他膝蓋上的深層傷口。

examples.en: It took several weeks for her painful wound to heal completely.
examples.zh: 她疼痛的傷口花了幾個星期的時間才完全癒合。

examples.en: He covered the open wound with a sterile bandage.
examples.zh: 他用無菌繃帶蓋住了開放性傷口。

examples.en: Harsh words can wound a sensitive child's feelings deeply.
examples.zh: 嚴厲的話語可能會深刻地傷害敏感孩子的心靈。

examples.en: Two passengers were slightly wounded in the car accident.
examples.zh: 兩名乘客在車禍中受了輕傷。

examples.en: He was careful not to wound anyone's pride during the debate.
examples.zh: 他在辯論中小心翼翼不傷害任何人的自尊。

examples.en: Please write your full name at the top of the paper.
examples.zh: 請在紙張頂端寫下你的全名。

examples.en: I will write a thank-you letter to my helpful teacher.
examples.zh: 我會寫一封感謝信給幫助我的老師。

examples.en: The famous author plans to write a new novel next year.
examples.zh: 這位著名的作家計劃明年寫一部新小說。

examples.en: The famous writer published a new novel last month.
examples.zh: 這位著名的作家上個月出版了一本新小說。

examples.en: She wants to become a successful travel writer in the future.
examples.zh: 她未來想成為一名成功的旅遊作家。

examples.en: The writer signed autographs for her fans after the speech.
examples.zh: 演講結束後，作者為她的粉絲簽名。

examples.en: He gave the wrong answer to the teacher during class.
examples.zh: 他在上課時給了老師錯誤的答案。

examples.en: There is something wrong with the motor of this washing machine.
examples.zh: 這台洗衣機的馬達出了一些問題。

examples.en: It is wrong to tell lies to your good friends.
examples.zh: 對你的好朋友說謊是不對的。

examples.en: Everything went wrong for him on that unlucky Monday morning.
examples.zh: 在那個不幸的星期一早上，對他來說一切都不順利。

examples.en: You spelled her last name completely wrong on the form.
examples.zh: 你在表格上把她的姓氏完全拼錯了。

examples.en: Don't get me wrong; I really like your idea.
examples.zh: 別誤會，我真的很喜歡你的點子。

examples.en: It is important to know the difference between right and wrong.
examples.zh: 知道對與錯之間的差別很重要。

examples.en: He apologized sincerely for the wrong he had done before.
examples.zh: 他對自己先前所犯的錯誤誠摯道歉。

examples.en: In his mother's eyes, he can do no wrong.
examples.zh: 在他母親眼中，他做什麼都是對的。

examples.en: Children are playing joyfully in the front yard right now.
examples.zh: 孩子們現在正在前院快樂地玩耍。

examples.en: Our family planted beautiful flowers in the yard.
examples.zh: 我們全家在院子裡種了美麗的花。

examples.en: The American football player ran ten yards to score.
examples.zh: 那位美式足球員奔跑了十碼得分。

examples.en: We visit our relatives in Japan once every year.
examples.zh: 我們每年造訪一次在日本的親戚。

examples.en: The new school year starts at the beginning of September.
examples.zh: 新學年於九月初開始。

examples.en: She lived in Paris for a full calendar year.
examples.zh: 她在巴黎住了整整一年。

examples.en: She bought a bright yellow raincoat for rainy school days.
examples.zh: 她買了一件鮮黃色的雨衣供下雨的上學日穿。

examples.en: Yellow sunflower fields stretched as far as the eye can see.
examples.zh: 黃色的向日葵花田延伸至視野所及之處。

examples.en: The traffic light turned yellow as we approached the intersection.
examples.zh: 當我們接近十字路口時，交通號誌變成了黃燈。

examples.en: Yellow is a warm color that creates a happy mood.
examples.zh: 黃色是一種能營造愉快心情的暖色調。

examples.en: Mixing red and green light produces yellow.
examples.zh: 混合紅光與綠光會產生黃色。

examples.en: The autumn leaves changed from dark green to bright yellow.
examples.zh: 秋天的樹葉從深綠色變成了鮮黃色。

examples.en: Yes, I would love to join your birthday party tonight.
examples.zh: 是的，我很樂意參加你今晚的生日派對。

examples.en: Yes, I have finished all my homework.
examples.zh: 是的，我已經寫完所有作業了。

examples.en: Yes, this is the correct address for the new restaurant.
examples.zh: 是的，這就是這家新餐廳的正確地址。

examples.en: I bought a new pair of shoes at the mall yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在購物中心買了一雙新鞋。

examples.en: She visited her grandparents in the countryside yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她昨天下午去鄉下看望了祖父母。

examples.en: The weather was very pleasant and sunny all day yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天的天氣整天都很舒適晴朗。

examples.en: Yesterday was the coldest day of the entire winter season.
examples.zh: 昨天是整個冬季最冷的一天。

examples.en: Forget about yesterday and focus on your goals for today.
examples.zh: 忘掉昨天，專注於你今天的目標。

examples.en: Yesterday's news is no longer interesting to most people.
examples.zh: 昨天的新聞對大多數人來說已經不再有趣。

examples.en: The train has not arrived at the station platform yet.
examples.zh: 火車尚未到達車站月台。

examples.en: Have you finished reading your English textbook assignment yet?
examples.zh: 你已經讀完你的英文教科書作業了嗎？

examples.en: We have not finished the report yet, but the deadline is near.
examples.zh: 我們還沒完成報告，但截止日期快到了。

examples.en: He worked hard, yet he failed to pass the examination.
examples.zh: 他努力工作，然而他未能通過考試。

examples.en: The weather was cold, yet they enjoyed the outdoor hike.
examples.zh: 天氣很冷，然而他們很享受戶外健行。

examples.en: She was tired, yet she stayed up to help.
examples.zh: 她很累，然而她熬夜提供協助。

examples.en: The young tree was planted in the school yard yesterday.
examples.zh: 這棵幼樹昨天被種在學校庭院裡。

examples.en: A young athlete broke the school swimming record this morning.
examples.zh: 一位年輕的運動員今天早上打破了學校的游泳紀錄。

examples.en: She looks much younger than her real age.
examples.zh: 她看起來比她的實際年齡年輕得多。

examples.en: In his youth, he loved to travel around the world.
examples.zh: 在他的青年時期，他熱愛環遊世界。

examples.en: The organization hosts sports events to support local community youth.
examples.zh: 該組織舉辦體育賽事以支持在地社區年輕人。

examples.en: She spent her early youth studying hard at music school.
examples.zh: 她的早期青春歲月是在音樂學校努力學習中度過的。

examples.en: A wild zebra has black and white stripes on its body.
examples.zh: 野生斑馬身上有黑白相間的條紋。

examples.en: We saw a herd of zebras eating grass in Africa.
examples.zh: 我們看到一群斑馬在非洲吃草。

examples.en: The zebra ran quickly across the plain to escape danger.
examples.zh: 斑馬快速奔跑跨越大草原以逃避危險。

examples.en: The temperature dropped below zero during the icy winter night.
examples.zh: 在結冰的冬夜裡，氣溫降到了零度以下。

examples.en: Add another zero to make the total amount ten times.
examples.zh: 再加一個零，讓總金額變成十倍。

examples.en: Our team scored zero points in the first half game.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍在上半場比賽中得零分。

examples.en: There is zero chance that he will change his mind.
examples.zh: 他改變主意的機率是零。

examples.en: The company has zero tolerance for dishonesty in the workplace.
examples.zh: 這間公司對職場上的不誠實行為零容忍。

examples.en: Drivers had zero visibility because of the thick heavy fog.
examples.zh: 由於濃霧，駕駛人的能見度為零。

examples.en: Elementary school students visited the city zoo on a field trip.
examples.zh: 國小學生在戶外教學時參觀了市立動物園。

examples.en: We saw lions, elephants, and monkeys at the Taipei zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在台北動物園看到了獅子、大象和猴子。

examples.en: The zoo works hard to care for injured wild animals.
examples.zh: 動物園努力照料受傷的野生動物。
